/*
WorldLedger Clean Core — Build 10.0A Release Matrix / Regression Gate
Made by: JustSomeBobby + ChatGPT clean-core rebuild assistance

Credit and direct inspiration:
- RPGUI by @RonenNess — state-first RPG/HUD presentation discipline and clean helper separation, reinterpreted for AI Dungeon as text-first state and command readouts. No HTML UI code is used.
- TAS / True Auto Stats by @Yi1i1i — freeform action reading, emergent growth ambition, and structured stats / inventory / abilities, rebuilt as proposal -> validation -> reducer ownership.
- Auto-Cards by @LewdLeah — object permanence, entity detection, Story Card drafting, and memory maintenance ideas, rebuilt so cards are editable canon memory while mechanics remain owner-routed.
- Inner Self by @LewdLeah — segmented long-term NPC memory and major-character persistence, rebuilt as selective reducer-owned memory rather than universal NPC simulation.
- AIDRPG / WorldLedger prior planning and rebuild material — project-specific RPG truth-engine requirements, acceptance failures, and clean-core control rules.

Status: Build 9.13C-R1 / SafeModeController generated-card create-limit patch. Not a final release promotion.
Purpose: preserve Build 9.13C safe-mode/degradation behavior while patching the generated-card create-limit fallback so an explicit safe-mode value of 0 remains 0 instead of falling through to 1. No gameplay authority, parser meaning, reducer ownership, context priority, command behavior, or Story Card mechanics are changed.
This build preserves 9.12C compact command surfaces, 9.12B context priority, 9.12A lore authority plus 9.11C absorption/evolution, 9.11B warfare, 9.11A crafting, 9.10D combat rewards, 9.10C threat tiers, 9.10B matchups, 9.10A combat outcomes, 9.9D ability growth, 9.9C anti-farm budgets, 9.9B stat formulas, 9.9A progression formulas, 9.8C controlled entities, 9.8B summons, 9.8A-a party/followers, 9.7C-a social treatment, 9.7B body formulas, 9.7A race trait candidates, 9.6C domain assets, 9.6B2 economy transactions, 9.6B1 domain projects, and 9.6A contracts/labor.
Warfare records are evidence-bound and remain freeform AI Dungeon play; casualties update force records, but control claims do not automatically grant domain authority, tax income, loot, XP, or law enforcement control.

Project doctrine:
- Input may intend.
- Context may remind.
- Output may propose.
- Parser hits/events are observations.
- Proposals are structured claims.
- CanonValidator decides eligibility.
- ReducerRegistry commits accepted validations through owner reducers.
- OperationLedger dedupes every side effect.
- DirtyQueue marks refresh targets.
- Context reads.
- Cards mirror truth later; raw Story Card prose does not auto-fire mechanics.
- ReleaseCheck must tell the truth.

Hard build law for the clean-core rebuild:
- No hook wrapping.
- No late repair authority.
- No fake green checks.
- No acceptance shrink.
- One active authority per major subsystem.

Maintainer navigation:
- This is still one AI Dungeon Library file. Input/Context/Output tabs should call only WL.onInput, WL.onContext, and WL.onOutput.
- Search tags:
  [WL-BOOT] constants, feature flags, utilities, schema, migrations, state safety
  [WL-RUNTIME] hook routing, source classification, read-only context, command suppression
  [WL-PIPELINE] scanner, proposal builder, validator, reducer registry
  [WL-OWNERS] reducer-owned gameplay systems: inventory, quests, time, world, actors, combat, contracts, labor, domain, economy
  [WL-MIRRORS] context budgeter, world graph, card registry/render/sync
  [WL-COMMANDS] command router and read-only command renderers
  [WL-TESTS] self-tests, source audit, schema audit, acceptance rows
  [WL-EXPORT] final hook binding
- Safe edit map:
  Parser phrasing -> EventScanner only.
  Eligibility and denials -> CanonValidator only.
  State commits -> the matching owner system via ReducerRegistry only.
  Player-facing display -> CommandRenderer, ContextBudgeter/ContextSystem, or CardRenderer only.
  Story Card writes -> CardApiAdapter/CardSync only.
- Debug command index:
  /sourceaudit, /schemaaudit, /runtimecheck, /contextcheck, /cardcheck
  /build100acheck, /releasematrix, /playtestmatrix, /livematrix, /regressionmatrix, /build913ccheck, /safemode, /safe, /degradation, /degradationcheck, /build913bcheck, /cleanup, /cleanupcheck, /quarantine, /quarantinecheck, /longruncheck, /build913acheck, /migration, /migrationcheck, /oldsavecheck, /build912ccheck, /commands, /commandcenter, /commandcheck, /build912bcheck, /contextpriority, /prioritycheck, /build912acheck, /lore, /worldbible, /lorecheck, /build911ccheck, /absorption, /evolution, /evolutioncheck, /build910dcheck, /combatrewards, /rewardcheck, /build910ccheck, /threattiers, /tiers, /tiercheck, /build910bcheck, /matchups, /matchupcheck, /build910acheck, /combatoutcomes, /combatoutcomecheck, /build97bcheck, /bodyformula, /bodycheck, /build97acheck, /racetraits, /racecheck, /build96acheck, /build96b1check, /build96b2check, /build96ccheck

  // 03. [WL-BOOT] Utility helpers

  WL.U = {
    norm: function (value) {
      return String(value == null ? '' : value)
        .replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'")
        .replace(/[\u201C\u201D]/g, '"')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    },
    lower: function (value) { return WL.U.norm(value).toLowerCase(); },
    title: function (value) {
      var raw = WL.U.norm(value).replace(/^the\s+/i, '');
      if (!raw) return '';
      var small = { a: 1, an: 1, and: 1, at: 1, by: 1, for: 1, from: 1, in: 1, of: 1, on: 1, or: 1, the: 1, to: 1, with: 1 };
      var parts = raw.split(/\s+/);
      for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        var w = parts[i].toLowerCase();
        parts[i] = (i > 0 && small[w]) ? w : w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1);
      }
      return parts.join(' ');
    },
    slug: function (value) {
      var s = WL.U.lower(value).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
      return s.slice(0, 80) || 'unknown';
    },
    clamp: function (n, min, max) {
      n = Number(n);
      if (!isFinite(n)) n = min;
      if (n < min) return min;
      if (n > max) return max;
      return n;
    },
    hash: function (value) {
      var s = String(value == null ? '' : value);
      var h = 2166136261;
      for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
        h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
        h += (h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24);
      }
      return ('00000000' + ((h >>> 0).toString(16))).slice(-8);
    },
    clone: function (value) {
      try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)); } catch (e) { return value; }
    },
    capArray: function (arr, max) {
      if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
      while (arr.length > max) arr.shift();
      return arr;
    },
    unique: function (arr) {
      arr = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
      var out = [];
      var seen = {};
      for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
        var value = WL.U.safeString(arr[i]);
        var key = WL.U.slug(value);
        if (!value || seen[key]) continue;
        seen[key] = true;
        out.push(value);
      }
      return out;
    },
    ensureObject: function (parent, key, factory) {
      if (!parent || typeof parent !== 'object') return factory ? factory() : {};
      if (!parent[key] || typeof parent[key] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parent[key])) parent[key] = factory ? factory() : {};
      return parent[key];
    },
    ensureArray: function (parent, key) {
      if (!parent || typeof parent !== 'object') return [];
      if (!Array.isArray(parent[key])) parent[key] = [];
      return parent[key];
    },
    startsCommand: function (text) { return /^\s*\/\w+/.test(String(text || '')); },
    commandName: function (text) {
      var m = String(text || '').match(/^\s*\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
      return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : '';
    },
    commandArgs: function (text) { return String(text || '').replace(/^\s*\/\S+\s*/, '').trim(); },
    safeString: function (value) {
      if (value == null) return '';
      if (typeof value === 'string') return WL.U.norm(value);
      if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') return String(value);
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(function (v) { return WL.U.safeString(v); }).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
      if (typeof value === 'object') {
        if (value.displayName) return WL.U.safeString(value.displayName);
        if (value.name) return WL.U.safeString(value.name);
        if (value.title) return WL.U.safeString(value.title);
        try { return JSON.stringify(value); } catch (e) { return '[object]'; }
      }
      return WL.U.norm(value);
    },
    getGlobalState: function () {
      if (typeof globalThis === 'undefined') return {};
      if (!globalThis.state || typeof globalThis.state !== 'object') globalThis.state = {};
      return globalThis.state;
    },
    getActionCount: function () {
      try {
        if (typeof info === 'object' && info && typeof info.actionCount === 'number') return info.actionCount;
      } catch (e) {}
      return 0;
    },
    getStoryCards: function (stateObj) {
      try { if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards)) return globalThis.storyCards; } catch (e) {}
      try { if (stateObj && Array.isArray(stateObj.storyCards)) return stateObj.storyCards; } catch (e2) {}
      try { if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && globalThis.state && Array.isArray(globalThis.state.storyCards)) return globalThis.state.storyCards; } catch (e3) {}
      return [];
    },
    cardTitle: function (card) { return WL.U.safeString(card && (card.title || card.name || card.keys || card.key || '')); },
    cardBody: function (card) { return WL.U.safeString(card && (card.entry || card.description || card.text || card.body || card.value || '')); },
    splitClauses: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.norm(text);
      if (!t) return [];
      return t.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+|;+/).map(function (s) { return WL.U.norm(s); }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 18);
    }
  };

  // [WL-ORG:BOOT] Migration
  WL.Migration = {
    CURRENT: '9.13C',
    isObject: function (value) { return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value); },
    arrify: function (value) {
      if (value == null) return [];
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      return [value];
    },
    ensureMigrationBucket: function (root) {
      if (!root.migration || typeof root.migration !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.migration)) {
        root.migration = { version: '9.13C', previousSchemaVersion: 0, previousSchemaId: '', previousBuildVersion: '', history: [], preservedNotes: [], legacyAliases: [], cleanupNotes: [], lastResult: '' };
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.history)) root.migration.history = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.preservedNotes)) root.migration.preservedNotes = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.legacyAliases)) root.migration.legacyAliases = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.cleanupNotes)) root.migration.cleanupNotes = [];
      root.migration.version = '9.13C';
      return root.migration;
    },
    fillMissingDefaults: function (target, defaults, depth) {
      if (!WL.Migration.isObject(target) || !WL.Migration.isObject(defaults) || depth < 0) return target;
      Object.keys(defaults).forEach(function (k) {
        if (typeof target[k] === 'undefined' || target[k] === null) target[k] = WL.U.clone(defaults[k]);
        else if (WL.Migration.isObject(target[k]) && WL.Migration.isObject(defaults[k]) && depth > 0) WL.Migration.fillMissingDefaults(target[k], defaults[k], depth - 1);
      });
      return target;
    },
    addUniqueString: function (arr, value, max) {
      if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return false;
      var text = WL.U.safeString(value);
      if (!text) return false;
      var key = WL.U.hash(text);
      for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) if (WL.U.hash(WL.U.safeString(arr[i])) === key) return false;
      arr.push(text);
      WL.U.capArray(arr, max || 40);
      return true;
    },
    preserveNote: function (root, sourceName, value) {
      var mig = WL.Migration.ensureMigrationBucket(root);
      var text = WL.U.safeString(value);
      if (!text) return false;
      if (text.length > 300) text = text.slice(0, 297) + '...';
      var hash = WL.U.hash(sourceName + '|' + text);
      for (var i = 0; i < mig.preservedNotes.length; i++) if (mig.preservedNotes[i] && mig.preservedNotes[i].hash === hash) return false;
      mig.preservedNotes.push({ source: sourceName, text: text, hash: hash });
      WL.U.capArray(mig.preservedNotes, 60);
      if (!root.meta || typeof root.meta !== 'object') root.meta = { initialized: true, lastUpdatedTurn: 0, notes: [], source: 'migration_rebuilt_meta' };
      if (!Array.isArray(root.meta.notes)) root.meta.notes = [];
      WL.Migration.addUniqueString(root.meta.notes, sourceName + ': ' + text, 40);
      return true;
    },
    preserveLegacyNotes: function (root, source) {
      var sources = [
        ['notes', source && source.notes],
        ['meta.notes', source && source.meta && source.meta.notes],
        ['player.notes', source && source.player && source.player.notes],
        ['player.backstoryNotes', source && source.player && source.player.backstoryNotes],
        ['character.notes', source && source.character && source.character.notes],
        ['profile.notes', source && source.profile && source.profile.notes],
        ['worldNotes', source && source.worldNotes],
        ['memory', source && source.memory]
      ];
      var count = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < sources.length; i++) {
        var arr = WL.Migration.arrify(sources[i][1]);
        for (var j = 0; j < arr.length; j++) if (WL.Migration.preserveNote(root, sources[i][0], arr[j])) count++;
      }
      if (count) {
        var mig = WL.Migration.ensureMigrationBucket(root);
        mig.cleanupNotes.push('preserved ' + count + ' legacy user note(s) from old-save fields');
        WL.U.capArray(mig.cleanupNotes, 40);
      }
      return count;
    },
    firstText: function () {
      for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
        var v = WL.U.safeString(arguments[i]);
        if (v) return v;
      }
      return '';
    },
    migrateLegacyAliases: function (root, source) {
      var mig = WL.Migration.ensureMigrationBucket(root);
      source = source || {};
      var profile = source.profile || source.character || source.hero || null;
      if (profile && typeof profile === 'object') {
        if (!root.player || typeof root.player !== 'object') root.player = WL.Schema.root().player;
        var changed = [];
        if ((!root.player.name || root.player.name === 'Unknown') && WL.Migration.firstText(profile.name, profile.characterName, profile.displayName)) { root.player.name = WL.U.title(WL.Migration.firstText(profile.name, profile.characterName, profile.displayName)); changed.push('name'); }
        if ((!root.player.raceSpecies || root.player.raceSpecies === 'unknown') && WL.Migration.firstText(profile.race, profile.species, profile.raceSpecies)) { var race = WL.U.title(WL.Migration.firstText(profile.race, profile.species, profile.raceSpecies)); root.player.raceSpecies = race; root.player.trueRace = race; if (!root.player.currentForm || root.player.currentForm === 'unknown') root.player.currentForm = race; changed.push('race'); }
        if ((!root.player.appearance || root.player.appearance === 'unspecified') && WL.Migration.firstText(profile.appearance, profile.description)) { root.player.appearance = WL.Migration.firstText(profile.appearance, profile.description); changed.push('appearance'); }
        if (!root.player.origin && WL.Migration.firstText(profile.origin, profile.background)) { root.player.origin = WL.Migration.firstText(profile.origin, profile.background); changed.push('origin'); }
        if (changed.length) mig.legacyAliases.push({ kind: 'profile_alias', fields: changed, source: source.profile ? 'profile' : (source.character ? 'character' : 'hero') });
      }
      var stats = source.stats || source.baseStats || (source.player && source.player.stats) || null;
      if (stats && typeof stats === 'object') {
        if (!root.statFormula || typeof root.statFormula !== 'object') root.statFormula = WL.Schema.root().statFormula;
        if (!root.statFormula.baseStats || typeof root.statFormula.baseStats !== 'object') root.statFormula.baseStats = { atk: 10, def: 10, spd: 10, int: 10, lck: 10 };
        var statMap = { atk: ['atk','attack','str','strength'], def: ['def','defense','res','resilience'], spd: ['spd','speed','dex','agility'], int: ['int','intelligence','mind','magic'], lck: ['lck','luck'] };
        var statChanged = [];
        Object.keys(statMap).forEach(function (k) {
          for (var i = 0; i < statMap[k].length; i++) {
            var n = Number(stats[statMap[k][i]]);
            if (isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 9999) { root.statFormula.baseStats[k] = WL.U.clamp(n, 0, 9999); statChanged.push(k); break; }
          }
        });
        if (statChanged.length) mig.legacyAliases.push({ kind: 'stat_alias', fields: WL.U.unique(statChanged), source: 'legacy_structured_stats' });
      }
      var bodySource = source.body || source.bodyState || source.resources || null;
      if (bodySource && typeof bodySource === 'object') {
        if (!root.body || typeof root.body !== 'object') root.body = WL.Schema.root().body;
        var bChanged = [];
        if (isFinite(Number(bodySource.hp))) { root.body.hp = WL.U.clamp(Number(bodySource.hp), 0, 999999); bChanged.push('hp'); }
        if (isFinite(Number(bodySource.maxHp))) { root.body.maxHp = WL.U.clamp(Number(bodySource.maxHp), 1, 999999); bChanged.push('maxHp'); }
        if (isFinite(Number(bodySource.mp))) { root.body.mp = WL.U.clamp(Number(bodySource.mp), 0, 999999); bChanged.push('mp'); }
        if (isFinite(Number(bodySource.maxMp))) { root.body.maxMp = WL.U.clamp(Number(bodySource.maxMp), 0, 999999); bChanged.push('maxMp'); }
        if (isFinite(Number(bodySource.ep))) { root.body.ep = WL.U.clamp(Number(bodySource.ep), 0, 999999); bChanged.push('ep'); }
        if (isFinite(Number(bodySource.maxEp))) { root.body.maxEp = WL.U.clamp(Number(bodySource.maxEp), 0, 999999); bChanged.push('maxEp'); }
        if (bChanged.length) mig.legacyAliases.push({ kind: 'body_resource_alias', fields: WL.U.unique(bChanged), source: 'legacy_structured_body' });
      }
      WL.U.capArray(mig.legacyAliases, 60);
      return mig.legacyAliases.length;
    },
    cleanupLegacyRuntime: function (root, isUpgrade) {
      var mig = WL.Migration.ensureMigrationBucket(root);
      if (!root.runtime || typeof root.runtime !== 'object') root.runtime = WL.Schema.root().runtime;
      root.runtime.currentHook = 'none';
      root.runtime.hookDepth = 0;
      if (isUpgrade && root.runtime.pendingCommandOutput) {
        root.runtime.pendingCommandOutput = '';
        root.runtime.pendingCommandHash = '';
        mig.cleanupNotes.push('cleared stale pending command output during migration');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(root.runtime.hookTrace)) root.runtime.hookTrace = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.runtime.warnings)) root.runtime.warnings = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.runtime.errors)) root.runtime.errors = [];
      WL.U.capArray(root.runtime.hookTrace, WL.Constants.maxHookTrace);
      WL.U.capArray(root.runtime.warnings, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.runtime.errors, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(mig.cleanupNotes, 40);
    },
    recordHistory: function (root, previousVersion, previousSchemaId, previousBuildVersion) {
      var mig = WL.Migration.ensureMigrationBucket(root);
      var entry = { fromVersion: Number(previousVersion || 0), fromSchemaId: WL.U.safeString(previousSchemaId || ''), fromBuildVersion: WL.U.safeString(previousBuildVersion || ''), toVersion: WL.SCHEMA_VERSION, toSchemaId: WL.SCHEMA_ID, migration: WL.Migration.CURRENT };
      var key = WL.U.hash(JSON.stringify(entry));
      for (var i = 0; i < mig.history.length; i++) if (mig.history[i] && mig.history[i].hash === key) return false;
      entry.hash = key;
      mig.history.push(entry);
      WL.U.capArray(mig.history, 30);
      return true;
    },
    migrate: function (root) {
      if (!root || typeof root !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root)) {
        var fresh = WL.Schema.root();
        WL.Migration.ensureMigrationBucket(fresh);
        fresh.migration.lastResult = 'rebuilt_invalid_root';
        fresh.migration.history.push({ fromVersion: 0, fromSchemaId: 'invalid', fromBuildVersion: '', toVersion: WL.SCHEMA_VERSION, toSchemaId: WL.SCHEMA_ID, migration: WL.Migration.CURRENT, hash: 'invalid_root' });
        return fresh;
      }
      var source = WL.U.clone(root);
      var previousVersion = Number(root.schemaVersion || 0);
      var previousSchemaId = WL.U.safeString(root.schemaId || '');
      var previousBuildVersion = WL.U.safeString(root.build && root.build.buildVersion || '');
      WL.Migration.fillMissingDefaults(root, WL.Schema.root(), 3);
      root.schemaVersion = WL.SCHEMA_VERSION;
      root.schemaId = WL.SCHEMA_ID;
      if (!root.features || typeof root.features !== 'object') root.features = WL.Schema.features();
      var defaults = WL.FeatureDefaults;
      Object.keys(defaults).forEach(function (k) { if (typeof root.features[k] === 'undefined') root.features[k] = defaults[k]; });
      var mig = WL.Migration.ensureMigrationBucket(root);
      mig.previousSchemaVersion = previousVersion || 0;
      mig.previousSchemaId = previousSchemaId;
      mig.previousBuildVersion = previousBuildVersion;
      if (previousVersion !== WL.SCHEMA_VERSION || previousSchemaId !== WL.SCHEMA_ID || previousBuildVersion !== WL.BUILD_VERSION) WL.Migration.recordHistory(root, previousVersion, previousSchemaId, previousBuildVersion);
      WL.Migration.preserveLegacyNotes(root, source);
      WL.Migration.migrateLegacyAliases(root, source);
      var isUpgrade = previousVersion !== WL.SCHEMA_VERSION || previousSchemaId !== WL.SCHEMA_ID || previousBuildVersion !== WL.BUILD_VERSION;
      WL.Migration.cleanupLegacyRuntime(root, isUpgrade);
      mig.lastResult = 'migrated_to_' + WL.BUILD_VERSION;
      return root;
    }
  };


  // ============================================================
  // 04B. [WL-BOOT] Long-run cleanup and quarantine

  // ============================================================
  // Owner note: QuarantineSystem records bounded forensic evidence only. It must not block gameplay, grant mechanics, or rewrite canon truth.
  WL.QuarantineSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.quarantine || typeof root.quarantine !== 'object') root.quarantine = { records: [], summary: { total: 0, lastKind: '', lastReason: '' } };
      if (!Array.isArray(root.quarantine.records)) root.quarantine.records = [];
      if (!root.quarantine.summary || typeof root.quarantine.summary !== 'object') root.quarantine.summary = { total: 0, lastKind: '', lastReason: '' };
      return root.quarantine;
    },
    summarizePayload: function (payload) {
      var text = '';
      try { text = JSON.stringify(payload); } catch (e) { text = WL.U.safeString(payload); }
      text = WL.U.safeString(text);
      if (text.length > 300) text = text.slice(0, 297) + '...';
      return text;
    },
    record: function (root, kind, source, payload, reason) {
      var q = WL.QuarantineSystem.ensure(root);
      var rec = {
        turn: root && root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || WL.U.getActionCount(),
        kind: WL.U.safeString(kind || 'unknown'),
        source: WL.U.safeString(source || 'unknown'),
        reason: WL.U.safeString(reason || 'quarantined_for_review'),
        summary: WL.QuarantineSystem.summarizePayload(payload),
        hash: WL.U.hash([kind, source, reason, WL.QuarantineSystem.summarizePayload(payload)].join('|'))
      };
      for (var i = 0; i < q.records.length; i++) if (q.records[i] && q.records[i].hash === rec.hash) return q.records[i];
      q.records.push(rec);
      q.summary.total = (q.summary.total || 0) + 1;
      q.summary.lastKind = rec.kind;
      q.summary.lastReason = rec.reason;
      WL.U.capArray(q.records, 80);
      return rec;
    },
    summaryLines: function (root) {
      var q = WL.QuarantineSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = [];
      lines.push('Quarantine: records ' + q.records.length + ' | total seen ' + (q.summary.total || 0) + ' | last ' + (q.summary.lastKind || 'none'));
      var recent = q.records.slice(-5);
      for (var i = 0; i < recent.length; i++) lines.push('- ' + recent[i].kind + ' from ' + recent[i].source + ': ' + recent[i].reason);
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // Owner note: CleanupManager only trims bounded caches and stale references. It must not parse story text, mutate gameplay ownership, grant rewards, or delete user-facing canon records.
  WL.CleanupManager = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.cleanup || typeof root.cleanup !== 'object') root.cleanup = { version: '9.13B', lastRunTurn: 0, lastRunReason: '', runCount: 0, notes: [], archivedCounts: {}, pressure: {}, lastResult: '' };
      if (!Array.isArray(root.cleanup.notes)) root.cleanup.notes = [];
      if (!root.cleanup.archivedCounts || typeof root.cleanup.archivedCounts !== 'object') root.cleanup.archivedCounts = {};
      if (!root.cleanup.pressure || typeof root.cleanup.pressure !== 'object') root.cleanup.pressure = {};
      root.cleanup.version = '9.13B';
      WL.QuarantineSystem.ensure(root);
      return root.cleanup;
    },
    addCount: function (root, key, n) {
      if (!n) return;
      WL.CleanupManager.ensure(root);
      root.cleanup.archivedCounts[key] = (root.cleanup.archivedCounts[key] || 0) + n;
    },
    capArrayCount: function (root, arr, max, key) {
      if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return 0;
      var before = arr.length;
      WL.U.capArray(arr, max);
      var removed = before - arr.length;
      if (removed > 0) WL.CleanupManager.addCount(root, key, removed);
      return removed;
    },
    keepMapIds: function (root, map, ids, keyName, max) {
      if (!map || typeof map !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(ids)) return 0;
      var beforeIds = ids.length;
      WL.U.capArray(ids, max);
      var keep = {};
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) keep[ids[i]] = true;
      var removed = beforeIds - ids.length;
      var keys = Object.keys(map);
      for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
        if (!keep[keys[k]]) { delete map[keys[k]]; removed++; }
      }
      if (removed > 0) WL.CleanupManager.addCount(root, keyName, removed);
      return removed;
    },
    trimOperationLedger: function (root) {
      if (!root.operationLedger || typeof root.operationLedger !== 'object') root.operationLedger = { recentKeys: [], keysById: {}, duplicateSkips: [] };
      if (!Array.isArray(root.operationLedger.recentKeys)) root.operationLedger.recentKeys = [];
      if (!root.operationLedger.keysById || typeof root.operationLedger.keysById !== 'object') root.operationLedger.keysById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.operationLedger.duplicateSkips)) root.operationLedger.duplicateSkips = [];
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.operationLedger.recentKeys, WL.Constants.maxRecentKeys, 'operation_recent_keys');
      var keep = {};
      for (var i = 0; i < root.operationLedger.recentKeys.length; i++) keep[root.operationLedger.recentKeys[i]] = true;
      var keys = Object.keys(root.operationLedger.keysById);
      var removed = 0;
      for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) if (!keep[keys[k]]) { delete root.operationLedger.keysById[keys[k]]; removed++; }
      if (removed) WL.CleanupManager.addCount(root, 'operation_key_map', removed);
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.operationLedger.duplicateSkips, 80, 'operation_duplicate_skips');
    },
    trimDiagnostics: function (root) {
      if (!root.diagnostics || typeof root.diagnostics !== 'object') root.diagnostics = { audit: [], parser: [], proposals: [], validations: [], reducers: [], sourceAudit: [] };
      ['audit','parser','proposals','validations','reducers','sourceAudit'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(root.diagnostics[k])) root.diagnostics[k] = []; });
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.diagnostics.audit, WL.Constants.maxAuditRows, 'diagnostics_audit');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.diagnostics.parser, WL.Constants.maxParserHits, 'diagnostics_parser');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.diagnostics.proposals, WL.Constants.maxProposals, 'diagnostics_proposals');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.diagnostics.validations, WL.Constants.maxValidations, 'diagnostics_validations');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.diagnostics.reducers, WL.Constants.maxReducerResults, 'diagnostics_reducers');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.diagnostics.sourceAudit, WL.Constants.maxAuditRows, 'diagnostics_source_audit');
    },
    trimCardsAndGraph: function (root) {
      if (!root.cards || typeof root.cards !== 'object') root.cards = { protectedIds: [], generatedIds: [], dirtyIds: [], warnings: [], generatedCapWarnings: [], candidatesById: {}, candidateIds: [], candidateLog: [] };
      if (!root.cards.candidatesById || typeof root.cards.candidatesById !== 'object') root.cards.candidatesById = {};
      ['protectedIds','generatedIds','dirtyIds','warnings','generatedCapWarnings','candidateIds','candidateLog'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(root.cards[k])) root.cards[k] = []; });
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.cards.dirtyIds, 80, 'cards_dirty_ids');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.cards.warnings, 40, 'cards_warnings');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.cards.generatedCapWarnings, 40, 'cards_generated_warnings');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.cards.candidateLog, 120, 'cards_candidate_log');
      WL.CleanupManager.keepMapIds(root, root.cards.candidatesById, root.cards.candidateIds, 'cards_candidates', 160);
      if (!root.worldGraph || typeof root.worldGraph !== 'object') root.worldGraph = { nodesById: {}, nodeIds: [], edges: [], lastRebuildTurn: 0, warnings: [] };
      if (!root.worldGraph.nodesById || typeof root.worldGraph.nodesById !== 'object') root.worldGraph.nodesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.worldGraph.nodeIds)) root.worldGraph.nodeIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.worldGraph.edges)) root.worldGraph.edges = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.worldGraph.warnings)) root.worldGraph.warnings = [];
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.worldGraph.warnings, 40, 'worldgraph_warnings');
      var nodes = root.worldGraph.nodesById || {};
      var filtered = [];
      var orphan = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < root.worldGraph.edges.length; i++) {
        var e = root.worldGraph.edges[i] || {};
        if (e.from && e.to && nodes[e.from] && nodes[e.to]) filtered.push(e);
        else orphan++;
      }
      if (orphan) WL.CleanupManager.addCount(root, 'worldgraph_orphan_edges', orphan);
      root.worldGraph.edges = filtered;
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.worldGraph.edges, 240, 'worldgraph_edges');
    },
    trimSocialQueues: function (root) {
      if (!root.social || typeof root.social !== 'object') return;
      if (root.social.rumors) {
        if (!Array.isArray(root.social.rumors.queue)) root.social.rumors.queue = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(root.social.rumors.recent)) root.social.rumors.recent = [];
        WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.social.rumors.queue, 40, 'rumor_queue');
        WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.social.rumors.recent, 40, 'rumor_recent');
        if (root.social.rumors.rumorsById && Array.isArray(root.social.rumors.rumorIds)) WL.CleanupManager.keepMapIds(root, root.social.rumors.rumorsById, root.social.rumors.rumorIds, 'rumor_records', 100);
      }
      if (root.social.knowledge) {
        if (!Array.isArray(root.social.knowledge.recent)) root.social.knowledge.recent = [];
        WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.social.knowledge.recent, 40, 'knowledge_recent');
      }
      if (Array.isArray(root.social.recent)) WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.social.recent, 80, 'social_recent');
    },
    trimPendingRuntime: function (root) {
      if (!root.pending || typeof root.pending !== 'object') root.pending = { lastParserHits: [], lastProposals: [], lastValidations: [], lastReducerResults: [], lastPipeline: null };
      ['lastParserHits','lastProposals','lastValidations','lastReducerResults'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(root.pending[k])) root.pending[k] = []; });
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.pending.lastParserHits, WL.Constants.maxParserHits, 'pending_parser_hits');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.pending.lastProposals, WL.Constants.maxProposals, 'pending_proposals');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.pending.lastValidations, WL.Constants.maxValidations, 'pending_validations');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.pending.lastReducerResults, WL.Constants.maxReducerResults, 'pending_reducers');
      if (!root.runtime || typeof root.runtime !== 'object') root.runtime = WL.Schema.root().runtime;
      if (!Array.isArray(root.runtime.warnings)) root.runtime.warnings = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.runtime.errors)) root.runtime.errors = [];
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.runtime.warnings, 40, 'runtime_warnings');
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.runtime.errors, 40, 'runtime_errors');
      if (Array.isArray(root.runtime.hookTrace)) WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.runtime.hookTrace, WL.Constants.maxHookTrace, 'runtime_hook_trace');
    },
    pressure: function (root) {
      return {
        operationKeys: root.operationLedger && root.operationLedger.recentKeys ? root.operationLedger.recentKeys.length : 0,
        diagnostics: root.diagnostics ? (root.diagnostics.audit || []).length + (root.diagnostics.parser || []).length + (root.diagnostics.proposals || []).length + (root.diagnostics.validations || []).length + (root.diagnostics.reducers || []).length : 0,
        cardCandidates: root.cards && root.cards.candidateIds ? root.cards.candidateIds.length : 0,
        graphNodes: root.worldGraph && root.worldGraph.nodeIds ? root.worldGraph.nodeIds.length : 0,
        graphEdges: root.worldGraph && root.worldGraph.edges ? root.worldGraph.edges.length : 0,
        quarantine: root.quarantine && root.quarantine.records ? root.quarantine.records.length : 0
      };
    },
    run: function (root, reason, force) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.longRunCleanup913BEnabled === false) return { applied: false, reason: 'disabled' };
      var clean = WL.CleanupManager.ensure(root);
      var turn = root.runtime && typeof root.runtime.currentTurn === 'number' && root.runtime.currentTurn > 0 ? root.runtime.currentTurn : WL.U.getActionCount();
      var interval = WL.U.clamp(root.features.cleanupIntervalTurns || 25, 1, 500);
      if (!force && clean.lastRunTurn && turn - clean.lastRunTurn < interval) return { applied: false, reason: 'interval_skip', nextTurn: clean.lastRunTurn + interval };
      var before = WL.CleanupManager.pressure(root);
      WL.CleanupManager.trimOperationLedger(root);
      WL.CleanupManager.trimDiagnostics(root);
      WL.CleanupManager.trimCardsAndGraph(root);
      WL.CleanupManager.trimSocialQueues(root);
      WL.CleanupManager.trimPendingRuntime(root);
      WL.QuarantineSystem.ensure(root);
      WL.CleanupManager.capArrayCount(root, root.quarantine.records, 80, 'quarantine_records');
      var after = WL.CleanupManager.pressure(root);
      clean.lastRunTurn = turn;
      clean.lastRunReason = reason || 'long_run_cleanup';
      clean.runCount = (clean.runCount || 0) + 1;
      clean.pressure = after;
      clean.lastResult = 'cleanup_applied';
      clean.notes.push({ turn: turn, reason: clean.lastRunReason, before: before, after: after, archivedCounts: WL.U.clone(clean.archivedCounts) });
      WL.U.capArray(clean.notes, 40);
      return { applied: true, before: before, after: after };
    },
    summaryLines: function (root) {
      var clean = WL.CleanupManager.ensure(root);
      var p = clean.pressure || WL.CleanupManager.pressure(root);
      return [
        'Cleanup: version ' + clean.version + ' | runs ' + (clean.runCount || 0) + ' | last turn ' + (clean.lastRunTurn || 0) + ' | reason ' + WL.U.safeString(clean.lastRunReason || 'none'),
        'Pressure: ops ' + (p.operationKeys || 0) + ', diagnostics ' + (p.diagnostics || 0) + ', candidates ' + (p.cardCandidates || 0) + ', graph ' + (p.graphNodes || 0) + '/' + (p.graphEdges || 0) + ', quarantine ' + (p.quarantine || 0),
        'Archived counts: ' + (Object.keys(clean.archivedCounts || {}).length ? Object.keys(clean.archivedCounts).map(function (k) { return k + '=' + clean.archivedCounts[k]; }).slice(-8).join(', ') : '(none)')
      ];
    }
  };


  // ============================================================
  // 04C. [WL-BOOT] Safe mode and degradation thresholds

  // ============================================================
  // Owner note: SafeModeController is a protective degradation layer only. It must not parse story text, grant/remove gameplay truth, or replace owner reducers.
  WL.SafeModeController = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.safeModeController || typeof root.safeModeController !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.safeModeController)) {
        root.safeModeController = { version: '9.13C', active: false, level: 'normal', reason: '', activatedTurn: 0, lastEvaluatedTurn: 0, events: [], failureCounts: {}, deferredWork: [], thresholds: {}, lastResult: '' };
      }
      var sm = root.safeModeController;
      if (!Array.isArray(sm.events)) sm.events = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(sm.deferredWork)) sm.deferredWork = [];
      if (!sm.failureCounts || typeof sm.failureCounts !== 'object') sm.failureCounts = {};
      if (!sm.thresholds || typeof sm.thresholds !== 'object') sm.thresholds = {};
      sm.version = '9.13C';
      sm.thresholds.failure = WL.U.clamp(root.features && root.features.safeModeFailureThreshold || 5, 1, 50);
      sm.thresholds.cardWarnings = WL.U.clamp(root.features && root.features.safeModeCardWarningThreshold || 6, 1, 50);
      sm.thresholds.quarantine = WL.U.clamp(root.features && root.features.safeModeQuarantineThreshold || 30, 5, 200);
      sm.thresholds.diagnostics = WL.U.clamp(root.features && root.features.safeModeDiagnosticThreshold || 180, 20, 500);
      sm.thresholds.deferredMax = WL.U.clamp(root.features && root.features.safeModeDeferredWorkMax || 80, 10, 300);
      return sm;
    },
    count: function (root, kind, n) {
      var sm = WL.SafeModeController.ensure(root);
      kind = WL.U.slug(kind || 'unknown');
      sm.failureCounts[kind] = (sm.failureCounts[kind] || 0) + (n || 1);
      return sm.failureCounts[kind];
    },
    record: function (root, kind, source, detail) {
      var sm = WL.SafeModeController.ensure(root);
      kind = WL.U.slug(kind || 'event');
      var rec = { turn: root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || WL.U.getActionCount(), kind: kind, source: WL.U.safeString(source || 'unknown'), detail: WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(detail || '', 180) : WL.U.safeString(detail || '').slice(0, 180) };
      sm.events.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(sm.events, 80);
      WL.SafeModeController.count(root, kind, 1);
      return rec;
    },
    defer: function (root, workKind, target, reason) {
      var sm = WL.SafeModeController.ensure(root);
      var key = WL.U.hash([workKind || '', target || '', reason || ''].join('|'));
      for (var i = 0; i < sm.deferredWork.length; i++) if (sm.deferredWork[i] && sm.deferredWork[i].key === key) return sm.deferredWork[i];
      var rec = { key: key, turn: root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || WL.U.getActionCount(), workKind: WL.U.safeString(workKind || 'optional_work'), target: WL.U.safeString(target || ''), reason: WL.U.safeString(reason || 'safe_mode_deferred') };
      sm.deferredWork.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(sm.deferredWork, sm.thresholds && sm.thresholds.deferredMax || 80);
      return rec;
    },
    pressure: function (root) {
      var diag = 0;
      if (root.diagnostics) ['audit','parser','proposals','validations','reducers','sourceAudit'].forEach(function (k) { if (Array.isArray(root.diagnostics[k])) diag += root.diagnostics[k].length; });
      var cardWarnings = (root.cards && Array.isArray(root.cards.warnings) ? root.cards.warnings.length : 0) + (root.cards && Array.isArray(root.cards.generatedCapWarnings) ? root.cards.generatedCapWarnings.length : 0);
      var runtimeFailures = (root.runtime && Array.isArray(root.runtime.errors) ? root.runtime.errors.length : 0) + (root.runtime && Array.isArray(root.runtime.warnings) ? Math.floor(root.runtime.warnings.length / 2) : 0);
      var quarantine = root.quarantine && Array.isArray(root.quarantine.records) ? root.quarantine.records.length : 0;
      var cleanupPressure = 0;
      try {
        if (WL.CleanupManager && typeof WL.CleanupManager.pressure === 'function') {
          var p = WL.CleanupManager.pressure(root);
          cleanupPressure = Math.floor(((p.operationKeys || 0) + (p.cardCandidates || 0) + (p.graphEdges || 0)) / 200);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return { diagnostics: diag, cardWarnings: cardWarnings, runtimeFailures: runtimeFailures, quarantine: quarantine, cleanupPressure: cleanupPressure };
    },
    shouldActivate: function (root, pressure) {
      var sm = WL.SafeModeController.ensure(root);
      var counts = sm.failureCounts || {};
      var totalFailures = Object.keys(counts).reduce(function (sum, k) { return sum + Number(counts[k] || 0); }, 0);
      if (root.features && root.features.safeMode === true) return { yes: true, reason: 'manual_safe_mode_flag' };
      if (totalFailures >= sm.thresholds.failure) return { yes: true, reason: 'failure_threshold' };
      if (pressure.runtimeFailures >= sm.thresholds.failure) return { yes: true, reason: 'runtime_failure_pressure' };
      if (pressure.cardWarnings >= sm.thresholds.cardWarnings) return { yes: true, reason: 'card_warning_pressure' };
      if (pressure.quarantine >= sm.thresholds.quarantine) return { yes: true, reason: 'quarantine_pressure' };
      if (pressure.diagnostics >= sm.thresholds.diagnostics) return { yes: true, reason: 'diagnostic_pressure' };
      return { yes: false, reason: 'below_threshold' };
    },
    activate: function (root, reason) {
      var sm = WL.SafeModeController.ensure(root);
      sm.active = true;
      sm.level = 'degraded';
      sm.reason = WL.U.safeString(reason || 'safe_mode');
      if (!sm.activatedTurn) sm.activatedTurn = root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || WL.U.getActionCount();
      sm.lastResult = 'active_' + sm.reason;
      if (root.features) {
        root.features.safeMode = true;
        root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn = 0;
        root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn = Math.min(Number(root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn || 0), 1);
      }
      WL.SafeModeController.defer(root, 'generated_card_creation', 'card_candidate_backlog', sm.reason);
      WL.SafeModeController.defer(root, 'optional_context_expansion', 'large_context_surfaces', sm.reason);
      return sm;
    },
    evaluate: function (root, reason) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.safeModeController913CEnabled === false) return { active: false, reason: 'disabled' };
      var sm = WL.SafeModeController.ensure(root);
      var pressure = WL.SafeModeController.pressure(root);
      var decision = WL.SafeModeController.shouldActivate(root, pressure);
      sm.lastEvaluatedTurn = root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || WL.U.getActionCount();
      sm.lastPressure = pressure;
      if (decision.yes && root.features.autoSafeModeEnabled !== false) {
        WL.SafeModeController.record(root, 'safe_mode_activation', reason || 'evaluate', decision.reason);
        WL.SafeModeController.activate(root, decision.reason);
      } else if (!sm.active) {
        sm.level = 'normal';
        sm.reason = '';
        sm.lastResult = 'normal_' + decision.reason;
      }
      WL.U.capArray(sm.deferredWork, sm.thresholds.deferredMax || 80);
      return { active: !!sm.active, reason: sm.reason || decision.reason, pressure: pressure };
    },
    summaryLines: function (root) {
      var sm = WL.SafeModeController.ensure(root);
      var p = sm.lastPressure || WL.SafeModeController.pressure(root);
      return [
        'Safe Mode: ' + (sm.active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'normal') + ' | level ' + (sm.level || 'normal') + ' | reason ' + WL.U.safeString(sm.reason || 'none'),
        'Pressure: runtime ' + (p.runtimeFailures || 0) + ', card warnings ' + (p.cardWarnings || 0) + ', diagnostics ' + (p.diagnostics || 0) + ', quarantine ' + (p.quarantine || 0) + ', cleanup ' + (p.cleanupPressure || 0),
        'Deferred optional work: ' + ((sm.deferredWork || []).length || 0) + ' | events ' + ((sm.events || []).length || 0)
      ];
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // 05. [WL-BOOT] StateManager and quarantine

  // ============================================================

  WL.StateManager = {
    root: function () { return WL.StateManager.init(WL.U.getGlobalState()); },
    init: function (stateObj) {
      var st = stateObj && typeof stateObj === 'object' ? stateObj : WL.U.getGlobalState();
      if (!st[WL.ROOT_KEY] || typeof st[WL.ROOT_KEY] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(st[WL.ROOT_KEY])) {
        st[WL.ROOT_KEY] = WL.Schema.root();
      }
      var root = WL.Migration.migrate(st[WL.ROOT_KEY]);
      WL.StateManager.ensureBuckets(root);
      WL.PlayerProfileSystem.importFromState(root, st);
      if (WL.RaceTraitSystem && typeof WL.RaceTraitSystem.syncFromSetupAndCards === 'function') WL.RaceTraitSystem.syncFromSetupAndCards(root, st);
      if (WL.BodyFormulaSystem && typeof WL.BodyFormulaSystem.syncFromRaceTraits === 'function') WL.BodyFormulaSystem.syncFromRaceTraits(root, 'state_init');
      if (WL.SocialTreatmentSystem && typeof WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.syncFromBodyEvidence === 'function') WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.syncFromBodyEvidence(root, 'state_init');
      root.build.projectName = WL.PROJECT_NAME;
      root.build.buildName = WL.BUILD_NAME;
      root.build.buildVersion = WL.BUILD_VERSION;
      root.build.buildStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE;
      root.build.status = WL.STATUS;
      if (root.features && root.features.livePollutionCleanup93DEnabled !== false && WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D && typeof WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.run === 'function') {
        WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.run(root, st);
      }
      if (root.features && root.features.longRunCleanup913BEnabled !== false && WL.CleanupManager && typeof WL.CleanupManager.run === 'function') WL.CleanupManager.run(root, 'state_init', false);
      if (root.features && root.features.safeModeController913CEnabled !== false && WL.SafeModeController && typeof WL.SafeModeController.evaluate === 'function') WL.SafeModeController.evaluate(root, 'state_init');
      root.meta.lastUpdatedTurn = WL.U.getActionCount();
      st[WL.ROOT_KEY] = root;
      return root;
    },
    ensureBuckets: function (root) {
      var fresh = WL.Schema.root();
      var keys = Object.keys(fresh);
      for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        var k = keys[i];
        if (k === 'schemaVersion' || k === 'schemaId') continue;
        if (!root[k] || typeof root[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root[k]) !== Array.isArray(fresh[k])) {
          root[k] = WL.U.clone(fresh[k]);
        }
      }
      WL.StateManager.enforceInvariants(root);
    },
    enforceInvariants: function (root) {
      root.body.maxHp = WL.U.clamp(root.body.maxHp, 1, 999999);
      root.body.hp = WL.U.clamp(root.body.hp, 0, root.body.maxHp);
      root.body.maxMp = WL.U.clamp(root.body.maxMp, 0, 999999);
      root.body.mp = WL.U.clamp(root.body.mp, 0, root.body.maxMp);
      root.body.maxEp = WL.U.clamp(root.body.maxEp, 0, 999999);
      root.body.ep = WL.U.clamp(root.body.ep, 0, root.body.maxEp);
      if (!root.startup || typeof root.startup !== 'object') root.startup = { profileImported: false, profileSourceHash: '', importedFields: [], rejectedMechanics: [], warnings: [] };
      if (!root.player || typeof root.player !== 'object') root.player = WL.Schema.root().player;
      if (!root.body.bodyTraits || !Array.isArray(root.body.bodyTraits)) root.body.bodyTraits = [];
      if (!root.body.visibleTraits || !Array.isArray(root.body.visibleTraits)) root.body.visibleTraits = [];
      if (!root.body.transformations || !Array.isArray(root.body.transformations)) root.body.transformations = [];
      if (!root.body.formHistory || !Array.isArray(root.body.formHistory)) root.body.formHistory = [];
      if (!root.body.formWarnings || !Array.isArray(root.body.formWarnings)) root.body.formWarnings = [];
      if (!root.body.deathBoundary) root.body.deathBoundary = 'alive';
      if (!root.player.personalityTraits || !Array.isArray(root.player.personalityTraits)) root.player.personalityTraits = [];
      if (!root.player.backstoryNotes || !Array.isArray(root.player.backstoryNotes)) root.player.backstoryNotes = [];
      if (!root.player.priorEvents || !Array.isArray(root.player.priorEvents)) root.player.priorEvents = [];
      if (!root.player.raceProfile || typeof root.player.raceProfile !== 'object') root.player.raceProfile = { source: 'unknown', sourceTitle: '', summary: '', traits: [], constraints: [], unknowns: [] };

      if (!root.social.reputation || typeof root.social.reputation !== 'object') root.social.reputation = { scopesById: {}, scopeIds: [], recent: [] };
      if (!root.social.rumors || typeof root.social.rumors !== 'object') root.social.rumors = { rumorsById: {}, rumorIds: [], queue: [], recent: [] };
      if (!root.social.crimes || typeof root.social.crimes !== 'object') root.social.crimes = { casesById: {}, caseIds: [], recent: [] };
      if (!root.social.clues || typeof root.social.clues !== 'object') root.social.clues = { cluesById: {}, clueIds: [], recent: [] };
      if (!root.social.law || typeof root.social.law !== 'object') root.social.law = { lawsByScopeId: {}, lawScopeIds: [], responsesById: {}, responseIds: [], enforcementQueue: [], recent: [] };
      if (!root.social.presence.actorsById || typeof root.social.presence.actorsById !== 'object') root.social.presence.actorsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.presence.actorIds)) root.social.presence.actorIds = [];
      if (!root.social.presence.genericGroupsById || typeof root.social.presence.genericGroupsById !== 'object') root.social.presence.genericGroupsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.presence.genericGroupIds)) root.social.presence.genericGroupIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.presence.hiddenObserverCandidates)) root.social.presence.hiddenObserverCandidates = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.presence.departedActorIds)) root.social.presence.departedActorIds = [];
      if (!root.social.knowledge.factsById || typeof root.social.knowledge.factsById !== 'object') root.social.knowledge.factsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.knowledge.factIds)) root.social.knowledge.factIds = [];
      if (!root.social.knowledge.byHolder || typeof root.social.knowledge.byHolder !== 'object') root.social.knowledge.byHolder = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.knowledge.recent)) root.social.knowledge.recent = [];
      if (!root.social.witnesses.recordsById || typeof root.social.witnesses.recordsById !== 'object') root.social.witnesses.recordsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.witnesses.recordIds)) root.social.witnesses.recordIds = [];
      if (!root.social.reputation.scopesById || typeof root.social.reputation.scopesById !== 'object') root.social.reputation.scopesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.reputation.scopeIds)) root.social.reputation.scopeIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.reputation.recent)) root.social.reputation.recent = [];
      if (!root.social.rumors.rumorsById || typeof root.social.rumors.rumorsById !== 'object') root.social.rumors.rumorsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.rumors.rumorIds)) root.social.rumors.rumorIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.rumors.queue)) root.social.rumors.queue = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.rumors.recent)) root.social.rumors.recent = [];
      if (!root.social.crimes.casesById || typeof root.social.crimes.casesById !== 'object') root.social.crimes.casesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.crimes.caseIds)) root.social.crimes.caseIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.crimes.recent)) root.social.crimes.recent = [];
      if (!root.social.clues.cluesById || typeof root.social.clues.cluesById !== 'object') root.social.clues.cluesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.clues.clueIds)) root.social.clues.clueIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.clues.recent)) root.social.clues.recent = [];
      if (!root.social.law.lawsByScopeId || typeof root.social.law.lawsByScopeId !== 'object') root.social.law.lawsByScopeId = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.law.lawScopeIds)) root.social.law.lawScopeIds = [];
      if (!root.social.law.responsesById || typeof root.social.law.responsesById !== 'object') root.social.law.responsesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.law.responseIds)) root.social.law.responseIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.law.enforcementQueue)) root.social.law.enforcementQueue = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.law.recent)) root.social.law.recent = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.social.recent)) root.social.recent = [];
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.presence.actorIds, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.presence.genericGroupIds, 24);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.presence.hiddenObserverCandidates, 20);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.presence.departedActorIds, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.knowledge.factIds, 120);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.knowledge.recent, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.witnesses.recordIds, 120);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.rumors.rumorIds, 100);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.rumors.queue, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.rumors.recent, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.crimes.caseIds, 120);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.crimes.recent, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.clues.clueIds, 120);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.clues.recent, 40);
      WL.U.capArray(root.social.recent, 80);
      if (!root.loreAuthority || typeof root.loreAuthority !== 'object') root.loreAuthority = WL.Schema.root().loreAuthority;
      if (!root.loreAuthority.sourcesById || typeof root.loreAuthority.sourcesById !== 'object') root.loreAuthority.sourcesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.sourceIds)) root.loreAuthority.sourceIds = [];
      if (!root.loreAuthority.revealedById || typeof root.loreAuthority.revealedById !== 'object') root.loreAuthority.revealedById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.revealedIds)) root.loreAuthority.revealedIds = [];
      if (!root.loreAuthority.hiddenById || typeof root.loreAuthority.hiddenById !== 'object') root.loreAuthority.hiddenById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.hiddenIds)) root.loreAuthority.hiddenIds = [];

      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.denied)) root.loreAuthority.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.recent)) root.loreAuthority.recent = [];
      if (typeof root.loreAuthority.lastSyncHash !== 'string') root.loreAuthority.lastSyncHash = '';
      root.loreAuthority.version = '9.12A';
      WL.U.capArray(root.loreAuthority.sourceIds, 240); WL.U.capArray(root.loreAuthority.revealedIds, 120); WL.U.capArray(root.loreAuthority.hiddenIds, 240); WL.U.capArray(root.loreAuthority.regionalTriggers, 120); WL.U.capArray(root.loreAuthority.denied, 80); WL.U.capArray(root.loreAuthority.recent, 80);
      if (!root.migration || typeof root.migration !== 'object') root.migration = WL.Schema.root().migration;
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.history)) root.migration.history = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.preservedNotes)) root.migration.preservedNotes = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.legacyAliases)) root.migration.legacyAliases = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.migration.cleanupNotes)) root.migration.cleanupNotes = [];
      root.migration.version = '9.13C';
      WL.U.capArray(root.migration.history, 30); WL.U.capArray(root.migration.preservedNotes, 60); WL.U.capArray(root.migration.legacyAliases, 60); WL.U.capArray(root.migration.cleanupNotes, 40);
      if (WL.CleanupManager && typeof WL.CleanupManager.ensure === 'function') WL.CleanupManager.ensure(root);
      WL.U.capArray(root.runtime.hookTrace, WL.Constants.maxHookTrace);
      WL.U.capArray(root.operationLedger.recentKeys, WL.Constants.maxRecentKeys);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.audit, WL.Constants.maxAuditRows);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.parser, WL.Constants.maxParserHits);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.proposals, WL.Constants.maxProposals);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.validations, WL.Constants.maxValidations);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.reducers, WL.Constants.maxReducerResults);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // 06. [WL-RUNTIME] Runtime hooks and source classification

  // ============================================================
  // Owner note: SourceGuard classifies text before any canon proposal. Commands, context, and managed-card echoes stay non-canon.
  WL.SourceGuard = {
    classify: function (text, hook) {
      var raw = String(text == null ? '' : text);
      var n = WL.U.norm(raw);
      if (WL.U.startsCommand(raw)) return { kind: 'command', hook: hook, commandName: WL.U.commandName(raw), eligibleForCanon: false, reason: 'command_input' };
      if (/^\s*You pause to check WorldLedger\./i.test(n)) {
        return { kind: 'command_placeholder', hook: hook || 'unknown', commandName: '', eligibleForCanon: false, reason: 'command_placeholder_not_canon' };
      }
      if (/^\[WorldLedger\]/i.test(n) || /\bCommand:\s*\//i.test(n) || /\bSummary:\s*PASS\b/i.test(n)) {
        return { kind: 'command_echo', hook: hook || 'unknown', commandName: '', eligibleForCanon: false, reason: 'command_or_check_output_echo' };
      }
      if (/\[WL-META\b|WL-PROTECTED:|WL-GENERATED:|<!--\s*WL:/i.test(n)) {
        return { kind: 'card_echo', hook: hook || 'unknown', commandName: '', eligibleForCanon: false, reason: 'managed_card_or_metadata_echo' };
      }
      if (hook === 'context') return { kind: 'context', hook: hook, commandName: '', eligibleForCanon: false, reason: 'context_is_read_only' };
      if (hook === 'input') return { kind: 'input', hook: hook, commandName: '', eligibleForCanon: false, reason: 'input_intent_only' };
      return { kind: hook || 'unknown', hook: hook || 'unknown', commandName: '', eligibleForCanon: hook === 'output', reason: hook === 'output' ? 'output_can_propose' : 'unknown_source' };
    }
  };

  // Owner note: Runtime is the only hook orchestration path. Do not add side observers around hooks.
  WL.Runtime = {
    begin: function (root, hook, text) {
      root.runtime.currentHook = hook;
      root.runtime.currentTurn = WL.U.getActionCount();
      root.runtime.hookDepth += 1;
      root.runtime.hookTrace.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, hook: hook, hash: WL.U.hash(text), phase: 'begin' });
      WL.U.capArray(root.runtime.hookTrace, WL.Constants.maxHookTrace);
    },
    end: function (root, hook, status) {
      root.runtime.lastReturnStatus = status || 'ok';
      root.runtime.hookTrace.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, hook: hook, phase: 'end', status: status || 'ok' });
      WL.U.capArray(root.runtime.hookTrace, WL.Constants.maxHookTrace);
      root.runtime.hookDepth = Math.max(0, root.runtime.hookDepth - 1);
      root.runtime.currentHook = 'none';
      WL.StateManager.enforceInvariants(root);
      if (root.features && root.features.safeModeController913CEnabled !== false && WL.SafeModeController && typeof WL.SafeModeController.evaluate === 'function') WL.SafeModeController.evaluate(root, 'runtime_end_' + hook);
    },
    runPipeline: function (root, text, hook) {
      var source = WL.SourceGuard.classify(text, hook);
      var events = [];
      if (source.eligibleForCanon || hook === 'input') {
        events = hook === 'output' ? WL.EventScanner.scanOutput(text, root, source) : WL.EventScanner.scanInput(text, root, source);
      }
      var proposals = WL.ProposalBuilder.fromEvents(root, events, source);
      var validations = WL.CanonValidator.validateAll(root, proposals, source);
      var reducerResults = WL.ReducerRegistry.applyAcceptedBatch(root, validations, source);
      WL.DirtyQueue.mark(root, reducerResults);
      if (hook === 'output' && WL.CardSync && typeof WL.CardSync.flushDirty === 'function') WL.CardSync.flushDirty(root, 'output_dirty_flush');
      root.pending.lastParserHits = events;
      root.pending.lastProposals = proposals;
      root.pending.lastValidations = validations;
      root.pending.lastReducerResults = reducerResults;
      root.pending.lastPipeline = { hook: hook, sourceKind: source.kind, events: events.length, proposals: proposals.length, validations: validations.length, reducers: reducerResults.length };
      root.runtime.lastPipelineSummary = hook + ': events=' + events.length + ', proposals=' + proposals.length + ', validations=' + validations.length + ', reducers=' + reducerResults.length;
      return root.pending.lastPipeline;
    },
    handleInput: function (text) {
      var root = WL.StateManager.root();
      WL.Runtime.begin(root, 'input', text);
      var source = WL.SourceGuard.classify(text, 'input');
      root.runtime.lastInputHash = WL.U.hash(text);
      var out = text;
      if (source.kind === 'command') {
        root.runtime.lastCommandName = source.commandName;
        root.runtime.lastCommandHash = WL.U.hash(text);
        root.runtime.lastCommandTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn;
        root.runtime.pendingCommandOutput = WL.CommandRouter.route(text, root);
        root.runtime.pendingCommandHash = WL.U.hash(root.runtime.pendingCommandOutput || '');
        out = 'You pause to check WorldLedger.';
      } else {
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(root, text, 'input');
      }
      WL.Runtime.end(root, 'input', 'ok');
      return out;
    },
    handleContext: function (text) {
      var root = WL.StateManager.root();
      WL.Runtime.begin(root, 'context', text);
      root.runtime.lastContextHash = WL.U.hash(text);
      var packet = WL.ContextSystem.build(root, text);
      WL.Runtime.end(root, 'context', 'ok');
      return packet;
    },
    handleOutput: function (text) {
      var root = WL.StateManager.root();
      WL.Runtime.begin(root, 'output', text);
      root.runtime.lastOutputHash = WL.U.hash(text);
      if (root.runtime.pendingCommandOutput) {
        var commandOut = root.runtime.pendingCommandOutput;
        root.runtime.lastCommandOutputHash = WL.U.hash(commandOut || '');
        root.runtime.pendingCommandOutput = '';
        root.runtime.pendingCommandHash = '';
        WL.Runtime.end(root, 'output', 'command_output');
        return commandOut || '[WorldLedger] Command processed.\n';
      }
      var source = WL.SourceGuard.classify(text, 'output');
      if (source.eligibleForCanon === false) {
        WL.Runtime.end(root, 'output', source.reason || 'source_rejected');
        return text;
      }
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(root, text, 'output');
      WL.Runtime.end(root, 'output', 'ok');
      return text;
    }
  };


  // ============================================================
  // 06B. [WL-OWNERS] Profile / race registry / form-body owner systems

  // ============================================================
  // Owner note: PlayerProfileSystem imports safe setup identity only; it must not grant mechanics from setup prose.
  WL.PlayerProfileSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.startup || typeof root.startup !== 'object') root.startup = { profileImported: false, profileSourceHash: '', importedFields: [], rejectedMechanics: [], warnings: [] };
      if (!root.player || typeof root.player !== 'object') root.player = WL.Schema.root().player;
      if (!Array.isArray(root.startup.importedFields)) root.startup.importedFields = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.startup.rejectedMechanics)) root.startup.rejectedMechanics = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.startup.warnings)) root.startup.warnings = [];
      return root.player;
    },
    collectPlaceholderEntries: function (stateObj) {
      var out = [];
      var ph = stateObj && stateObj.placeholders;
      if (!ph) return out;
      if (Array.isArray(ph)) {
        for (var i = 0; i < ph.length; i++) {
          var e = ph[i];
          if (e && typeof e === 'object') out.push({ label: WL.U.safeString(e.label || e.name || e.key || e.title || e.prompt || e.question || ''), value: WL.U.safeString(e.value || e.answer || e.text || e.result || e.response || '') });
        }
      } else if (typeof ph === 'object') {
        var keys = Object.keys(ph);
        for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) out.push({ label: keys[j], value: WL.U.safeString(ph[keys[j]]) });
      }
      return out.filter(function (e) { return e.label && e.value; });
    },
    classifyLabel: function (label) {
      var l = WL.U.lower(label).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim();
      var compact = l.replace(/\s+/g, '');
      if (/pronouns?/.test(l)) return 'pronouns';
      if (/(^| )(age|years old|how old|old are you)( |$)/.test(l) || /howoldareyou/.test(compact)) return 'age';
      if (/(appearance|look like|looks|describe yourself|description|physical traits|body description)/.test(l)) return 'appearance';
      if (/(personality|traits|demeanor|temperament|attitude|what are you like)/.test(l)) return 'personality';
      if (/(backstory|history|past|former life|before the story)/.test(l)) return 'backstory';
      // Identity labels must win before the looser race/form question. "What are you called?" is a name, not a form.
      if (/(^| )(name|called|known as|what are you called|who are you called|character name|player name|choose your name)( |$)/.test(l) || /whatsyourname|whatareyoucalled/.test(compact)) return 'name';
      if (/(class|profession|job|role|origin|background|where are you from)/.test(l)) return 'origin';
      if (/(race|species|ancestry|lineage|bloodline|creature type|form|body type)/.test(l) || /^what are you$/.test(l) || /^what kind of (?:being|creature|person) are you$/.test(l)) return 'race';
      return 'notes';
    },
    hasMechanicalCheat: function (value) {
      var v = WL.U.lower(value);
      return /\blevel\s*\d{2,}\b/.test(v) || /\b\d{4,}\s*(?:gold|silver|copper)\b/.test(v) || /\b(?:own|owns|owned|have|has)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?(?:legendary|artifact|mythic|divine)\b/.test(v) || /\bcan\s+cast\s+[A-Z]?[a-z]+/.test(value) || /\bcompleted\s+(?:the\s+)?quest\b/.test(v);
    },
    addUnique: function (arr, value, max) {
      var v = WL.U.norm(value);
      if (!v || !Array.isArray(arr)) return false;
      var sv = WL.U.slug(v);
      for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) if (WL.U.slug(arr[i]) === sv) return false;
      arr.push(v); WL.U.capArray(arr, max || 12); return true;
    },
    applyEntry: function (root, entry) {
      var category = WL.PlayerProfileSystem.classifyLabel(entry.label);
      var value = WL.U.norm(entry.value);
      if (!value) return;
      if (WL.PlayerProfileSystem.hasMechanicalCheat(value)) {
        root.startup.rejectedMechanics.push({ label: entry.label, value: value, reason: 'mechanical_setup_claim_not_imported' });
        WL.U.capArray(root.startup.rejectedMechanics, 20);
      }
      if (category === 'name' && !WL.PlayerProfileSystem.hasMechanicalCheat(value)) root.player.name = WL.U.title(value);
      else if (category === 'pronouns') root.player.pronouns = value;
      else if (category === 'age') { var m = value.match(/\b(\d{1,4})\b/); root.player.age = m ? m[1] : value; }
      else if (category === 'appearance') root.player.appearance = value;
      else if (category === 'personality') WL.PlayerProfileSystem.addUnique(root.player.personalityTraits, value, 12);
      else if (category === 'backstory') {
        WL.PlayerProfileSystem.addUnique(root.player.backstoryNotes, value, 12);
        if (/\bkilled\s+(?:the\s+)?king\b/i.test(value)) WL.PlayerProfileSystem.addUnique(root.player.priorEvents, 'Killed the king before the story began', 12);
      } else if (category === 'race') WL.RaceRegistry.applyChosenRace(root, value);
      else if (category === 'origin') {
        if (/class|role/i.test(entry.label)) root.player.classLabel = value;
        else if (/profession|job/i.test(entry.label)) root.player.profession = value;
        else root.player.origin = value;
      } else WL.PlayerProfileSystem.addUnique(root.player.notes, entry.label + ': ' + value, 12);
      root.startup.importedFields.push({ label: entry.label, category: category });
      WL.U.capArray(root.startup.importedFields, 30);
    },
    importFromState: function (root, stateObj) {
      WL.PlayerProfileSystem.ensure(root);
      var entries = WL.PlayerProfileSystem.collectPlaceholderEntries(stateObj || {});
      var hash = WL.U.hash(JSON.stringify(entries));
      if (!entries.length || root.startup.profileSourceHash === hash) return false;
      for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) WL.PlayerProfileSystem.applyEntry(root, entries[i]);
      root.startup.profileImported = true;
      root.startup.profileSourceHash = hash;
      return true;
    }
  };

  // Owner note: RaceRegistry resolves chosen race/source-card summaries; 9.7A will add trait candidates without stat grants.
  WL.RaceRegistry = {
    normalizeRaceName: function (value) {
      var v = WL.U.norm(value).replace(/^(?:i am|i'm|a|an|the)\s+/i, '').replace(/\s+(?:race|species|form)$/i, '');
      return WL.U.title(v || 'Unknown');
    },
    scanStoryCards: function (stateObj) {
      var cards = WL.U.getStoryCards(stateObj);
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
        var c = cards[i] || {};
        var title = WL.U.cardTitle(c);
        var body = WL.U.cardBody(c);
        var keys = WL.U.safeString(c.keys || c.key || '');
        var hay = WL.U.lower(title + ' ' + keys + ' ' + body);
        if (title && /(race|species|ancestry|lineage|bloodline|elf|orc|human|dwarf|dragon|beast|kin|folk)/i.test(hay)) out.push({ id: c.id || ('racecard_' + WL.U.hash(title + body)), title: title, keys: keys, body: body });
      }
      return out;
    },
    resolveChosenRace: function (name) {
      var chosen = WL.RaceRegistry.normalizeRaceName(name);
      var slug = WL.U.slug(chosen);
      var cards = WL.RaceRegistry.scanStoryCards(WL.U.getGlobalState());
      for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
        var card = cards[i];
        var hay = WL.U.lower(card.title + ' ' + card.keys);
        if (WL.U.slug(card.title) === slug || hay.indexOf(WL.U.lower(chosen)) >= 0) return { name: chosen, source: 'story_card', sourceTitle: card.title, summary: WL.RaceRegistry.summarizeCard(card.body), traits: WL.RaceRegistry.extractTraits(card.body), constraints: [], unknowns: [] };
      }
      return { name: chosen, source: 'setup_only_uncertain', sourceTitle: '', summary: 'Race/species chosen in setup; no scenario race card found yet.', traits: [], constraints: [], unknowns: ['traits_unknown_until_confirmed'] };
    },
    summarizeCard: function (body) {
      var b = WL.U.norm(body);
      if (!b) return '';
      return b.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+/)[0].slice(0, 240);
    },
    extractTraits: function (body) {
      var low = WL.U.lower(body);
      var traits = [];
      var candidates = ['wings','horns','tail','night vision','darkvision','gills','claws','fangs','fire resistance','cold resistance','magic sensitivity'];
      for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) if (low.indexOf(candidates[i]) >= 0) traits.push(WL.U.title(candidates[i]));
      return traits.slice(0, 8);
    },
    applyChosenRace: function (root, value) {
      var rec = WL.RaceRegistry.resolveChosenRace(value);
      root.player.raceSpecies = rec.name;
      root.player.trueRace = rec.name;
      if (!root.player.currentForm || root.player.currentForm === 'unknown') root.player.currentForm = rec.name;
      root.player.raceProfile = { source: rec.source, sourceTitle: rec.sourceTitle, summary: rec.summary, traits: rec.traits || [], constraints: rec.constraints || [], unknowns: rec.unknowns || [] };
      if (WL.RaceTraitSystem && typeof WL.RaceTraitSystem.recordRaceProfile === 'function') WL.RaceTraitSystem.recordRaceProfile(root, rec, 'setup_race_resolution');
      return rec;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: RaceTraitSystem owns race/species trait candidates only; it never grants stats, resources, body formulas, or abilities.
  WL.RaceTraitSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.raceTraits || typeof root.raceTraits !== 'object') root.raceTraits = WL.Schema.root().raceTraits;
      if (!root.raceTraits.candidatesById || typeof root.raceTraits.candidatesById !== 'object') root.raceTraits.candidatesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.raceTraits.candidateIds)) root.raceTraits.candidateIds = [];
      if (!root.raceTraits.sourcesByRaceId || typeof root.raceTraits.sourcesByRaceId !== 'object') root.raceTraits.sourcesByRaceId = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.raceTraits.evidenceLog)) root.raceTraits.evidenceLog = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.raceTraits.denied)) root.raceTraits.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.raceTraits.recent)) root.raceTraits.recent = [];
      if (typeof root.raceTraits.lastSyncHash !== 'string') root.raceTraits.lastSyncHash = '';
    },
    raceName: function (value) { return WL.RaceRegistry && WL.RaceRegistry.normalizeRaceName ? WL.RaceRegistry.normalizeRaceName(value || '') : WL.U.title(value || 'Unknown'); },
    raceId: function (raceName) { return 'race_' + WL.U.slug(WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(raceName || 'unknown')); },
    traitId: function (raceName, traitName) { return 'race_trait_' + WL.U.slug(WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(raceName || 'unknown') + '_' + (traitName || 'unknown')); },
    currentRace: function (root) { return WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(root && root.player && (root.player.trueRace || root.player.raceSpecies || root.player.currentForm || '')); },
    sourceRef: function (source) {
      source = source || {};
      return {
        sourceType: WL.U.safeString(source.sourceType || source.type || 'unknown'),
        sourceId: WL.U.safeString(source.sourceId || source.id || ''),
        sourceTitle: WL.U.safeString(source.sourceTitle || source.title || ''),
        sourceHash: WL.U.safeString(source.sourceHash || WL.U.hash((source.sourceTitle || source.title || '') + '|' + (source.text || source.body || ''))),
        confidence: WL.U.safeString(source.confidence || 'candidate')
      };
    },
    addUniqueRef: function (arr, ref) {
      arr = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
      var key = [ref.sourceType, ref.sourceId, ref.sourceTitle, ref.sourceHash].join('|');
      for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) if ([arr[i].sourceType, arr[i].sourceId, arr[i].sourceTitle, arr[i].sourceHash].join('|') === key) return arr;
      arr.push(ref); WL.U.capArray(arr, 12); return arr;
    },
    hasMechanicalGrantClaim: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      return /(?:\+\s*\d{1,5}|\b\d{2,}\s*(?:str|strength|atk|def|spd|int|lck|hp|mp|ep|levels?|stats?)\b|\blevel\s*\d{2,}\b|\bgrants?\s+\d{2,}\b|\bgain(?:s)?\s+\d{2,}\s*(?:xp|stats?|strength|atk|def|spd|int|lck)\b)/i.test(text || '') || /(?:huge|massive|infinite|unlimited|godlike)\s+(?:stats?|strength|power)\b/.test(t);
    },
    denyMechanicalGrant: function (root, raceName, source, text) {
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.ensure(root);
      var rec = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, raceName: WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(raceName || 'unknown'), reason: 'mechanical_or_huge_stat_grant_denied', phrase: WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(text || '', 180) : WL.U.safeString(text || '').slice(0, 180), source: WL.RaceTraitSystem.sourceRef(source) };
      root.raceTraits.denied.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(root.raceTraits.denied, 80);
      return rec;
    },
    addCandidateFromRule: function (out, raceName, traitName, traitKind, domain, summary, text, source) {
      out.push({
        raceName: WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(raceName || 'unknown'),
        traitName: traitName,
        traitKind: traitKind || 'trait',
        domain: domain || 'general',
        candidateStatus: 'candidate',
        confidence: source && source.confidence || (source && source.sourceType === 'story_card' ? 'story_card_candidate' : 'candidate'),
        summary: summary,
        evidence: WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(text || summary || '', 220) : WL.U.safeString(text || summary || '').slice(0, 220),
        sourceRefs: [WL.RaceTraitSystem.sourceRef(source || {})],
        mechanicalGrant: false,
        statsGranted: false
      });
    },
    extractCandidatesFromText: function (raceName, text, source) {
      var out = [];
      var raw = WL.U.norm(text || '');
      var t = WL.U.lower(raw);
      if (!raceName || !raw) return out;
      if (WL.RaceTraitSystem.hasMechanicalGrantClaim(raw)) return out;
      function add(name, kind, domain, summary) { WL.RaceTraitSystem.addCandidateFromRule(out, raceName, name, kind, domain, summary, raw, source); }
      if (/\b(?:strength|strong|stronger|powerful|forceful|raw force|physical expression|bodily power|muscle|shove|lift)\b/.test(t)) add('Physical Strength', 'body_trait_candidate', 'strength', 'Race lore suggests stronger physical expression than a baseline human in appropriate contexts.');
      if (/\b(?:resilient|resilience|durable|durability|endurance|withstand|survival|hardship|resist(?:ance)?|defense)\b/.test(t)) add('Resilience', 'body_trait_candidate', 'resilience', 'Race lore suggests durability, survival pressure, or resistance candidate evidence.');
      if (/\b(?:senses|perception|perceptive|vision|sight|hearing|smell|night vision|darkvision|awareness|precision)\b/.test(t)) add('Enhanced Senses', 'sensory_trait_candidate', 'senses', 'Race lore suggests perception, precision, or sensory advantage candidate evidence.');
      if (/\b(?:magic affinity|magical affinity|attuned to magic|magic sensitivity|sense magic|mana|arcane|spell|sorcery|aether)\b/.test(t)) add('Magic Affinity', 'affinity_trait_candidate', 'magic', 'Race lore suggests magical sensitivity, control, or affinity candidate evidence.');
      if (/\b(?:agility|agile|reflex|reflexes|speed|swift|fast|coordination|balance|mobility)\b/.test(t)) add('Agility', 'body_trait_candidate', 'agility', 'Race lore suggests mobility, coordination, or reflex candidate evidence.');
      if (/\b(?:conflict|struggle|hardship|battle|combat adaptation|growth through resistance|pressure|aggression tolerance)\b/.test(t)) add('Conflict Adaptation', 'growth_trait_candidate', 'conflict', 'Race lore suggests growth or adaptation through conflict, hardship, or pressure.');
