      if (/\b(?:water|aquatic|submerged|swim|gills|marine|pressure-adapted|river|ocean|depth)\b/.test(t)) add('Aquatic Adaptation', 'environment_trait_candidate', 'aquatic', 'Race lore suggests water, depth, or submerged-environment adaptation.');
      if (/\b(?:wings|winged|flight|fly|aerial|altitude|sky|vertical movement)\b/.test(t)) add('Flight / Aerial Mobility', 'body_trait_candidate', 'aerial', 'Race lore suggests wings, flight, or aerial movement candidate evidence.');
      if (/\b(?:long-lived|longevity|centuries|century|age slowly|immortal|does not age)\b/.test(t)) add('Longevity', 'lifespan_trait_candidate', 'lifespan', 'Race lore suggests altered lifespan or aging candidate evidence.');
      if (/\b(?:environment|habitat|terrain|biome|desert|forest|mountain|underground|subterranean|climate|regional adaptation)\b/.test(t)) add('Environmental Adaptation', 'environment_trait_candidate', 'environment', 'Race lore suggests terrain, climate, or habitat specialization.');
      if (/\b(?:large|larger|giant|small|smaller|size|mass|scale|body scale|colossal|tiny)\b/.test(t)) add('Body Scale Logic', 'body_trait_candidate', 'body_scale', 'Race lore suggests size or body-scale logic that may matter later.');
      if (/\b(?:feared|respected|prejudice|distrusted|admired|social|treated differently|viewed|perceived)\b/.test(t)) add('Social Treatment Candidate', 'social_trait_candidate', 'social', 'Race lore suggests future social-treatment evidence, not an automatic reaction.');
      return out;
    },
    recordCandidate: function (root, candidate, key) {
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.ensure(root);
      if (!candidate || !candidate.raceName || !candidate.traitName) return null;
      var raceName = WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(candidate.raceName);
      var id = candidate.id || WL.RaceTraitSystem.traitId(raceName, candidate.traitName);
      var rec = root.raceTraits.candidatesById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, raceId: WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceId(raceName), raceName: raceName, traitName: WL.U.title(candidate.traitName), traitKind: candidate.traitKind || 'trait', domain: candidate.domain || 'general', candidateStatus: candidate.candidateStatus || 'candidate', confidence: candidate.confidence || 'candidate', summary: candidate.summary || '', evidence: [], sourceRefs: [], mechanicalGrant: false, statsGranted: false, createdTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, keys: [] };
        root.raceTraits.candidatesById[id] = rec;
        root.raceTraits.candidateIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || rec.updatedTurn || 0;
      rec.confidence = /story_card|confirmed/.test(candidate.confidence || '') ? candidate.confidence : (rec.confidence || candidate.confidence || 'candidate');
      rec.summary = candidate.summary || rec.summary || '';
      rec.mechanicalGrant = false; rec.statsGranted = false;
      var evidence = WL.U.safeString(candidate.evidence || candidate.summary || '').slice(0, 240);
      var evidenceHash = WL.U.hash(evidence);
      var seen = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < rec.evidence.length; i++) if (rec.evidence[i].hash === evidenceHash) seen = true;
      if (evidence && !seen) rec.evidence.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, text: evidence, hash: evidenceHash, key: key || '' });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 8);
      var refs = candidate.sourceRefs || [];
      for (var r = 0; r < refs.length; r++) rec.sourceRefs = WL.RaceTraitSystem.addUniqueRef(rec.sourceRefs, refs[r]);
      if (!root.raceTraits.sourcesByRaceId[rec.raceId]) root.raceTraits.sourcesByRaceId[rec.raceId] = [];
      for (var rr = 0; rr < rec.sourceRefs.length; rr++) root.raceTraits.sourcesByRaceId[rec.raceId] = WL.RaceTraitSystem.addUniqueRef(root.raceTraits.sourcesByRaceId[rec.raceId], rec.sourceRefs[rr]);
      root.raceTraits.evidenceLog.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, id: id, raceName: rec.raceName, traitName: rec.traitName, confidence: rec.confidence, key: key || '' });
      root.raceTraits.recent.push({ id: id, raceName: rec.raceName, traitName: rec.traitName, confidence: rec.confidence });
      WL.U.capArray(root.raceTraits.evidenceLog, 120); WL.U.capArray(root.raceTraits.recent, 60); WL.U.capArray(root.raceTraits.candidateIds, 120);
      return rec;
    },
    recordRaceProfile: function (root, raceProfile, sourceKind) {
      if (!root || !raceProfile) return false;
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.ensure(root);
      var raceName = WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(raceProfile.name || root.player.trueRace || root.player.raceSpecies || 'unknown');
      var source = { sourceType: sourceKind || raceProfile.source || 'setup', sourceTitle: raceProfile.sourceTitle || 'setup', sourceId: raceProfile.sourceTitle ? 'card_' + WL.U.slug(raceProfile.sourceTitle) : 'setup_race', sourceHash: WL.U.hash((raceProfile.sourceTitle || '') + '|' + (raceProfile.summary || '') + '|' + (raceProfile.traits || []).join(',')), confidence: raceProfile.source === 'story_card' ? 'story_card_candidate' : 'setup_candidate' };
      var changed = false;
      if (raceProfile.summary) {
        if (WL.RaceTraitSystem.hasMechanicalGrantClaim(raceProfile.summary)) WL.RaceTraitSystem.denyMechanicalGrant(root, raceName, source, raceProfile.summary);
        var cands = WL.RaceTraitSystem.extractCandidatesFromText(raceName, raceProfile.summary, source);
        for (var i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) { WL.RaceTraitSystem.recordCandidate(root, cands[i], source.sourceHash); changed = true; }
      }
      var traits = raceProfile.traits || [];
      for (var t = 0; t < traits.length; t++) {
        var trait = WL.U.title(traits[t]);
        if (!trait) continue;
        WL.RaceTraitSystem.recordCandidate(root, { raceName: raceName, traitName: trait, traitKind: 'profile_trait_candidate', domain: WL.U.slug(trait), candidateStatus: 'candidate', confidence: source.confidence, summary: 'Race profile listed this as a trait candidate.', evidence: trait, sourceRefs: [WL.RaceTraitSystem.sourceRef(source)] }, source.sourceHash); changed = true;
      }
      return changed;
    },
    isRaceCardMatch: function (raceName, card) {
      var race = WL.U.lower(WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(raceName || '')).replace(/s$/, '');
      if (!race || race === 'unknown') return false;
      var title = WL.U.lower(WL.U.cardTitle(card || '')).replace(/s$/, '');
      var keys = WL.U.lower(WL.U.safeString(card && (card.keys || card.key || '')));
      var hay = title + ' ' + keys;
      return title === race || hay.indexOf(race) >= 0 || hay.indexOf(race + ' race') >= 0 || hay.indexOf(race + ' peoples') >= 0;
    },
    syncFromSetupAndCards: function (root, stateObj) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.raceTraitSystemEnabled === false) return false;
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.ensure(root);
      var raceName = WL.RaceTraitSystem.currentRace(root);
      if (!raceName || /^unknown$/i.test(raceName)) return false;
      var cards = (stateObj && Array.isArray(stateObj.storyCards)) ? stateObj.storyCards.slice(0, 96) : WL.U.getStoryCards(stateObj || WL.U.getGlobalState()).slice(0, 96);
      var relevant = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) if (WL.RaceTraitSystem.isRaceCardMatch(raceName, cards[i])) relevant.push(cards[i]);
      var sig = raceName + '|' + relevant.map(function (card) { return WL.U.cardTitle(card) + ':' + WL.U.hash(WL.U.cardBody(card)); }).join('|');
      var hash = WL.U.hash(sig);
      if (root.raceTraits.lastSyncHash === hash) return false;
      root.raceTraits.lastSyncHash = hash;
      var changed = false;
      if (root.player && root.player.raceProfile) changed = WL.RaceTraitSystem.recordRaceProfile(root, { name: raceName, source: root.player.raceProfile.source, sourceTitle: root.player.raceProfile.sourceTitle, summary: root.player.raceProfile.summary, traits: root.player.raceProfile.traits || [] }, 'setup_race_profile') || changed;
      for (var c = 0; c < relevant.length; c++) {
        var card = relevant[c] || {};
        var title = WL.U.cardTitle(card) || raceName;
        var body = WL.U.cardBody(card);
        var source = { sourceType: 'story_card', sourceId: card.id || ('story_card_' + WL.U.slug(title)), sourceTitle: title, text: body, sourceHash: WL.U.hash(title + '|' + body), confidence: 'story_card_candidate' };
        if (WL.RaceTraitSystem.hasMechanicalGrantClaim(body)) WL.RaceTraitSystem.denyMechanicalGrant(root, raceName, source, body);
        var cands = WL.RaceTraitSystem.extractCandidatesFromText(raceName, body, source);
        for (var j = 0; j < cands.length; j++) { WL.RaceTraitSystem.recordCandidate(root, cands[j], source.sourceHash); changed = true; }
      }
      if (changed && root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets) && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('profile') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('profile');
      return changed;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {};
      var d = p.data || {};
      if (p.type !== 'race_trait_candidate') return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_race_trait_event' };
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.ensure(root);
      if (d.denied) { WL.RaceTraitSystem.denyMechanicalGrant(root, d.raceName || WL.RaceTraitSystem.currentRace(root), { sourceType: 'output', sourceTitle: 'story output', sourceHash: p.sourceHash, confidence: 'denied' }, p.textPreview); return { status: 'DENIED_MECHANICAL_GRANT', applied: true, family: 'raceTrait', type: p.type, key: ledger.key }; }
      var cands = d.candidates || [];
      if (!cands.length && d.traitName) cands = [d];
      for (var i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) WL.RaceTraitSystem.recordCandidate(root, cands[i], ledger.key);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'raceTrait', type: p.type, count: cands.length, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.ensure(root);
      var ids = root.raceTraits.candidateIds || [];
      if (!ids.length) return ['Race Traits: (none confirmed; candidates require setup/card/story evidence)'];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < (max || 6); i++) {
        var rec = root.raceTraits.candidatesById[ids[i]];
        if (rec) parts.push(rec.raceName + ' — ' + rec.traitName + ' [' + WL.U.safeString(rec.confidence || 'candidate') + ']');
      }
      return ['Race Traits: ' + (parts.join(' | ') || '(none)')];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = [];
      var ids = root.raceTraits.candidateIds || [];
      if (!ids.length) return ['(none)'];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && lines.length < (max || 20); i++) {
        var rec = root.raceTraits.candidatesById[ids[i]];
        if (!rec) continue;
        var refs = (rec.sourceRefs || []).map(function (r) { return r.sourceTitle || r.sourceType; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3).join(', ') || 'evidence';
        lines.push('- ' + rec.raceName + ' / ' + rec.traitName + ': ' + WL.U.safeString(rec.summary || rec.domain || 'candidate') + ' [' + WL.U.safeString(rec.confidence || 'candidate') + '; sources: ' + refs + '; no stat grant]');
      }
      if (ids.length > lines.length) lines.push('- ... ' + (ids.length - lines.length) + ' more race trait candidate records kept in state.');
      if ((root.raceTraits.denied || []).length) lines.push('Denied mechanical claims: ' + root.raceTraits.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: BodyFormulaSystem owns bounded derived body formulas and constraints. It does not grant base stats, XP, inventory, or automatic success.
  WL.BodyFormulaSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.bodyFormula || typeof root.bodyFormula !== 'object') root.bodyFormula = WL.Schema.root().bodyFormula;
      if (!root.bodyFormula.derived || typeof root.bodyFormula.derived !== 'object') root.bodyFormula.derived = WL.Schema.root().bodyFormula.derived;
      if (!root.bodyFormula.modifiersById || typeof root.bodyFormula.modifiersById !== 'object') root.bodyFormula.modifiersById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.bodyFormula.modifierIds)) root.bodyFormula.modifierIds = [];
      if (!root.bodyFormula.constraintsById || typeof root.bodyFormula.constraintsById !== 'object') root.bodyFormula.constraintsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.bodyFormula.constraintIds)) root.bodyFormula.constraintIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.bodyFormula.actionNotes)) root.bodyFormula.actionNotes = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.bodyFormula.denied)) root.bodyFormula.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.bodyFormula.recent)) root.bodyFormula.recent = [];
      if (typeof root.bodyFormula.lastSyncHash !== 'string') root.bodyFormula.lastSyncHash = '';
    },
    currentRace: function (root) { return WL.RaceTraitSystem && WL.RaceTraitSystem.currentRace ? WL.RaceTraitSystem.currentRace(root) : WL.U.title(root && root.player && (root.player.trueRace || root.player.raceSpecies || root.player.currentForm || 'Unknown')); },
    isSmallRaceName: function (name) { return /^(?:Halflings?|Gnomes?|Kobolds?)$/i.test(WL.U.safeString(name || '')); },
    isLargeRaceName: function (name) { return /^(?:Giants?|Dragonkin)$/i.test(WL.U.safeString(name || '')); },
    modId: function (raceName, kind, label) { return 'body_formula_mod_' + WL.U.slug((raceName || 'unknown') + '_' + kind + '_' + label); },
    constraintId: function (raceName, kind, label) { return 'body_formula_constraint_' + WL.U.slug((raceName || 'unknown') + '_' + kind + '_' + label); },
    addModifier: function (root, raceName, kind, label, data) {
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var id = WL.BodyFormulaSystem.modId(raceName, kind, label);
      var rec = root.bodyFormula.modifiersById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, raceName: WL.U.title(raceName || 'Unknown'), kind: kind || 'modifier', label: WL.U.title(label || kind || 'Modifier'), status: 'derived_candidate', summary: '', sources: [], effects: {}, createdTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0 };
        root.bodyFormula.modifiersById[id] = rec;
        root.bodyFormula.modifierIds.push(id);
      }
      data = data || {};
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || rec.updatedTurn || 0;
      rec.summary = data.summary || rec.summary || '';
      rec.effects = data.effects || rec.effects || {};
      if (data.sourceId && rec.sources.indexOf(data.sourceId) < 0) rec.sources.push(data.sourceId);
      WL.U.capArray(rec.sources, 8);
      WL.U.capArray(root.bodyFormula.modifierIds, 80);
      return rec;
    },
    addConstraint: function (root, raceName, kind, label, data) {
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var id = WL.BodyFormulaSystem.constraintId(raceName, kind, label);
      var rec = root.bodyFormula.constraintsById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, raceName: WL.U.title(raceName || 'Unknown'), kind: kind || 'constraint', label: WL.U.title(label || kind || 'Constraint'), status: 'derived_constraint', summary: '', triggers: [], sources: [], createdTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0 };
        root.bodyFormula.constraintsById[id] = rec;
        root.bodyFormula.constraintIds.push(id);
      }
      data = data || {};
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || rec.updatedTurn || 0;
      rec.summary = data.summary || rec.summary || '';
      rec.triggers = data.triggers || rec.triggers || [];
      if (data.sourceId && rec.sources.indexOf(data.sourceId) < 0) rec.sources.push(data.sourceId);
      WL.U.capArray(rec.sources, 8);
      WL.U.capArray(root.bodyFormula.constraintIds, 80);
      return rec;
    },
    traitRecords: function (root) {
      var out = [];
      if (!root || !root.raceTraits || !root.raceTraits.candidateIds) return out;
      for (var i = 0; i < root.raceTraits.candidateIds.length; i++) { var rec = root.raceTraits.candidatesById[root.raceTraits.candidateIds[i]]; if (rec) out.push(rec); }
      return out;
    },
    resetDerived: function (root) {
      root.bodyFormula.modifiersById = {}; root.bodyFormula.modifierIds = []; root.bodyFormula.constraintsById = {}; root.bodyFormula.constraintIds = [];
      root.bodyFormula.derived = { effectiveMaxHp: root.body.maxHp, effectiveMaxMp: root.body.maxMp, effectiveMaxEp: root.body.maxEp, hpPressure: [], mpPressure: [], epPressure: [], recovery: [], notes: [] };
    },
    interpretTrait: function (root, rec) {
      if (!rec || rec.mechanicalGrant || rec.statsGranted) return;
      var raceName = rec.raceName || WL.BodyFormulaSystem.currentRace(root);
      var name = WL.U.lower(rec.traitName || rec.domain || '');
      var domain = WL.U.lower(rec.domain || '');
      var id = rec.id || '';
      if (/physical strength|strength|body scale|body_scale/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) {
        WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'action_fit', 'forceful physical actions', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Body/race evidence can help forceful actions such as shove, lift, push, break, or haul when the scene supports it.', effects: { actionTags: ['shove', 'lift', 'push', 'haul', 'break'], automaticSuccess: false } });
        root.bodyFormula.derived.epPressure.push('forceful actions may cost less EP when body leverage applies');
      }
      if (/resilience|durability|endurance|defense/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) {
        WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'resource_pressure', 'resilience pressure', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Body evidence may reduce minor injury/fatigue pressure and support recovery interpretation, but does not change base HP directly.', effects: { hpPressure: 'minor_reduction_candidate', effectiveHpCapBonus: 10, automaticStatGrant: false } });
        root.bodyFormula.derived.effectiveMaxHp = Math.max(root.bodyFormula.derived.effectiveMaxHp, root.body.maxHp + 10);
        root.bodyFormula.derived.hpPressure.push('minor injury/fatigue pressure can be softened when resilience is relevant');
      }
      if (/magic affinity|magic|mana|arcane/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) {
        WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'resource_pressure', 'magic affinity pressure', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Magic affinity may improve MP efficiency/control in fitting scenes without granting MP or spells.', effects: { mpEfficiency: 'minor_candidate', automaticAbilityGrant: false } });
        root.bodyFormula.derived.mpPressure.push('magic use may be more efficient when lore and training support it');
      }
      if (/agility|mobility|senses|perception/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) {
        WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'action_fit', 'mobility or perception fit', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Body/race evidence may help movement, balance, awareness, or precision checks when relevant.', effects: { actionTags: ['balance', 'dodge', 'notice', 'track'], automaticSuccess: false } });
        root.bodyFormula.derived.epPressure.push('movement pressure may shift with body fit and terrain');
      }
      if (/conflict|growth/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'fatigue_pressure', 'pressure adaptation', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Race evidence may affect fatigue/resolve under hardship, but it does not grant XP or stats.', effects: { fatigueUnderPressure: 'candidate', automaticXpGrant: false } });
      if (/aquatic|water|depth/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) {
        WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'environment_fit', 'aquatic environment fit', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Aquatic traits improve water/depth action fit and may create dry-land pressure depending on form.', effects: { environment: 'water', automaticSuccess: false } });
        WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addConstraint(root, raceName, 'environment_constraint', 'water dependency or dry-land pressure', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Aquatic forms may face pressure away from water unless the story establishes adaptation.', triggers: ['dry land', 'heat', 'long travel away from water'] });
      }
      if (/flight|aerial|wing/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addConstraint(root, raceName, 'space_constraint', 'flight needs space', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Winged/aerial bodies need enough space, air, and usable wings; cramped rooms can restrict flight.', triggers: ['cramped room', 'low ceiling', 'bound wings'] });
      if (/body scale|body_scale|size|small|large/.test(name + ' ' + domain) || WL.BodyFormulaSystem.isSmallRaceName(raceName) || WL.BodyFormulaSystem.isLargeRaceName(raceName)) {
        if (WL.BodyFormulaSystem.isSmallRaceName(raceName)) {
          WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addConstraint(root, raceName, 'equipment_constraint', 'small form equipment fit', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Small body scale can affect oversized weapons, armor, mounts, reach, and heavy loads.', triggers: ['greatsword', 'large armor', 'heavy shield', 'oversized gear'] });
          WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'action_fit', 'small form efficiency', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Small bodies may gain access, stealth, and efficiency advantages in fitting spaces.', effects: { actionTags: ['sneak', 'crawl', 'fit', 'hide'], automaticSuccess: false } });
        } else if (WL.BodyFormulaSystem.isLargeRaceName(raceName)) {
          WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'body_scale', 'large body scale', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Large body scale can improve reach, mass, and leverage but also increases space/resource needs.', effects: { actionTags: ['reach', 'lift', 'crush', 'block'], automaticSuccess: false } });
          WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addConstraint(root, raceName, 'space_constraint', 'large form cramped-space pressure', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Large bodies may struggle in narrow tunnels, small rooms, fragile floors, or cramped streets.', triggers: ['narrow tunnel', 'small room', 'fragile floor', 'tight crowd'] });
        }
      }
      if (/longevity|lifespan/.test(name + ' ' + domain)) WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, 'time_perspective', 'longevity perspective', { sourceId: id, summary: 'Longevity affects recovery pacing, patience, memory, and social perspective more than direct resources.', effects: { automaticStatGrant: false } });
    },
    syncFromRaceTraits: function (root, reason) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.bodyFormulaSystemEnabled === false) return false;
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var traits = WL.BodyFormulaSystem.traitRecords(root);
      var sig = WL.BodyFormulaSystem.currentRace(root) + '|' + traits.map(function (r) { return r.id + ':' + r.confidence + ':' + r.updatedTurn; }).join('|') + '|' + root.body.maxHp + ':' + root.body.maxMp + ':' + root.body.maxEp;
      var hash = WL.U.hash(sig);
      if (root.bodyFormula.lastSyncHash === hash) return false;
      root.bodyFormula.lastSyncHash = hash;
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.resetDerived(root);
      for (var i = 0; i < traits.length; i++) WL.BodyFormulaSystem.interpretTrait(root, traits[i]);
      root.bodyFormula.derived.notes.push('Derived formula only: base HP/MP/EP and stats are not overwritten by race/card text.');
      root.bodyFormula.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: 'body_formula_sync', reason: reason || 'sync', modifiers: root.bodyFormula.modifierIds.length, constraints: root.bodyFormula.constraintIds.length });
      WL.U.capArray(root.bodyFormula.recent, 60);
      if (root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets) && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('body') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('body');
      return true;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {}; var d = p.data || {};
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.ensure(root); WL.BodyFormulaSystem.syncFromRaceTraits(root, 'reducer_apply');
      if (p.type !== 'body_formula_evidence_candidate') return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_body_formula_event' };
      if (d.denied) { root.bodyFormula.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: 'mechanical_grant_denied', phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key }); WL.U.capArray(root.bodyFormula.denied, 60); return { status: 'DENIED_MECHANICAL_GRANT', applied: true, family: 'bodyFormula', type: p.type, key: ledger.key }; }
      var raceName = d.raceName || WL.BodyFormulaSystem.currentRace(root);
      if (d.constraintKind) WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addConstraint(root, raceName, d.constraintKind, d.label || d.constraintKind, { sourceId: ledger.key, summary: d.summary || p.textPreview || '', triggers: d.triggers || [] });
      if (d.modifierKind) WL.BodyFormulaSystem.addModifier(root, raceName, d.modifierKind, d.label || d.modifierKind, { sourceId: ledger.key, summary: d.summary || p.textPreview || '', effects: d.effects || {} });
      if (d.actionKind) { root.bodyFormula.actionNotes.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, raceName: WL.U.title(raceName || 'Unknown'), actionKind: d.actionKind, status: d.status || 'evidence', phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key }); WL.U.capArray(root.bodyFormula.actionNotes, 60); }
      root.bodyFormula.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: 'body_formula_evidence', kind: d.actionKind || d.constraintKind || d.modifierKind || 'evidence', key: ledger.key }); WL.U.capArray(root.bodyFormula.recent, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'bodyFormula', type: p.type, key: ledger.key };
    },
    actionHint: function (root, text) {
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      var mods = root.bodyFormula.modifierIds.map(function (id) { return root.bodyFormula.modifiersById[id]; }).filter(Boolean);
      var constraints = root.bodyFormula.constraintIds.map(function (id) { return root.bodyFormula.constraintsById[id]; }).filter(Boolean);
      var hasForce = mods.some(function (m) { return /forceful|large body scale|strength/i.test(m.label + ' ' + m.summary); });
      var hasSmallConstraint = constraints.some(function (c) { return /small form equipment/i.test(c.label + ' ' + c.summary); });
      if (hasSmallConstraint && /greatsword|oversized|large armor|heavy shield|too large|two-handed/.test(t)) return 'constraint: small form affects oversized equipment use';
      if (hasForce && /shove|push|lift|haul|break|force|cart|gate|boulder|debris/.test(t)) return 'advantage: body formula supports forceful physical action when scene conditions allow';
      return 'neutral: no strong body formula fit recorded';
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var mids = root.bodyFormula.modifierIds || []; var cids = root.bodyFormula.constraintIds || [];
      if (!mids.length && !cids.length) return ['Body Formula: (none derived; needs race/body trait evidence)'];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < mids.length && parts.length < (max || 4); i++) { var m = root.bodyFormula.modifiersById[mids[i]]; if (m) parts.push(m.label + ' [' + m.status + ']'); }
      for (var c = 0; c < cids.length && parts.length < (max || 4); c++) { var con = root.bodyFormula.constraintsById[cids[c]]; if (con) parts.push(con.label + ' [' + con.status + ']'); }
      return ['Body Formula: ' + parts.join(' | ') + ' | Effective caps shown as derived only HP ' + root.bodyFormula.derived.effectiveMaxHp + ', MP ' + root.bodyFormula.derived.effectiveMaxMp + ', EP ' + root.bodyFormula.derived.effectiveMaxEp];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      WL.BodyFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = [WL.BodyFormulaSystem.summary(root, 6)[0]];
      var mids = root.bodyFormula.modifierIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < mids.length && lines.length < (max || 24); i++) { var m = root.bodyFormula.modifiersById[mids[i]]; if (m) lines.push('- Modifier: ' + m.raceName + ' / ' + m.label + ': ' + WL.U.safeString(m.summary || 'derived candidate') + ' [no base stat grant]'); }
      var cids = root.bodyFormula.constraintIds || [];
      for (var c = 0; c < cids.length && lines.length < (max || 24); c++) { var con = root.bodyFormula.constraintsById[cids[c]]; if (con) lines.push('- Constraint: ' + con.raceName + ' / ' + con.label + ': ' + WL.U.safeString(con.summary || 'derived constraint')); }
      if (root.bodyFormula.actionNotes.length) lines.push('Recent action evidence: ' + root.bodyFormula.actionNotes.slice(-3).map(function (n) { return n.actionKind + ' [' + n.status + ']'; }).join(', '));
      if (root.bodyFormula.denied.length) lines.push('Denied mechanical body formula claims: ' + root.bodyFormula.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: SocialTreatmentSystem owns race/body/social treatment evidence only; it does not mutate reputation, law, XP, stats, inventory, or social outcomes automatically.
  WL.SocialTreatmentSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.socialTreatment || typeof root.socialTreatment !== 'object') root.socialTreatment = WL.Schema.root().socialTreatment;
      if (!root.socialTreatment.treatmentsById || typeof root.socialTreatment.treatmentsById !== 'object') root.socialTreatment.treatmentsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.socialTreatment.treatmentIds)) root.socialTreatment.treatmentIds = [];
      if (!root.socialTreatment.localAttitudesById || typeof root.socialTreatment.localAttitudesById !== 'object') root.socialTreatment.localAttitudesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.socialTreatment.localAttitudeIds)) root.socialTreatment.localAttitudeIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.socialTreatment.evidenceLog)) root.socialTreatment.evidenceLog = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.socialTreatment.denied)) root.socialTreatment.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.socialTreatment.recent)) root.socialTreatment.recent = [];
      if (typeof root.socialTreatment.lastSyncHash !== 'string') root.socialTreatment.lastSyncHash = '';
    },
    currentRace: function (root) { return WL.RaceTraitSystem && WL.RaceTraitSystem.currentRace ? WL.RaceTraitSystem.currentRace(root) : WL.U.title(root && root.player && (root.player.trueRace || root.player.raceSpecies || root.player.currentForm || 'Unknown')); },
    normalizeAxis: function (value) {
      var v = WL.U.lower(value || '');
      if (/fear|fright|scare|alarm|recoil|intimidat|uneasy|nervous/.test(v)) return 'fear';
      if (/prejudice|suspicion|distrust|hostile|cold|warily|different/.test(v)) return 'prejudice';
      if (/respect|admire|honou?r|approval|impressed|defer/.test(v)) return 'respect';
      if (/curious|interest|fascinat/.test(v)) return 'curiosity';
      return v || 'attitude';
    },
    treatmentId: function (raceName, scopeName, axis, trigger) { return 'social_treatment_' + WL.U.slug([raceName || 'unknown', scopeName || 'scene', axis || 'attitude', trigger || 'evidence'].join('_')); },
    localId: function (raceName, localName, axis) { return 'social_attitude_' + WL.U.slug([raceName || 'unknown', localName || 'local', axis || 'attitude'].join('_')); },
    reputationContext: function (root, scopeName) {
      try {
        var scopes = root.social && root.social.reputation && root.social.reputation.scopesById || {};
        var keys = Object.keys(scopes);
        var slug = WL.U.slug(scopeName || '');
        for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
          var rec = scopes[keys[i]];
          if (rec && WL.U.slug(rec.scopeName || rec.name || '') === slug) return { scopeId: rec.id || keys[i], scopeName: rec.scopeName || rec.name || scopeName, note: 'existing_reputation_scope_present' };
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return null;
    },
    addTreatment: function (root, data, key, phrase) {
      WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.ensure(root);
      data = data || {};
      var raceName = WL.U.title(data.raceName || WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.currentRace(root) || 'Unknown');
      var axis = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.normalizeAxis(data.axis || data.treatmentKind || 'attitude');
      var scopeName = WL.U.title(data.scopeName || data.actorName || 'Scene');
      var trigger = WL.U.safeString(data.trigger || data.visibleTrait || 'race/body evidence');
      var id = data.targetId || WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.treatmentId(raceName, scopeName, axis, trigger);
      var rec = root.socialTreatment.treatmentsById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, raceName: raceName, scopeKind: data.scopeKind || 'actor', scopeName: scopeName, actorName: data.actorName || '', axis: axis, treatmentKind: data.treatmentKind || axis, trigger: trigger, intensity: data.intensity || 'low', status: 'evidence', confidence: data.confidence || 'confirmed_social_treatment_evidence', evidence: [], sourceKeys: [], reputationContext: null, createdTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0 };
        root.socialTreatment.treatmentsById[id] = rec;
        root.socialTreatment.treatmentIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || rec.updatedTurn || 0;
      rec.intensity = data.intensity || rec.intensity || 'low';
      rec.summary = data.summary || rec.summary || '';
      rec.reputationContext = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.reputationContext(root, scopeName);
      if (key && rec.sourceKeys.indexOf(key) < 0) rec.sourceKeys.push(key);
      if (phrase) rec.evidence.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, phrase: WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(phrase, 180) : WL.U.safeString(phrase).slice(0, 180), key: key || '' });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 8); WL.U.capArray(rec.sourceKeys, 8); WL.U.capArray(root.socialTreatment.treatmentIds, 100);
      return rec;
    },
    addLocalAttitude: function (root, data, key, phrase) {
      WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.ensure(root);
      data = data || {};
      var raceName = WL.U.title(data.raceName || WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.currentRace(root) || 'Unknown');
      var localName = WL.U.title(data.localName || data.scopeName || 'Local Area');
      var axis = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.normalizeAxis(data.axis || data.treatmentKind || 'attitude');
      var id = data.targetId || WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.localId(raceName, localName, axis);
      var rec = root.socialTreatment.localAttitudesById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, raceName: raceName, localName: localName, axis: axis, attitudeKind: data.treatmentKind || axis, intensity: data.intensity || 'low', status: 'evidence', confidence: data.confidence || 'confirmed_local_attitude_evidence', evidence: [], sourceKeys: [], reputationContext: null, createdTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0 };
        root.socialTreatment.localAttitudesById[id] = rec;
        root.socialTreatment.localAttitudeIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || rec.updatedTurn || 0;
      rec.summary = data.summary || rec.summary || '';
      rec.reputationContext = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.reputationContext(root, localName);
      if (key && rec.sourceKeys.indexOf(key) < 0) rec.sourceKeys.push(key);
      if (phrase) rec.evidence.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, phrase: WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(phrase, 180) : WL.U.safeString(phrase).slice(0, 180), key: key || '' });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 8); WL.U.capArray(rec.sourceKeys, 8); WL.U.capArray(root.socialTreatment.localAttitudeIds, 80);
      return rec;
    },
    syncFromBodyEvidence: function (root, reason) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.socialTreatmentSystemEnabled === false) return false;
      WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.ensure(root);
      var race = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.currentRace(root);
      var visible = (root.body && root.body.visibleTraits || []).concat(root.body && root.body.bodyTraits || []).map(function (t) { return WL.U.safeString(t.name || t.trait || t); }).join('|');
      var bodyMods = root.bodyFormula && root.bodyFormula.modifierIds ? root.bodyFormula.modifierIds.join('|') : '';
      var sig = race + '|' + visible + '|' + bodyMods;
      var hash = WL.U.hash(sig);
      if (root.socialTreatment.lastSyncHash === hash) return false;
      root.socialTreatment.lastSyncHash = hash;
      root.socialTreatment.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: 'social_treatment_sync', reason: reason || 'sync', raceName: race, note: 'sync only; no automatic attitude created without story evidence' });
      WL.U.capArray(root.socialTreatment.recent, 60);
      return true;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {}; var d = p.data || {};
      WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.ensure(root); WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.syncFromBodyEvidence(root, 'reducer_apply');
      if (p.type !== 'social_treatment_candidate') return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_social_treatment_event' };
      if (d.denied) { root.socialTreatment.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: d.reason || 'universal_or_mechanical_social_claim_denied', phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key }); WL.U.capArray(root.socialTreatment.denied, 60); return { status: 'DENIED_SOCIAL_TREATMENT_CLAIM', applied: true, family: 'socialTreatment', type: p.type, key: ledger.key }; }
      var rec = d.localAttitude ? WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.addLocalAttitude(root, d, ledger.key, p.textPreview) : WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.addTreatment(root, d, ledger.key, p.textPreview);
      root.socialTreatment.evidenceLog.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, id: rec.id, axis: rec.axis || rec.attitudeKind, raceName: rec.raceName, local: !!d.localAttitude, key: ledger.key });
      root.socialTreatment.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: d.localAttitude ? 'local_attitude_evidence' : 'social_treatment_evidence', id: rec.id, axis: rec.axis || rec.attitudeKind, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.socialTreatment.evidenceLog, 80); WL.U.capArray(root.socialTreatment.recent, 60);
      if (root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets) && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('social') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('social');
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'socialTreatment', type: p.type, recordId: rec.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.ensure(root);
      var parts = [];
      var tids = root.socialTreatment.treatmentIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < tids.length && parts.length < (max || 4); i++) { var t = root.socialTreatment.treatmentsById[tids[i]]; if (t) parts.push((t.scopeName || t.actorName || 'Scene') + ': ' + t.axis + ' toward ' + t.raceName); }
      var lids = root.socialTreatment.localAttitudeIds || [];
      for (var j = 0; j < lids.length && parts.length < (max || 4); j++) { var l = root.socialTreatment.localAttitudesById[lids[j]]; if (l) parts.push((l.localName || 'Local') + ': ' + l.axis + ' toward ' + l.raceName); }
      if (!parts.length) return ['Social Treatment: (none confirmed; race/body traits do not create social outcomes by themselves)'];
      return ['Social Treatment: ' + parts.join(' | ')];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = [WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.summary(root, 6)[0]];
      var tids = root.socialTreatment.treatmentIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < tids.length && lines.length < (max || 24); i++) { var t = root.socialTreatment.treatmentsById[tids[i]]; if (t) lines.push('- Treatment: ' + t.scopeName + ' / ' + t.axis + ' / ' + t.raceName + ' via ' + WL.U.safeString(t.trigger || 'evidence') + ' [' + t.status + '; no auto reputation/law]'); }
      var lids = root.socialTreatment.localAttitudeIds || [];
      for (var j = 0; j < lids.length && lines.length < (max || 24); j++) { var l = root.socialTreatment.localAttitudesById[lids[j]]; if (l) lines.push('- Local Attitude: ' + l.localName + ' / ' + l.axis + ' toward ' + l.raceName + ' [' + l.status + '; evidence only]'); }
      if (root.socialTreatment.denied.length) lines.push('Denied overbroad/social-mechanical claims: ' + root.socialTreatment.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: PartyFollowerSystem owns persistent companion/follower membership. It must not grant stats, summons, items, or automatic combat outcomes.
  WL.PartyFollowerSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.partyFollowers || typeof root.partyFollowers !== 'object') root.partyFollowers = WL.Schema.root().partyFollowers;
      if (!root.partyFollowers.membersById || typeof root.partyFollowers.membersById !== 'object') root.partyFollowers.membersById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.partyFollowers.memberIds)) root.partyFollowers.memberIds = [];
      if (!root.partyFollowers.byStatus || typeof root.partyFollowers.byStatus !== 'object') root.partyFollowers.byStatus = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.partyFollowers.statusLog)) root.partyFollowers.statusLog = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.partyFollowers.denied)) root.partyFollowers.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.partyFollowers.recent)) root.partyFollowers.recent = [];
      if (typeof root.partyFollowers.lastSyncHash !== 'string') root.partyFollowers.lastSyncHash = '';
    },
    memberId: function (name) { return 'party_member_' + WL.U.slug(name || 'unknown'); },
    normalizeStatus: function (status) {
      var s = WL.U.lower(status || 'active');
      if (/dead|killed|fallen/.test(s)) return 'dead';
      if (/elsewhere|away|behind|waiting|absent/.test(s)) return 'elsewhere';
      if (/left|departed|dismissed|released/.test(s)) return 'left';
      return 'active';
    },
    statusPresence: function (status) {
      status = WL.PartyFollowerSystem.normalizeStatus(status);
      if (status === 'active') return 'present';
      if (status === 'elsewhere') return 'elsewhere';
      return 'absent';
    },
    rebuildStatusIndex: function (root) {
      WL.PartyFollowerSystem.ensure(root);
      root.partyFollowers.byStatus = {};
      var ids = root.partyFollowers.memberIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var rec = root.partyFollowers.membersById[ids[i]];
        if (!rec) continue;
        var st = WL.PartyFollowerSystem.normalizeStatus(rec.status);
        if (!root.partyFollowers.byStatus[st]) root.partyFollowers.byStatus[st] = [];
        if (root.partyFollowers.byStatus[st].indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.partyFollowers.byStatus[st].push(rec.id);
      }
      return root.partyFollowers.byStatus;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {}; var d = p.data || {};
      WL.PartyFollowerSystem.ensure(root);
      if (p.type !== 'party_follower_candidate') return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_party_follower_event' };
      if (d.denied) {
        root.partyFollowers.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: d.reason || 'not_persistent_party_evidence', actorName: WL.U.safeString(d.actorName || ''), phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.partyFollowers.denied, 80);
        return { status: 'DENIED_PARTY_FOLLOWER_CLAIM', applied: true, family: 'partyFollower', type: p.type, key: ledger.key };
      }
      var name = WL.U.title(d.actorName || d.targetName || '');
      if (!name) return { status: 'REJECTED_EMPTY_PARTY_MEMBER', applied: false, family: 'partyFollower', type: p.type, key: ledger.key };
      var id = d.targetId || WL.PartyFollowerSystem.memberId(name);
      var rec = root.partyFollowers.membersById[id];
      var status = WL.PartyFollowerSystem.normalizeStatus(d.status || 'active');
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, actorId: 'actor_' + WL.U.slug(name), name: name, role: WL.U.safeString(d.role || 'companion'), status: status, presence: WL.PartyFollowerSystem.statusPresence(status), loyalty: 'unknown_evidence_only', lastKnownPlace: WL.U.safeString(d.lastKnownPlace || ''), joinedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, evidence: [], sourceKeys: [] };
        root.partyFollowers.membersById[id] = rec;
        if (root.partyFollowers.memberIds.indexOf(id) < 0) root.partyFollowers.memberIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.role = WL.U.safeString(d.role || rec.role || 'companion');
      rec.status = status;
      rec.presence = WL.PartyFollowerSystem.statusPresence(status);
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || rec.updatedTurn || 0;
      if (d.lastKnownPlace) rec.lastKnownPlace = WL.U.safeString(d.lastKnownPlace);
      if (ledger && ledger.key && rec.sourceKeys.indexOf(ledger.key) < 0) rec.sourceKeys.push(ledger.key);
      rec.evidence.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: d.partyAction || 'party_status', status: status, phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 10); WL.U.capArray(rec.sourceKeys, 10); WL.U.capArray(root.partyFollowers.memberIds, 40);
      root.partyFollowers.statusLog.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, memberId: id, name: name, status: status, presence: rec.presence, key: ledger.key });
      root.partyFollowers.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: d.partyAction || 'party_status', memberId: id, status: status, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.partyFollowers.statusLog, 120); WL.U.capArray(root.partyFollowers.recent, 80);
      WL.PartyFollowerSystem.rebuildStatusIndex(root);
      if (root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets) && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('party') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('party');
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'partyFollower', type: p.type, memberId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.PartyFollowerSystem.ensure(root); WL.PartyFollowerSystem.rebuildStatusIndex(root);
      var ids = root.partyFollowers.memberIds || [];
      if (!ids.length) return ['Party: (none confirmed; generic helpers stay scene-only)'];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < (max || 5); i++) {
        var rec = root.partyFollowers.membersById[ids[i]];
        if (rec) parts.push(rec.name + ' [' + rec.role + '; ' + rec.status + '; ' + rec.presence + ']');
      }
      return ['Party: ' + parts.join(' | ')];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      WL.PartyFollowerSystem.ensure(root); WL.PartyFollowerSystem.rebuildStatusIndex(root);
      var lines = [WL.PartyFollowerSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]];
      var ids = root.partyFollowers.memberIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && lines.length < (max || 24); i++) {
        var rec = root.partyFollowers.membersById[ids[i]];
        if (rec) lines.push('- ' + rec.name + ': ' + rec.role + ', ' + rec.status + ', ' + rec.presence + (rec.lastKnownPlace ? ', at ' + rec.lastKnownPlace : '') + ' [loyalty: ' + WL.U.safeString(rec.loyalty || 'unknown') + ']');
      }
      if (root.partyFollowers.denied.length) lines.push('Denied scene-only/nonconfirmed party claims: ' + root.partyFollowers.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // Owner note: SummonSystem owns temporary or bound summoned entities. It must not create party members, pets/mounts/vehicles, inventory, XP, stats, or automatic combat outcomes.
  WL.SummonSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.summons || typeof root.summons !== 'object') root.summons = WL.Schema.root().summons;
      if (!root.summons.summonsById || typeof root.summons.summonsById !== 'object') root.summons.summonsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.summons.summonIds)) root.summons.summonIds = [];
      if (!root.summons.byStatus || typeof root.summons.byStatus !== 'object') root.summons.byStatus = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.summons.controlLog)) root.summons.controlLog = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.summons.denied)) root.summons.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.summons.recent)) root.summons.recent = [];
      if (!root.summons.capacity || typeof root.summons.capacity !== 'object') root.summons.capacity = { activeLimit: 3 };
      root.summons.capacity.activeLimit = WL.U.clamp(root.summons.capacity.activeLimit || 3, 1, 12);
      if (typeof root.summons.lastSyncHash !== 'string') root.summons.lastSyncHash = '';
      return root.summons;
    },
    summonId: function (name) { return 'summon_' + WL.U.slug(name || 'unknown'); },
    normalizeStatus: function (status) {
      status = WL.U.lower(status || 'active');
      if (/dismiss|release/.test(status)) return 'dismissed';
      if (/fade|expire|end|gone/.test(status)) return 'expired';
      if (/uncontrol|lost/.test(status)) return 'uncontrolled';
      if (/dead|killed|destroyed/.test(status)) return 'dead';
      if (/bound|active|present|summoned/.test(status)) return 'active';
      return 'active';
    },
    statusPresence: function (status) {
      status = WL.SummonSystem.normalizeStatus(status);
      return (status === 'active' || status === 'uncontrolled') ? 'present' : 'absent';
    },
    activeCount: function (root) {
      WL.SummonSystem.ensure(root);
      var count = 0;
      var ids = root.summons.summonIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var rec = root.summons.summonsById[ids[i]];
        if (rec && WL.SummonSystem.normalizeStatus(rec.status) === 'active') count++;
      }
      return count;
    },
    rebuildStatusIndex: function (root) {
      WL.SummonSystem.ensure(root);
      root.summons.byStatus = {};
      var ids = root.summons.summonIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var rec = root.summons.summonsById[ids[i]];
        if (!rec) continue;
        var st = WL.SummonSystem.normalizeStatus(rec.status);
        if (!root.summons.byStatus[st]) root.summons.byStatus[st] = [];
        if (root.summons.byStatus[st].indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.summons.byStatus[st].push(rec.id);
      }
      return root.summons.byStatus;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (!p || p.type !== 'summon_candidate') return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_summon_event' };
      WL.SummonSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = p.data || {};
      if (d.denied) {
        root.summons.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: d.reason || 'not_confirmed_summon_evidence', summonName: WL.U.safeString(d.summonName || ''), phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.summons.denied, 80);
        root.summons.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: 'denied', reason: d.reason || '', name: WL.U.safeString(d.summonName || ''), key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.summons.recent, 80);
        return { status: 'DENIED_RECORDED', applied: true, family: 'summon', type: 'summon_candidate', reason: d.reason || 'denied', key: ledger.key };
      }
      var name = WL.U.title(d.summonName || d.actorName || 'Unknown Summon');
      if (!name || /^(?:You|Your|Everyone|Everybody|Someone|Something|Army|Horde|Legion|Summon)$/i.test(name)) {
        root.summons.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: 'generic_or_overbroad_summon_name', summonName: name, phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.summons.denied, 80);
        return { status: 'DENIED_RECORDED', applied: true, family: 'summon', type: 'summon_candidate', reason: 'generic_or_overbroad_summon_name', key: ledger.key };
      }
      var status = WL.SummonSystem.normalizeStatus(d.status || 'active');
      var id = d.targetId || WL.SummonSystem.summonId(name);
      var rec = root.summons.summonsById[id];
      if (!rec && status === 'active' && WL.SummonSystem.activeCount(root) >= root.summons.capacity.activeLimit) {
        root.summons.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: 'summon_capacity_limit', summonName: name, phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.summons.denied, 80);
        return { status: 'DENIED_RECORDED', applied: true, family: 'summon', type: 'summon_candidate', reason: 'summon_capacity_limit', key: ledger.key };
      }
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, actorId: 'actor_' + WL.U.slug(name), name: name, summonKind: WL.U.safeString(d.summonKind || 'summon'), controller: WL.U.safeString(d.controller || 'player'), duration: WL.U.safeString(d.duration || ''), expiresAtNote: WL.U.safeString(d.expiresAtNote || ''), status: status, controlState: WL.U.safeString(d.controlState || 'controlled_evidence'), loyalty: WL.U.safeString(d.loyalty || 'bound_or_unknown'), presence: WL.SummonSystem.statusPresence(status), createdTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, evidence: [], sourceKeys: [] };
        root.summons.summonsById[id] = rec;
        if (root.summons.summonIds.indexOf(id) < 0) root.summons.summonIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.name = name;
      rec.summonKind = WL.U.safeString(d.summonKind || rec.summonKind || 'summon');
      rec.controller = WL.U.safeString(d.controller || rec.controller || 'player');
      rec.duration = WL.U.safeString(d.duration || rec.duration || '');
      rec.expiresAtNote = WL.U.safeString(d.expiresAtNote || rec.expiresAtNote || '');
      rec.status = status;
      rec.controlState = WL.U.safeString(d.controlState || rec.controlState || 'controlled_evidence');
      rec.loyalty = WL.U.safeString(d.loyalty || rec.loyalty || 'bound_or_unknown');
      rec.presence = WL.SummonSystem.statusPresence(status);
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || 0;
      rec.evidence.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, phrase: p.textPreview || '', status: status, controlState: rec.controlState, key: ledger.key });
      if (rec.sourceKeys.indexOf(ledger.key) < 0) rec.sourceKeys.push(ledger.key);
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 10); WL.U.capArray(rec.sourceKeys, 10); WL.U.capArray(root.summons.summonIds, 40);
      root.summons.controlLog.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, summonId: id, name: name, status: status, controlState: rec.controlState, presence: rec.presence, key: ledger.key });
      root.summons.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: d.summonAction || 'summon_status', summonId: id, status: status, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.summons.controlLog, 120); WL.U.capArray(root.summons.recent, 80);
      WL.SummonSystem.rebuildStatusIndex(root);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'summon', type: 'summon_candidate', summonId: id, summonName: name, summonStatus: status, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.SummonSystem.ensure(root); WL.SummonSystem.rebuildStatusIndex(root);
      var ids = root.summons.summonIds || [];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < (max || 5); i++) {
        var rec = root.summons.summonsById[ids[i]];
        if (!rec) continue;
        var detail = rec.name + ' [' + rec.status + (rec.duration ? ', ' + rec.duration : '') + ']';
        parts.push(detail);
      }
      return ['Summons: ' + (parts.join(', ') || '(none)') + ' | Denied: ' + (root.summons.denied.length || 0)];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      WL.SummonSystem.ensure(root); WL.SummonSystem.rebuildStatusIndex(root);
      var lines = [WL.SummonSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]];
      var ids = root.summons.summonIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && i < (max || 20); i++) {
        var rec = root.summons.summonsById[ids[i]];
        if (!rec) continue;
        lines.push('- ' + rec.name + ': ' + rec.status + ' | controller ' + (rec.controller || 'unknown') + ' | control ' + (rec.controlState || 'unknown') + (rec.duration ? ' | duration ' + rec.duration : '') + (rec.expiresAtNote ? ' | expires ' + rec.expiresAtNote : ''));
      }
      if (root.summons.denied.length) lines.push('Denied nonconfirmed/overbroad summon claims: ' + root.summons.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: ControlledEntitySystem owns pets, mounts, and vehicles. It must not create party members, summons, inventory items, XP, stats, or automatic outcomes.
  WL.ControlledEntitySystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.controlledEntities || typeof root.controlledEntities !== 'object') root.controlledEntities = WL.Schema.root().controlledEntities;
      if (!root.controlledEntities.entitiesById || typeof root.controlledEntities.entitiesById !== 'object') root.controlledEntities.entitiesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.controlledEntities.entityIds)) root.controlledEntities.entityIds = [];
      if (!root.controlledEntities.byKind || typeof root.controlledEntities.byKind !== 'object') root.controlledEntities.byKind = {};
      if (!root.controlledEntities.byStatus || typeof root.controlledEntities.byStatus !== 'object') root.controlledEntities.byStatus = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.controlledEntities.custodyLog)) root.controlledEntities.custodyLog = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.controlledEntities.conditionLog)) root.controlledEntities.conditionLog = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.controlledEntities.denied)) root.controlledEntities.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.controlledEntities.recent)) root.controlledEntities.recent = [];
      if (typeof root.controlledEntities.lastSyncHash !== 'string') root.controlledEntities.lastSyncHash = '';
      return root.controlledEntities;
    },
    entityId: function (kind, name) { return 'controlled_' + WL.U.slug(kind || 'entity') + '_' + WL.U.slug(name || 'unknown'); },
    cleanEntityName: function (name) {
      var n = WL.U.norm(name || '');
      n = n.replace(/\b(?:bolts?|runs? away|ran away|escapes?|escaped|disappears?|disappeared|is lost|was lost|is|was|becomes?|became|damaged|broken|wrecked|injured|hurt|lame|tired|exhausted)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      n = n.replace(/\s+(?:and|or|but)$/i, '');
      return WL.U.title(n);
    },
    normalizeKind: function (kind, name) {
      var k = WL.U.lower(kind || ''); var n = WL.U.lower(name || '');
      if (/vehicle|wagon|cart|carriage|boat|ship|raft|sled|sledge|coach/.test(k + ' ' + n)) return 'vehicle';
      if (/mount|horse|pony|mule|donkey|camel|griffon|riding|steed/.test(k + ' ' + n)) return 'mount';
      if (/pet|hound|dog|cat|wolf|hawk|falcon|familiar/.test(k + ' ' + n)) return 'pet';
      return k || 'controlled';
    },
    normalizeStatus: function (status) {
      var s = WL.U.lower(status || 'controlled');
      if (/lost|missing|bolted|escaped|gone|stolen/.test(s)) return 'lost';
      if (/rented|leased|borrowed/.test(s)) return 'rented';
      if (/released|sold|returned|dismissed/.test(s)) return 'released';
      if (/destroyed|dead|wrecked/.test(s)) return 'destroyed';
      return 'controlled';
    },
    normalizeCondition: function (condition) {
      var c = WL.U.lower(condition || 'sound');
      if (/broken|wreck|destroy/.test(c)) return 'broken';
      if (/damage|injur|hurt|wounded|limp|cracked/.test(c)) return 'damaged';
      if (/repair|fixed|mended|healed/.test(c)) return 'repaired';
      if (/tired|exhaust|fatigue/.test(c)) return 'tired';
      return 'sound';
    },
    travelCapability: function (kind, name) {
      kind = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.normalizeKind(kind, name);
      if (kind === 'mount') return 'riding_or_pack_travel_evidence_only';
      if (kind === 'vehicle') return 'cargo_or_group_travel_evidence_only';
      if (kind === 'pet') return 'companion_animal_evidence_only';
      return 'controlled_entity_evidence_only';
    },
    findExistingSummonId: function (root, name) {
      if (!root.summons || !root.summons.summonsById) return '';
      var slug = WL.U.slug(name || ''); var ids = root.summons.summonIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var rec = root.summons.summonsById[ids[i]];
        if (rec && WL.U.slug(rec.name || '') === slug) return rec.id;
      }
      return '';
    },
    rebuildIndexes: function (root) {
      WL.ControlledEntitySystem.ensure(root);
      root.controlledEntities.byKind = {}; root.controlledEntities.byStatus = {};
      var ids = root.controlledEntities.entityIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var rec = root.controlledEntities.entitiesById[ids[i]];
        if (!rec) continue;
        var kind = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.normalizeKind(rec.kind, rec.name);
        var status = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.normalizeStatus(rec.status);
        if (!root.controlledEntities.byKind[kind]) root.controlledEntities.byKind[kind] = [];
        if (!root.controlledEntities.byStatus[status]) root.controlledEntities.byStatus[status] = [];
        if (root.controlledEntities.byKind[kind].indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.controlledEntities.byKind[kind].push(rec.id);
        if (root.controlledEntities.byStatus[status].indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.controlledEntities.byStatus[status].push(rec.id);
      }
      return root.controlledEntities;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (!p || p.type !== 'controlled_entity_candidate') return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_controlled_entity_event' };
      WL.ControlledEntitySystem.ensure(root);
      var d = p.data || {};
      if (d.denied) {
        root.controlledEntities.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: d.reason || 'not_confirmed_controlled_entity_evidence', entityName: WL.U.safeString(d.entityName || ''), kind: WL.U.safeString(d.kind || ''), phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.denied, 100);
        root.controlledEntities.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: 'denied', reason: d.reason || '', name: WL.U.safeString(d.entityName || ''), key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.recent, 100);
        return { status: 'DENIED_RECORDED', applied: true, family: 'controlledEntity', type: p.type, reason: d.reason || 'denied', key: ledger.key };
      }
      var name = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.cleanEntityName(d.entityName || d.targetName || 'Unknown Controlled Entity');
      if (!name || /^(?:You|Your|Everyone|Everybody|Someone|Something|Army|Horde|Legion|Entity)$/i.test(name)) {
        root.controlledEntities.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: 'generic_or_overbroad_controlled_entity_name', entityName: name, phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.denied, 100);
        return { status: 'DENIED_RECORDED', applied: true, family: 'controlledEntity', type: p.type, reason: 'generic_or_overbroad_controlled_entity_name', key: ledger.key };
      }
      var kind = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.normalizeKind(d.kind || d.entityKind, name);
      var relatedSummonId = d.relatedSummonId || WL.ControlledEntitySystem.findExistingSummonId(root, name);
      if (relatedSummonId && !/permanent|settles|ordinary|natural|stays after/i.test(p.textPreview || '')) {
        root.controlledEntities.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: 'summon_not_pet_mount_vehicle_without_persistence_confirmation', entityName: name, relatedSummonId: relatedSummonId, phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.denied, 100);
        return { status: 'DENIED_RECORDED', applied: true, family: 'controlledEntity', type: p.type, reason: 'summon_boundary_not_persistent_entity', key: ledger.key };
      }
      var id = d.targetId || WL.ControlledEntitySystem.entityId(kind, name);
      var rec = root.controlledEntities.entitiesById[id];
      var status = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.normalizeStatus(d.status || (rec && rec.status) || 'controlled');
      var condition = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.normalizeCondition(d.condition || (rec && rec.condition) || 'sound');
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, actorId: 'actor_' + WL.U.slug(name), name: name, kind: kind, status: status, custody: WL.U.safeString(d.custody || (status === 'rented' ? 'rented' : 'controlled')), condition: condition, travelCapability: WL.ControlledEntitySystem.travelCapability(kind, name), owner: WL.U.safeString(d.owner || 'player'), rental: status === 'rented' || d.action === 'rent', sourceKind: WL.U.safeString(d.sourceKind || d.action || 'controlled_entity_evidence'), relatedSummonId: relatedSummonId || '', relatedPartyId: d.relatedPartyId || '', updatedTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, createdTurn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, evidence: [], sourceKeys: [] };
        root.controlledEntities.entitiesById[id] = rec;
        if (root.controlledEntities.entityIds.indexOf(id) < 0) root.controlledEntities.entityIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.name = name;
      rec.kind = kind;
      rec.status = status;
      rec.custody = WL.U.safeString(d.custody || rec.custody || (status === 'rented' ? 'rented' : 'controlled'));
      rec.condition = condition;
      rec.travelCapability = WL.ControlledEntitySystem.travelCapability(kind, name);
      rec.owner = WL.U.safeString(d.owner || rec.owner || 'player');
      rec.rental = !!(rec.rental || status === 'rented' || d.action === 'rent');
      rec.relatedSummonId = relatedSummonId || rec.relatedSummonId || '';
      rec.updatedTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || 0;
      if (d.note) rec.note = WL.U.safeString(d.note);
      if (ledger && ledger.key && rec.sourceKeys.indexOf(ledger.key) < 0) rec.sourceKeys.push(ledger.key);
      rec.evidence.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: d.action || 'controlled_entity_status', status: status, condition: condition, phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 12); WL.U.capArray(rec.sourceKeys, 12); WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.entityIds, 80);
      root.controlledEntities.custodyLog.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, entityId: id, name: name, kind: kind, status: status, custody: rec.custody, key: ledger.key });
      if (d.condition || /damage|repair|broken|hurt|injur|tired|wreck/i.test(p.textPreview || '')) root.controlledEntities.conditionLog.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, entityId: id, name: name, condition: condition, phrase: p.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
      root.controlledEntities.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, action: d.action || 'controlled_entity_status', entityId: id, kind: kind, status: status, condition: condition, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.custodyLog, 160); WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.conditionLog, 160); WL.U.capArray(root.controlledEntities.recent, 100);
      WL.ControlledEntitySystem.rebuildIndexes(root);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'controlledEntity', type: p.type, entityId: id, entityKind: kind, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.ControlledEntitySystem.ensure(root); WL.ControlledEntitySystem.rebuildIndexes(root);
      var ids = root.controlledEntities.entityIds || [];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < (max || 5); i++) {
        var rec = root.controlledEntities.entitiesById[ids[i]];
        if (rec) parts.push(rec.name + ' [' + rec.kind + '; ' + rec.status + '; ' + rec.condition + ']');
      }
      return ['Controlled: ' + (parts.join(' | ') || '(none)') + ' | Denied: ' + (root.controlledEntities.denied.length || 0)];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      WL.ControlledEntitySystem.ensure(root); WL.ControlledEntitySystem.rebuildIndexes(root);
      var lines = [WL.ControlledEntitySystem.summary(root, 8)[0]];
      var ids = root.controlledEntities.entityIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && i < (max || 28); i++) {
        var rec = root.controlledEntities.entitiesById[ids[i]];
        if (!rec) continue;
        lines.push('- ' + rec.name + ': ' + rec.kind + ', ' + rec.status + ', ' + rec.condition + ' | custody ' + (rec.custody || 'controlled') + ' | travel ' + (rec.travelCapability || 'evidence-only') + (rec.relatedSummonId ? ' | summon boundary ' + rec.relatedSummonId : ''));
      }
      if (root.controlledEntities.denied.length) lines.push('Denied nonconfirmed/overbroad controlled-entity claims: ' + root.controlledEntities.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: FormTransformationSystem owns true/current form separation, disguise, illusion, injuries, and conditions.
  WL.FormTransformationSystem = {
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'dream_form_candidate' || p.type === 'vision_form_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.recordNonCanon(root, p, ledger, 'dream_or_vision_not_true_form');
      if (p.type === 'illusion_form_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.setIllusion(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'disguise_form_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.setDisguise(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'temporary_form_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.setTemporary(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'permanent_form_candidate' || p.type === 'race_shift_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.setPermanent(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'body_trait_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.addBodyTrait(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'body_injury_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.addInjury(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'body_condition_candidate') return WL.FormTransformationSystem.addCondition(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_form_event' };
    },
    record: function (root, kind, target, key, phrase) {
      var rec = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, kind: kind, target: WL.U.title(target || ''), key: key, phrase: phrase || '' };
      root.body.formHistory.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(root.body.formHistory, 30); return rec;
    },
    recordNonCanon: function (root, proposal, ledger, reason) {
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, reason, proposal.data.targetForm || '', ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: 'RECORDED_NON_CANON', applied: false, family: 'form', type: proposal.type, targetForm: proposal.data.targetForm || '', key: ledger.key };
    },
    setIllusion: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      root.body.activeIllusion = WL.U.title(proposal.data.targetForm || '');
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, 'illusion_only', root.body.activeIllusion, ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'form', type: 'illusion', targetForm: root.body.activeIllusion, key: ledger.key };
    },
    setDisguise: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      root.body.activeDisguise = WL.U.title(proposal.data.targetForm || '');
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, 'disguise_only', root.body.activeDisguise, ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'form', type: 'disguise', targetForm: root.body.activeDisguise, key: ledger.key };
    },
    setTemporary: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      root.body.temporaryForm = WL.U.title(proposal.data.targetForm || '');
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, 'temporary_form', root.body.temporaryForm, ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'form', type: 'temporary', targetForm: root.body.temporaryForm, key: ledger.key };
    },
    setPermanent: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var form = WL.U.title(proposal.data.targetForm || 'Unknown');
      root.player.currentForm = form;
      root.player.raceSpecies = form;
      root.player.trueRace = form;
      root.body.temporaryForm = '';
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, 'permanent_form', form, ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'form', type: 'permanent', targetForm: form, key: ledger.key };
    },
    addBodyTrait: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var trait = WL.U.title(proposal.data.trait || proposal.data.targetForm || 'Unknown Trait');
      var id = 'trait_' + WL.U.slug(trait);
      var exists = root.body.bodyTraits.some(function (t) { return t.id === id; });
      if (!exists) root.body.bodyTraits.push({ id: id, name: trait, source: 'confirmed_body_change', key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.body.bodyTraits, 30);
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, 'body_trait', trait, ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: exists ? 'DUPLICATE_TRAIT_SKIPPED' : 'APPLIED', applied: !exists, family: 'form', type: 'body_trait', trait: trait, key: ledger.key };
    },
    cleanInjuryName: function (value, location, phrase) {
      var raw = WL.U.norm(value || '');
      var loc = WL.U.norm(location || '');
      var text = WL.U.lower((raw + ' ' + loc + ' ' + (phrase || '')).slice(0, 500));
      if (/\b(?:street noise|noise|silence|air|crowd|attention|conversation|voice|whistle|sound|words?|thought|memory|idea|rumou?r|vision|dream)\b/.test(text)) return '';
      if (/\b(?:calves?|calf)\b/.test(text) && /\b(?:wound|injur|throb|ache|pain|aggravat)\b/.test(text)) return 'Old Calf Wound';
      raw = raw.replace(/^(?:begins?\s+(?:in|to)|through\s+the|into\s+the|across\s+the)\s+/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:begins?|starts?)\s+to\s+(?:throb|ache|hurt|burn)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:noise|silence|air|crowd|attention|voice|whistle|sound)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\s+(?:and|while|as|because|when|before|after)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = WL.U.norm(raw).replace(/^(?:your|the|a|an)\s+/i, '');
      if (!raw && loc) raw = loc + ' wound';
      if (!/\b(?:wound|cut|burn|bite|bruise|sprain|break|fracture|crack|poison|injur|ribs?)\b/i.test(raw)) raw = raw + ' wound';
      raw = WL.U.title(raw);
      if (/^(?:Wound|Injury|Through|Begins|Noise|Air|Street Noise|The Street Noise Wound)$/i.test(raw)) return '';
      if (/\b(?:Street Noise|Noise|Silence|Air|Whistle|Sound)\b/i.test(raw)) return '';
      return raw.slice(0, 80);
    },
    mergeSeverity: function (oldSev, newSev) {
      var rank = { minor: 1, moderate: 2, severe: 3, fatal: 4 };
      return (rank[newSev] || 1) > (rank[oldSev] || 1) ? newSev : (oldSev || newSev || 'minor');
    },
    addInjury: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var sev = proposal.data.severity || 'minor';
      var injuryName = WL.FormTransformationSystem.cleanInjuryName(proposal.data.injury || '', proposal.data.location || '', proposal.textPreview || '');
      if (!injuryName) {
        WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, 'false_injury_rejected', proposal.data.injury || '', ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
        return { status: 'REJECTED_FALSE_INJURY', applied: false, family: 'form', type: 'body_injury', hp: root.body.hp, ep: root.body.ep, key: ledger.key };
      }
      var damage = proposal.data.hpDamage;
      if (damage == null) damage = sev === 'severe' ? 16 : (sev === 'moderate' ? 8 : 4);
      damage = WL.U.clamp(damage, 0, 999);
      var slug = WL.U.slug(injuryName);
      var existing = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < root.body.injuries.length; i++) if (WL.U.slug(root.body.injuries[i].name || '') === slug) existing = root.body.injuries[i];
      var inj;
      if (existing) {
        existing.severity = WL.FormTransformationSystem.mergeSeverity(existing.severity, sev);
        existing.status = 'active';
        existing.key = ledger.key;
        existing.phrase = proposal.textPreview;
        existing.hpDamage = Math.max(Number(existing.hpDamage || 0), damage);
        if (/aggravat|throb|ache|pain/i.test(proposal.textPreview || '')) existing.aggravated = true;
        inj = existing;
      } else {
        inj = { id: 'injury_' + WL.U.slug(injuryName), name: injuryName, location: proposal.data.location || '', severity: sev, hpDamage: damage, status: 'active', key: ledger.key, phrase: proposal.textPreview, aggravated: /aggravat|throb|ache|pain/i.test(proposal.textPreview || '') };
        root.body.injuries.push(inj);
      }
      if (damage > 0) root.body.hp = Math.max(0, root.body.hp - damage);
      if (root.body.hpTrack && typeof root.body.hpTrack === 'object') root.body.hpTrack.current = root.body.hp;
      WL.U.capArray(root.body.injuries, 40);
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, damage > 0 ? 'body_injury' : 'body_injury_note', inj.name, ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: existing ? 'UPDATED_EXISTING_INJURY' : 'APPLIED', applied: !existing || damage > 0, family: 'form', type: 'body_injury', injuryId: inj.id, severity: inj.severity, hp: root.body.hp, ep: root.body.ep, key: ledger.key };
    },
    addCondition: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var name = WL.U.title(proposal.data.condition || 'condition');
      if (/^(?:dead|death|dying)$/i.test(name)) {
        root.body.deathBoundary = 'dead';
        root.body.hp = 0;
        if (root.body.hpTrack && typeof root.body.hpTrack === 'object') root.body.hpTrack.current = 0;
      }
      var hpDamage = WL.U.clamp(proposal.data.hpDamage || 0, 0, 999);
      var epDamage = WL.U.clamp(proposal.data.epDamage || 0, 0, 999);
      if (/^(?:winded|tired|fatigued|exhausted|strained)$/i.test(name)) hpDamage = 0;
      var cond = { id: 'condition_' + WL.U.slug(name), name: name, severity: proposal.data.severity || (/^(?:dead|death)$/i.test(name) ? 'fatal' : 'minor'), duration: proposal.data.duration || '', epDamage: epDamage, hpDamage: hpDamage, status: 'active', key: ledger.key, phrase: proposal.textPreview };
      var existing = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < root.body.conditions.length; i++) if (root.body.conditions[i].id === cond.id) existing = root.body.conditions[i];
      if (!existing) root.body.conditions.push(cond);
      else {
        existing.severity = WL.FormTransformationSystem.mergeSeverity(existing.severity, cond.severity);
        existing.duration = cond.duration || existing.duration;
        existing.key = ledger.key;
        existing.phrase = proposal.textPreview;
        existing.epDamage = Math.max(Number(existing.epDamage || 0), epDamage);
        existing.hpDamage = Math.max(Number(existing.hpDamage || 0), hpDamage);
      }
      if (hpDamage > 0) root.body.hp = Math.max(0, root.body.hp - hpDamage);
      if (epDamage > 0) root.body.ep = Math.max(0, root.body.ep - epDamage);
      if (root.body.hpTrack && typeof root.body.hpTrack === 'object') root.body.hpTrack.current = root.body.hp;
      if (root.body.epTrack && typeof root.body.epTrack === 'object') root.body.epTrack.current = root.body.ep;
      WL.U.capArray(root.body.conditions, 40);
      WL.FormTransformationSystem.record(root, 'body_condition', name, ledger.key, proposal.textPreview);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'form', type: 'body_condition', conditionId: cond.id, condition: name, hp: root.body.hp, ep: root.body.ep, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var lines = [];
      lines.push('True Race: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.trueRace || root.player.raceSpecies || 'unknown'));
      lines.push('Current Form: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.currentForm || 'unknown'));
      lines.push('Disguise: ' + (root.body.activeDisguise || '(none)'));
