      lines.push('Illusion: ' + (root.body.activeIllusion || '(none)'));
      lines.push('Temporary Form: ' + (root.body.temporaryForm || '(none)'));
      lines.push('Body Traits: ' + (root.body.bodyTraits.length ? root.body.bodyTraits.map(function (t) { return t.name; }).join(', ') : '(none)'));
      lines.push('Injuries: ' + (root.body.injuries.length ? root.body.injuries.map(function (i) { return i.name + ' [' + i.severity + ']'; }).join(', ') : '(none)'));
      lines.push('Conditions: ' + (root.body.conditions.length ? root.body.conditions.map(function (c) { return c.name + ' [' + c.severity + ']'; }).join(', ') : '(none)'));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // 06C. [WL-OWNERS] Ability lifecycle / progression / cost systems

  // ============================================================
  // Owner note: AbilityCostSystem estimates and hardens costs; passives have no activation cost.
  WL.AbilityCostSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.abilityCosts || typeof root.abilityCosts !== 'object') root.abilityCosts = WL.Schema.root().abilityCosts;
      ['costIds', 'recent'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(root.abilityCosts[k])) root.abilityCosts[k] = []; });
      ['costsById', 'historyByAbilityId', 'estimatesById', 'confirmedById', 'overchargeRisksById', 'observationsByCostId', 'developmentByAbilityId'].forEach(function (k) { if (!root.abilityCosts[k] || typeof root.abilityCosts[k] !== 'object') root.abilityCosts[k] = {}; });
      root.abilityCosts.matrixVersion = '9.4C';
    },
    classifyDomain: function (name) {
      var n = WL.U.lower(name);
      var out = [];
      if (/fire|flame|ember|burn|inferno|pyro/.test(n)) out.push('fire');
      if (/spell|magic|mana|fireball|ward|arcane|rune|shadow|lightning|heal|aether|aeth|sorcery|curse/.test(n)) out.push('magic');
      if (/summon|conjure|call|familiar|spirit|bound|minion|pet|servitor|raise/.test(n)) out.push('summoning');
      if (/sword|blade|slash|duel|parry|riposte/.test(n)) out.push('swordsmanship');
      if (/box|punch|fist|martial|kick|palm|stance|guard/.test(n)) out.push('martial');
      if (/inspect|investigat|search|perceiv|study|analysis|sense/.test(n)) out.push('investigation');
      if (/regen|recover|heal|mend/.test(n)) out.push('healing');
      if (!out.length) out.push('general');
      return out;
    },
    parseCostNumbers: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      var cost = { mp: null, ep: null, hpRisk: null, focus: null, materials: [], cooldown: '', upkeep: null, raw: WL.U.norm(text || '') };
      function each(re, cb) { var m; while ((m = re.exec(t))) cb(m); }
      each(/(\d{1,4})\s*(?:mp|mana|magicka)/g, function (m) { cost.mp = Math.max(cost.mp || 0, Number(m[1])); });
      each(/(\d{1,4})\s*(?:ep|stamina|energy|exertion)/g, function (m) { cost.ep = Math.max(cost.ep || 0, Number(m[1])); });
      each(/(\d{1,4})\s*(?:hp|health|blood|life force|lifeforce)/g, function (m) { cost.hpRisk = Math.max(cost.hpRisk || 0, Number(m[1])); });
      each(/(\d{1,4})\s*(?:focus|concentration)/g, function (m) { cost.focus = Math.max(cost.focus || 0, Number(m[1])); });
      var up = t.match(/(?:upkeep|maintain|maintenance)[^\d]{0,30}(\d{1,4})\s*(mp|mana|ep|stamina|energy|hp|health)/i);
      if (up) cost.upkeep = { amount: Number(up[1]), resource: /mp|mana/.test(up[2]) ? 'MP' : (/hp|health/.test(up[2]) ? 'HP' : 'EP') };
      var cd = t.match(/(?:cooldown|recharge|cannot use again for)\s+(\d{1,3}\s+(?:turns?|minutes?|hours?))/i);
      if (cd) cost.cooldown = cd[1];
      var mat = t.match(/(?:requires?|consumes?|uses?)\s+([^.!?;]{2,80}?)(?:\s+as\s+material|\s+component|\s+components|\s+to\s+cast|[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (mat && !/\b(?:mp|mana|ep|stamina|energy|hp|health|focus)\b/i.test(mat[1])) cost.materials = [WL.U.title(mat[1])];
      return cost;
    },
    parseExplicitCostClause: function (clause) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var m = c.match(/\b(?:casting|using|activating|performing|maintaining|summoning)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)\s+(?:costs?|uses?|drains?|requires?)\s+([^.!?;]{2,160})/i);
      if (!m) m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)\s+(?:costs?|uses?|drains?|requires?)\s+([^.!?;]{2,160})\s+(?:to\s+(?:cast|use|activate|perform|maintain|summon)|when\s+(?:cast|used|activated|performed|maintained)|per\s+use)?/i);
      if (!m) return null;
      var name = WL.EventScanner && WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName ? WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]) : WL.U.title(m[1]);
      if (!name || /^(?:This|That|It|The Skill|The Spell|Ability)$/i.test(name)) return null;
      var parsed = WL.AbilityCostSystem.parseCostNumbers(m[2]);
      if (parsed.mp == null && parsed.ep == null && parsed.hpRisk == null && parsed.focus == null && !parsed.materials.length && !parsed.cooldown && !parsed.upkeep) return null;
      parsed.abilityName = name;
      return parsed;
    },
    matrixFactors: function (root, abilityName, category, detail) {
      var name = WL.U.title(abilityName || 'Unknown Ability');
      var cat = WL.U.lower(category || 'ability');
      var domains = WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name);
      var words = WL.U.lower((detail && (detail.words || detail.textPreview || detail.detail)) || name);
      var scale = 'standard';
      if (/city|army|massive|huge|giant|storm|wide area|battlefield|domain|kingdom|hundreds|thousands/.test(words)) scale = 'huge';
      else if (/area|group|room|large|wall|building|dozens|cone|wave|burst/.test(words)) scale = 'large';
      else if (/minor|small|spark|flicker|simple|brief/.test(words)) scale = 'minor';
      var mp = 0, ep = 0, hpRisk = 0, focus = 0, time = 'action', cooldown = '', upkeep = null;
      if (cat === 'passive') { time = 'always-on/conditional'; }
      else if (domains.indexOf('magic') >= 0 || domains.indexOf('fire') >= 0 || domains.indexOf('healing') >= 0) { mp = 10; ep = 1; focus = 1; }
      else if (domains.indexOf('summoning') >= 0) { mp = 14; ep = 2; focus = 2; upkeep = { amount: 2, resource: 'MP' }; }
      else if (domains.indexOf('swordsmanship') >= 0 || domains.indexOf('martial') >= 0) { ep = 5; }
      else { ep = 2; }
      if (/ward|shield|barrier|guard/.test(WL.U.lower(name))) { mp = Math.max(mp, 6); ep += 1; }
      if (/blood|life force|lifeforce|sacrifice|forbidden|necrom|death/.test(words + ' ' + WL.U.lower(name))) hpRisk = Math.max(hpRisk, 2);
      if (/ritual|chant|circle|complex|prepare/.test(words)) time = 'ritual/preparation';
      if (/instant|reflex|snap/.test(words)) time = 'reaction';
      var mult = scale === 'huge' ? 3 : (scale === 'large' ? 1.75 : (scale === 'minor' ? 0.5 : 1));
      mp = Math.ceil(mp * mult); ep = Math.ceil(ep * mult); hpRisk = Math.ceil(hpRisk * mult); focus = Math.ceil(focus * mult);
      var mastery = WL.ProgressionSystem && WL.ProgressionSystem.domainTotal ? WL.ProgressionSystem.domainTotal(root, domains) : 0;
      var fatiguePenalty = 0;
      if (root && root.body && root.body.conditions && root.body.conditions.some(function (c) { return /fatigue|tired|winded|exhaust/i.test(c.name || c.id || ''); })) fatiguePenalty = 1;
      if (root && root.body && root.body.injuries && root.body.injuries.length && (domains.indexOf('martial') >= 0 || domains.indexOf('swordsmanship') >= 0)) fatiguePenalty += 1;
      if (mastery >= 150) { mp = Math.max(mp > 0 ? 1 : 0, Math.floor(mp * 0.6)); ep = Math.max(ep > 0 ? 1 : 0, Math.floor(ep * 0.6)); focus = Math.max(focus > 0 ? 1 : 0, Math.floor(focus * 0.7)); }
      else if (mastery >= 50) { mp = Math.max(mp > 0 ? 1 : 0, Math.floor(mp * 0.75)); ep = Math.max(ep > 0 ? 1 : 0, Math.floor(ep * 0.75)); }
      ep += fatiguePenalty;
      var bodyDependency = /wing|claw|bite|tail|breath|orc|elf|dragon|gill|horn|fang/.test(WL.U.lower(name + ' ' + words));
      var environmentDependency = /rain|underwater|snow|wind|storm|dark|sunlight|moonlight|forest|desert|cave|city|holy ground/.test(words);
      return { name: name, category: cat, domains: domains, scale: scale, mp: mp, ep: ep, hpRisk: hpRisk, focus: focus, time: time, cooldown: cooldown, upkeep: upkeep, mastery: mastery, fatiguePenalty: fatiguePenalty, bodyDependency: bodyDependency, environmentDependency: environmentDependency };
    },
    costId: function (abilityName, category) { return 'cost_' + WL.U.slug((category || 'ability') + '_' + (abilityName || 'unknown')); },
    estimate: function (root, abilityName, category, detail) {
      WL.AbilityCostSystem.ensure(root);
      var name = WL.U.title(abilityName || 'Unknown Ability');
      var cat = WL.U.lower(category || 'ability');
      var id = WL.AbilityCostSystem.costId(name, cat);
      var factors = WL.AbilityCostSystem.matrixFactors(root, name, cat, { detail: detail || '', words: detail || '' });
      var rec = root.abilityCosts.costsById[id] || { id: id, abilityName: name, category: cat, confidence: 'rough_matrix', history: [], observations: [], developmentStage: 'inbox' };
      rec.activationCost = cat === 'passive' ? 'none' : 'matrix_estimate';
      rec.estimated = { mp: factors.mp, ep: factors.ep, hpRisk: factors.hpRisk, focus: factors.focus, time: factors.time, scale: factors.scale, upkeep: factors.upkeep, cooldown: factors.cooldown };
      if (rec.observed && rec.confidence && /observed|hardened/.test(rec.confidence)) {
        rec.mp = rec.observed.mp != null ? rec.observed.mp : factors.mp;
        rec.ep = rec.observed.ep != null ? rec.observed.ep : factors.ep;
        rec.hpRisk = rec.observed.hpRisk != null ? rec.observed.hpRisk : factors.hpRisk;
        rec.focus = rec.observed.focus != null ? rec.observed.focus : factors.focus;
      } else {
        rec.mp = factors.mp; rec.ep = factors.ep; rec.hpRisk = factors.hpRisk; rec.focus = factors.focus;
      }
      rec.time = factors.time;
      rec.domains = factors.domains;
      rec.scale = factors.scale;
      rec.upkeep = factors.upkeep;
      rec.cooldown = factors.cooldown;
      rec.matrixFactors = { mastery: factors.mastery, fatiguePenalty: factors.fatiguePenalty, bodyDependency: factors.bodyDependency, environmentDependency: factors.environmentDependency };
      rec.notes = cat === 'passive' ? ['Passives have no activation cost; related actions may still cost normal effort or upkeep.'] : ['9.4C matrix estimate. Explicit story costs and repeated observed use harden this record.'];
      rec.lastDetail = detail || '';
      rec.history.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, kind: 'estimate', mp: rec.mp, ep: rec.ep, hpRisk: rec.hpRisk, focus: rec.focus, confidence: rec.confidence, stage: rec.developmentStage });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 14);
      root.abilityCosts.costsById[id] = rec;
      if (root.abilityCosts.costIds.indexOf(id) < 0) root.abilityCosts.costIds.push(id);
      root.abilityCosts.estimatesById[id] = rec;
      root.abilityCosts.recent.push({ id: id, abilityName: name, category: cat, mp: rec.mp, ep: rec.ep, hpRisk: rec.hpRisk, confidence: rec.confidence, stage: rec.developmentStage });
      WL.U.capArray(root.abilityCosts.recent, 40);
      return rec;
    },
    observeUse: function (root, abilityName, detail) {
      detail = detail || {};
      var name = WL.U.title(abilityName || 'Unknown Ability');
      var category = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem && WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.categoryForName ? WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.categoryForName(root, name) : 'ability';
      var rec = WL.AbilityCostSystem.estimate(root, name, category, detail.textPreview || detail.kind || 'observed_use');
      rec.useCount = (rec.useCount || 0) + 1;
      if (detail.kind === 'training_evidence_candidate') rec.trainingCount = (rec.trainingCount || 0) + 1;
      if (detail.kind === 'failed_attempt_candidate') rec.failureCount = (rec.failureCount || 0) + 1;
      else rec.successCount = (rec.successCount || 0) + 1;
      rec.lastUse = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, kind: detail.kind || 'use', phrase: detail.textPreview || '', key: detail.key || '' };
      rec.observations = rec.observations || [];
      rec.observations.push(rec.lastUse);
      WL.U.capArray(rec.observations, 16);
      root.abilityCosts.observationsByCostId[rec.id] = rec.observations.slice();
      if (rec.useCount >= 6 && (rec.successCount || 0) >= 3) rec.confidence = 'hardened_observed';
      else if (rec.useCount >= 3) rec.confidence = 'observed';
      else if (!/observed|hardened/.test(rec.confidence || '')) rec.confidence = 'rough_matrix';
      rec.developmentStage = WL.AbilityDevelopmentMatrix.stageFor(rec, root, name);
      root.abilityCosts.developmentByAbilityId['ability_' + WL.U.slug(name)] = { abilityName: name, stage: rec.developmentStage, useCount: rec.useCount || 0, successCount: rec.successCount || 0, trainingCount: rec.trainingCount || 0, failureCount: rec.failureCount || 0, costId: rec.id };
      root.abilityCosts.costsById[rec.id] = rec;
      return rec;
    },
    recordExplicitObservation: function (root, abilityName, cost, detail) {
      WL.AbilityCostSystem.ensure(root);
      detail = detail || {};
      var name = WL.U.title(abilityName || cost.abilityName || 'Unknown Ability');
      var category = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem && WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.categoryForName ? WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.categoryForName(root, name) : 'ability';
      var rec = WL.AbilityCostSystem.estimate(root, name, category, 'explicit_story_cost');
      rec.observed = {
        mp: cost.mp != null ? cost.mp : rec.observed && rec.observed.mp,
        ep: cost.ep != null ? cost.ep : rec.observed && rec.observed.ep,
        hpRisk: cost.hpRisk != null ? cost.hpRisk : rec.observed && rec.observed.hpRisk,
        focus: cost.focus != null ? cost.focus : rec.observed && rec.observed.focus,
        materials: cost.materials || [], cooldown: cost.cooldown || rec.cooldown || '', upkeep: cost.upkeep || rec.upkeep || null
      };
      var hasExplicitResource = cost.mp != null || cost.ep != null || cost.hpRisk != null || cost.focus != null;
      if (hasExplicitResource) {
        rec.mp = cost.mp != null ? cost.mp : 0;
        rec.ep = cost.ep != null ? cost.ep : 0;
        rec.hpRisk = cost.hpRisk != null ? cost.hpRisk : 0;
        rec.focus = cost.focus != null ? cost.focus : (rec.focus || 0);
      }
      if (rec.observed.cooldown) rec.cooldown = rec.observed.cooldown;
      if (rec.observed.upkeep) rec.upkeep = rec.observed.upkeep;
      rec.confidence = rec.confidence === 'hardened_observed' ? rec.confidence : 'observed_story_cost';
      rec.activationCost = category === 'passive' ? 'none' : 'observed_story_cost';
      rec.observations = rec.observations || [];
      rec.observations.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, kind: 'explicit_cost', phrase: detail.textPreview || cost.raw || '', observed: WL.U.clone(rec.observed), key: detail.key || '' });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.observations, 16);
      root.abilityCosts.observationsByCostId[rec.id] = rec.observations.slice();
      rec.developmentStage = WL.AbilityDevelopmentMatrix.stageFor(rec, root, name);
      root.abilityCosts.developmentByAbilityId['ability_' + WL.U.slug(name)] = { abilityName: name, stage: rec.developmentStage, useCount: rec.useCount || 0, successCount: rec.successCount || 0, trainingCount: rec.trainingCount || 0, failureCount: rec.failureCount || 0, costId: rec.id };
      root.abilityCosts.confirmedById[rec.id] = rec;
      root.abilityCosts.costsById[rec.id] = rec;
      root.abilityCosts.recent.push({ id: rec.id, abilityName: name, explicit: true, mp: rec.mp, ep: rec.ep, hpRisk: rec.hpRisk, confidence: rec.confidence, stage: rec.developmentStage });
      WL.U.capArray(root.abilityCosts.recent, 40);
      return rec;
    },
    recordPressure: function (root, abilityName, detail) {
      WL.AbilityCostSystem.ensure(root);
      detail = detail || {};
      var name = WL.U.title(abilityName || 'Unknown Ability');
      var category = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem && WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.categoryForName ? WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.categoryForName(root, name) : 'ability';
      var rec = WL.AbilityCostSystem.observeUse(root, name, { kind: 'cost_pressure_candidate', textPreview: detail.textPreview || '', key: detail.key || '' });
      var words = WL.U.lower(detail.words || detail.textPreview || '');
      var hpRisk = detail.hpRisk || 0, mpRisk = detail.mpRisk || 0, epRisk = detail.epRisk || 0;
      if (/blood|life force|lifeforce|sacrifice|vein|heart|flesh|body burns|burns inside|burning inside/.test(words)) hpRisk = Math.max(hpRisk, 4);
      if (/mana|mind|focus|headache|arcane|spell/.test(words)) mpRisk = Math.max(mpRisk, 3);
      if (/strain|fatigue|muscle|breath|exhaust/.test(words)) epRisk = Math.max(epRisk, 3);
      if (/overcharge|overloads?|beyond|limit|maximum|too much/.test(words)) { mpRisk = Math.max(mpRisk, 2); epRisk = Math.max(epRisk, 1); }
      rec.confidence = rec.confidence === 'hardened_observed' ? rec.confidence : 'observed_cost_pressure';
      rec.hpRisk = Math.max(rec.hpRisk || 0, hpRisk);
      rec.mpPressureRisk = Math.max(rec.mpPressureRisk || 0, mpRisk);
      rec.epPressureRisk = Math.max(rec.epPressureRisk || 0, epRisk);
      rec.overchargeRisk = Math.max(rec.overchargeRisk || 0, hpRisk + mpRisk + epRisk);
      rec.history.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, kind: 'cost_pressure', hpRisk: hpRisk, mpRisk: mpRisk, epRisk: epRisk, phrase: detail.textPreview || '', confidence: rec.confidence, stage: rec.developmentStage });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 16);
      var risk = root.abilityCosts.overchargeRisksById[rec.id] || { costId: rec.id, abilityName: name, events: [] };
      risk.events.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, hpRisk: hpRisk, mpRisk: mpRisk, epRisk: epRisk, phrase: detail.textPreview || '', key: detail.key || '' });
      WL.U.capArray(risk.events, 16);
      root.abilityCosts.overchargeRisksById[rec.id] = risk;
      root.abilityCosts.costsById[rec.id] = rec;
      root.abilityCosts.estimatesById[rec.id] = rec;
      root.abilityCosts.recent.push({ id: rec.id, abilityName: name, category: category, pressure: true, hpRisk: rec.hpRisk, mpRisk: rec.mpPressureRisk, epRisk: rec.epPressureRisk, stage: rec.developmentStage });
      WL.U.capArray(root.abilityCosts.recent, 40);
      return rec;
    },
    costLine: function (rec) {
      if (!rec) return '';
      var parts = [];
      if (rec.mp) parts.push(rec.mp + ' MP');
      if (rec.ep) parts.push(rec.ep + ' EP');
      if (rec.hpRisk) parts.push(rec.hpRisk + ' HP risk');
      if (rec.focus) parts.push(rec.focus + ' focus');
      if (rec.upkeep && rec.upkeep.amount) parts.push('upkeep ' + rec.upkeep.amount + ' ' + rec.upkeep.resource);
      if (rec.cooldown) parts.push('cooldown ' + rec.cooldown);
      if (!parts.length) parts.push(rec.activationCost === 'none' ? 'no activation cost' : 'minor/unknown cost');
      return rec.abilityName + ': ' + parts.join(', ') + ' [' + (rec.confidence || 'rough') + ', ' + (rec.developmentStage || 'inbox') + ']';
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      WL.AbilityCostSystem.ensure(root);
      var ids = root.abilityCosts.costIds || [];
      if (!ids.length) return ['(none)'];
      return ids.slice(0, 30).map(function (id) { return WL.AbilityCostSystem.costLine(root.abilityCosts.costsById[id]); });
    }
  };

  // Owner note: AbilityDevelopmentMatrix derives candidate/practice/stability stage from observed use.
  WL.AbilityDevelopmentMatrix = {
    stageFor: function (costRec, root, abilityName) {
      var use = Number(costRec && costRec.useCount || 0);
      var success = Number(costRec && costRec.successCount || 0);
      var training = Number(costRec && costRec.trainingCount || 0);
      var failure = Number(costRec && costRec.failureCount || 0);
      var confidence = WL.U.lower(costRec && costRec.confidence || '');
      if (/hardened/.test(confidence) || (success >= 5 && use >= 6)) return 'hardened';
      if (success >= 3 && use >= 4) return 'stable';
      if (success >= 1 && (use + training) >= 2) return 'practiced';
      if (success >= 1 || training >= 1 || /observed/.test(confidence)) return 'unstable';
      if (failure > 0) return 'failed-candidate';
      return 'inbox';
    },
    touchRecord: function (root, abilityName, stage, costId) {
      var id = 'ability_' + WL.U.slug(abilityName || 'unknown');
      var rec = root.abilities && (root.abilities.abilitiesById[id] || root.abilities.inboxById[id] || root.abilities.candidatesById[id] || root.abilities.failedById[id]);
      if (rec) {
        rec.developmentStage = stage;
        rec.costId = costId || rec.costId || WL.AbilityCostSystem.costId(abilityName, rec.category || 'ability');
        rec.costConfidence = root.abilityCosts.costsById[rec.costId] && root.abilityCosts.costsById[rec.costId].confidence || rec.costConfidence || 'rough_matrix';
      }
      return rec;
    },
    summaryForAbility: function (root, abilityName) {
      WL.AbilityCostSystem.ensure(root);
      var rec = root.abilityCosts.developmentByAbilityId['ability_' + WL.U.slug(abilityName || '')];
      if (!rec) return abilityName + ': inbox / no cost record';
      return rec.abilityName + ': ' + rec.stage + ' | uses ' + rec.useCount + ' | successes ' + rec.successCount + ' | cost ' + rec.costId;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: AbilityGrowthSystem owns 9.9D mastery/cost growth records. It strengthens the existing ability inbox/cost matrix path instead of wrapping or replacing AbilityLifecycleSystem.
  WL.AbilityGrowthSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.abilityGrowth || typeof root.abilityGrowth !== 'object') root.abilityGrowth = WL.Schema.root().abilityGrowth;
      var g = root.abilityGrowth;
      if (!g.recordsById || typeof g.recordsById !== 'object') g.recordsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(g.recordIds)) g.recordIds = [];
      if (!g.masteryByAbilityId || typeof g.masteryByAbilityId !== 'object') g.masteryByAbilityId = {};
      if (!g.costPressureById || typeof g.costPressureById !== 'object') g.costPressureById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(g.categoryTransfers)) g.categoryTransfers = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(g.denied)) g.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(g.recent)) g.recent = [];
      g.version = '9.9D';
      return g;
    },
    recordId: function (name) { return 'growth_' + WL.U.slug(name || 'unknown'); },
    pressureFromRoot: function (root, text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      var out = { fatigue: 0, environment: '', notes: [] };
      if (/\b(?:tired|fatigued|exhausted|wounded|injured|winded)\b/.test(t)) { out.fatigue += 1; out.notes.push('text fatigue pressure'); }
      if (root && root.body && root.body.conditions && root.body.conditions.some(function (c) { return /fatigue|tired|winded|exhaust/i.test(c.name || c.id || ''); })) { out.fatigue += 1; out.notes.push('body condition pressure'); }
      if (/\b(?:rain|storm|underwater|snow|wind|dark|sunlight|moonlight|forest|desert|cave|city)\b/.test(t)) out.environment = WL.U.norm((t.match(/\b(?:rain|storm|underwater|snow|wind|dark|sunlight|moonlight|forest|desert|cave|city)\b/) || [''])[0]);
      return out;
    },
    masteryStage: function (rec) {
      var score = (rec.masteryXp || 0) + ((rec.successes || 0) * 2) + ((rec.training || 0) * 2) - ((rec.failures || 0) * 1);
      if (rec.explicitStable || score >= 12 || ((rec.training || 0) >= 3 && (rec.failures || 0) <= 1)) return 'stable';
      if (score >= 7) return 'practiced';
      if ((rec.successes || 0) > 0 || (rec.training || 0) > 0) return 'unstable';
      if ((rec.failures || 0) > 0) return 'denied_until_evidence';
      return 'inbox';
    },
    stabilizeIfReady: function (root, lifecycleRec, growthRec, proposal, ledger) {
      if (!lifecycleRec || !growthRec) return false;
      var stage = WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.masteryStage(growthRec);
      lifecycleRec.developmentStage = stage;
      lifecycleRec.growthId = growthRec.id;
      lifecycleRec.masteryXp = growthRec.masteryXp || 0;
      if (stage !== 'stable') return false;
      var category = WL.U.lower(growthRec.category || proposal.data.category || 'ability');
      var verdict = { status: 'stable', reason: 'ability_growth_training_threshold_met' };
      if (category === 'skill') WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installSkill(root, lifecycleRec, verdict);
      else if (category === 'talent') WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installTalent(root, lifecycleRec, verdict);
      else if (category === 'passive') WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installPassive(root, lifecycleRec, verdict);
      else WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installAbility(root, lifecycleRec, verdict);
      lifecycleRec.status = 'stable'; lifecycleRec.stable = true; lifecycleRec.category = category;
      return true;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {};
      if (p.type === 'ability_growth_candidate' || p.type === 'ability_category_growth_candidate') return WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.recordGrowth(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_ability_growth_event' };
    },
    recordGrowth: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var g = WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.ensure(root);
      WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.ensure(root);
      WL.AbilityCostSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = proposal.data || {};
      var name = WL.U.title(d.abilityName || d.targetName || 'Unknown Ability');
      var abilityId = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name);
      var growthId = WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.recordId(name);
      var kind = WL.U.lower(d.growthKind || 'evidence');
      var category = WL.U.lower(d.category || WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.categoryForName(root, name) || 'ability');
      var rec = g.recordsById[growthId] || { id: growthId, abilityId: abilityId, abilityName: name, category: category, masteryXp: 0, attempts: 0, successes: 0, failures: 0, training: 0, pressureEvents: [], history: [], status: 'inbox' };
      rec.category = category;
      rec.attempts += 1;
      var life = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.getOrCreateInbox(root, name, 'ability_growth_candidate', proposal.textPreview);
      var costKind = 'ability_growth_candidate';
      if (kind === 'failed_attempt') {
        rec.failures += 1;
        rec.status = 'denied_until_evidence';
        if ((life.failureCount || 0) <= 0) life.failureCount = 1;
        life.status = 'failed_candidate';
        root.abilities.failedById[life.id] = life;
        if (root.abilities.failedIds.indexOf(life.id) < 0) root.abilities.failedIds.push(life.id);
        g.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, abilityName: name, reason: d.reason || 'failed_attempt_does_not_stabilize_ability', phrase: proposal.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(g.denied, 60);
        costKind = 'failed_attempt_candidate';
      } else if (kind === 'training' || kind === 'category_transfer') {
        var weight = WL.U.clamp(d.trainingWeight || 1, 1, 6);
        rec.training += weight;
        rec.masteryXp += WL.U.clamp(d.masteryDelta || (2 * weight), 1, 30);
        rec.explicitStable = rec.explicitStable || !!d.explicitStable;
        life.trainingCount = (life.trainingCount || 0) + weight;
        life.compactUseCount = (life.compactUseCount || 0) + weight;
        life.status = 'candidate';
        root.abilities.candidatesById[life.id] = life;
        if (root.abilities.candidateIds.indexOf(life.id) < 0) root.abilities.candidateIds.push(life.id);
        if (kind === 'category_transfer') {
          var verdict = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.validateTransfer(root, life, category);
          g.categoryTransfers.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, abilityName: name, category: category, status: verdict.status, reason: verdict.reason, key: ledger.key });
          WL.U.capArray(g.categoryTransfers, 60);
          if (verdict.status === 'denied') rec.status = 'denied_until_evidence';
        }
        costKind = 'training_evidence_candidate';
      } else if (kind === 'success') {
        rec.successes += 1;
        rec.masteryXp += WL.U.clamp(d.masteryDelta || 3, 1, 30);
        life.successCount = (life.successCount || 0) + 1;
        life.status = 'candidate';
        root.abilities.candidatesById[life.id] = life;
        if (root.abilities.candidateIds.indexOf(life.id) < 0) root.abilities.candidateIds.push(life.id);
        costKind = 'ability_evidence_candidate';
      } else if (kind === 'environment_pressure') {
        rec.masteryXp += WL.U.clamp(d.masteryDelta || 1, 0, 10);
        var pressure = WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.pressureFromRoot(root, proposal.textPreview || '');
        pressure.turn = root.runtime.currentTurn; pressure.abilityName = name; pressure.environment = d.environment || pressure.environment || ''; pressure.key = ledger.key;
        rec.pressureEvents.push(pressure); WL.U.capArray(rec.pressureEvents, 20);
        g.costPressureById[growthId] = rec.pressureEvents.slice();
        costKind = 'cost_pressure_candidate';
      }
      var cost = (costKind === 'cost_pressure_candidate') ? WL.AbilityCostSystem.recordPressure(root, name, { textPreview: proposal.textPreview || '', words: proposal.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key }) : WL.AbilityCostSystem.observeUse(root, name, { kind: costKind, textPreview: proposal.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
      rec.costId = cost.id;
      rec.costConfidence = cost.confidence;
      rec.domains = cost.domains || d.domains || WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name);
      rec.status = rec.status === 'denied_until_evidence' && (rec.training || rec.successes) <= 0 ? rec.status : WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.masteryStage(rec);
      var stabilized = WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.stabilizeIfReady(root, life, rec, proposal, ledger);
      if (stabilized && cost) {
        var stableStage = cost.developmentStage === 'hardened' ? 'hardened' : 'stable';
        cost.developmentStage = stableStage;
        if (!/hardened/.test(cost.confidence || '')) cost.confidence = 'observed_ability_growth_stable';
        root.abilityCosts.costsById[cost.id] = cost;
        root.abilityCosts.developmentByAbilityId[abilityId] = { abilityName: name, stage: stableStage, useCount: cost.useCount || 0, successCount: cost.successCount || 0, trainingCount: cost.trainingCount || 0, failureCount: cost.failureCount || 0, costId: cost.id };
        life.developmentStage = stableStage;
        life.costId = cost.id;
        life.costConfidence = cost.confidence;
      }
      rec.history.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, kind: kind, status: rec.status, masteryXp: rec.masteryXp, training: rec.training, successes: rec.successes, failures: rec.failures, costId: cost.id, phrase: proposal.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 24);
      g.recordsById[growthId] = rec;
      if (g.recordIds.indexOf(growthId) < 0) g.recordIds.push(growthId);
      g.masteryByAbilityId[abilityId] = { abilityId: abilityId, abilityName: name, status: rec.status, masteryXp: rec.masteryXp, training: rec.training, successes: rec.successes, failures: rec.failures, costId: rec.costId };
      g.recent.push({ abilityName: name, kind: kind, status: rec.status, masteryXp: rec.masteryXp, stabilized: stabilized, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(g.recent, 60);
      root.abilities.recent.push({ action: 'ability_growth', abilityId: abilityId, kind: kind, status: rec.status, growthId: growthId, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.abilities.recent, 50);
      return { status: stabilized ? 'APPLIED_STABILIZED' : (d.denied ? 'RECORDED_DENIAL' : 'APPLIED'), applied: true, family: 'abilityGrowth', type: kind, abilityId: abilityId, growthId: growthId, masteryStatus: rec.status, masteryXp: rec.masteryXp, costId: rec.costId, key: ledger.key };
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      var g = WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.ensure(root);
      max = max || 10;
      var lines = ['Ability Growth: records ' + g.recordIds.length + ', denials ' + g.denied.length + ', transfers ' + g.categoryTransfers.length + ' [9.9D]'];
      var ids = g.recordIds.slice(-max);
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var r = g.recordsById[ids[i]];
        if (!r) continue;
        lines.push('- ' + r.abilityName + ': ' + r.status + ' | mastery ' + (r.masteryXp || 0) + ' | training ' + (r.training || 0) + ' | success ' + (r.successes || 0) + ' | fail ' + (r.failures || 0));
      }
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // Owner note: ProgressionSystem owns XP/stat/domain lanes and never scales the world to the player.

  // Owner note: ProgressionFormulaSystem owns 9.9A XP economy, level thresholds, and bounded level-up application.

  // Owner note: XPBudgetSystem owns anti-farm training/reward budgets. It may dampen XP application through ProgressionFormulaSystem, but it does not create XP by itself, resolve combat rewards, or replace stat formulas.
  WL.XPBudgetSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.xpBudget || typeof root.xpBudget !== 'object') root.xpBudget = WL.Schema.root().xpBudget;
      var b = root.xpBudget;
      if (!b.activityByKey || typeof b.activityByKey !== 'object') b.activityByKey = {};
      if (!b.domainBudgetByKey || typeof b.domainBudgetByKey !== 'object') b.domainBudgetByKey = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(b.rewardEvents)) b.rewardEvents = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(b.trainingEvents)) b.trainingEvents = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(b.dampened)) b.dampened = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(b.denied)) b.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(b.recent)) b.recent = [];
      b.version = '9.9C';
      return b;
    },
    activityLabelFromText: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      if (/jump|hop/.test(t)) return 'jumping';
      if (/push\s*up|pushup/.test(t)) return 'pushups';
      if (/swing|training dummy|dummy/.test(t)) return 'weapon drills';
      if (/run|sprint|dash/.test(t)) return 'running drills';
      if (/study|read|rune|magic|spell/.test(t)) return 'study practice';
      if (/hard|dangerous|deadly|boss|dragon|inferno|ancient|fight|battle|duel|ambush|surviv/.test(t)) return 'dangerous encounter';
      if (/craft|forge|repair/.test(t)) return 'craft practice';
      return 'general training';
    },
    activityKeyFromText: function (text, lane) {
      return WL.U.slug((lane || 'level') + '_' + WL.XPBudgetSystem.activityLabelFromText(text || '')).slice(0, 80);
    },
    riskClassFromText: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      if (/\b(?:deadly|boss|dragon|ancient|inferno|near death|life-or-death|wounded|bloodied|ambush|trap|hard fight|dangerous fight|elite|overwhelming|survived)\b/.test(t)) return 'high';
      if (/\b(?:safe|easy|trivial|low risk|in place|dummy|repeat|repeatedly|again and again|practice yard|warmup|jumping|pushups?)\b/.test(t)) return 'low';
      return 'normal';
    },
    contributionClassFromText: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      if (/\b(?:single-handed|decisive|saved|protected|finished|carried|major contribution)\b/.test(t)) return 'major';
      if (/\b(?:watched|stood by|minor|barely helped|tagged along|witnessed)\b/.test(t)) return 'minor';
      return 'normal';
    },
    decayFor: function (riskClass, repetitionCount) {
      repetitionCount = WL.U.clamp(repetitionCount || 0, 0, 999);
      if (riskClass === 'high') return 1;
      if (riskClass === 'normal') {
        if (repetitionCount <= 0) return 1;
        if (repetitionCount === 1) return 0.85;
        if (repetitionCount === 2) return 0.65;
        if (repetitionCount === 3) return 0.45;
        return 0.25;
      }
      if (repetitionCount <= 0) return 1;
      if (repetitionCount === 1) return 0.5;
      if (repetitionCount === 2) return 0.1;
      return 0;
    },
    riskMultiplier: function (riskClass) {
      return riskClass === 'high' ? 1.5 : (riskClass === 'low' ? 0.5 : 1);
    },
    contributionMultiplier: function (contributionClass) {
      return contributionClass === 'major' ? 1.25 : (contributionClass === 'minor' ? 0.5 : 1);
    },
    evaluateXp: function (root, proposal, rawAmount, lane) {
      var b = WL.XPBudgetSystem.ensure(root);
      var text = proposal && proposal.textPreview || '';
      var d = proposal && proposal.data || {};
      lane = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem && WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.normalizeLane ? WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.normalizeLane(lane || d.lane || 'level') : WL.U.lower(lane || 'level');
      rawAmount = WL.U.clamp(rawAmount || 0, 0, 5000);
      var activityKey = d.activityKey || WL.XPBudgetSystem.activityKeyFromText(text, lane);
      var label = d.activityLabel || WL.XPBudgetSystem.activityLabelFromText(text);
      var riskClass = d.riskClass || WL.XPBudgetSystem.riskClassFromText(text);
      var contributionClass = d.contributionClass || WL.XPBudgetSystem.contributionClassFromText(text);
      var rec = b.activityByKey[activityKey] || { key: activityKey, label: label, count: 0, rawTotal: 0, appliedTotal: 0, lastTurn: 0, riskHistory: [] };
      var repetition = rec.count || 0;
      var decay = WL.XPBudgetSystem.decayFor(riskClass, repetition);
      var riskMult = WL.XPBudgetSystem.riskMultiplier(riskClass);
      var contribMult = WL.XPBudgetSystem.contributionMultiplier(contributionClass);
      var multiplier = decay * contribMult;
      var applied = Math.floor(rawAmount * multiplier);
      if (riskClass === 'high') applied = rawAmount;
      if (applied < 0) applied = 0;
      if (applied > rawAmount) applied = rawAmount;
      var domainKey = lane + '_' + activityKey;
      var dom = b.domainBudgetByKey[domainKey] || { key: domainKey, lane: lane, activityKey: activityKey, rawTotal: 0, appliedTotal: 0, count: 0 };
      dom.rawTotal += rawAmount; dom.appliedTotal += applied; dom.count += 1; b.domainBudgetByKey[domainKey] = dom;
      rec.count = repetition + 1;
      rec.rawTotal += rawAmount;
      rec.appliedTotal += applied;
      rec.lastTurn = root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || 0;
      rec.riskHistory.push({ turn: rec.lastTurn, riskClass: riskClass, contributionClass: contributionClass, decay: decay, rawAmount: rawAmount, appliedAmount: applied });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.riskHistory, 12);
      b.activityByKey[activityKey] = rec;
      var event = { turn: rec.lastTurn, activityKey: activityKey, activityLabel: label, lane: lane, rawAmount: rawAmount, appliedAmount: applied, repetition: repetition, riskClass: riskClass, contributionClass: contributionClass, decay: decay, riskMultiplier: riskMult, contributionMultiplier: contribMult, effectiveRewardWeight: Math.round(rawAmount * riskMult * contribMult), phrase: text, key: proposal && proposal.opKey || '' };
      b.rewardEvents.push(event); WL.U.capArray(b.rewardEvents, 120);
      if (applied < rawAmount) { b.dampened.push(event); WL.U.capArray(b.dampened, 80); }
      if (applied <= 0 && rawAmount > 0) { b.denied.push({ turn: event.turn, reason: 'repetition_budget_exhausted', activityKey: activityKey, rawAmount: rawAmount, phrase: text }); WL.U.capArray(b.denied, 80); }
      b.recent.push(event); WL.U.capArray(b.recent, 60);
      return event;
    },
    recordBudgetEvidence: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var b = WL.XPBudgetSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = proposal.data || {};
      var rec = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, activityKey: d.activityKey || WL.XPBudgetSystem.activityKeyFromText(proposal.textPreview || '', 'level'), activityLabel: d.activityLabel || WL.XPBudgetSystem.activityLabelFromText(proposal.textPreview || ''), riskClass: d.riskClass || WL.XPBudgetSystem.riskClassFromText(proposal.textPreview || ''), contributionClass: d.contributionClass || WL.XPBudgetSystem.contributionClassFromText(proposal.textPreview || ''), hasExplicitReward: !!d.hasExplicitReward, hasTraining: !!d.hasTraining, phrase: proposal.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key };
      b.trainingEvents.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(b.trainingEvents, 120);
      b.recent.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(b.recent, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'xpBudget', type: 'xp_budget_evidence', activityKey: rec.activityKey, riskClass: rec.riskClass, key: ledger.key };
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {};
      if (p.type === 'xp_budget_candidate') return WL.XPBudgetSystem.recordBudgetEvidence(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_xp_budget_event' };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      var b = WL.XPBudgetSystem.ensure(root);
      var keys = Object.keys(b.activityByKey || {});
      var damp = b.dampened ? b.dampened.length : 0;
      var recent = b.recent && b.recent.length ? b.recent[b.recent.length - 1] : null;
      var line = 'XP Budget: activities ' + keys.length + ', dampened ' + damp + ', denied ' + ((b.denied || []).length) + (recent ? ' | Recent ' + WL.U.safeString(recent.activityLabel || recent.activityKey) + ' [' + WL.U.safeString(recent.riskClass || 'normal') + ']' : '');
      return [line];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      var b = WL.XPBudgetSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = WL.XPBudgetSystem.summary(root, max);
      var events = (b.rewardEvents || []).slice(-(max || 8));
      if (events.length) lines.push('Reward budget: ' + events.map(function (e) { return e.activityLabel + ' raw ' + e.rawAmount + ' -> applied ' + e.appliedAmount + ' [' + e.riskClass + ', repeat ' + e.repetition + ']'; }).join(' | '));
      var training = (b.trainingEvents || []).slice(-((max || 8) > 6 ? 6 : (max || 8)));
      if (training.length) lines.push('Training evidence: ' + training.map(function (e) { return e.activityLabel + ' [' + e.riskClass + ']'; }).join(' | '));
      if (b.denied && b.denied.length) lines.push('Denied budget: ' + b.denied.slice(-3).map(function (d) { return d.activityKey + ' [' + d.reason + ']'; }).join(' | '));
      lines.push('Boundary: 9.9C dampens repetitive low-risk XP and records risk/contribution budgets; it does not create combat rewards or override explicit owner reducers.');
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // [WL-ORG:OWNERS] ProgressionFormulaSystem
  WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.progression || typeof root.progression !== 'object') root.progression = {};
      var p = root.progression;
      if (typeof p.level !== 'number' || !isFinite(p.level) || p.level < 1) p.level = 1;
      if (typeof p.xp !== 'number' || !isFinite(p.xp)) p.xp = 0;
      if (typeof p.levelXp !== 'number' || !isFinite(p.levelXp)) p.levelXp = 0;
      if (typeof p.totalEarnedXp !== 'number' || !isFinite(p.totalEarnedXp)) p.totalEarnedXp = p.xp || p.levelXp || 0;
      if (typeof p.xpToNext !== 'number' || !isFinite(p.xpToNext) || p.xpToNext <= 0) p.xpToNext = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.thresholdForLevel(p.level);
      if (!p.xpLanes || typeof p.xpLanes !== 'object') p.xpLanes = { level: 0, stat: 0, ability: 0, skill: 0, talent: 0, passive: 0, domain: 0, basicAbility: 0 };
      ['level','stat','ability','skill','talent','passive','domain','basicAbility'].forEach(function (k) { if (typeof p.xpLanes[k] !== 'number') p.xpLanes[k] = 0; });
      if (!p.statXp || typeof p.statXp !== 'object') p.statXp = { atk: 0, def: 0, spd: 0, int: 0, lck: 0 };
      ['atk','def','spd','int','lck'].forEach(function (k) { if (typeof p.statXp[k] !== 'number') p.statXp[k] = 0; });
      if (!p.domainXp || typeof p.domainXp !== 'object') p.domainXp = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(p.domainIds)) p.domainIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(p.recent)) p.recent = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(p.xpEvents)) p.xpEvents = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(p.levelUps)) p.levelUps = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(p.denied)) p.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(p.thresholdHistory)) p.thresholdHistory = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(p.statGrowthByLevel)) p.statGrowthByLevel = [];
      if (!p.statCaps || typeof p.statCaps !== 'object') p.statCaps = { atk: 10, def: 10, spd: 10, int: 10, lck: 10 };
      if (!p.appliedStats || typeof p.appliedStats !== 'object') p.appliedStats = { atk: 0, def: 0, spd: 0, int: 0, lck: 0 };
      ['atk','def','spd','int','lck'].forEach(function (k) {
        if (typeof p.statCaps[k] !== 'number') p.statCaps[k] = 10;
        if (typeof p.appliedStats[k] !== 'number') p.appliedStats[k] = 0;
      });
      if (!p.buildIdentity || typeof p.buildIdentity !== 'object') p.buildIdentity = { tags: [], summary: 'developing', noRubberBandScaling: true };
      p.buildIdentity.noRubberBandScaling = true;
      p.formulaVersion = '9.9A';
      if (WL.XPBudgetSystem && typeof WL.XPBudgetSystem.ensure === 'function') WL.XPBudgetSystem.ensure(root);
    },
    thresholdForLevel: function (level) {
      level = WL.U.clamp(level || 1, 1, 999);
      return 100 + ((level - 1) * 50);
    },
    normalizeLane: function (lane) {
      lane = WL.U.lower(lane || 'level');
      if (/skill/.test(lane)) return 'skill';
      if (/talent/.test(lane)) return 'talent';
      if (/passive/.test(lane)) return 'passive';
      if (/stat/.test(lane)) return 'stat';
      if (/domain/.test(lane)) return 'domain';
      if (/basic/.test(lane)) return 'basicAbility';
      if (/ability|spell|technique|training|practice/.test(lane)) return 'ability';
      return 'level';
    },
    statHintsFromText: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      var out = {};
      if (/strength|attack|strike|sword|martial|force|power|shove|lift/.test(t)) out.atk = 2;
      if (/defense|defence|guard|shield|endure|resilience|armor|armour/.test(t)) out.def = 2;
      if (/speed|agility|dodge|chase|sprint|mobility|stealth/.test(t)) out.spd = 2;
      if (/intelligence|study|magic|spell|arcane|knowledge|analysis|craft|forge/.test(t)) out.int = 2;
      if (/luck|fortune|chance|instinct|survival/.test(t)) out.lck = 1;
      return out;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {};
      if (p.type === 'xp_candidate') return WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.applyXp(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'level_up_confirmation_candidate') return WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.applyLevelUpConfirmation(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_progression_formula_event' };
    },
    applyXp: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = proposal.data || {};
      var rawAmount = WL.U.clamp(d.amount || 0, 0, 5000);
      if (!rawAmount) return { status: 'NO_XP', applied: false, family: 'progression', type: proposal.type, key: ledger.key };
      var lane = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.normalizeLane(d.lane || 'level');
      var budget = (root.features && root.features.xpBudgetSystemEnabled === false) ? { rawAmount: rawAmount, appliedAmount: rawAmount, decay: 1, riskClass: 'disabled', contributionClass: 'normal', activityKey: 'disabled' } : WL.XPBudgetSystem.evaluateXp(root, proposal, rawAmount, lane);
      var amount = WL.U.clamp(budget.appliedAmount, 0, rawAmount);
      if (!amount) {
        root.progression.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, reason: 'xp_budget_dampened_to_zero', rawAmount: rawAmount, lane: lane, phrase: proposal.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.progression.denied, 40);
        return { status: 'RECORDED_DAMPENED_ZERO', applied: true, family: 'progression', type: 'xp', lane: lane, amount: 0, rawAmount: rawAmount, budget: budget, key: ledger.key };
      }
      var p = root.progression;
      p.totalEarnedXp += amount;
      p.xp += amount;
      p.levelXp += amount;
      if (lane !== 'domain') p.xpLanes[lane] = (p.xpLanes[lane] || 0) + amount;
      if (lane === 'skill') p.skillXp += amount;
      else if (lane === 'talent') p.talentXp += amount;
      else if (lane === 'passive') p.passiveXp += amount;
      else if (lane === 'basicAbility') p.basicAbilityXp += amount;
      else if (lane === 'ability') p.abilityXp += amount;
      var stats = WL.U.clone(d.stats || {});
      if (rawAmount && amount < rawAmount) {
        Object.keys(stats).forEach(function (k) { stats[k] = Math.floor(WL.U.clamp(stats[k], 0, 999999) * (amount / rawAmount)); });
      }
      Object.keys(stats).forEach(function (k) { if (p.statXp[k] != null) p.statXp[k] += WL.U.clamp(stats[k], 0, 999999); });
      var domains = d.domains || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < domains.length; i++) WL.ProgressionSystem.addDomainXp(root, domains[i], amount);
      var event = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, lane: lane, amount: amount, rawAmount: rawAmount, budgetActivityKey: budget.activityKey || '', budgetRisk: budget.riskClass || '', budgetDecay: budget.decay, reason: d.reason || '', domains: domains, stats: WL.U.clone(stats), key: ledger.key };
      p.xpEvents.push(event); WL.U.capArray(p.xpEvents, 120);
      p.recent.push(event); WL.U.capArray(p.recent, 80);
      var levelUps = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.applyPendingLevelUps(root, { reason: d.reason || 'xp_gain', key: ledger.key });
      WL.ProgressionSystem.updateBuildIdentity(root);
      return { status: amount < rawAmount ? 'APPLIED_DAMPENED' : 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'progression', type: 'xp', lane: lane, amount: amount, rawAmount: rawAmount, budget: budget, level: p.level, levelXp: p.levelXp, xpToNext: p.xpToNext, levelUps: levelUps, key: ledger.key };
    },
    applyLevelUpConfirmation: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var levelUps = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.applyPendingLevelUps(root, { reason: 'explicit_level_up_confirmation', key: ledger.key });
      if (!levelUps) {
        root.progression.denied.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, reason: 'level_up_confirmation_without_enough_level_xp', phrase: proposal.textPreview || '', key: ledger.key });
        WL.U.capArray(root.progression.denied, 40);
        return { status: 'RECORDED_DENIAL', applied: true, family: 'progression', type: 'level_up_confirmation', reason: 'not_enough_level_xp', level: root.progression.level, levelXp: root.progression.levelXp, xpToNext: root.progression.xpToNext, key: ledger.key };
      }
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'progression', type: 'level_up_confirmation', levelUps: levelUps, level: root.progression.level, key: ledger.key };
    },
    growthForLevel: function (root, newLevel) {
      var stats = { atk: 0, def: 0, spd: 0, int: 0, lck: 0 };
      var sx = root.progression.statXp || {};
      var best = 'atk';
      ['atk','def','spd','int','lck'].forEach(function (k) { if ((sx[k] || 0) > (sx[best] || 0)) best = k; });
      stats[best] = 1;
      if (newLevel % 3 === 0) stats.def += 1;
      if (newLevel % 5 === 0) stats.lck += 1;
      return { hpCap: 5 + (newLevel % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0), mpCap: 2, epCap: 3, statGrowth: stats };
    },
    applyPendingLevelUps: function (root, detail) {
      WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var p = root.progression;
      var count = 0;
      var guard = 0;
      while (p.levelXp >= p.xpToNext && guard < 20) {
        guard += 1;
        var oldLevel = p.level;
        var threshold = p.xpToNext;
        p.levelXp -= threshold;
        p.level += 1;
        var growth = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.growthForLevel(root, p.level);
        root.body.maxHp += growth.hpCap; root.body.hp = Math.min(root.body.maxHp, root.body.hp + growth.hpCap);
        root.body.maxMp += growth.mpCap; root.body.mp = Math.min(root.body.maxMp, root.body.mp + growth.mpCap);
        root.body.maxEp += growth.epCap; root.body.ep = Math.min(root.body.maxEp, root.body.ep + growth.epCap);
        Object.keys(growth.statGrowth).forEach(function (k) {
          p.appliedStats[k] = (p.appliedStats[k] || 0) + growth.statGrowth[k];
          p.statCaps[k] = Math.max(p.statCaps[k] || 10, 10 + p.appliedStats[k]);
        });
        p.xpToNext = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.thresholdForLevel(p.level);
        var rec = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, oldLevel: oldLevel, newLevel: p.level, spentLevelXp: threshold, remainingLevelXp: p.levelXp, nextThreshold: p.xpToNext, growth: growth, reason: detail && detail.reason || '', key: detail && detail.key || '' };
        p.levelUps.push(rec); p.statGrowthByLevel.push(rec); p.thresholdHistory.push({ level: oldLevel, threshold: threshold, key: rec.key });
        WL.U.capArray(p.levelUps, 60); WL.U.capArray(p.statGrowthByLevel, 60); WL.U.capArray(p.thresholdHistory, 80);
        count += 1;
      }
      return count;
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var p = root.progression;
      var recent = p.xpEvents && p.xpEvents.length ? p.xpEvents[p.xpEvents.length - 1] : null;
      var line = 'Progression: Level ' + p.level + ' | Level XP ' + p.levelXp + '/' + p.xpToNext + ' | Total XP ' + p.totalEarnedXp + ' | Lanes ability ' + (p.xpLanes.ability || 0) + ', skill ' + (p.xpLanes.skill || 0) + ', stat ' + (p.xpLanes.stat || 0) + ', domain ' + (p.xpLanes.domain || 0);
      if (recent) line += ' | Recent +' + recent.amount + ' ' + recent.lane;
      return [line, 'Applied Stat Growth: ATK +' + (p.appliedStats.atk || 0) + ', DEF +' + (p.appliedStats.def || 0) + ', SPD +' + (p.appliedStats.spd || 0) + ', INT +' + (p.appliedStats.int || 0) + ', LCK +' + (p.appliedStats.lck || 0), 'Level-Ups: ' + (p.levelUps.length ? p.levelUps.slice(-(max || 3)).map(function (u) { return u.oldLevel + '->' + u.newLevel + ' [' + u.reason + ']'; }).join(', ') : '(none)')];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      var lines = WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.summary(root, max);
      var p = root.progression;
      var events = (p.xpEvents || []).slice(-(max || 12));
      if (events.length) lines.push('Recent XP: ' + events.map(function (e) { return '+' + e.amount + ' ' + e.lane + ' [' + (e.reason || 'xp') + ']'; }).join(' | '));
      if (p.denied && p.denied.length) lines.push('Denied/Pending: ' + p.denied.slice(-3).map(function (d) { return d.reason; }).join(' | '));
      lines.push('Boundary: 9.9A applies XP lanes and bounded level-up growth; 9.9B computes derived stat formulas; 9.9C owns anti-farm budgets and repetition decay.');
      return lines;
    }
  };


  // Owner note: StatFormulaSystem owns ATK/DEF/SPD/INT/LCK derived formulas and action-fit display. It records stat effects without XP grants, direct damage mutation, or combat outcomes.
  WL.StatFormulaSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.statFormula || typeof root.statFormula !== 'object') root.statFormula = WL.Schema.root().statFormula;
      var sf = root.statFormula;
      if (!sf.baseStats || typeof sf.baseStats !== 'object') sf.baseStats = { atk: 10, def: 10, spd: 10, int: 10, lck: 10 };
      if (!sf.derivedStats || typeof sf.derivedStats !== 'object') sf.derivedStats = { atk: 10, def: 10, spd: 10, int: 10, lck: 10 };
      if (!sf.derivedValues || typeof sf.derivedValues !== 'object') sf.derivedValues = { chase: 10, evasion: 10, study: 10, magicControl: 10, mitigation: 10, force: 10, uncertainty: 10 };
      if (!Array.isArray(sf.snapshots)) sf.snapshots = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(sf.actionEffects)) sf.actionEffects = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(sf.denied)) sf.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(sf.recent)) sf.recent = [];
      sf.version = '9.9B';
      WL.StatFormulaSystem.recompute(root, 'ensure');
      return sf;
    },
    statKeys: ['atk', 'def', 'spd', 'int', 'lck'],
    labelFor: function (key) {
      return ({ atk: 'ATK', def: 'DEF', spd: 'SPD', int: 'INT', lck: 'LCK' })[key] || WL.U.safeString(key).toUpperCase();
    },
    pressureFromXp: function (xp) {
      xp = WL.U.clamp(xp || 0, 0, 999999);
      return Math.min(10, Math.floor(xp / 25));
    },
    bodyModifierFor: function (root, key) {
      var bonus = 0;
      var notes = [];
      try {
        if (root.bodyFormula && Array.isArray(root.bodyFormula.modifierIds)) {
          for (var i = 0; i < root.bodyFormula.modifierIds.length; i++) {
            var rec = root.bodyFormula.modifiersById[root.bodyFormula.modifierIds[i]];
            var hay = WL.U.lower((rec && (rec.label + ' ' + rec.summary + ' ' + rec.actionKind + ' ' + rec.domain)) || '');
            if (key === 'atk' && /\b(force|strength|large body scale|shove|physical)\b/.test(hay)) { bonus += 1; notes.push('body force'); }
            if (key === 'def' && /\b(resilien|durab|armor|armour|endurance|injury)\b/.test(hay)) { bonus += 1; notes.push('body resilience'); }
            if (key === 'spd' && /\b(mobility|speed|agility|flight|aerial)\b/.test(hay)) { bonus += 1; notes.push('body mobility'); }
            if (key === 'int' && /\b(magic|senses|perception|study|affinity|precision)\b/.test(hay)) { bonus += 1; notes.push('body/magic affinity'); }
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return { bonus: Math.min(3, bonus), notes: WL.U.unique(notes).slice(0, 3) };
    },
    conditionPenaltyFor: function (root, key) {
      var penalty = 0;
      var notes = [];
      var hay = WL.U.lower(JSON.stringify((root.body && (root.body.conditions || []).concat(root.body.injuries || [])) || []));
      if (/\b(exhausted|fatigued|winded|tired)\b/.test(hay)) {
        if (key === 'spd' || key === 'atk') { penalty += 2; notes.push('fatigue'); }
        if (key === 'int') { penalty += 1; notes.push('fatigue'); }
      }
      if (/\b(wound|injury|broken|fracture|sprain|bleeding)\b/.test(hay)) {
        if (key === 'atk' || key === 'spd' || key === 'def') { penalty += 1; notes.push('injury'); }
      }
      return { penalty: penalty, notes: WL.U.unique(notes).slice(0, 3) };
    },
    computeStat: function (root, key) {
      WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var p = root.progression || {};
      var base = 10 + WL.U.clamp(p.appliedStats && p.appliedStats[key] || 0, 0, 999);
      var xpPressure = WL.StatFormulaSystem.pressureFromXp(p.statXp && p.statXp[key] || 0);
      var body = WL.StatFormulaSystem.bodyModifierFor(root, key);
      var cond = WL.StatFormulaSystem.conditionPenaltyFor(root, key);
      var value = Math.max(1, base + xpPressure + body.bonus - cond.penalty);
      return { key: key, label: WL.StatFormulaSystem.labelFor(key), base: base, xpPressure: xpPressure, bodyBonus: body.bonus, conditionPenalty: cond.penalty, value: value, notes: WL.U.unique((body.notes || []).concat(cond.notes || [])) };
    },
    recompute: function (root, reason) {
      if (!root.statFormula || typeof root.statFormula !== 'object') return null;
      var sf = root.statFormula;
      var snap = { turn: root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, reason: reason || 'recompute', stats: {}, formulas: {}, derivedValues: {}, noWorldScaling: true };
      for (var i = 0; i < WL.StatFormulaSystem.statKeys.length; i++) {
        var key = WL.StatFormulaSystem.statKeys[i];
        var f = WL.StatFormulaSystem.computeStat(root, key);
        sf.baseStats[key] = f.base;
        sf.derivedStats[key] = f.value;
        snap.stats[key] = f.value;
        snap.formulas[key] = f;
      }
      sf.derivedValues.chase = sf.derivedStats.spd + Math.floor(sf.derivedStats.lck / 3);
      sf.derivedValues.evasion = sf.derivedStats.spd + Math.floor(sf.derivedStats.def / 4);
      sf.derivedValues.study = sf.derivedStats.int + Math.floor(sf.derivedStats.lck / 4);
      sf.derivedValues.magicControl = sf.derivedStats.int + Math.floor(sf.derivedStats.spd / 5);
      sf.derivedValues.mitigation = sf.derivedStats.def + Math.floor(sf.derivedStats.atk / 5);
      sf.derivedValues.force = sf.derivedStats.atk + Math.floor(sf.derivedStats.def / 4);
      sf.derivedValues.uncertainty = sf.derivedStats.lck + Math.floor(sf.derivedStats.int / 5);
      snap.derivedValues = WL.U.clone(sf.derivedValues);
      if (reason !== 'ensure' && reason !== 'display') {
        sf.snapshots.push(snap); WL.U.capArray(sf.snapshots, 80);
        sf.recent.push({ turn: snap.turn, reason: snap.reason, stats: WL.U.clone(sf.derivedStats), derivedValues: WL.U.clone(sf.derivedValues) }); WL.U.capArray(sf.recent, 40);
      }
      return snap;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {};
      if (p.type === 'stat_formula_evidence_candidate') return WL.StatFormulaSystem.recordEffect(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_stat_formula_event' };
    },
    recordEffect: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      WL.StatFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = proposal.data || {};
      var stat = d.primaryStat || 'atk';
      var snapshot = WL.StatFormulaSystem.recompute(root, 'stat_effect_' + (d.effectKind || stat));
      var value = root.statFormula.derivedValues[d.effectKind] || root.statFormula.derivedStats[stat] || 0;
      var rec = { id: 'stat_effect_' + WL.U.hash((d.effectKind || '') + '|' + stat + '|' + proposal.localClauseHash), turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, effectKind: d.effectKind || 'general', primaryStat: stat, value: value, formulaVersion: '9.9B', phrase: proposal.textPreview || '', note: d.note || '', key: ledger.key, snapshot: snapshot && snapshot.stats || {} };
      root.statFormula.actionEffects.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(root.statFormula.actionEffects, 80);
      root.statFormula.recent.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(root.statFormula.recent, 40);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'statFormula', type: 'stat_formula_evidence', effectKind: rec.effectKind, primaryStat: stat, value: value, key: ledger.key };
    },
    actionHint: function (root, text) {
      WL.StatFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var t = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      if (/chase|outrun|sprint|dash|dodge|evade/.test(t)) return 'SPD-derived chase/evasion value ' + root.statFormula.derivedValues.chase + ' (stat formula note; no automatic success)';
      if (/study|inspect|analy|magic|spell|rune|arcane/.test(t)) return 'INT-derived study/magic value ' + root.statFormula.derivedValues.study + ' (stat formula note; no automatic success)';
      if (/block|brace|endure|absorb|shield|armor|armour|damage/.test(t)) return 'DEF-derived mitigation value ' + root.statFormula.derivedValues.mitigation + ' (stat formula note; no HP mutation here)';
      if (/strike|attack|shove|lift|break|force/.test(t)) return 'ATK-derived force value ' + root.statFormula.derivedValues.force + ' (stat formula note; no automatic outcome)';
      return 'Stat formula neutral: no strong action-fit note.';
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      WL.StatFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var s = root.statFormula.derivedStats;
      var d = root.statFormula.derivedValues;
      return ['Stats: ATK ' + s.atk + ', DEF ' + s.def + ', SPD ' + s.spd + ', INT ' + s.int + ', LCK ' + s.lck + ' | Derived: chase ' + d.chase + ', study ' + d.study + ', mitigation ' + d.mitigation + ' [9.9B]'];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      WL.StatFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = WL.StatFormulaSystem.summary(root, max);
      var sf = root.statFormula;
      var formulas = sf.snapshots.length ? sf.snapshots[sf.snapshots.length - 1].formulas : {};
      ['atk','def','spd','int','lck'].forEach(function (k) {
        var f = formulas[k] || WL.StatFormulaSystem.computeStat(root, k);
        lines.push('- ' + f.label + ': base ' + f.base + ' + xp-pressure ' + f.xpPressure + ' + body ' + f.bodyBonus + ' - condition ' + f.conditionPenalty + ' = ' + f.value + (f.notes.length ? ' [' + f.notes.join(', ') + ']' : ''));
      });
      if (sf.actionEffects.length) lines.push('Recent stat effects: ' + sf.actionEffects.slice(-((max || 8) > 8 ? 8 : 4)).map(function (e) { return e.effectKind + '/' + WL.StatFormulaSystem.labelFor(e.primaryStat) + ' ' + e.value; }).join(' | '));
      lines.push('Boundary: 9.9B computes/display derived stat effects only; 9.9C owns anti-farm budgets and 9.10 owns combat outcome resolution.');
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // [WL-ORG:OWNERS] ProgressionSystem
  WL.ProgressionSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      var fresh = WL.Schema.root().progression;
      if (!root.progression || typeof root.progression !== 'object') root.progression = WL.U.clone(fresh);
      if (!root.progression.statXp || typeof root.progression.statXp !== 'object') root.progression.statXp = { atk: 0, def: 0, spd: 0, int: 0, lck: 0 };
      ['atk', 'def', 'spd', 'int', 'lck'].forEach(function (k) { if (typeof root.progression.statXp[k] !== 'number') root.progression.statXp[k] = 0; });
      if (!root.progression.xpLanes || typeof root.progression.xpLanes !== 'object') root.progression.xpLanes = WL.U.clone(fresh.xpLanes);
      if (!root.progression.domainXp || typeof root.progression.domainXp !== 'object') root.progression.domainXp = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.progression.domainIds)) root.progression.domainIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.progression.recent)) root.progression.recent = [];
      if (!root.progression.buildIdentity || typeof root.progression.buildIdentity !== 'object') root.progression.buildIdentity = { tags: [], summary: 'undeveloped', noRubberBandScaling: true };
      if (WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem && typeof WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.ensure === 'function') WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
      if (WL.StatFormulaSystem && typeof WL.StatFormulaSystem.ensure === 'function') WL.StatFormulaSystem.ensure(root);
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'xp_candidate' || p.type === 'level_up_confirmation_candidate') return WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_progression_event' };
      WL.ProgressionSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = p.data || {};
      var amount = WL.U.clamp(d.amount || 0, 0, 999999);
      var lane = WL.U.lower(d.lane || 'ability');
      if (!amount) return { status: 'NO_XP', applied: false, family: 'progression', type: 'xp', key: ledger.key };
      if (lane === 'level') { root.progression.xp += amount; root.progression.levelXp += amount; root.progression.xpLanes.level += amount; }
      else if (lane === 'skill') { root.progression.skillXp += amount; root.progression.xpLanes.skill += amount; }
      else if (lane === 'talent') { root.progression.talentXp += amount; root.progression.xpLanes.talent += amount; }
      else if (lane === 'passive') { root.progression.passiveXp += amount; root.progression.xpLanes.passive += amount; }
      else if (lane === 'stat') { root.progression.xpLanes.stat += amount; }
      else { root.progression.abilityXp += amount; root.progression.xpLanes.ability += amount; }
      var stats = d.stats || {};
      Object.keys(stats).forEach(function (k) { if (root.progression.statXp[k] != null) root.progression.statXp[k] += WL.U.clamp(stats[k], 0, 999999); });
      var domains = d.domains || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < domains.length; i++) WL.ProgressionSystem.addDomainXp(root, domains[i], amount);
      root.progression.recent.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, lane: lane, amount: amount, domains: domains, reason: d.reason || '', key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.progression.recent, 80);
      WL.ProgressionSystem.updateBuildIdentity(root);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'progression', type: 'xp', lane: lane, amount: amount, key: ledger.key };
    },
    addDomainXp: function (root, domain, amount) {
      var d = WL.U.slug(domain || 'general');
      if (!root.progression.domainXp[d]) root.progression.domainXp[d] = 0;
      root.progression.domainXp[d] += WL.U.clamp(amount, 0, 999999);
      if (root.progression.domainIds.indexOf(d) < 0) root.progression.domainIds.push(d);
      root.progression.xpLanes.domain += amount;
    },
    domainTotal: function (root, domains) {
      WL.ProgressionSystem.ensure(root);
      var total = 0;
      domains = domains || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < domains.length; i++) total += root.progression.domainXp[WL.U.slug(domains[i])] || 0;
      return total;
    },
    updateBuildIdentity: function (root) {
      var tags = [];
      var sx = root.progression.statXp;
      if (sx.spd > sx.atk && sx.spd > sx.def) tags.push('mobility-focused');
      if ((root.progression.domainXp.magic || 0) + (root.progression.domainXp.fire || 0) >= 10) tags.push('magic-leaning');
      if ((root.progression.domainXp.swordsmanship || 0) >= 8) tags.push('sword-trained');
      if ((root.progression.domainXp.boxing || 0) >= 8) tags.push('martial-trained');
      if (!tags.length) tags.push('developing');
      root.progression.buildIdentity.tags = tags;
      root.progression.buildIdentity.summary = tags.join(', ');
    },
    estimateEnemyXp: function (profile) {
      profile = profile || {};
      var level = WL.U.clamp(profile.level || 1, 1, 999999);
      var xp = level * 4;
      var type = WL.U.lower(profile.type || profile.species || '');
      if (/rat/.test(type)) xp = Math.max(1, xp - 3);
      if (/soldier|guard|human/.test(type)) xp += 8;
      if (/wolf/.test(type)) xp += 4;
      if (/inferno|fire|demon|dragon|ancient|legendary|magical/.test(type)) xp += level * 3 + 20;
      if (/tiny/.test(WL.U.lower(profile.size || ''))) xp = Math.max(1, Math.floor(xp * 0.5));
      if (/trained|veteran|elite/.test(WL.U.lower(profile.training || ''))) xp += 10;
      if (/human|sapient|genius/.test(WL.U.lower(profile.intelligence || ''))) xp += 6;
      return Math.max(1, Math.floor(xp));
    },
    compareStats: function (a, b, stat) {
      stat = stat || 'spd';
      var av = Number((a && a.stats && a.stats[stat]) || 0);
      var bv = Number((b && b.stats && b.stats[stat]) || 0);
      if (av === bv) return 'tie';
      return av > bv ? 'a' : 'b';
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      WL.ProgressionSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = Object.keys(root.progression.domainXp).map(function (k) { return k + ':' + root.progression.domainXp[k]; }).join(', ') || '(none)';
      return [
        'Level: ' + root.progression.level + ' | Level XP: ' + root.progression.levelXp + '/' + root.progression.xpToNext + ' | Total XP: ' + (root.progression.totalEarnedXp || root.progression.xp || 0),
        'Lanes: ability ' + root.progression.abilityXp + ', skill ' + root.progression.skillXp + ', talent ' + root.progression.talentXp + ', passive ' + root.progression.passiveXp + ', domain ' + root.progression.xpLanes.domain,
        'Stat XP: ATK ' + root.progression.statXp.atk + ', DEF ' + root.progression.statXp.def + ', SPD ' + root.progression.statXp.spd + ', INT ' + root.progression.statXp.int + ', LCK ' + root.progression.statXp.lck,
        'Domains: ' + d,
        'Build: ' + root.progression.buildIdentity.summary
      ];
    }
  };

  // Owner note: AbilityLifecycleSystem keeps ability-like concepts in the inbox/candidate path before stable transfer.
  WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      var fresh = WL.Schema.root();
      ['abilities', 'skills', 'talents', 'passives'].forEach(function (k) { if (!root[k] || typeof root[k] !== 'object') root[k] = WL.U.clone(fresh[k]); });
      if (!Array.isArray(root.abilities.inboxIds)) root.abilities.inboxIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.abilities.candidateIds)) root.abilities.candidateIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.abilities.failedIds)) root.abilities.failedIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.abilities.denied)) root.abilities.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.abilities.transferLog)) root.abilities.transferLog = [];
    },
    abilityId: function (name) { return 'ability_' + WL.U.slug(name || 'unknown'); },
    getOrCreateInbox: function (root, name, source, phrase) {
      WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.ensure(root);
      var display = WL.U.title(name || 'Unknown Ability');
      var id = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(display);
      var rec = root.abilities.inboxById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id: id, name: display, status: 'inbox', evidence: [], evidenceHashes: [], compactUseCount: 0, repeatCount: 0, successCount: 0, failureCount: 0, trainingCount: 0, category: 'unclassified', stable: false, origin: source || 'observed' };
        root.abilities.inboxById[id] = rec;
        root.abilities.inboxIds.push(id);
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(rec.evidenceHashes)) rec.evidenceHashes = [];
      if (typeof rec.compactUseCount !== 'number') rec.compactUseCount = 0;
      if (typeof rec.repeatCount !== 'number') rec.repeatCount = 0;
      if (phrase) WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.addCompactEvidence(rec, phrase, source || 'observed', root.runtime.currentTurn);
      return rec;
    },
    addCompactEvidence: function (rec, phrase, source, turn) {
      var clean = WL.U.norm(phrase || '').slice(0, 220);
      if (!clean) return rec;
      var h = WL.U.hash(clean);
      if (!Array.isArray(rec.evidenceHashes)) rec.evidenceHashes = [];
      if (rec.evidenceHashes.indexOf(h) >= 0) {
        rec.repeatCount = (rec.repeatCount || 0) + 1;
        rec.lastRepeatedEvidence = { turn: turn, phraseHash: h, source: source || 'observed' };
        return rec;
      }
      rec.evidenceHashes.push(h);
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidenceHashes, 24);
      var compact = /\b(?:again|same|practiced|repeated|once more|another)\b/i.test(clean) || (rec.evidence && rec.evidence.length >= 8);
      if (compact) {
        rec.compactUseCount = (rec.compactUseCount || 0) + 1;
        rec.lastCompactEvidence = { turn: turn, phrase: clean, source: source || 'observed' };
        if (!rec.evidenceSummary) rec.evidenceSummary = [];
        rec.evidenceSummary.push({ turn: turn, source: source || 'observed', note: WL.U.title(rec.name || 'Ability') + ' repeated/practiced evidence', phraseHash: h });
        WL.U.capArray(rec.evidenceSummary, 8);
      } else {
        rec.evidence.push({ turn: turn, phrase: clean, source: source || 'observed' });
        WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 8);
      }
      return rec;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'ability_evidence_candidate' || p.type === 'failed_attempt_candidate' || p.type === 'training_evidence_candidate') return WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.recordEvidence(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'category_transfer_request') return WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.transferCategory(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'keys_update_request') return WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.setPlayerKeys(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'cost_pressure_candidate') return WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.recordCostPressure(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'cost_observation_candidate') return WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.recordCostObservation(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'skill_gain_candidate') return WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.recordSkillGain(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: validation.type, reason: 'unsupported_ability_event' };
    },
    recordEvidence: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var name = proposal.data.abilityName || proposal.data.targetName || proposal.targetName || 'Unknown Ability';
      var rec = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.getOrCreateInbox(root, name, proposal.type, proposal.textPreview);
      if (proposal.type === 'failed_attempt_candidate') {
        rec.failureCount += 1; rec.status = 'failed_candidate'; root.abilities.failedById[rec.id] = rec; if (root.abilities.failedIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.abilities.failedIds.push(rec.id);
      } else if (proposal.type === 'training_evidence_candidate') {
        rec.trainingCount += 1; rec.compactUseCount = (rec.compactUseCount || 0) + 1; rec.status = 'candidate'; root.abilities.candidatesById[rec.id] = rec; if (root.abilities.candidateIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.abilities.candidateIds.push(rec.id);
      } else {
        rec.successCount += 1; rec.compactUseCount = (rec.compactUseCount || 0) + 1; rec.status = 'candidate'; root.abilities.candidatesById[rec.id] = rec; if (root.abilities.candidateIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.abilities.candidateIds.push(rec.id);
      }
      var costRec = WL.AbilityCostSystem.observeUse(root, rec.name, { kind: proposal.type, textPreview: proposal.textPreview, key: ledger.key });
      rec.costId = costRec.id;
      rec.costConfidence = costRec.confidence;
      rec.developmentStage = costRec.developmentStage;
      WL.AbilityDevelopmentMatrix.touchRecord(root, rec.name, costRec.developmentStage, costRec.id);
      root.abilities.recent.push({ action: 'evidence', abilityId: rec.id, type: proposal.type, stage: rec.developmentStage, costId: rec.costId, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.abilities.recent, 50);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'ability', type: 'evidence', abilityId: rec.id, stage: rec.developmentStage, costId: rec.costId, key: ledger.key };
    },
    recordSkillGain: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var name = WL.U.title(proposal.data.abilityName || proposal.data.targetName || 'Unknown Skill');
      var rec = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.getOrCreateInbox(root, name, 'explicit_skill_gain', proposal.textPreview);
      rec.successCount += 1;
      rec.status = 'candidate';
      root.abilities.candidatesById[rec.id] = rec;
      if (root.abilities.candidateIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.abilities.candidateIds.push(rec.id);
      WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installSkill(root, rec, { status: 'stable', reason: 'explicit_story_skill_gain' });
      var skillCost = WL.AbilityCostSystem.observeUse(root, name, { kind: 'skill_gain_candidate', textPreview: proposal.textPreview, key: ledger.key });
      WL.AbilityDevelopmentMatrix.touchRecord(root, name, skillCost.developmentStage, skillCost.id);
      root.abilities.recent.push({ action: 'skill_gain', abilityId: rec.id, key: ledger.key });
      WL.U.capArray(root.abilities.recent, 50);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'ability', type: 'skill_gain', abilityId: rec.id, skillId: 'skill_' + WL.U.slug(name), key: ledger.key };
    },
    transferCategory: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var name = WL.U.title(proposal.data.abilityName || proposal.data.targetName || 'Unknown Ability');
      var category = WL.U.lower(proposal.data.category || 'ability');
      var rec = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.getOrCreateInbox(root, name, 'category_transfer_request', proposal.textPreview);
      var verdict = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.validateTransfer(root, rec, category);
      var log = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, abilityId: rec.id, name: name, category: category, status: verdict.status, reason: verdict.reason, key: ledger.key };
      root.abilities.transferLog.push(log); WL.U.capArray(root.abilities.transferLog, 60);
      if (verdict.status === 'denied') { root.abilities.denied.push(log); WL.U.capArray(root.abilities.denied, 40); return { status: 'DENIED', applied: true, family: 'ability', type: 'category_transfer', abilityId: rec.id, category: category, reason: verdict.reason, key: ledger.key }; }
      if (category === 'skill') WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installSkill(root, rec, verdict);
      else if (category === 'talent') WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installTalent(root, rec, verdict);
      else if (category === 'passive') WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installPassive(root, rec, verdict);
      else WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.installAbility(root, rec, verdict);
      var transferCost = WL.AbilityCostSystem.estimate(root, name, category, verdict.reason);
      WL.AbilityDevelopmentMatrix.touchRecord(root, name, transferCost.developmentStage, transferCost.id);
