      if (m) { var mon3 = money(m[2], m[3]); var un = cleanAssetName(m[1]); out.push({ family: 'domainAsset', type: 'domain_upkeep_evidence_candidate', targetId: assetId(un) + '_upkeep_' + WL.U.hash(c), assetId: assetId(un), assetName: un, amount: mon3.amount, currency: mon3.currency, evidenceKind: /repair/i.test(c) ? 'maintenance' : 'upkeep', status: 'evidence_only_no_auto_spend', confidence: 'confirmed_domain_upkeep_evidence' }); }
      return out;
    },

    detectCraftingCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var out = [];
      if (!c) return out;
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      if (/\b(?:debug|command|example|instruction|pretend|joke|dream|vision|rumor|rumour|plan|plans|intend|intends|want|wants|wish|wishes|try to|tries to|attempts? to|fails? to|failed to|cannot|can't|could not|couldn't)\b/.test(lower) && /\b(?:craft|recipe|repair|forge|assemble|quality|masterwork)\b/.test(lower)) {
        out.push({ type: 'crafting_denial', reason: 'unconfirmed_or_noncanonical_crafting_language', denied: true, confidence: 'crafting_denial_guard' });
        return out;
      }
      function craftId(name) { return 'craft_' + WL.U.slug(WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(name || 'unknown_craft')); }
      function recipeId(name) { return 'recipe_' + WL.U.slug(WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(name || 'unknown_recipe')); }
      function parseCraftTime(txt) {
        var t = WL.U.norm(txt || '');
        var tm = t.match(/(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|a|an)\s+(minutes?|hours?|days?|weeks?)/i);
        if (!tm) return null;
        return { amount: WL.EventScanner.numberWord(tm[1]), unit: WL.U.lower(tm[2]).replace(/s$/, '') };
      }
      function cleanProjectName(raw) {
        return WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(raw || '')
          .replace(/\s+(?:using|with|from|for)\s+[\s\S]*$/i, '')
          .replace(/\s+(?:recipe|project|item)$/i, '')
          .trim();
      }
      function qualityFromText(txt) {
        var l = WL.U.lower(txt || '');
        if (/\b(?:masterwork|mastercrafted|legendary)\b/.test(l)) return 'masterwork';
        if (/\b(?:excellent|superior|fine|high-quality|high quality)\b/.test(l)) return 'fine';
        if (/\b(?:poor|crude|rough|flawed|shoddy)\b/.test(l)) return 'poor';
        if (/\b(?:repaired|restored|mended)\b/.test(l)) return 'repaired';
        return '';
      }
      var m;
      m = c.match(/\byou\s+(?:learn|learned|discover|discovered|study|studied)\s+(?:the\s+)?recipe\s+for\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80})\b/i);
      if (m) {
        var rn = cleanProjectName(m[1]);
        if (rn) out.push({ type: 'crafting_recipe_candidate', recipeName: rn, recipeId: recipeId(rn), status: 'known_recipe_evidence', confidence: 'confirmed_recipe_knowledge' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\byou\s+(?:craft|crafted|forge|forged|assemble|assembled|prepare|prepared|begin crafting|start crafting|work on)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90}?)(?:\s+(?:using|with|from)\s+([^.!?;]{3,180}))?(?:\s+for\s+([^.!?;]{3,80}))?[.!?]?$/i);
      if (m && !/\b(?:complete|completed|finish|finished|fail|failed|cannot|can't)\b/i.test(c)) {
        var cn = cleanProjectName(m[1]);
        if (cn) out.push({ type: 'crafting_project_candidate', projectName: cn, projectId: craftId(cn), materials: WL.EventScanner.parseMaterialList(m[2] || ''), time: parseCraftTime((m[2] || '') + ' ' + (m[3] || '')), quality: qualityFromText(c), status: 'in_progress_evidence_only', confidence: 'confirmed_crafting_project_evidence' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:after\s+)?(?:consuming|using|spending)\s+([^.!?;]{3,180})\s+(?:you\s+)?(?:complete|finish|finished|complete crafting|finish crafting|craft|crafted|forge|forged)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90})\b/i);
      if (m) {
        var dn = cleanProjectName(m[2]);
        if (dn) out.push({ type: 'crafting_completion_candidate', projectName: dn, projectId: craftId(dn), materials: WL.EventScanner.parseMaterialList(m[1] || ''), time: parseCraftTime(m[1] || ''), quality: qualityFromText(c), status: 'completion_evidence_pending_inventory_validation', confidence: 'confirmed_crafting_completion_evidence' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\byou\s+(?:repair|repaired|mend|mended|fix|fixed|restore|restored)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90}?)(?:\s+(?:using|with|from)\s+([^.!?;]{3,180}))?[.!?]?$/i);
      if (m) {
        var rep = cleanProjectName(m[1]);
        if (rep) out.push({ type: 'crafting_repair_candidate', projectName: rep, projectId: craftId('repair_' + rep), materials: WL.EventScanner.parseMaterialList(m[2] || ''), time: parseCraftTime(m[2] || ''), status: /\b(?:completed|finished|restored|fixed|repaired)\b/i.test(c) ? 'repair_completion_evidence' : 'repair_evidence_only', confidence: 'confirmed_repair_evidence' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90}?)\s+(?:is|comes out|turns out|proves)\s+(?:as\s+)?(?:a\s+)?(masterwork|mastercrafted|fine|excellent|superior|poor|crude|rough|flawed|shoddy|high-quality|high quality)\b/i);
      if (m) {
        var qn = cleanProjectName(m[1]);
        if (qn) out.push({ type: 'crafting_quality_candidate', projectName: qn, projectId: craftId(qn), quality: qualityFromText(m[2]), status: 'quality_evidence', confidence: 'confirmed_crafting_quality_evidence' });
      }
      return out;
    },

    detectWarfareCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var out = [];
      if (!c || !(WL.WarfareSystem && WL.WarfareSystem.dedicatedOwnerActive)) return out;
      if (WL.SourceGuard && WL.SourceGuard.isCommandLike && WL.SourceGuard.isCommandLike(c)) return out;
      if (/\b(?:debug|command|check says|test says|example|joke|pretend|dream|vision|rumou?r|prophecy|wanted to|plans? to|will try to|would march|could take)\b/i.test(c)) {
        if (/\b(?:army|soldiers|guards|militia|forces|legion|company|battalion|raiders|bandits|casualties|capture|control)\b/i.test(c)) out.push({ type: 'warfare_denial', reason: 'noncanonical_or_command_like_warfare_text', targetName: 'warfare_denial', confidence: 'denied_warfare_evidence' });
        return out;
      }
      var m;
      function forceId(name) { return 'force_' + WL.U.slug(WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(name)); }
      function placeId(name) { return 'place_' + WL.U.slug(WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(name)); }
      function num(v) { return WL.EventScanner.numberWord(v); }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:an?\s+)?(?:army|force|company|legion|battalion|warband|unit)\s+of\s+(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|thirteen|fourteen|fifteen|sixteen|seventeen|eighteen|nineteen|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|seventy|eighty|ninety|hundred)\s+([a-z][a-z' -]{2,70}?)\s+(?:march|marches|advance|advances|arrive|arrives|hold|holds|guard|guards|deploy|deploys|rally|rallies)\b/i);
      if (m) {
        var fn = WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(m[2]);
        if (fn) out.push({ type: 'warfare_force_candidate', forceName: fn, forceId: forceId(fn), count: num(m[1]), status: 'active_force_evidence', confidence: 'confirmed_warfare_force_record' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|thirteen|fourteen|fifteen|sixteen|seventeen|eighteen|nineteen|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|seventy|eighty|ninety|hundred)\s+([a-z][a-z' -]{2,70}?)\s+(?:march|marches|advance|advances|arrive|arrives|hold|holds|guard|guards|deploy|deploys|rally|rallies)\b/i);
      if (m && /soldiers?|guards?|militia|raiders?|bandits?|knights?|archers?|spearmen|mercenaries|legionaries|forces?|troops?/i.test(m[2])) {
        var fn2 = WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(m[2]);
        if (fn2) out.push({ type: 'warfare_force_candidate', forceName: fn2, forceId: forceId(fn2), count: num(m[1]), status: 'active_force_evidence', confidence: 'confirmed_warfare_force_record' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|thirteen|fourteen|fifteen|sixteen|seventeen|eighteen|nineteen|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|seventy|eighty|ninety|hundred)\s+([a-z][a-z' -]{2,70}?)\s+(?:die|died|are killed|were killed|fall|fell|are lost|were lost|become casualties|are wounded|were wounded)\b(?:\s+(?:in|during|to|from|after)\s+([^.!?;]{0,100}))?/i);
      if (m && /soldiers?|guards?|militia|raiders?|bandits?|knights?|archers?|spearmen|mercenaries|legionaries|forces?|troops?/i.test(m[2])) {
        var fn3 = WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(m[2]);
        if (fn3) out.push({ type: 'warfare_casualty_candidate', forceName: fn3, forceId: forceId(fn3), casualties: num(m[1]), casualtyKind: /wounded/i.test(m[0]) ? 'wounded' : 'dead_or_lost', reason: WL.U.norm(m[3] || ''), confidence: 'confirmed_warfare_casualties' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90}?)\s+(?:take|takes|took|capture|captures|captured|seize|seizes|seized|hold|holds|held|claim|claims|claimed|control|controls|controlled)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,100})\b/i);
      if (m && /soldiers?|army|guard|guards|militia|forces?|company|legion|raiders?|bandits?|knights?|troops?|warband/i.test(m[1])) {
        var fn4 = WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(m[1]);
        var pn = WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(m[2]);
        if (fn4 && pn) out.push({ type: 'warfare_control_candidate', forceName: fn4, forceId: forceId(fn4), placeName: pn, placeId: placeId(pn), truthStatus: 'claim_until_proven', confidence: 'warfare_control_claim_evidence_only' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90}?)\s+morale\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:breaks|broken|collapses|rises|holds|falters|improves|surges|low|high)\b/i);
      if (m && /soldiers?|army|guard|guards|militia|forces?|company|legion|raiders?|bandits?|knights?|troops?|warband/i.test(m[1])) {
        var moraleForce = WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(m[1]);
        out.push({ type: 'warfare_morale_candidate', forceName: moraleForce, forceId: forceId(moraleForce), morale: /rises|holds|improves|surges|high/i.test(c) ? 'improved_or_steady' : 'low_or_breaking', confidence: 'warfare_morale_evidence' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90}?)\s+(?:run|runs|ran|are running|is running)\s+(?:low|short|out)\s+on\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80})\b/i);
      if (m && /soldiers?|army|guard|guards|militia|forces?|company|legion|raiders?|bandits?|knights?|troops?|warband/i.test(m[1])) {
        var logForce = WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(m[1]);
        out.push({ type: 'warfare_logistics_candidate', forceName: logForce, forceId: forceId(logForce), logistics: 'shortage', resource: WL.EventScanner.cleanMaterialName(m[2]), confidence: 'warfare_logistics_evidence' });
      }
      return out;
    },


    detectEvolutionAbsorptionCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var out = [];
      if (!c || !WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem) return out;
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      var m;

      function denied(reason, rawName) {
        var name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(rawName || 'evolution absorption claim') || 'Evolution Absorption Claim';
        out.push({ type: 'evolution_absorption_denial', denied: true, reason: reason || 'unsafe_or_unvalidated_evolution_absorption_claim', candidateId: 'evo_abs_denied_' + WL.U.hash(c), sourceName: name, targetForm: name, status: 'denied', confidence: 'denied_evolution_absorption_claim' });
      }
      function unsafeMechanics(text) {
        return /\b(?:gain(?:s|ed)?\s+(?:\d{2,6}|huge|massive|infinite|unlimited)\s+(?:xp|stats?|strength|atk|def|spd|int|lck|levels?)|\+?\d{2,6}\s+(?:xp|stats?|strength|atk|def|spd|int|lck)|becomes?\s+(?:level\s+\d{2,6}|a\s+god|godlike)|overwrites?\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:race|true\s+race|form)|true\s+race\s+(?:is|becomes?|changes?)|current\s+form\s+(?:is|becomes?|changes?)|instant(?:ly)?\s+(?:master|evolve|ascend|transform))\b/i.test(text);
      }
      function nonCanon(text) {
        return /\b(?:dream|vision|rumor|rumour|joke|pretend|example|instruction|debug|command|check output|worldledger)\b/i.test(text);
      }
      function progressFor(text) {
        if (/\b(?:stable|stabilizes|stabilised|stabilized|settles|locks in|integrates fully)\b/i.test(text)) return 10;
        if (/\b(?:repeated|several|many|again|threshold|progresses|deepens|advances|stirs|adapts|adaptation)\b/i.test(text)) return 3;
        return 1;
      }
      function statusFor(text, kind) {
        if (/\b(?:stable|stabilizes|stabilised|stabilized|settles|locks in|integrates fully)\b/i.test(text)) return 'stable_candidate_evidence_only';
        if (/\b(?:repeated|several|many|threshold|progresses|deepens|advances|stirs|adaptation)\b/i.test(text)) return kind === 'evolution' ? 'unstable_evolution_threshold_evidence' : 'unstable_absorption_threshold_evidence';
        return 'candidate_evidence_only';
      }

      if (nonCanon(c)) {
        if (/\b(?:absorb|absorbs|absorbed|absorption|evolve|evolves|evolved|evolution|metamorphosis|adaptation)\b/i.test(c)) denied('noncanonical_command_debug_dream_or_instruction_claim');
        return out;
      }
      if (/\b(?:everyone|everybody|all\s+(?:people|races|nations)|the\s+whole\s+world)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:absorbs?|evolves?|transforms?|ascends?)\b/i.test(c)) {
        denied('overbroad_universal_evolution_absorption_claim');
        return out;
      }
      if (unsafeMechanics(c)) {
        denied('mechanical_grant_or_race_overwrite_requires_form_progression_validation');
        return out;
      }

      m = c.match(/\byou\s+(?:absorb|absorbed|draw in|take in|consume|assimilate)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)(?:\s+(?:essence|blood|core|fragment|power|energy))?\b/i);

      }

      m = c.match(/\b(?:after\s+)?(?:repeated|several|many)\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)(?:\s+(?:essence|absorptions?|exposures?|fragments?|cores?))(?:,)?\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?\s+)?(?:essence|energy|power|threshold)\s+(?:begins?|starts?)\s+to\s+(?:change|alter|reshape|adapt)\s+(?:you|your\s+body|your\s+traits?)\b/i);

      }

      m = c.match(/\b(?:your\s+)?(?:evolution|metamorphosis|adaptation)\s+(?:toward|into)\s+(?:an?\s+|the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80})\s+(?:progresses|deepens|advances|stirs|stabilizes|stabilized|settles)\b/i);

      }

      if (!(WL.CraftingSystem && WL.CraftingSystem.dedicatedOwnerActive)) {

      }

      if (!(WL.WarfareSystem && WL.WarfareSystem.dedicatedOwnerActive)) {

      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)\s+(?:take|takes|capture|captures|seize|seizes|hold|holds)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80})\b/i);

      m = c.match(/\b(?:your\s+)?(?:evolution|metamorphosis|adaptation)\s+(?:toward|into)\s+(?:an?\s+|the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80})\s+(?:progresses|deepens|advances|stirs)\b/i);

    detectRaceTraitCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var out = [];
      if (!c || !WL.RaceTraitSystem) return out;
      if (/\b(?:dream|vision|rumor|rumour|joke|pretend|example|instruction|debug|command)\b/i.test(c)) return out;
      var raceName = root && root.player && (root.player.trueRace || root.player.raceSpecies || root.player.currentForm) || '';
      var m = c.match(/\b(Orcs?|Elves?|Dwarves?|Giants?|Humans?|Halflings?|Gnomes?|Merfolk|Spirits?|Dragonkin|Beastfolk|Goblinoids?|Kobolds?|Centaurs?)\b[\s\S]{0,180}\b(?:are|have|possess|excel|show|tend|gain|carry|inherit|are known for)\b[\s\S]{2,220}/i);
      if (m) raceName = WL.RaceTraitSystem.raceName(m[1]);
      if (!raceName || /^unknown$/i.test(raceName)) return out;
      var source = { sourceType: 'output_lore', sourceTitle: 'story output', sourceHash: WL.U.hash(c), confidence: 'output_lore_candidate' };
      if (WL.RaceTraitSystem.hasMechanicalGrantClaim(c)) {
        out.push({ type: 'race_trait_candidate', targetId: 'race_trait_denied_' + WL.U.slug(raceName) + '_' + WL.U.hash(c), raceName: raceName, denied: true, confidence: 'denied_mechanical_claim' });
        return out;
      }
      var cands = WL.RaceTraitSystem.extractCandidatesFromText(raceName, c, source);
      if (cands.length) out.push({ type: 'race_trait_candidate', targetId: 'race_trait_batch_' + WL.U.slug(raceName) + '_' + WL.U.hash(c), raceName: raceName, candidates: cands, confidence: 'output_lore_candidate' });
      return out;
    },
    detectBodyFormulaCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);

      if (!c || !root || !WL.BodyFormulaSystem) return out;

      if (/\b(?:orc|orcs|your build|your body|your frame|your strength|broad shoulders|powerful build)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:helps?|lets?|allows?|makes it easier|gives you leverage)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:shove|push|lift|haul|move|break|force)\b/i.test(c) || /\b(?:shove|push|lift|haul|move)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:cart|gate|boulder|debris|beam|wagon)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:because of|thanks to|with)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:body|build|strength|frame)\b/i.test(c)) {

      }
      if (/\b(?:small|short|halfling|gnome|kobold|small frame|small body)\b[\s\S]{0,160}\b(?:greatsword|oversized|large armor|heavy shield|too large|does not fit|awkward|unwieldy)\b/i.test(c) || /\b(?:greatsword|oversized|large armor|heavy shield)\b[\s\S]{0,160}\b(?:awkward|unwieldy|too large|does not fit)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:small|short|halfling|gnome|kobold|body|frame)\b/i.test(c)) {
        out.push({ type: 'body_formula_evidence_candidate', targetId: 'body_formula_small_equipment_' + WL.U.slug(raceName) + '_' + WL.U.hash(c), raceName: raceName, actionKind: 'equipment_fit_constraint', constraintKind: 'equipment_constraint', label: 'small form equipment fit', summary: 'Confirmed story output links small body/form to oversized equipment pressure.', triggers: ['greatsword', 'oversized gear', 'large armor'], confidence: 'confirmed_body_formula_constraint' });
      }
      if (/\b(?:wings?|flight|flying)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:cramped|low ceiling|too narrow|bound|pinned|no room)\b/i.test(c)) {

      }
      if (/\b(?:gills?|aquatic|water|swim|submerged)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:helps?|allows?|lets?|makes it easier|pressure|dry land|needs water)\b/i.test(c)) {
        out.push({ type: 'body_formula_evidence_candidate', targetId: 'body_formula_aquatic_' + WL.U.slug(raceName) + '_' + WL.U.hash(c), raceName: raceName, actionKind: 'aquatic_environment_fit', modifierKind: 'environment_fit', label: 'aquatic environment fit', summary: 'Confirmed story output links aquatic body traits to water/depth action fit or pressure.', effects: { environment: 'water', automaticSuccess: false }, confidence: 'confirmed_body_formula_evidence' });

    detectSocialTreatmentCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var out = [];
      if (!c || !root || !WL.SocialTreatmentSystem) return out;
      if (/\b(?:dream|vision|rumor|rumour|joke|pretend|example|instruction|debug|command)\b/i.test(c)) return out;
      var raceName = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.currentRace(root);
      var raceMatch = c.match(/\b(Orcs?|Elves?|Dwarves?|Giants?|Humans?|Halflings?|Gnomes?|Merfolk|Spirits?|Dragonkin|Beastfolk|Goblinoids?|Kobolds?|Centaurs?|Demi-Humans?)\b/i);
      if ((!raceName || /^unknown$/i.test(raceName)) && raceMatch) raceName = WL.U.title(raceMatch[1]);
      if (!raceName || /^unknown$/i.test(raceName)) return out;
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      if (/\b(?:everyone|everybody|all\s+(?:people|towns|nations|races)|the\s+whole\s+world)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:hates?|fears?|respects?|obeys?|trusts?)\b/i.test(c)) {
        out.push({ type: 'social_treatment_candidate', targetId: 'social_treatment_denied_' + WL.U.slug(raceName) + '_' + WL.U.hash(c), raceName: raceName, denied: true, reason: 'universal_social_claim_requires_scoped_evidence', confidence: 'denied_overbroad_social_claim' });
        return out;
      }
      function cleanActor(v) { return WL.EventScanner.cleanActorName ? WL.EventScanner.cleanActorName(v || '') : WL.U.title(v || ''); }
      function cleanLocal(v) { return WL.EventScanner.cleanPlaceName ? WL.EventScanner.cleanPlaceName(v || '') : WL.U.title(v || ''); }
      function pushTreatment(actorRaw, axisRaw, trigger, intensity, summary) {
        var actor = cleanActor(actorRaw || 'Unknown Actor') || WL.U.title(actorRaw || 'Unknown Actor');
        if (!actor) return;
        var axis = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.normalizeAxis(axisRaw || 'attitude');
        out.push({ type: 'social_treatment_candidate', targetId: 'social_treatment_' + WL.U.slug([raceName, actor, axis, trigger || 'trait'].join('_')), raceName: raceName, scopeKind: 'actor', scopeName: actor, actorName: actor, axis: axis, treatmentKind: axis, trigger: WL.U.title(trigger || 'Visible Trait'), intensity: intensity || 'low', summary: summary || 'Confirmed story output links race/body presentation to social treatment evidence.', confidence: 'confirmed_social_treatment_evidence' });
      }
      function pushLocal(localRaw, axisRaw, trigger, intensity, summary) {
        var local = cleanLocal(localRaw || 'Local Area') || WL.U.title(localRaw || 'Local Area');
        if (!local) return;
        var axis = WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.normalizeAxis(axisRaw || 'attitude');
        out.push({ type: 'social_treatment_candidate', targetId: 'social_attitude_' + WL.U.slug([raceName, local, axis].join('_')), raceName: raceName, localAttitude: true, scopeKind: 'local', scopeName: local, localName: local, axis: axis, treatmentKind: axis, trigger: WL.U.title(trigger || 'Race/Body Evidence'), intensity: intensity || 'low', summary: summary || 'Confirmed local/social scene evidence affects treatment context only.', confidence: 'confirmed_local_attitude_evidence' });
      }
      var m;
      if (/\b(?:tusks?|horns?|tail|wings?|claws?|fangs?|scales?|orcish\s+face|demonic\s+(?:look|features)|draconic\s+eyes)\b/i.test(c) && /\b(?:frightens?|scares?|alarms?|intimidates?|unsettles?|recoils?|flinches?|steps?\s+back)\b/i.test(c)) {
        var simpleActor = (c.match(/\b(clerk|guard|merchant|child|crowd|bystanders?|locals?)\b/i) || ['', 'bystander'])[1];
        var simpleTrait = (c.match(/\b(tusks?|horns?|tail|wings?|claws?|fangs?|scales?|orcish\s+face|demonic\s+(?:look|features)|draconic\s+eyes)\b/i) || ['', 'visible trait'])[1];
        pushTreatment(simpleActor, 'fear', simpleTrait, /panic|terrifi|pale/i.test(lower) ? 'medium' : 'low', 'Visible race/body trait creates fear or unease evidence for this actor/group.');
      }
      if (/\b(?:respects?|admires?|honou?rs?|is\s+impressed\s+by)\b/i.test(c) && /\b(?:smith|guard|elder|merchant|clerk|captain|dwarven|elven|orcish|lineage|heritage|discipline)\b/i.test(c)) {
        var respectActor = (c.match(/\b(smith|guard|elder|merchant|clerk|captain)\b/i) || ['', 'bystander'])[1];
        var respectTrigger = (c.match(/\b(dwarven\s+lineage|elven\s+grace|orcish\s+strength|lineage|heritage|craft\s+discipline|discipline|build)\b/i) || ['', 'race/body presentation'])[1];
        pushTreatment(respectActor, 'respect', respectTrigger, 'low', 'Actor reaction confirms respect evidence from race/body/cultural presentation.');
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:your\s+)?(tusks?|horns?|tail|wings?|claws?|fangs?|scales?|orcish\s+face|demonic\s+(?:look|features)|draconic\s+eyes)\b[\s\S]{0,100}\b(?:frightens?|scares?|alarms?|intimidates?|unsettles?|makes\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50}|clerk|guard|merchant|child|crowd)\s+recoil)\b(?:\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50}|clerk|guard|merchant|child|crowd))?/i);
      if (m) pushTreatment(m[2] || m[3] || 'bystander', 'fear', m[1], /terrif|panic/i.test(lower) ? 'medium' : 'low', 'Visible race/body trait creates fear or unease evidence for this actor/group.');
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50}|clerk|guard|merchant|child|crowd)\s+(?:recoils?|flinches?|steps?\s+back|goes\s+pale|stiffens?)\s+(?:at|from|because\s+of)\s+(?:your\s+)?(tusks?|horns?|tail|wings?|claws?|fangs?|scales?|orcish\s+face|demonic\s+(?:look|features)|draconic\s+eyes)\b/i);
      if (m) pushTreatment(m[1], 'fear', m[2], /panic|pale/i.test(lower) ? 'medium' : 'low', 'Actor reaction confirms fear/unease evidence from visible race/body trait.');
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?\s+(?:quarter|district|market|village|town|camp|court|hall|guild|temple|clan))\s+(?:treats?|regards?|views?|receives?)\s+(?:you|your\s+[^.!?;,]{1,40})\s+(?:with|as|like)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) pushLocal(m[1], m[2], /orc|tusk|horn|elf|dwarf|demon|beast/i.test(c) ? 'race/body presentation' : 'social presentation', /hostile|hate|fear|spit|threat/i.test(WL.U.lower(m[2])) ? 'medium' : 'low', 'Named local/social group treatment is recorded as scoped attitude evidence only.');
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?\s+(?:quarter|district|market|village|town|camp|court|hall|guild|temple|clan))\s+(?:treats?|regards?|views?|receives?)\s+(?:you|your\s+[^.!?;,]{1,40})\s+(?:differently|warily|coldly|with\s+suspicion|with\s+respect)\b/i);
      if (m) pushLocal(m[1], /respect/i.test(m[0]) ? 'respect' : 'prejudice', 'race/body presentation', /respect/i.test(m[0]) ? 'low' : 'medium', 'Named local/social group reacts to race/body presentation as scoped attitude evidence.');
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50}|smith|guard|elder|merchant|clerk|captain)\s+(?:respects?|admires?|honou?rs?|is\s+impressed\s+by)\s+(?:your\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)(?:\s+lineage|\s+discipline|\s+heritage|\s+build|\s+restraint)?\b/i);
      if (m) pushTreatment(m[1], 'respect', m[2], 'low', 'Actor reaction confirms respect evidence from race/body/cultural presentation.');
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50}|clerk|guard|merchant|elder|captain)\s+(?:eyes?|watches?|studies?)\s+(?:your\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})\s+(?:with\s+)?(suspicion|distrust|fear|respect|curiosity)\b/i);
      if (m) pushTreatment(m[1], m[3], m[2], /fear|suspicion|distrust/i.test(m[3]) ? 'low' : 'low', 'Actor gaze/reaction records scoped social treatment evidence.');
      return out;
    },
    detectFormBodyCandidates: function (clause) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      var out = [];
      var m;
      function cleanForm(v) { return WL.U.title(WL.U.norm(v).replace(/^(?:a|an|the)\s+/i, '').replace(/\s+(?:form|body)$/i, '')); }
      function injurySeverity() {
        if (/\b(?:severe|terrible|deep|gaping|crippling|crushed|shattered|broken bone|cracked ribs?|fractured ribs?|broken ribs?|spurts?|gushes?|badly)\b/.test(lower)) return 'severe';
        if (/\b(?:blood|bleeding|burns?|poison|venom|limps?|sprain|deep)\b/.test(lower)) return 'moderate';
        return 'minor';
      }
      function damageFor(sev) { return sev === 'severe' ? 16 : (sev === 'moderate' ? 8 : 4); }
      function isMetaphoricalDamageText(text) { return /\b(?:cuts?|slashes?)\s+through\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:air|noise|street noise|silence|crowd|conversation|attention|sound|whistle|voices?)\b/i.test(text); }
      function isNonPhysicalLocation(loc) { return /^(?:through\s+)?(?:the\s+)?(?:air|noise|street noise|silence|crowd|conversation|attention|sound|whistle|voice|words?)\b/i.test(WL.U.lower(loc || '')); }
      function exertionConditionName() { if (/\b(?:exhausted|exhaustion|collapse from exhaustion)\b/.test(lower)) return 'exhausted'; if (/\b(?:winded|panting|ragged gasps?|breath(?:ing)?\s+(?:quickens|comes)|out of breath)\b/.test(lower)) return 'winded'; return 'fatigued'; }
      function exertionSeverity() { if (/\b(?:dangerously low|collapse|collapsed|exhausted|all day|seven|eight|nine|ten|twelve|hours?)\b/.test(lower)) return 'moderate'; return 'minor'; }
      function exertionEpDamage() { if (/\b(?:burned? through a good chunk|good chunk|energy is low|energy is flagging|exhausted|all day)\b/.test(lower)) return 18; if (/\b(?:winded|panting|ragged gasps?|tired|fatigued|sweating|muscles? burn|legs? ache|calves? ache|thighs? ache)\b/.test(lower)) return 10; return 6; }
      if (/\b(dream|vision|nightmare)\b/.test(lower)) {
        m = c.match(/\b(?:becomes?|turns? into|transforms? into|looks? like)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
        if (m) out.push({ type: /\bvision\b/.test(lower) ? 'vision_form_candidate' : 'dream_form_candidate', targetForm: cleanForm(m[1]), confidence: 'non_canon_dream_or_vision' });
        return out;
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:disguise(?:s)? yourself as|disguised as|pretend(?:s)? to be)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) { out.push({ type: 'disguise_form_candidate', targetForm: cleanForm(m[1]), confidence: 'confirmed_disguise_only' }); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:illusion|glamor|glamour)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:look(?:s)? like|appear(?:s)? as|seem(?:s)? to be)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) { out.push({ type: 'illusion_form_candidate', targetForm: cleanForm(m[1]), confidence: 'confirmed_illusion_only' }); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:temporarily|for now|for a moment|briefly)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:becomes?|turns? into|transforms? into)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) { out.push({ type: 'temporary_form_candidate', targetForm: cleanForm(m[1]), confidence: 'confirmed_temporary_form' }); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:permanently|forever|irreversibly)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:becomes?|turns? into|transforms? into|changes? into)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) { out.push({ type: 'permanent_form_candidate', targetForm: cleanForm(m[1]), confidence: 'confirmed_permanent_form' }); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:your\s+)?(?:race|species)\s+(?:changes?|shifts?)\s+(?:to|into)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) { out.push({ type: 'race_shift_candidate', targetForm: cleanForm(m[1]), confidence: 'confirmed_race_shift' }); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:wings?|horns?|tail|claws?|fangs?|gills?)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:grow|sprout|tear|burst|emerge|form)\b|\b(?:grow|sprout|tear|burst|emerge|form)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:wings?|horns?|tail|claws?|fangs?|gills?)\b/i);
      if (m) {
        var traitMatch = c.match(/\b(wings?|horns?|tail|claws?|fangs?|gills?)\b/i);
        out.push({ type: 'body_trait_candidate', trait: traitMatch ? cleanForm(traitMatch[1]) : 'Body Mutation', confidence: 'confirmed_body_trait' });
      }
      if (/\b(?:you\s+are|you're|you\s+lie)\s+(?:dead|dying)\b|\byou\s+(?:die|died)\b/i.test(c)) {
        out.push({ type: 'body_condition_candidate', condition: 'dead', severity: 'fatal', hpDamage: 999999, duration: 'permanent_until_revival_or_retcon', confidence: 'confirmed_death_boundary' });
        return out;
      }
      if (/\b(?:cracks?|fractures?|breaks?)\s+(?:your\s+)?ribs?\b|\byour\s+ribs?\s+(?:crack|cracks|fracture|fractures|break|breaks|are\s+(?:cracked|fractured|broken))\b/i.test(c)) {
        out.push({ type: 'body_injury_candidate', injury: 'Cracked Ribs', location: 'Ribs', severity: 'severe', hpDamage: 12, confidence: 'confirmed_rib_injury' });
        return out;
      }
      var oldWound = c.match(/\b(?:old\s+)?(?:wound|injury)\s+in\s+your\s+(calves?|calf|leg|arm|shoulder|side|ribs?)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:throb|throbs|ache|aches|hurt|hurts|pain|aggravat|burns?)\b/i);
      if (oldWound) {
        var oldLoc = cleanForm(oldWound[1]);
        out.push({ type: 'body_injury_candidate', injury: 'Old ' + oldLoc + ' Wound', location: oldLoc, severity: 'minor', hpDamage: 0, confidence: 'existing_injury_aggravation_no_new_hp_damage' });
      }
      if (!isMetaphoricalDamageText(c)) {
        m = c.match(/\b(?:cuts?|slashes?|stabs?|bites?|burns?|poisons?|breaks?|crushes?|shatters?|cracks?|fractures?)\s+(?:your\s+)?([a-z][a-z -]{1,40})\b|\byour\s+([a-z][a-z -]{1,40})\s+(?:is|are)\s+(cut|slashed|stabbed|bitten|burned|poisoned|broken|crushed|shattered|cracked|fractured)\b/i);
      } else m = null;
      if (m) {
        var rawLoc = WL.U.norm(m[1] || m[2] || 'body').replace(/\s+and\b[\s\S]*$/i, '').replace(/\s+(?:leaves?|leaving|sending|causing|forcing)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
        var loc = cleanForm(rawLoc);
        var sev = injurySeverity();
        if (isNonPhysicalLocation(rawLoc)) {
          // Live 9.3C: metaphorical cut/slash targets are not body injuries.
        } else if (/poison|venom|spider/.test(lower)) out.push({ type: 'body_condition_candidate', condition: 'poisoned', severity: sev === 'minor' ? 'moderate' : sev, hpDamage: 4, duration: 'until_treated_or_recovered', confidence: 'confirmed_poison_condition' });
        else out.push({ type: 'body_injury_candidate', injury: loc + ' wound', location: loc, severity: sev, hpDamage: damageFor(sev), confidence: 'confirmed_body_injury' });
      } else if ((/\bpoison\b|\bvenom\b/.test(lower) && /\b(?:burns?|courses?|spreads?|in your veins|bites?)\b/.test(lower)) || /\bspider\s+bites?\s+you\b[\s\S]{0,80}\bpoison\b/i.test(lower)) {
        out.push({ type: 'body_condition_candidate', condition: 'poisoned', severity: 'moderate', hpDamage: 4, duration: 'until_treated_or_recovered', confidence: 'confirmed_poison_condition' });
      }
      if (/\b(?:jump|jumps|jumping|run|running|sprint|sprinting|climb|climbing|train|training|practice|march|marching|swim|swimming|lift|lifting|work|labor|haul|dig|carry|docks?)\b[\s\S]{0,140}\b(?:tired|winded|exhausted|fatigued|fatigue|sweat|sweating|pant|panting|breath|ragged gasps?|energy|flagging|burn(?:ed)? through|muscles? burn|legs? ache|calves? ache|thighs? ache)\b/i.test(lower) || /\b(?:energy\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:low|flagging)|burned? through a good chunk|winded|panting|ragged gasps?|out of breath)\b/i.test(lower) || /\b(?:hours?|day|shift)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:work|labor|haul|dig|march|train|practice|carry|lifting|docks?)\b|\b(?:work|labor|haul|dig|march|train|practice|carry|lifting)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:hours?|shift|until exhausted|tired|fatigue)\b/i.test(lower)) {
        out.push({ type: 'body_condition_candidate', condition: exertionConditionName(), severity: exertionSeverity(), epDamage: exertionEpDamage(), hpDamage: 0, duration: 'until_rest', confidence: 'confirmed_exertion_ep_fatigue_no_hp_damage' });
      }
      return out;
    },

    cleanAbilityName: function (name) {
      var n = WL.U.norm(name)
        .replace(/^(?:the|a|an|your)\s+/i, '')
        .replace(/^(?:same\s+practiced|practiced)\s+/i, '')
        .replace(/\s+(?:as\s+you\s+level\s+up|through\s+training|from\s+practice)$/i, '')
        .replace(/\s+(?:at|toward|against|into|onto|on)\s+(?:the\s+)?[a-z][\s\S]*$/i, '')
        .replace(/\s+until\s+[\s\S]*$/i, '')
        .replace(/\s+(?:again|carefully|successfully|hard|under pressure)$/i, '')
        .replace(/\b(?:spell|technique|skill|ability|passive|talent)$/i, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
      if (!n || n.length < 2) return '';
      if (/^(?:sword|dagger|coin|key|ring|lantern|map|potion|quest|task|mission)$/i.test(n)) return '';
      return WL.U.title(n);
    },

    detectPartyFollowerCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var out = [];
      if (!c || !root || !WL.PartyFollowerSystem) return out;
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      if (/\b(?:dream|vision|rumor|rumour|joke|pretend|example|instruction|debug|command)\b/.test(lower)) return out;

      function denied(reason, name) {
        out.push({ type: 'party_follower_candidate', denied: true, reason: reason || 'not_persistent_party_evidence', actorName: WL.U.title(name || ''), targetId: 'party_denied_' + WL.U.hash(c), confidence: 'denied_party_follower_claim' });
      }
      function cleanName(name) {
        name = WL.U.norm(name || '').replace(/^(?:the|a|an|your)\s+/i, '').replace(/\s+(?:says|asks|agrees|joins|leaves|waits|stays|dies|is|was|has|had)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
        if (/^(?:everyone|everybody|anyone|someone|nobody|all\s+(?:people|towns|nations|races)|whole\s+world|the\s+whole\s+world)\b/i.test(name)) return '';
        name = WL.U.title(name);
        if (!name || /^(?:You|Your|He|She|They|Them|It|The|A|An|Guard|Guards|Soldier|Soldiers|Villager|Villagers|Stranger|Someone|Everyone|Everybody|Anyone|Nobody|Companion|Follower|Party|Group|Crew)$/i.test(name)) return '';
        if (name.split(/\s+/).length > 4) return '';
        return name;
      }
      function emit(kind, name, role, status, place) {
        name = cleanName(name);
        if (!name) { denied('generic_or_unnamed_helper_not_party_member', name); return; }
        out.push({ type: 'party_follower_candidate', partyAction: kind || 'join', actorName: name, role: role || 'companion', status: status || 'active', presence: status === 'elsewhere' ? 'elsewhere' : (status === 'dead' || status === 'left' ? 'absent' : 'present'), lastKnownPlace: place || '', targetId: 'party_member_' + WL.U.slug(name), confidence: 'confirmed_party_follower_evidence' });
      }

      if (/\b(?:a|an|the)\s+(?:guard|soldier|villager|stranger|merchant|servant|worker|porter|scout)\s+(?:helps?|helped|assists?|assisted|guides?|guided)\s+you\b/.test(lower) && !/\b(?:joins?|joined|becomes?|became|agrees?|agreed)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:party|companion|follower|travel with you|come with you)\b/.test(lower)) {
        denied('generic_helper_scene_only');
        return out;
      }
      if (/\b(?:plans?|planned|wants?|wanted|promises?|promised|might|may|would|could|refuses?|refused|declines?|declined|does not|doesn't|did not|didn't|not yet)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:join|follow|travel with you|come with you|become your companion)\b/.test(lower)) {
        denied('nonconfirmed_future_or_refused_party_membership');
        return out;
      }
      if (/\b(?:everyone|everybody|all\s+(?:people|towns|nations|races)|the\s+whole\s+world|whole\s+world)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:joins?|joined|follows?|followed|becomes?|became)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:party|group|company|crew|companion|follower)\b/.test(lower)) {
        denied('overbroad_collective_not_party_member');
        return out;
      }

      var m;
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:joins?|joined)\s+(?:your|the)\s+(party|group|company|crew)\b/);
      if (m) { emit('join', m[1], 'companion', 'active', ''); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:agrees?|agreed)\s+to\s+(?:travel|come|go|walk|ride)\s+with\s+you\b/);
      if (m) { emit('join', m[1], 'companion', 'active', ''); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:becomes?|became|is now)\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:new\s+)?(companion|follower|party member|ally)\b/i);
      if (m) { emit('join', m[1], m[2] || 'companion', 'active', ''); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:recruit|recruited|invite|invited)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:as|to be|into)\s+(?:your\s+|the\s+)?(companion|follower|party|party member|guide|scout|healer|guard)\b/i);
      if (m) { emit('join', m[1], m[2] === 'party' ? 'companion' : m[2], 'active', ''); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:follows?|followed)\s+you\s+as\s+(?:a\s+)?(companion|follower|guide|scout|healer|guard)\b/i);
      if (m) { emit('join', m[1], m[2] || 'follower', 'active', ''); return out; }

      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:leaves?|left|parts?\s+ways\s+with)\s+(?:your|the)?\s*(?:party|group|company|crew)?\b/);
      if (m && /\b(?:party|group|company|crew|parts ways)\b/i.test(c)) { emit('status', m[1], 'companion', 'left', ''); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:stays?|stayed|waits?|waited|remains?|remained)\s+behind(?:\s+at\s+the\s+([A-Za-z' -]{2,60}))?\b/i);
      if (m) { emit('status', m[1], 'companion', 'elsewhere', m[2] ? WL.U.title(m[2]) : 'behind'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:returns?|returned)\s+to\s+(?:your|the)\s+(?:party|group|company|crew)\b/i);
      if (m) { emit('status', m[1], 'companion', 'active', ''); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+(?:dies|died|is killed|was killed|falls dead)\b/i);
      if (m) { emit('status', m[1], 'companion', 'dead', ''); return out; }
      return out;
    },


    detectSummonCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var out = [];
      if (!c || !root || !WL.SummonSystem) return out;
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      function denied(reason, name) {
        out.push({ type: 'summon_candidate', denied: true, reason: reason || 'not_confirmed_summon_evidence', summonName: WL.U.title(name || ''), targetId: 'summon_denied_' + WL.U.hash(c), confidence: 'denied_summon_claim' });
      }
      function countOf(raw) {
        raw = WL.U.lower(raw || 'one');
        if (/^\d+$/.test(raw)) return Number(raw);
        var map = { one: 1, a: 1, an: 1, single: 1, two: 2, three: 3, four: 4, five: 5, six: 6, seven: 7, eight: 8, nine: 9, ten: 10, dozen: 12 };
        return map[raw] || 1;
      }
      function cleanName(name) {
        name = WL.U.norm(name || '').replace(/^(?:a|an|the|your|bound|summoned|temporary)\s+/i, '');
        name = name.replace(/\s+(?:for|until|that|who|which|and|but|with|to)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
        name = name.replace(/\s+(?:appears?|forms?|materializes?|arrives?|remains?|stays?|obeys?|follows?)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
        name = WL.U.title(name);
        if (!name || /^(?:You|Your|Everyone|Everybody|Anyone|Someone|Something|Nothing|Army|Horde|Legion|Summon|Creature|Monster|Beast|Spirit)$/i.test(name)) return '';
        if (name.split(/\s+/).length > 4) return '';
        return name;
      }
      function emit(action, name, status, duration, controlState, kind) {
        name = cleanName(name);
        if (!name) { denied('generic_or_unnamed_summon_not_recorded'); return; }
        out.push({ type: 'summon_candidate', summonAction: action || 'summon', summonName: name, summonKind: kind || 'summon', controller: 'player', duration: WL.U.safeString(duration || ''), expiresAtNote: WL.U.safeString(duration || ''), status: status || 'active', controlState: controlState || 'controlled_evidence', targetId: 'summon_' + WL.U.slug(name), confidence: 'confirmed_summon_evidence' });
      }

      if (/\b(?:dream|vision|rumou?r|joke|pretend|example|instruction|debug|command)\b/.test(lower)) return out;
      if (/\b(?:plan|plans|planned|want|wanted|hope|hoped|might|may|would|could|try|tries|tried|attempt|attempts|attempted|fail|fails|failed|refuse|refuses|refused|not yet|cannot|can't|does not|doesn't|did not|didn't)\b[\s\S]{0,100}\b(?:summon|conjure|call forth|bind)\b/.test(lower)) { denied('nonconfirmed_future_failed_or_refused_summon'); return out; }
      if (/\b(?:army|horde|legion|swarm|host|hundreds|thousands|everyone|everybody|whole world|the whole world)\b[\s\S]{0,100}\b(?:summon|summoned|appears?|arrives?)\b/.test(lower)) { denied('overbroad_or_army_summon_denied'); return out; }

      var m;
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:summon|summoned|conjure|conjured|call forth|called forth)\s+(?:(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|a|an|single)\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)(?:\s+(for\s+[^.!?;]{2,40}|until\s+[^.!?;]{2,40}))?(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m) {
        var count = countOf(m[1] || 'one');
        if (count !== 1) { denied('multi_summon_requires_later_capacity_system', m[2]); return out; }
        emit('summon', m[2], 'active', m[3] || '', 'controlled_evidence', 'summon');
        return out;
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)\s+(?:appears?|appeared|materializes?|materialized)\s+(?:as\s+)?(?:your\s+)?(?:summon|summoned creature|bound spirit)(?:\s+(for\s+[^.!?;]{2,40}|until\s+[^.!?;]{2,40}))?/i);
      if (m) { emit('summon', m[1], 'active', m[2] || '', 'controlled_evidence', 'summon'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)\s+(?:remains?|remained|is|was)\s+bound\s+to\s+you(?:\s+(for\s+[^.!?;]{2,40}|until\s+[^.!?;]{2,40}))?/i);
      if (m) { emit('bound', m[1], 'active', m[2] || '', 'bound_control', 'bound_summon'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:lose|lost)\s+control\s+of\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m) { emit('control_lost', m[1], 'uncontrolled', '', 'control_lost', 'summon'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)\s+(?:fades?|faded|vanishes?|vanished|expires?|expired|dissolves?|dissolved)\s+(?:away)?(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m && /\b(?:summon|spirit|shade|wolf|elemental|familiar|phantom|wraith|servitor|bound)\b/i.test(m[1] + ' ' + c)) { emit('expired', m[1], 'expired', '', 'expired_or_faded', 'summon'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:dismiss|dismissed|release|released)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m) { emit('dismissed', m[1], 'dismissed', '', 'dismissed_by_controller', 'summon'); return out; }
      return out;
    },
    detectControlledEntityCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      var out = [];
      function isTemp() { return /\b(?:for a moment|briefly|temporary|temporarily|just this once|for now|until the scene ends|dream|vision|rumou?r|joke|pretend|example|instruction|debug|command)\b/i.test(c); }
      function countOf(word) { var w = WL.U.lower(word || 'one'); var map = { a:1, an:1, single:1, one:1, two:2, three:3, four:4, five:5, six:6, seven:7, eight:8, nine:9, ten:10 }; return map[w] || Number(w) || 1; }
      function denied(reason, name, kind) { out.push({ family: 'controlledEntity', type: 'controlled_entity_candidate', denied: true, reason: reason, entityName: WL.U.title(name || ''), kind: kind || '', confidence: 'denial_record' }); }
      function emit(action, name, kind, status, condition, custody, note) {
        name = WL.ControlledEntitySystem && WL.ControlledEntitySystem.cleanEntityName ? WL.ControlledEntitySystem.cleanEntityName(name || '') : WL.U.title(name || ''); kind = WL.ControlledEntitySystem ? WL.ControlledEntitySystem.normalizeKind(kind, name) : (kind || 'controlled');
        out.push({ family: 'controlledEntity', type: 'controlled_entity_candidate', action: action || 'controlled_entity_status', entityName: name, kind: kind, entityKind: kind, status: status || '', condition: condition || 'sound', custody: custody || '', owner: 'player', note: WL.U.safeString(note || ''), targetName: name, targetId: 'controlled_' + WL.U.slug(kind) + '_' + WL.U.slug(name), confidence: 'confirmed_controlled_entity_evidence' });
      }
      if (!c || !root || !WL.ControlledEntitySystem) return out;
      if (/\b(?:everyone|everybody|whole world|the whole world|all people|all nations|all races|army|horde|legion|hundreds|thousands)\b[\s\S]{0,100}\b(?:pets?|mounts?|vehicles?|horses?|wagons?|carts?|boats?|ships?|ride|owned by you|belongs to you)\b/.test(lower)) { denied('overbroad_controlled_entity_claim_denied'); return out; }
      if (/\b(?:plan|plans|planned|want|wanted|hope|hoped|might|may|would|could|try|tries|tried|attempt|attempts|attempted|fail|fails|failed|refuse|refuses|refused|not yet|cannot|can't|does not|doesn't|did not|didn't|promise|promises|someday)\b[\s\S]{0,100}\b(?:buy|rent|tame|claim|mount|ride|pet|vehicle|horse|wagon)\b/.test(lower)) { denied('nonconfirmed_future_failed_or_refused_controlled_entity'); return out; }
      if (isTemp() && /\b(?:follows|helps|carries|guards|mount|ride|pet)\b/.test(lower)) { denied('temporary_scene_only_controlled_entity', '', 'controlled'); return out; }
      var m;
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:buy|bought|purchase|purchased)\s+(?:(?:a|an|the|your)\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)(?:\s+(?:as|for)\s+(?:a\s+)?(pet|mount|vehicle|wagon|cart|boat|horse))?(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m) { emit('acquire', m[1], m[2] || m[1], 'controlled', 'sound', 'owned', 'confirmed purchase/control evidence'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:rent|rented|hire|hired|borrow|borrowed)\s+(?:(?:a|an|the|your)\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m && /\b(?:horse|pony|mule|donkey|camel|wagon|cart|carriage|boat|ship|raft|sled|coach|mount|vehicle)\b/i.test(m[1])) { emit('rent', m[1], m[1], 'rented', 'sound', 'rented', 'rental/custody evidence'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:tame|tamed|adopt|adopted|claim|claimed)\s+(?:(?:a|an|the|your)\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)\s+(?:as\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:pet|mount)|to\s+ride|as\s+your\s+steed)(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m) { emit('acquire', m[1], /ride|steed|mount/i.test(c) ? 'mount' : 'pet', 'controlled', 'sound', 'controlled', 'tamed/adopted custody evidence'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:your\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)\s+(?:is|becomes|became)\s+(?:your\s+)?(pet|mount|vehicle|steed)(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m) { emit('acquire', m[1], m[2], 'controlled', 'sound', 'controlled', 'explicit controlled entity relationship'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:your\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)\s+(?:bolts|bolted|runs away|ran away|escapes|escaped|disappears|disappeared|is lost|was lost)(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m && /\b(?:horse|pony|mule|donkey|camel|wagon|cart|carriage|boat|ship|raft|pet|dog|cat|wolf|hawk|mount|vehicle)\b/i.test(m[1] + ' ' + c)) { emit('lost', m[1], m[1], 'lost', 'sound', 'lost', 'custody lost evidence'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+|your\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)\s+(?:is|was|becomes|became)?\s*(damaged|broken|wrecked|injured|hurt|lame|tired|exhausted)(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m && /\b(?:horse|pony|mule|donkey|camel|wagon|cart|carriage|boat|ship|raft|pet|dog|cat|wolf|hawk|mount|vehicle|wheel)\b/i.test(m[1] + ' ' + c)) { emit('condition', m[1], m[1], '', m[2], '', 'condition evidence'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:repair|repaired|fix|fixed|mend|mended|heal|healed)\s+(?:the\s+|your\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m && /\b(?:horse|pony|mule|donkey|camel|wagon|cart|carriage|boat|ship|raft|pet|dog|cat|wolf|hawk|mount|vehicle|wheel)\b/i.test(m[1] + ' ' + c)) { emit('repair', m[1], m[1], '', 'repaired', '', 'repair/healing evidence'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:return|returned|release|released|sell|sold)\s+(?:the\s+|your\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?)(?:[.!?;]|$)/i);
      if (m && /\b(?:horse|pony|mule|donkey|camel|wagon|cart|carriage|boat|ship|raft|pet|dog|cat|wolf|hawk|mount|vehicle)\b/i.test(m[1] + ' ' + c)) { emit('release', m[1], m[1], 'released', 'sound', 'released', 'release/return evidence'); return out; }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:your\s+)?(horse|pony|mule|donkey|camel|wagon|cart|carriage|boat|ship|raft|dog|cat|hawk|falcon|pet wolf|riding lizard)\s+(?:waits|waited|carries|carried|pulls|pulled|bears|bore|travels|traveled)\b/i);
      if (m) { emit('confirmed_presence', m[1], m[1], '', 'sound', '', 'presence/travel capability evidence'); return out; }
      return out;
    },

    detectStatFormulaCandidates: function (clause, root) {

      }
      if (/\b(?:you|player)\s+(?:chase|chases|chased|pursue|pursues|pursued|outrun|outruns|outran|sprint|sprints|sprinted|dash|dashes|dashed)\b/i.test(c)) emit('chase', 'spd', 'movement', 'SPD affects chase/evasion pressure');
      if (/\b(?:you|player)\s+(?:dodge|dodges|dodged|evade|evades|evaded|sidestep|sidesteps|sidestepped)\b/i.test(c)) emit('evasion', 'spd', 'evasion', 'SPD affects evasion and reaction positioning');

      if (/\b(?:you|player)\s+(?:strike|strikes|struck|slash|slashes|slashed|punch|punches|punched|shove|shoves|shoved|lift|lifts|lifted|break|breaks|broke)\b/i.test(c)) emit('force', 'atk', 'physical force', 'ATK affects forceful physical output and weapon pressure');
      if (/\b(?:luck|lucky|fortune|chance|instinct|barely|by a hair|near miss)\b/i.test(c) && /\b(?:you|player)\b/i.test(c)) emit('uncertainty', 'lck', 'chance', 'LCK affects uncertainty, opportunity, and lucky survival notes');
      return out;
    },
    detectXPBudgetCandidates: function (clause, root) {

    detectProgressionFormulaCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      var out = [];
      if (!c) return out;
      if (/\b(?:command|debug|check|audit|worldledger|sourceaudit|schemaaudit|build\d+check)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:xp|experience|level\s+up|gains?)\b/.test(lower)) return out;
      if (/\b(?:example|sample|pretend|joke|joking|dream|vision|wish|plan|would gain|could gain|should gain|might gain|if you gain|manual says|card says|context says)\b/.test(lower) && /\b(?:xp|experience|level\s+up|levelled|leveled)\b/.test(lower)) return out;
      if (WL.EventScanner.isCombatRewardXpClause && WL.EventScanner.isCombatRewardXpClause(c)) return out;
      var m = c.match(/\b(?:you|player)\s+(?:gain|gained|earn|earned|receive|received|are awarded|were awarded)\s+(\d{1,5})\s*(?:xp|experience)(?:\s+(?:toward|to|for|in)\s+([a-z][a-z' -]{1,80}))?/i);
      if (m) {

        var laneText = WL.U.lower(m[2] || 'level');
        var lane = 'level';
        if (/skill/.test(laneText)) lane = 'skill';
        else if (/talent/.test(laneText)) lane = 'talent';
        else if (/passive/.test(laneText)) lane = 'passive';
        else if (/stat|strength|speed|defense|defence|intelligence|luck/.test(laneText)) lane = 'stat';
        else if (/domain|craft|forge|magic|sword|martial|social|labor|leadership|trade|travel/.test(laneText)) lane = 'domain';
        else if (/ability|spell|technique|training|practice/.test(laneText)) lane = 'ability';
        var domains = [];
        if (lane === 'domain') domains.push(WL.U.slug(laneText.replace(/\bxp\b/g, '') || 'general'));
        out.push({ type: 'xp_candidate', targetId: 'progression_xp_' + lane + '_' + amount + '_' + WL.U.hash(c), lane: lane, amount: amount, domains: domains, stats: WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem && WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.statHintsFromText ? WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.statHintsFromText(laneText + ' ' + c) : {}, reason: 'explicit_story_xp_gain', levelCredit: true, confidence: 'confirmed_explicit_xp_gain' });
        return out;
      }
      if (/\b(?:you|player)\s+(?:level|levels|leveled|levelled)\s+up\b/i.test(c)) {
        out.push({ type: 'level_up_confirmation_candidate', targetId: 'progression_level_up_confirmation_' + WL.U.hash(c), reason: 'explicit_story_level_up_confirmation', confidence: 'confirmed_level_up_language' });
      }
      return out;
    },
    detectAbilityProgressionCandidates: function (clause, hookKind) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      var out = [];
      var m, name;
      if (/\b(?:only read the title|learn nothing|no usable technique remains|do not know that technique|don't know that technique|pretend to use|joking|as a joke|manual says|scroll title says)\b/i.test(lower)) return out;
      if (hookKind === 'output') {
        var explicitCost = WL.AbilityCostSystem.parseExplicitCostClause(c);
        if (explicitCost && explicitCost.abilityName) {
          out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'cost_observation_candidate', abilityName: explicitCost.abilityName, targetName: explicitCost.abilityName, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(explicitCost.abilityName), observedCost: explicitCost, confidence: 'explicit_story_cost_observation' });
        }
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:gain|gained|learn|learned|unlock|unlocked|acquire|acquired)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:skill|technique|ability)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80})(?:\s+as\s+you\s+level\s+up|\s+through\s+training|\s+from\s+practice)?/i);
      if (m) {
        name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
        if (name) {
          out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'skill_gain_candidate', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), category: 'skill', confidence: 'explicit_story_skill_gain' });
          out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'skill', amount: 5, domains: WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name), stats: WL.EventScanner.statXpForAbility(name), reason: 'explicit_skill_gain', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
        }
        return out;
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:set|add|update)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)\s+keys?\s*[:=]\s*([^.!?]{1,180})/i);
      if (!m) m = c.match(/\b([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)\s+keys?\s+(?:are|as)\s+([^.!?]{1,180})/i);
      if (m) {
        name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
        var keys = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.cleanKeys ? WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.cleanKeys(m[2]) : String(m[2] || '').split(/[,;|]/);
        if (name && keys.length) out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'keys_update_request', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), keys: keys, confidence: hookKind === 'input' ? 'player_management_request' : 'story_keys_evidence' });
        return out;
      }
      if (hookKind === 'output') {
        m = c.match(/\b(?:overcharge|overcharges)\s+(?:your\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)(?:\s+(?:until|beyond|past|with|through|so)\b|[.!?;,]|$)/i);
        if (!m) m = c.match(/\b(?:push|pushes|force|forces)\s+(?:your\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)\s+(?:beyond|past|over|through)\s+(?:its\s+|your\s+)?(?:limit|limits|maximum|safe limit)/i);
        if (m) {
          name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
          if (name) {
            var hpRisk = /blood|life force|lifeforce|sacrifice|vein|heart|flesh|body burns|burns inside|burning inside/.test(lower) ? 4 : 0;
            var mpRisk = /mana|mind|focus|headache|arcane|spell|magic/.test(lower) ? 3 : 1;
            var epRisk = /strain|fatigue|muscle|breath|exhaust|body/.test(lower) ? 3 : 1;
            out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'cost_pressure_candidate', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), riskWords: c, hpRisk: hpRisk, mpRisk: mpRisk, epRisk: epRisk, confidence: 'observed_overcharge_cost_pressure' });
          }
        }
      }
      if (hookKind === 'output') {
        m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?(?:Ward|Step|Stance|Guard|Form|Style|Palm|Fang|Slash|Veil|Shield|Technique|Art))\s+(?:forms?|flares?|activates?|settles?|wraps?|surges?|ignites?|holds?)\b[\s\S]{0,120}\b(?:again|same|practiced|practice|repeated|familiar)\b/i);
        if (!m) m = c.match(/\b(?:you\s+)?(?:settle|settles|drop|drops|shift|shifts)\s+into\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?(?:Stance|Guard|Form|Style|Art))\b/i);
        if (!m) m = c.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?same\s+practiced\s+([A-Z]?[A-Za-z' -]{2,60}?\s*(?:ward|stance|guard|technique|form|style))\b/i);
        if (m) {
          name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
          if (name) {
            out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'ability_evidence_candidate', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), compact: true, confidence: 'practiced_repeated_ability_evidence' });
            out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'ability', amount: 1, domains: WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name), stats: WL.EventScanner.statXpForAbility(name), reason: 'practiced_ability_use_compact', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
          }
          return out;
        }
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:make|set|classify|treat)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)\s+(?:(?:as|into|to be)\s+)?(?:a\s+|an\s+)?(skill|passive|talent|ability)\b/i);
      if (m) {
        name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
        if (name) out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'category_transfer_request', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), category: WL.U.lower(m[2]), confidence: hookKind === 'input' ? 'player_management_request' : 'story_category_evidence' });
        return out;
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:try|tries|attempt|attempts)\s+to\s+(?:cast|use|perform|activate|shape)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)(?:\s*,?\s*(?:but|and)\s+|\s+but\b|\s+fails?\b|\s+fizzles?\b|\s+sputters?\b)/i);
      if (m) {
        name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
        if (name) out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'failed_attempt_candidate', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), confidence: 'failed_attempt_evidence' });
        return out;
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:successfully\s+)?(?:cast|casts|perform|performs|activate|activates)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) {
        name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
        if (name) {
          out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'ability_evidence_candidate', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), confidence: 'successful_use_evidence' });
          out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'ability', amount: 5, domains: WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name), stats: WL.EventScanner.statXpForAbility(name), reason: 'successful_ability_use', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
        }
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:practice|practices|train|trains|trained)\s+(?:your\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) {
        name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
        if (name) {
          out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'training_evidence_candidate', abilityName: name, targetName: name, targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name), confidence: 'training_evidence' });
          out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'ability', amount: 3, domains: WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name), stats: WL.EventScanner.statXpForAbility(name), reason: 'training_or_practice', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
        }
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:study|studies|studied)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) {
        name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(m[1]);
        if (name) out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'ability', amount: 2, domains: WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name), stats: { int: 2 }, reason: 'study_or_theory', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
      }
      if (/\binspect(?:s|ed)?\b/.test(lower)) {
        out.push({ family: 'ability', type: 'ability_evidence_candidate', abilityName: 'Inspection', targetName: 'Inspection', targetId: WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId('Inspection'), confidence: 'practical_ability_use' });
        out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'ability', amount: 2, domains: ['investigation'], stats: { int: 1, lck: 1 }, reason: 'inspection_use', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
      }
      if (/\b(sprint|dash|dodge|evade|outrun)\b/.test(lower)) out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'stat', amount: 2, domains: ['mobility'], stats: { spd: 3 }, reason: 'mobility_pressure', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
      if (/\b(block|endure|withstand|brace)\b/.test(lower)) out.push({ family: 'progression', type: 'xp_candidate', lane: 'stat', amount: 2, domains: ['defense'], stats: { def: 3 }, reason: 'defensive_pressure', confidence: 'confirmed_output_growth' });
      return out;
    },
    detectAbilityGrowthCandidates: function (clause, root, hookKind) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      var out = [];
      if (!c || hookKind !== 'output') return out;
      if (/\b(?:only read the title|learn nothing|no usable technique remains|do not know that technique|don't know that technique|pretend to use|joking|as a joke|manual says|scroll title says|debug|command output|example)\b/i.test(lower)) return out;
      if (/^[A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50}\s+(?:attempts?|tries|trains|practices|casts|uses|performs|activates)\b/.test(c) && !/^You\b/.test(c)) return out;
      function cleanGrowthName(raw) {
        var name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAbilityName(raw || '');
        name = WL.U.norm(name)
          .replace(/\s+(?:for|during|over)\s+(?:an?\s+)?\d{1,3}\s*(?:minutes?|hours?|days?|weeks?|turns?)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '')
          .replace(/\s+(?:for|during|over)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:hour|minute|day|week|turn|morning|evening|night)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '')
          .replace(/\s+(?:until|while|with|under|inside|in)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '')
          .replace(/\s+(?:again|repeatedly|carefully|steadily|successfully)$/i, '')
          .trim();
        return name ? WL.U.title(name) : '';
      }
      function push(kind, rawName, extra) {
        var name = cleanGrowthName(rawName);
        if (!name) return;
        extra = extra || {};
        extra.type = kind === 'category_transfer' ? 'ability_category_growth_candidate' : 'ability_growth_candidate';
        extra.growthKind = kind;
        extra.abilityName = name;
        extra.targetName = name;
        extra.targetId = WL.AbilityLifecycleSystem.abilityId(name);
        if (kind === 'category_transfer') extra.targetId = extra.targetId + '_category_' + WL.U.slug(extra.category || 'ability');
        extra.category = extra.category || 'ability';
        extra.domains = WL.AbilityCostSystem.classifyDomain(name);
        extra.confidence = extra.confidence || 'ability_growth_evidence';
        out.push(extra);
      }
      var m;
      m = c.match(/\b(?:try|tries|attempt|attempts)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?:cast|use|perform|activate|shape)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)(?:\s*,?\s*(?:but|and)\s+|\s+but\b|\s+fails?\b|\s+fizzles?\b|\s+sputters?\b)/i);
      if (m) {
        push('failed_attempt', m[1], { denied: true, reason: 'failed_attempt_does_not_stabilize_ability', masteryDelta: 0, costPressure: { failure: 1 }, confidence: 'denied_until_more_evidence' });
        return out;
      }
      m = c.match(/\b(?:after\s+)?(?:repeated|steady|focused|weeks?\s+of|days?\s+of)?\s*(?:practice|practices|train|trains|trained|training)\s+(?:your\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,90})/i);
      if (m) {
        var weight = /\b(?:repeated|steady|focused|weeks?\s+of|days?\s+of|stabilizes?|stabilized|mastered|mastery)\b/i.test(c) ? 3 : 1;
        push('training', m[1], { trainingWeight: weight, masteryDelta: 2 * weight, confidence: weight >= 3 ? 'strong_training_evidence' : 'training_evidence' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?(?:Ward|Step|Stance|Guard|Form|Style|Palm|Fang|Slash|Veil|Shield|Technique|Art|Spell|Fireball))\s+(?:stabilizes?|stabilized|settles?|settled|becomes\s+stable|is\s+now\s+stable)\b/i);
      if (m) push('training', m[1], { trainingWeight: 3, masteryDelta: 6, explicitStable: true, confidence: 'explicit_stabilization_evidence' });
      m = c.match(/\b(?:successfully\s+)?(?:cast|casts|perform|performs|activate|activates|use|uses)\s+([^.!?;,]{2,80})/i);
      if (m) push('success', m[1], { masteryDelta: 3, confidence: 'successful_use_growth_evidence' });
      m = c.match(/\b(?:using|casting|activating|performing|maintaining)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)\s+(?:in|under|during|while)\s+([^.!?;]{2,120})/i);
      if (m && /\b(?:rain|storm|underwater|snow|wind|dark|sunlight|moonlight|forest|desert|cave|city|fatigue|wounded|injured|exhausted|tired)\b/i.test(m[2])) {
        push('environment_pressure', m[1], { environment: WL.U.norm(m[2]).slice(0, 80), masteryDelta: 1, confidence: 'environment_cost_pressure_evidence' });
      }
      m = c.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)\s+(?:stabilizes?|stabilized|settles?|settled)\s+as\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?(skill|passive|talent|ability)\b/i);
      if (m) push('category_transfer', m[1], { category: WL.U.lower(m[2]), trainingWeight: 3, masteryDelta: 5, explicitStable: true, confidence: 'story_category_stabilization_evidence' });
      return out;
    },
    statXpForAbility: function (name) {
      var n = WL.U.lower(name);
      if (/fire|spell|magic|rune|inspect|study/.test(n)) return { int: 2 };
      if (/sword|slash|blade/.test(n)) return { atk: 2, spd: 1 };
      if (/box|punch|fist/.test(n)) return { atk: 1, def: 1 };
      if (/regen|heal/.test(n)) return { def: 1 };
      return {};
    },
    detectQuestCandidate: function (clause) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      var m, giver, objective, reward;
      // Build 7.4: quest offers may come from named people, organizations, or generic institutions like the guild.
      m = c.match(/^((?:The\s+)?[A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,70}|the\s+[a-z][a-z' -]{2,50})\s+(?:asks?|asked|hires?|hired|tasks?|contracts?|contracted|charges?)\s+you\s+to\s+([^.!?;]{3,220}?)(?:\s+and\s+promises?\s+(\d{1,6})\s+(copper|silver|gold))?[.!?]?$/i);
      if (!m) m = c.match(/^((?:The\s+)?[A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,70}|the\s+[a-z][a-z' -]{2,50})\s+offers?\s+(?:you\s+)?(?:a\s+)?(?:quest|task|mission|contract)\s+to\s+([^.!?;]{3,220}?)(?:\s+for\s+(\d{1,6})\s+(copper|silver|gold))?[.!?]?$/i);
      if (m) {
        giver = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestGiver(m[1]);
        objective = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestObjective(m[2]);
        reward = m[3] ? { amount: Number(m[3]), currency: WL.U.lower(m[4] || 'gold'), payer: giver } : null;
        return { type: 'offer_candidate', giver: giver, objective: objective, title: WL.EventScanner.makeQuestTitle(objective), reward: reward, links: WL.EventScanner.extractQuestObjectiveLinks(objective, giver), confidence: 'confirmed_quest_offer' };
      }
      m = c.match(/\byou\s+(?:accept|accepted|agree\s+to|agreed\s+to|take|took)\s+((?:[A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,70}|the\s+[a-z][a-z' -]{2,50})'?s)?\s*(?:quest|task|mission|contract)\s+to\s+([^.!?;]{3,220})[.!?]?/i);
      if (!m) m = c.match(/\byou\s+(?:accept|accepted|agree\s+to|agreed\s+to|take|took)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:quest|task|mission|contract)\s+to\s+([^.!?;]{3,220})/i);
      if (m) {
        if (m.length >= 3) { giver = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestGiver((m[1] || '').replace(/'s$/i, '')); objective = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestObjective(m[2]); }
        else { giver = ''; objective = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestObjective(m[1]); }
        return { type: 'accept_candidate', giver: giver, objective: objective, title: WL.EventScanner.makeQuestTitle(objective), links: WL.EventScanner.extractQuestObjectiveLinks(objective, giver), confidence: 'confirmed_quest_acceptance' };
      }
      m = c.match(/\byou\s+(?:clear|cleared|finish|finished|complete|completed|resolve|resolved|defeat|defeated|drive off|drove off|repair|repaired|escort|escorted|deliver|delivered|recover|recovered|retrieve|retrieved|bring|brought|find|found|investigate|investigated|protect|protected)\s+([^.!?;]{3,220})/i);
      if (m) {
        objective = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestObjective(m[1]);
        return { type: 'status_candidate', status: 'ready_to_turn_in', objective: objective, title: WL.EventScanner.makeQuestTitle(objective), links: WL.EventScanner.extractQuestObjectiveLinks(objective, ''), confidence: 'objective_progress_or_completion_language' };
      }
      if (/\b(quest|task|mission|contract)\b/.test(lower) && /\b(complete|completed|finished|failed|abandoned|ready|turned in|turn in)\b/.test(lower)) {
        var status = /fail|abandon/.test(lower) ? 'failed' : (/turn(ed)? in|complete|completed/.test(lower) ? 'completed' : 'ready_to_turn_in');
        objective = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestObjective(c);
        return { type: 'status_candidate', status: status, objective: objective, title: WL.EventScanner.makeQuestTitle(objective), links: WL.EventScanner.extractQuestObjectiveLinks(objective, ''), confidence: 'quest_status_language' };
      }
      return null;
    },
    cleanQuestGiver: function (value) {
      var raw = WL.U.norm(value).replace(/^(?:the\s+)/i, '');
      if (!raw) return 'Unknown';
      if (/^guild$/i.test(raw)) return 'Guild';
      return WL.U.title(raw);
    },
    extractQuestObjectiveLinks: function (objective, giver) {
      var o = WL.U.norm(objective);
      var links = { actors: [], places: [], items: [], factions: [] };
      function add(list, name, kind) {
        name = WL.U.title(WL.U.norm(name).replace(/^(?:the|a|an)\s+/i, ''));
        if (!name || name.length < 2) return;
        var id = (kind || 'ref') + '_' + WL.U.slug(name);
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i].id === id) return;
        list.push({ id: id, name: name, kind: kind || 'ref' });
      }
      var m;
      m = o.match(/\bescort\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,60})\s+to\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90})\b/i);
      if (m) { add(links.actors, m[1], 'actor'); add(links.places, m[2], 'place'); }
      m = o.match(/\b(?:meet|find|protect|rescue)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,60})(?:\s+(?:at|in|near|from)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,90}))?/i);
      if (m) { add(links.actors, m[1], 'actor'); if (m[2]) add(links.places, m[2], 'place'); }
      m = o.match(/\b(?:repair|rebuild|reinforce|inspect|investigate|protect)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{2,80}?\b(?:wall|gate|bridge|road|tower|well|house|farm|barrow|tavern|inn|hall|market|prison))\b/i);
      if (m) add(links.places, m[1], 'place');
      m = o.match(/\b(?:recover|retrieve|find|fetch|bring)\s+(?:the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)(?:\s+(?:from|at|in|inside|near)\s+(?:the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,90}))?$/i);
      if (m) {
        var item = WL.U.norm(m[1]).replace(/\s+(?:from|at|in|inside|near)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
        if (item && !/^(?:your|his|her|their)\s/i.test(item)) add(links.items, item, 'objective_item');
        if (m[2]) add(links.places, m[2], 'place');
      }
      if (giver && /guild|company|circle|clan|order|synod|dominion|consortium|covenant|faction/i.test(giver)) add(links.factions, giver, 'faction');
      return links;
    },
    cleanQuestObjective: function (objective) {
      var o = WL.U.norm(objective)
        .replace(/\s+and\s+promises?\s+\d{1,6}\s+(?:copper|silver|gold)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '')
        .replace(/\s+for\s+\d{1,6}\s+(?:copper|silver|gold)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '')
        .replace(/^(?:the\s+)?(?:quest|task|mission)\s+to\s+/i, '')
        .replace(/^resolve\s+/i, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
      return o || 'unspecified objective';
    },
    makeQuestTitle: function (objective) {
      var o = WL.EventScanner.cleanQuestObjective(objective);
      o = o.replace(/^(?:to\s+)?/i, '');
      return WL.U.title(o).replace(/^(?:Resolve\s+)+/i, '') || 'Untitled Quest';
    },

    detectLoreAuthorityCandidates: function (clause, root) {
      var out = [];
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var lower = WL.U.lower(c);
      if (!c) return out;
      if (/\b(?:command|debug|worldledger|sourceaudit|build\d+check|acceptancecheck|fullacceptancecheck)\b/i.test(c)) return out;
      var hiddenOnly = /\b(?:hidden|secret|forbidden|unrevealed|unknown)\s+(?:lore|truth|history|knowledge)\b/i.test(c) && !/\b(?:learn|learned|discover|discovered|reveal|revealed|uncover|uncovered|research|researched|hear|heard|tell|tells|told)\b/i.test(c);
      var unsafe = /\b(?:everyone|the whole world|all people|all nations|all races)\b/i.test(c);
      var loreCue = /\b(?:god|goddess|aethros|decay|storm|life|endurance|depth|balance|memory|silence|destruction|order|conflict|faction|nation|region|world bible|lore|history|legend|myth|archive|veilbound|iron dominion|verdant archive|rootbound|tidebound|stone veil|fracted kingdoms|fractured kingdoms)\b/i.test(c);
      var revealCue = /\b(?:you\s+)?(?:learn|learned|discover|discovered|reveal|revealed|uncover|uncovered|research|researched|remember|remembered|hear|heard|are told|were told|the archivist tells you|the elder tells you|the scholar explains)\b/i.test(c);
      if (unsafe || hiddenOnly) {
        if (loreCue || hiddenOnly) out.push({ type: 'lore_authority_denial', targetName: 'lore authority denial', reason: unsafe ? 'overbroad_universal_lore_claim_denied' : 'hidden_lore_not_revealed', phrase: c, confidence: 'denied' });
        return out;
      }
      if (!loreCue || !revealCue) return out;
      var topic = WL.EventScanner.extractLoreTopic(c);
      if (!topic) topic = 'World Lore';
      var regional = WL.EventScanner.extractLoreRegion(c);
      out.push({ type: 'lore_reveal_candidate', targetName: topic, title: topic, topic: topic, region: regional, visibility: 'revealed', phrase: c, confidence: 'confirmed_revealed_lore' });
      return out;
    },
    extractLoreTopic: function (clause) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var known = ['Vael Threnos','Zyraeth Voln','Aethros','Elyndra Vaelis','Tharok Veldran','Nythral Voss','Serathis Vale','Varkros Malenth','Elyon Theskar','Valmyr Kareth','Kharos Veyr','Velkaris Nox','Iron Dominion','Verdant Archive','Rootbound Circle','Veilbound','Tidebound Consortium','Deep Forge Clans','Fractured Kingdoms','Stone Veil','Harmonic Coast','Borderlands','Frozen Expanse','Death of Decay','Death of Storm','Broken Death Cycle','Storm Instability'];
      for (var i = 0; i < known.length; i++) if (new RegExp('\\b' + known[i].replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\b', 'i').test(c)) return known[i];
      var m = c.match(/\b(?:about|of|regarding|concerning)\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,80}?)(?:\s+(?:from|in|at|after|because|and|is|was|were|remains|,|\.|$))/);
      if (m) return WL.U.title(WL.U.norm(m[1]).replace(/^(?:the\s+)/i, ''));
      m = c.match(/\b(?:god|goddess|faction|nation|region|legend|myth|lore|history)\s+(?:of\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,60})/);
      if (m) return WL.U.title(m[1]);
      return '';
    },
    extractLoreRegion: function (clause) {
      var c = WL.U.norm(clause);
      var regions = ['Verdant Archive','Iron Marches','Fractured Kingdoms','Stone Veil','Harmonic Coast','Borderlands','Frozen Expanse','Ashen Wastes','Green-War Zone','Blighted Marches','Frosthaven','Obel City'];
      for (var i = 0; i < regions.length; i++) if (new RegExp('\\b' + regions[i].replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\b', 'i').test(c)) return regions[i];
      return '';
    },
    record: function (root, events) {
      for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) root.diagnostics.parser.push(events[i]);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.parser, WL.Constants.maxParserHits);
    }
  };

  // Pipeline note: ProposalBuilder turns scanner events into structured claims without committing them.

  // [WL-ORG:PIPELINE] ProposalBuilder
  WL.ProposalBuilder = {
    fromEvents: function (root, events, source) {
      var out = [];
      var seen = {};
      for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
        var ev = events[i];
        var target = ev.data && (ev.data.targetId || ev.data.targetName || ev.data.objective || ev.data.title || ev.data.currency || ev.type) || '';
        var targetSlug = ev.data && ev.data.targetId ? ev.data.targetId : WL.U.slug(target);
        var localKey = [ev.family, ev.type, ev.sourceHash, ev.localClauseHash, targetSlug].join('|');
        if (seen[localKey]) continue;
        seen[localKey] = true;
        var proposal = {
          id: 'proposal_' + WL.U.hash(localKey + '|' + i),
          family: ev.family,
          type: ev.type,
          sourceHook: ev.sourceHook,
          sourceKind: ev.sourceKind,
          sourceHash: ev.sourceHash,
          localClauseHash: ev.localClauseHash,
          targetId: targetSlug,
          targetName: ev.data && ev.data.targetName || ev.data && ev.data.title || '',
          textPreview: ev.textPreview,
          data: ev.data || {},
          status: 'proposed',
          opKey: WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([ev.sourceHook, ev.sourceHash, ev.localClauseHash, ev.family, ev.type, targetSlug || 'none'])
        };
        out.push(proposal);
        root.diagnostics.proposals.push(proposal);
      }
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.proposals, WL.Constants.maxProposals);
      return out;
    }
  };

  // Pipeline note: CanonValidator is the eligibility boundary between claims and reducers.

  // [WL-ORG:PIPELINE] CanonValidator
  WL.CanonValidator = {
    validateAll: function (root, proposals, source) {
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < proposals.length; i++) out.push(WL.CanonValidator.validate(root, proposals[i], source));
      for (var j = 0; j < out.length; j++) root.diagnostics.validations.push(out[j]);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.validations, WL.Constants.maxValidations);
      return out;
    },
    validate: function (root, proposal, source) {
      var result = {
        id: 'validation_' + WL.U.hash(proposal.id + '|' + proposal.opKey),
        proposalId: proposal.id,
        proposal: proposal,
