      m.denied.push(rec);
      m.recent.push({ kind: 'denied', id: rec.id, phrase: rec.phrase, turn: rec.turn });
      WL.U.capArray(m.denied, 80); WL.U.capArray(m.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'RECORDED_DENIAL', applied: true, family: 'matchup', type: proposal.type, id: rec.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    recordMatchup: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var m = WL.MatchupSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = proposal.data || {};
      var id = d.targetId || proposal.targetId || ('matchup_' + WL.U.hash(proposal.textPreview || ledger.key));
      if (!m.recordsById[id]) m.recordIds.push(id);
      var rec = {
        id: id,
        key: ledger.key,
        actorName: d.actorName || 'Player',
        actorId: d.actorId || 'player',
        targetName: d.targetName || proposal.targetName || 'Opponent',
        targetActorId: d.targetActorId || '',
        terrain: d.terrain || '',
        equipment: d.equipment || '',
        magic: d.magic || '',
        weights: Array.isArray(d.weights) ? d.weights.slice(0, 8) : [],
        totalWeight: Number(d.totalWeight) || 0,
        stance: d.stance || 'mixed',
        phrase: proposal.textPreview || '',
        turn: root.runtime.currentTurn,
        confidence: d.confidence || 'confirmed_matchup_evidence'
      };
      m.recordsById[id] = rec;
      if (rec.targetActorId) {
        if (!m.byTargetId[rec.targetActorId]) m.byTargetId[rec.targetActorId] = [];
        m.byTargetId[rec.targetActorId].push(id);
        WL.U.capArray(m.byTargetId[rec.targetActorId], 20);
      }
      for (var i = 0; i < rec.weights.length; i++) {
        var axis = rec.weights[i].axis || 'general';
        if (!m.weightsByAxis[axis]) m.weightsByAxis[axis] = [];
        m.weightsByAxis[axis].push({ id: id, value: rec.weights[i].value || 0, label: rec.weights[i].label || axis, turn: rec.turn });
        WL.U.capArray(m.weightsByAxis[axis], 40);
      }
      if (rec.terrain) {
        m.terrainRecords.push({ id: id, terrain: rec.terrain, totalWeight: rec.totalWeight, turn: rec.turn, phrase: rec.phrase });
        WL.U.capArray(m.terrainRecords, 120);
      }
      m.lastRecordId = id;
      m.recent.push({ kind: 'matchup', id: id, targetName: rec.targetName, stance: rec.stance, totalWeight: rec.totalWeight, turn: rec.turn });
      WL.U.capArray(m.recordIds, 160); WL.U.capArray(m.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'matchup', type: proposal.type, recordId: id, totalWeight: rec.totalWeight, stance: rec.stance, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      var m = WL.MatchupSystem.ensure(root);
      var count = m.recordIds.length;
      var axes = Object.keys(m.weightsByAxis || {}).filter(function (k) { return (m.weightsByAxis[k] || []).length; });
      var recent = m.recordIds.slice(-Math.max(1, max || 4)).map(function (id) {
        var r = m.recordsById[id];
        return r ? (r.targetName + ' ' + r.stance + ' ' + (r.totalWeight >= 0 ? '+' : '') + r.totalWeight) : '';
      }).filter(Boolean);
      return ['Matchups: ' + count + ' | Axes: ' + (axes.length ? axes.join(', ') : '(none)') + (recent.length ? ' | Recent: ' + recent.join(' | ') : '')];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      var m = WL.MatchupSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = WL.MatchupSystem.summary(root, max);
      var ids = m.recordIds.slice(-Math.max(1, max || 8));
      if (!ids.length) { lines.push('(no matchup records)'); return lines; }
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var r = m.recordsById[ids[i]];
        if (!r) continue;
        var parts = [];
        for (var w = 0; w < (r.weights || []).length; w++) parts.push((r.weights[w].axis || 'general') + ':' + (r.weights[w].value >= 0 ? '+' : '') + r.weights[w].value + ' ' + (r.weights[w].label || ''));
        lines.push('- ' + WL.U.safeString(r.actorName) + ' vs ' + WL.U.safeString(r.targetName) + ': ' + WL.U.safeString(r.stance) + ' ' + (r.totalWeight >= 0 ? '+' : '') + r.totalWeight + (parts.length ? ' [' + parts.join('; ') + ']' : '') + (r.terrain ? ' terrain=' + WL.U.safeString(r.terrain) : ''));
      }
      if (m.denied.length) lines.push('Denied matchup claims: ' + m.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.MatchupReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.MatchupSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };

  // Owner note: CombatOutcomeSystem owns 9.10A combat outcome events. It records resolved attacks/defense/dodges/captures/downed/flee/overwhelming evidence without rewards, matchup weights, or automatic HP mutation.
  WL.CombatOutcomeSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.combatOutcome || typeof root.combatOutcome !== 'object') root.combatOutcome = WL.Schema.root().combatOutcome;
      var co = root.combatOutcome;
      if (!co.outcomesById || typeof co.outcomesById !== 'object') co.outcomesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(co.outcomeIds)) co.outcomeIds = [];
      if (!co.injuriesById || typeof co.injuriesById !== 'object') co.injuriesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(co.injuryIds)) co.injuryIds = [];
      if (!co.byActorId || typeof co.byActorId !== 'object') co.byActorId = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(co.captureRecords)) co.captureRecords = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(co.downedRecords)) co.downedRecords = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(co.fleeRecords)) co.fleeRecords = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(co.denied)) co.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(co.recent)) co.recent = [];
      co.version = '9.10A';
      return co;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'combat_outcome_candidate') return WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.recordOutcome(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'combat_outcome_denial') return WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.recordDenial(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'combatOutcome', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_combat_outcome_event' };
    },
    recordDenial: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var co = WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.ensure(root);
      var rec = { id: proposal.data.targetId || ('combat_outcome_denied_' + WL.U.hash(proposal.textPreview || ledger.key)), key: ledger.key, reason: proposal.data.reason || 'denied', phrase: proposal.textPreview || '', turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      co.denied.push(rec);
      co.recent.push('denied: ' + rec.reason);
      WL.U.capArray(co.denied, 80); WL.U.capArray(co.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'RECORDED_DENIAL', applied: true, family: 'combatOutcome', type: proposal.type, id: rec.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    recordOutcome: function (root, proposal, ledger) {
      var co = WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = proposal.data || {};
      var id = d.targetId || ('combat_outcome_' + WL.U.hash((proposal.textPreview || '') + '|' + ledger.key));
      var rec = co.outcomesById[id] || {
        id: id,
        key: ledger.key,
        outcomeKind: d.outcomeKind || 'combat',
        actorName: d.actorName || '',
        actorId: d.actorId || 'unknown',
        targetName: d.targetName || '',
        targetActorId: d.targetActorId || '',
        result: d.result || '',
        successState: d.successState || 'confirmed',
        severity: d.severity || 'moderate',
        bodyPart: d.bodyPart || '',
        injuryName: d.injuryName || '',
        partial: !!d.partial,
        phrase: proposal.textPreview || '',
        turn: root.runtime.currentTurn,
        history: []
      };
      rec.key = ledger.key;
      rec.outcomeKind = d.outcomeKind || rec.outcomeKind;
      rec.actorName = d.actorName || rec.actorName;
      rec.actorId = d.actorId || rec.actorId;
      rec.targetName = d.targetName || rec.targetName;
      rec.targetActorId = d.targetActorId || rec.targetActorId;
      rec.result = d.result || rec.result;
      rec.successState = d.successState || rec.successState;
      rec.severity = d.severity || rec.severity;
      rec.bodyPart = d.bodyPart || rec.bodyPart;
      rec.injuryName = d.injuryName || rec.injuryName;
      rec.partial = !!d.partial || rec.partial;
      rec.phrase = proposal.textPreview || rec.phrase;
      rec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, result: rec.result, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 12);
      co.outcomesById[id] = rec;
      if (co.outcomeIds.indexOf(id) < 0) co.outcomeIds.push(id);
      if (rec.actorId) {
        if (!co.byActorId[rec.actorId]) co.byActorId[rec.actorId] = [];
        if (co.byActorId[rec.actorId].indexOf(id) < 0) co.byActorId[rec.actorId].push(id);
        WL.U.capArray(co.byActorId[rec.actorId], 40);
      }
      if (rec.targetActorId) {
        if (!co.byActorId[rec.targetActorId]) co.byActorId[rec.targetActorId] = [];
        if (co.byActorId[rec.targetActorId].indexOf(id) < 0) co.byActorId[rec.targetActorId].push(id);
        WL.U.capArray(co.byActorId[rec.targetActorId], 40);
      }
      if (rec.injuryName || rec.bodyPart) {
        var injId = 'combat_injury_' + WL.U.slug((rec.targetName || 'target') + '_' + (rec.injuryName || rec.bodyPart || 'injury'));
        var inj = co.injuriesById[injId] || { id: injId, targetName: rec.targetName || '', targetActorId: rec.targetActorId || '', bodyPart: rec.bodyPart || '', injuryName: rec.injuryName || '', severity: rec.severity || 'minor', outcomeId: id, status: 'recorded_outcome_only', turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, history: [] };
        inj.severity = WL.FormTransformationSystem && WL.FormTransformationSystem.mergeSeverity ? WL.FormTransformationSystem.mergeSeverity(inj.severity, rec.severity) : (rec.severity || inj.severity);
        inj.outcomeId = id;
        inj.phrase = rec.phrase;
        inj.history.push({ key: ledger.key, severity: inj.severity, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn });
        WL.U.capArray(inj.history, 12);
        co.injuriesById[injId] = inj;
        if (co.injuryIds.indexOf(injId) < 0) co.injuryIds.push(injId);
      }
      if (rec.outcomeKind === 'capture') { co.captureRecords.push({ id: id, actorName: rec.actorName, targetName: rec.targetName, result: rec.result, key: ledger.key, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn }); WL.U.capArray(co.captureRecords, 80); }
      if (rec.outcomeKind === 'downed' || rec.outcomeKind === 'overwhelming') { co.downedRecords.push({ id: id, actorName: rec.actorName, targetName: rec.targetName, result: rec.result, key: ledger.key, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn }); WL.U.capArray(co.downedRecords, 80); }
      if (rec.outcomeKind === 'flee') { co.fleeRecords.push({ id: id, actorName: rec.actorName, targetName: rec.targetName, result: rec.result, key: ledger.key, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn }); WL.U.capArray(co.fleeRecords, 80); }
      co.lastOutcomeId = id;
      co.recent.push(rec.outcomeKind + ': ' + (rec.actorName || 'unknown') + ' -> ' + (rec.targetName || 'unknown') + ' [' + rec.result + ']');
      WL.U.capArray(co.outcomeIds, 160); WL.U.capArray(co.injuryIds, 120); WL.U.capArray(co.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'combatOutcome', type: proposal.type, outcomeId: id, outcomeKind: rec.outcomeKind, result: rec.result, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, max) {
      var co = WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = ['Combat Outcomes: ' + co.outcomeIds.length + ' | Injuries: ' + co.injuryIds.length + ' | Captures: ' + co.captureRecords.length + ' | Downed: ' + co.downedRecords.length + ' | Flee: ' + co.fleeRecords.length];
      var recent = (co.recent || []).slice(-(max || 3));
      if (recent.length) lines.push('Recent outcomes: ' + recent.join(' | '));
      return lines;
    },
    detailLines: function (root, max) {
      var co = WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.summary(root, max);
      var ids = (co.outcomeIds || []).slice(-(max || 8));
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var r = co.outcomesById[ids[i]];
        if (r) lines.push('- ' + r.outcomeKind + ': ' + (r.actorName || 'unknown') + ' -> ' + (r.targetName || 'unknown') + ' = ' + (r.result || 'resolved') + (r.partial ? ' [partial]' : '') + ' [' + (r.severity || 'moderate') + ']');
      }
      if (!ids.length) lines.push('(none)');
      if ((co.denied || []).length) lines.push('Denied outcome claims: ' + co.denied.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // Owner note: ContractSystem owns agreements distinct from quests and inventory.
  WL.ContractSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.contracts || typeof root.contracts !== 'object') root.contracts = WL.Schema.root().contracts;
      if (!root.contracts.contractsById || typeof root.contracts.contractsById !== 'object') root.contracts.contractsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.contracts.contractIds)) root.contracts.contractIds = [];
      if (!root.contracts.byParty || typeof root.contracts.byParty !== 'object') root.contracts.byParty = {};
      if (!root.contracts.byStatus || typeof root.contracts.byStatus !== 'object') root.contracts.byStatus = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.contracts.payments)) root.contracts.payments = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.contracts.breaches)) root.contracts.breaches = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.contracts.recent)) root.contracts.recent = [];
      return root.contracts;
    },
    addIndex: function (root, rec) {
      var c = WL.ContractSystem.ensure(root);
      if (c.contractIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) c.contractIds.push(rec.id);
      var partyKey = WL.U.slug(rec.partyB || rec.actorName || 'unknown');
      if (!c.byParty[partyKey]) c.byParty[partyKey] = [];
      if (c.byParty[partyKey].indexOf(rec.id) < 0) c.byParty[partyKey].push(rec.id);
      var st = rec.status || 'unknown';
      if (!c.byStatus[st]) c.byStatus[st] = [];
      if (c.byStatus[st].indexOf(rec.id) < 0) c.byStatus[st].push(rec.id);
      Object.keys(c.byStatus).forEach(function (k) { if (k !== st) c.byStatus[k] = (c.byStatus[k] || []).filter(function (id) { return id !== rec.id; }); });
      WL.U.capArray(c.contractIds, 120);
    },
    findLikelyContract: function (root, actorName, reason) {
      var c = WL.ContractSystem.ensure(root);
      var actorSlug = WL.U.slug(actorName || '');
      var ids = c.byParty[actorSlug] || [];
      for (var i = ids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var rec = c.contractsById[ids[i]];
        if (rec && !/completed|terminated/.test(rec.status || '')) return rec;
      }
      var keys = c.contractIds || [];
      for (var j = keys.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        var r = c.contractsById[keys[j]];
        if (r && WL.U.slug(r.partyB) === actorSlug && !/completed|terminated/.test(r.status || '')) return r;
      }
      return null;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'contract_lifecycle_candidate') return WL.ContractSystem.lifecycle(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'contract_status_candidate') return WL.ContractSystem.status(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'contract_payment_candidate') return WL.ContractSystem.payment(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'contract', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_contract_event' };
    },
    lifecycle: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var c = WL.ContractSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = p.data || {};
      var id = d.contractId || d.targetId || ('contract_' + WL.U.slug((d.partyB || 'unknown') + '_' + (d.work || 'work')));
      var rec = c.contractsById[id] || { id: id, history: [], payments: [], obligations: [] };
      rec.id = id;
      rec.partyA = d.partyA || rec.partyA || 'Player';
      rec.partyB = d.partyB || rec.partyB || d.actorName || 'Unknown Worker';
      rec.partyBId = d.partyBId || rec.partyBId || ('actor_' + WL.U.slug(rec.partyB));
      rec.work = d.work || rec.work || 'unspecified work';
      rec.role = d.role || rec.role || WL.EventScanner.inferLaborRole(rec.work);
      rec.status = d.status || rec.status || 'active';
      rec.payment = d.payment || rec.payment || null;
      rec.deadline = d.deadline || rec.deadline || '';
      rec.obligations = rec.obligations || [];
      if (rec.obligations.indexOf(rec.work) < 0) rec.obligations.push(rec.work);
      rec.truthStatus = rec.status === 'promised' ? 'terms_promised_not_paid' : 'confirmed_contract_record';
      rec.lastTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn;
      rec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, status: rec.status, phrase: p.textPreview });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 30);
      c.contractsById[id] = rec;
      WL.ContractSystem.addIndex(root, rec);
      c.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, contractId: id, type: 'lifecycle', status: rec.status });
      WL.U.capArray(c.recent, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'contract', type: 'contract_lifecycle', contractId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    status: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var c = WL.ContractSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = p.data || {};
      var rec = WL.ContractSystem.findLikelyContract(root, d.actorName || d.partyB || '', d.reason || '') || { id: 'contract_' + WL.U.slug((d.actorName || 'unknown') + '_unspecified_work'), history: [], payments: [], obligations: [], partyA: 'Player', partyB: d.actorName || 'Unknown Worker', partyBId: d.actorId || '' };
      rec.status = d.status || 'status_recorded';
      rec.reason = d.reason || rec.reason || '';
      rec.lastTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn;
      rec.history = rec.history || [];
      rec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, status: rec.status, reason: rec.reason, phrase: p.textPreview });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 30);
      c.contractsById[rec.id] = rec;
      WL.ContractSystem.addIndex(root, rec);
      if (rec.status === 'breached') c.breaches.push({ key: ledger.key, contractId: rec.id, actorName: rec.partyB, reason: rec.reason, phrase: p.textPreview });
      WL.U.capArray(c.breaches, 40);
      c.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, contractId: rec.id, type: 'status', status: rec.status });
      WL.U.capArray(c.recent, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'contract', type: 'contract_status', contractId: rec.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    payment: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var c = WL.ContractSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = p.data || {};
      var rec = WL.ContractSystem.findLikelyContract(root, d.actorName || '', d.reason || '');
      var cid = rec ? rec.id : ('contract_' + WL.U.slug((d.actorName || 'unknown') + '_' + (d.reason || 'work')));
      var pay = { key: ledger.key, contractId: cid, actorName: d.actorName || '', amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'silver', reason: d.reason || '', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      c.payments.push(pay);
      WL.U.capArray(c.payments, 80);
      if (rec) { rec.payments = rec.payments || []; rec.payments.push(pay); WL.U.capArray(rec.payments, 40); rec.lastPaymentTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn; c.contractsById[rec.id] = rec; }
      c.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, contractId: cid, type: 'payment', amount: pay.amount, currency: pay.currency });
      WL.U.capArray(c.recent, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'contract', type: 'contract_payment', contractId: cid, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var c = WL.ContractSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = ['Contracts: ' + c.contractIds.length + ' | Payments: ' + c.payments.length + ' | Breaches: ' + c.breaches.length];
      var ids = c.contractIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && i < 8; i++) {
        var r = c.contractsById[ids[i]];
        if (r) lines.push('- [' + (r.status || 'unknown') + '] ' + (r.partyB || 'Unknown') + ': ' + (r.work || 'unspecified work') + (r.payment ? ' for ' + r.payment.amount + ' ' + r.payment.currency + '/' + r.payment.interval : ''));
      }
      if (ids.length > 8) lines.push('- ... ' + (ids.length - 8) + ' more contract records kept in state.');
      return lines;
    }
  };

  // Owner note: LaborSystem owns worker records, assignments, refusals, and contract links.
  WL.LaborSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.labor || typeof root.labor !== 'object') root.labor = WL.Schema.root().labor;
      if (!root.labor.employeesById || typeof root.labor.employeesById !== 'object') root.labor.employeesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.labor.employeeIds)) root.labor.employeeIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.labor.assignments)) root.labor.assignments = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.labor.refusals)) root.labor.refusals = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.labor.recent)) root.labor.recent = [];
      return root.labor;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'labor_employee_candidate') return WL.LaborSystem.employee(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'labor_assignment_candidate') return WL.LaborSystem.assignment(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'labor_refusal_candidate') return WL.LaborSystem.refusal(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'labor', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_labor_event' };
    },
    employee: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var l = WL.LaborSystem.ensure(root);
      var d = p.data || {};
      var id = d.targetId || ('employee_' + WL.U.slug(d.actorName || 'unknown'));
      var e = l.employeesById[id] || { id: id, history: [] };
      e.id = id; e.actorName = d.actorName || e.actorName || 'Unknown Worker'; e.actorId = d.actorId || e.actorId || ('actor_' + WL.U.slug(e.actorName));
      e.role = d.role || e.role || 'Worker'; e.wage = d.wage || e.wage || null; e.contractId = d.contractId || e.contractId || '';
      e.assignment = d.assignment || e.assignment || ''; e.status = d.status || e.status || 'employed'; e.availability = e.status === 'employed' ? 'assigned_or_available' : 'unknown'; e.loyalty = e.loyalty || 'unknown';
      e.history.push({ key: ledger.key, status: e.status, assignment: e.assignment, phrase: p.textPreview }); WL.U.capArray(e.history, 30);
      l.employeesById[id] = e; if (l.employeeIds.indexOf(id) < 0) l.employeeIds.push(id); WL.U.capArray(l.employeeIds, 120);
      if (e.assignment) l.assignments.push({ key: ledger.key, employeeId: id, actorName: e.actorName, contractId: e.contractId, assignment: e.assignment, status: 'assigned_by_contract' });
      WL.U.capArray(l.assignments, 80);
      l.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, employeeId: id, type: 'employee', status: e.status }); WL.U.capArray(l.recent, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'labor', type: 'employee_record', employeeId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    assignment: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var l = WL.LaborSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {}; var id = d.employeeId || d.actorId || ('employee_' + WL.U.slug(d.actorName || 'unknown'));
      l.assignments.push({ key: ledger.key, employeeId: id, actorName: d.actorName || '', contractId: d.contractId || '', assignment: d.assignment || '', status: d.status || 'assignment_evidence' }); WL.U.capArray(l.assignments, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'labor', type: 'labor_assignment', employeeId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    refusal: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var l = WL.LaborSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {}; var id = d.targetId || ('labor_refusal_' + WL.U.slug(d.actorName || 'unknown'));
      l.refusals.push({ key: ledger.key, id: id, actorName: d.actorName || '', actorId: d.actorId || '', reason: d.reason || 'refusal', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn }); WL.U.capArray(l.refusals, 60);
      l.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'refusal', actorName: d.actorName || '', reason: d.reason || '' }); WL.U.capArray(l.recent, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'labor', type: 'labor_refusal', key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var l = WL.LaborSystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = ['Employees: ' + l.employeeIds.length + ' | Assignments: ' + l.assignments.length + ' | Refusals: ' + l.refusals.length];
      for (var i = 0; i < l.employeeIds.length && i < 8; i++) { var e = l.employeesById[l.employeeIds[i]]; if (e) lines.push('- [' + (e.status || 'unknown') + '] ' + (e.actorName || 'Unknown') + ': ' + (e.role || 'Worker') + (e.assignment ? ' -> ' + e.assignment : '')); }
      if (l.employeeIds.length > 8) lines.push('- ... ' + (l.employeeIds.length - 8) + ' more worker records kept in state.');
      if (l.refusals.length) lines.push('Recent refusal: ' + (l.refusals[l.refusals.length - 1].actorName || 'Unknown') + ' — ' + (l.refusals[l.refusals.length - 1].reason || 'refused'));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.ContractLifecycleReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.ContractSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.LaborSystemReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.LaborSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };


  // Owner note: DomainProjectSystem owns construction/project requirements, progress, materials, time, and completion evidence.
  WL.DomainProjectSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.advanced) root.advanced = WL.Schema.root().advanced;
      if (!root.advanced.domain || typeof root.advanced.domain !== 'object') root.advanced.domain = { projectsById: {}, projectIds: [], claims: [], assignments: [], progressLedgers: [], requirementLedgers: [], materialLedgers: [], timeLedgers: [], blockedLedgers: [], completionLedgers: [], readyAssetIds: [] };
      var d = root.advanced.domain;
      if (!d.projectsById || typeof d.projectsById !== 'object') d.projectsById = {};
      ['projectIds','claims','assignments','progressLedgers','requirementLedgers','materialLedgers','timeLedgers','blockedLedgers','completionLedgers','readyAssetIds'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(d[k])) d[k] = []; });
      return d;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'domain_project_candidate') return WL.DomainProjectSystem.project(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_requirement_candidate') return WL.DomainProjectSystem.requirement(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_progress_candidate') return WL.DomainProjectSystem.progress(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_assignment_candidate') return WL.DomainProjectSystem.assignment(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_completion_candidate') return WL.DomainProjectSystem.completion(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_blocked_candidate') return WL.DomainProjectSystem.blocked(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'advanced', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_domain_project_event' };
    },
    cleanProjectName: function (name) { return WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(name || '').replace(/\s+(?:project|construction)$/i, '').trim(); },
    projectId: function (name) { return 'project_' + WL.U.slug(WL.DomainProjectSystem.cleanProjectName(name)); },
    ensureProject: function (root, d) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root);
      var name = WL.DomainProjectSystem.cleanProjectName(d.projectName || d.name || 'Unknown Project') || 'Unknown Project';
      var id = d.projectId || WL.DomainProjectSystem.projectId(name);
      if (!bucket.projectsById[id]) {
        bucket.projectsById[id] = { id: id, name: name, status: 'planned_or_started', progressPercent: 0, requirements: { materials: [], time: null, notes: [] }, consumedMaterials: [], timeSpent: [], workers: [], assignments: [], progressNotes: [], blocked: [], completionEvidence: [], history: [], assetConversionStatus: 'not_ready' };
        if (bucket.projectIds.indexOf(id) < 0) bucket.projectIds.push(id);
      }
      var proj = bucket.projectsById[id];
      proj.name = proj.name || name;
      ['consumedMaterials','timeSpent','workers','assignments','progressNotes','blocked','completionEvidence','history'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(proj[k])) proj[k] = []; });
      if (!proj.requirements || typeof proj.requirements !== 'object') proj.requirements = { materials: [], time: null, notes: [] };
      if (!Array.isArray(proj.requirements.materials)) proj.requirements.materials = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(proj.requirements.notes)) proj.requirements.notes = [];
      return proj;
    },
    addMaterials: function (list, mats, key, mode) { mats = Array.isArray(mats) ? mats : []; for (var i = 0; i < mats.length; i++) if (mats[i] && mats[i].name) list.push({ key: key, name: mats[i].name, quantity: mats[i].quantity || 1, mode: mode || 'recorded' }); },
    addTime: function (list, time, key, mode) { if (time && time.amount > 0) list.push({ key: key, amount: time.amount, unit: time.unit || 'day', mode: mode || 'recorded' }); },
    project: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root); var proj = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {});
      proj.status = proj.progressPercent > 0 ? 'in_progress' : 'started';
      proj.history.push({ key: ledger.key, type: p.type, phrase: p.textPreview });
      if (p.data.materials && p.data.materials.length) { WL.DomainProjectSystem.addMaterials(proj.requirements.materials, p.data.materials, ledger.key, 'initial_requirement_or_allocation'); bucket.requirementLedgers.push({ key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, materials: p.data.materials, phrase: p.textPreview }); }
      if (p.data.time) { proj.requirements.time = p.data.time; bucket.timeLedgers.push({ key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, time: p.data.time, mode: 'estimated_requirement' }); }
      WL.U.capArray(proj.history, 30); WL.U.capArray(bucket.requirementLedgers, 80); WL.U.capArray(bucket.timeLedgers, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_project', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    requirement: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root); var proj = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {});
      proj.status = proj.status || 'planned_or_started';
      WL.DomainProjectSystem.addMaterials(proj.requirements.materials, p.data.materials || [], ledger.key, 'required');
      if (p.data.time) proj.requirements.time = p.data.time;
      if (p.data.rawRequirements) proj.requirements.notes.push({ key: ledger.key, note: p.data.rawRequirements });
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, materials: p.data.materials || [], time: p.data.time || null, phrase: p.textPreview };
      bucket.requirementLedgers.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(proj.requirements.notes, 20); WL.U.capArray(bucket.requirementLedgers, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_requirement', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    progress: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root); var proj = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {});
      var pct = WL.U.clamp(p.data.progressPercent || 0, 0, 100);
      proj.progressPercent = Math.max(proj.progressPercent || 0, pct);
      proj.status = proj.progressPercent >= 100 ? 'completion_evidence_pending_asset_conversion' : 'in_progress';
      WL.DomainProjectSystem.addMaterials(proj.consumedMaterials, p.data.materials || [], ledger.key, 'consumed'); WL.DomainProjectSystem.addTime(proj.timeSpent, p.data.time, ledger.key, 'spent');
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, progressPercent: proj.progressPercent, materials: p.data.materials || [], time: p.data.time || null, phrase: p.textPreview };
      proj.progressNotes.push(rec); bucket.progressLedgers.push(rec);
      if (p.data.materials && p.data.materials.length) bucket.materialLedgers.push({ key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, materials: p.data.materials, mode: 'consumed' });
      if (p.data.time) bucket.timeLedgers.push({ key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, time: p.data.time, mode: 'spent' });
      WL.U.capArray(proj.progressNotes, 40); WL.U.capArray(bucket.progressLedgers, 80); WL.U.capArray(bucket.materialLedgers, 80); WL.U.capArray(bucket.timeLedgers, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_progress', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    assignment: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root); var proj = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {});
      var actorName = p.data.actorName || ''; var actorId = p.data.actorId || (actorName ? 'actor_' + WL.U.slug(actorName) : '');
      if (actorName && proj.workers.indexOf(actorName) < 0) proj.workers.push(actorName);
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, actorId: actorId, actorName: actorName, phrase: p.textPreview };
      proj.assignments.push(rec); bucket.assignments.push(rec);
      if (root.labor && actorId && root.labor.employeesById && root.labor.employeesById[actorId]) root.labor.employeesById[actorId].assignment = proj.name;
      WL.U.capArray(proj.assignments, 40); WL.U.capArray(bucket.assignments, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_assignment', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    completion: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root); var proj = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {});
      proj.progressPercent = Math.max(proj.progressPercent || 0, 100); proj.status = 'completion_evidence_pending_asset_conversion'; proj.assetConversionStatus = 'pending_9_6c_asset_validation';
      WL.DomainProjectSystem.addMaterials(proj.consumedMaterials, p.data.materials || [], ledger.key, 'completion_consumed'); WL.DomainProjectSystem.addTime(proj.timeSpent, p.data.time, ledger.key, 'completion_time');
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, phrase: p.textPreview, materials: p.data.materials || [], time: p.data.time || null };
      proj.completionEvidence.push(rec); bucket.completionLedgers.push(rec); if (bucket.readyAssetIds.indexOf(proj.id) < 0) bucket.readyAssetIds.push(proj.id);
      WL.U.capArray(proj.completionEvidence, 20); WL.U.capArray(bucket.completionLedgers, 80); WL.U.capArray(bucket.readyAssetIds, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_completion_evidence', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    blocked: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root); var proj = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {});
      proj.status = 'blocked'; var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, reason: p.data.reason || 'unspecified blockage', phrase: p.textPreview };
      proj.blocked.push(rec); bucket.blockedLedgers.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(proj.blocked, 20); WL.U.capArray(bucket.blockedLedgers, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_blocked', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var d = WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root); var lines = [];
      lines.push('Domain Projects: ' + d.projectIds.length);
      if (!d.projectIds.length) { lines.push('Active: (none)'); return lines; }
      var shown = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < d.projectIds.length && i < 4; i++) { var p = d.projectsById[d.projectIds[i]]; if (p) shown.push(p.name + ' [' + (p.status || 'unknown') + ' ' + (p.progressPercent || 0) + '%]'); }
      lines.push('Active: ' + (shown.length ? shown.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      lines.push('Requirements: ' + d.requirementLedgers.length + ' / Material ledgers: ' + d.materialLedgers.length + ' / Time ledgers: ' + d.timeLedgers.length);
      lines.push('Assignments: ' + d.assignments.length + ' / Blocked: ' + d.blockedLedgers.length + ' / Completion evidence: ' + d.completionLedgers.length);
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.DomainProjectReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) { return WL.DomainProjectSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger); };


  // Owner note: DomainAssetSystem owns completed assets, holdings, rooms, control claims, tax evidence, and upkeep evidence.
  WL.DomainAssetSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.domainAssets || typeof root.domainAssets !== 'object') root.domainAssets = WL.Schema.root().domainAssets;
      var d = root.domainAssets;
      if (!d.assetsById || typeof d.assetsById !== 'object') d.assetsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(d.assetIds)) d.assetIds = [];
      if (!d.holdingsById || typeof d.holdingsById !== 'object') d.holdingsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(d.holdingIds)) d.holdingIds = [];
      if (!d.roomsById || typeof d.roomsById !== 'object') d.roomsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(d.roomIds)) d.roomIds = [];
      ['controlClaims','ownershipClaims','taxRecords','rentRecords','revenueRecords','upkeepRecords','maintenanceRecords','recent'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(d[k])) d[k] = []; });
      return d;
    },
    cleanAssetName: function (name) { return WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(name || '').replace(/^(?:control|ownership|claim|hold)\s+of\s+(?:the\s+)?/i, '').replace(/\s+(?:asset|holding|building|project|construction)$/i, '').trim(); },
    assetId: function (name) { return 'asset_' + WL.U.slug(WL.DomainAssetSystem.cleanAssetName(name || 'unknown')); },
    classifyAssetType: function (name, explicitType) {
      var text = WL.U.lower((explicitType || '') + ' ' + (name || ''));
      if (/wall/.test(text)) return 'wall';
      if (/gate/.test(text)) return 'gate';
      if (/bridge/.test(text)) return 'bridge';
      if (/tower/.test(text)) return 'tower';
      if (/market|shop|store/.test(text)) return 'market';
      if (/farm|field|orchard/.test(text)) return 'farm';
      if (/mine|quarry/.test(text)) return 'mine';
      if (/workshop|forge|mill/.test(text)) return 'workshop';
      if (/barracks|hall|manor|keep|house|inn|tavern|building/.test(text)) return 'building';
      if (/road/.test(text)) return 'road';
      if (/well/.test(text)) return 'well';
      return explicitType ? WL.U.lower(explicitType) : 'holding';
    },
    ensureAsset: function (root, data, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensure(root);
      data = data || {};
      var name = WL.DomainAssetSystem.cleanAssetName(data.assetName || data.name || data.projectName || 'Unknown Asset') || 'Unknown Asset';
      var id = data.assetId || WL.DomainAssetSystem.assetId(name);
      var type = data.assetType || WL.DomainAssetSystem.classifyAssetType(name, data.assetType);
      if (!bucket.assetsById[id]) {
        bucket.assetsById[id] = { id: id, name: name, type: type, status: (data.status && !/^evidence_only/.test(data.status)) ? data.status : 'active', sourceProjectId: data.projectId || '', rooms: [], control: [], ownership: [], revenueEvidence: [], upkeepEvidence: [], history: [], createdKey: ledger && ledger.key || '' };
        if (bucket.assetIds.indexOf(id) < 0) bucket.assetIds.push(id);
      }
      var asset = bucket.assetsById[id];
      asset.name = asset.name || name;
      asset.type = asset.type || type;
      asset.status = (data.status && !/^evidence_only/.test(data.status)) ? data.status : (asset.status || 'active');
      if (data.projectId && !asset.sourceProjectId) asset.sourceProjectId = data.projectId;
      ['rooms','control','ownership','revenueEvidence','upkeepEvidence','history'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(asset[k])) asset[k] = []; });
      if (/(holding|farm|market|mine|workshop|building|wall|gate|bridge|tower|road|well)/i.test(asset.type || '') && !bucket.holdingsById[id]) {
        bucket.holdingsById[id] = { id: id, assetId: id, name: asset.name, type: asset.type, status: asset.status };
        if (bucket.holdingIds.indexOf(id) < 0) bucket.holdingIds.push(id);
      }
      return asset;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'domain_asset_conversion_candidate') return WL.DomainAssetSystem.asset(root, p, ledger, true);
      if (p.type === 'domain_asset_record_candidate') return WL.DomainAssetSystem.asset(root, p, ledger, false);
      if (p.type === 'domain_room_record_candidate') return WL.DomainAssetSystem.room(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_control_claim_candidate') return WL.DomainAssetSystem.control(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_tax_evidence_candidate' || p.type === 'domain_rent_evidence_candidate' || p.type === 'domain_revenue_evidence_candidate') return WL.DomainAssetSystem.revenue(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'domain_upkeep_evidence_candidate') return WL.DomainAssetSystem.upkeep(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: validation.family, type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_domain_asset_event' };
    },
    mirrorAdvancedAsset: function (root, asset) {
      if (!root.advanced) root.advanced = WL.Schema.root().advanced;
      if (!root.advanced.domain || typeof root.advanced.domain !== 'object') WL.DomainProjectSystem.ensure(root);
      if (!root.advanced.domain.assetsById) root.advanced.domain.assetsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.advanced.domain.assetIds)) root.advanced.domain.assetIds = [];
      root.advanced.domain.assetsById[asset.id] = { id: asset.id, name: asset.name, type: asset.type, status: asset.status, sourceProjectId: asset.sourceProjectId || '' };
      if (root.advanced.domain.assetIds.indexOf(asset.id) < 0) root.advanced.domain.assetIds.push(asset.id);
    },
    asset: function (root, p, ledger, fromProject) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var asset = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensureAsset(root, d, ledger);
      asset.history.push({ key: ledger.key, type: p.type, phrase: p.textPreview, projectId: d.projectId || '' });
      if (fromProject && d.projectId && root.advanced && root.advanced.domain && root.advanced.domain.projectsById && root.advanced.domain.projectsById[d.projectId]) {
        var proj = root.advanced.domain.projectsById[d.projectId];
        proj.assetConversionStatus = 'converted_to_asset';
        proj.status = 'completed_asset_converted';
        proj.linkedAssetId = asset.id;
      }
      WL.DomainAssetSystem.mirrorAdvancedAsset(root, asset);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: fromProject ? 'asset_conversion' : 'asset_record', assetId: asset.id, name: asset.name, phrase: p.textPreview });
      WL.U.capArray(asset.history, 30); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 120);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'domainAsset', type: fromProject ? 'asset_conversion' : 'asset_record', assetId: asset.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    room: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var asset = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensureAsset(root, d, ledger);
      var roomName = WL.U.title(d.roomName || 'Room');
      var id = d.roomId || (asset.id + '_room_' + WL.U.slug(roomName));
      if (!bucket.roomsById[id]) { bucket.roomsById[id] = { id: id, assetId: asset.id, assetName: asset.name, name: roomName, status: 'active', createdKey: ledger.key, history: [] }; bucket.roomIds.push(id); }
      var room = bucket.roomsById[id];
      room.history.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview });
      if (asset.rooms.indexOf(id) < 0) asset.rooms.push(id);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'room', assetId: asset.id, roomId: id, name: roomName });
      WL.U.capArray(room.history, 20); WL.U.capArray(asset.rooms, 40); WL.U.capArray(bucket.roomIds, 160); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 120);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'domainAsset', type: 'room', assetId: asset.id, roomId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    control: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var asset = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensureAsset(root, d, ledger);
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, assetId: asset.id, assetName: asset.name, claimant: d.claimant || 'unknown', claimKind: d.claimKind || 'control', status: d.status || 'claim_recorded', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      if (rec.claimKind === 'ownership') { asset.ownership.push(rec); bucket.ownershipClaims.push(rec); }
      else { asset.control.push(rec); bucket.controlClaims.push(rec); }
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: rec.claimKind, assetId: asset.id, claimant: rec.claimant });
      WL.U.capArray(asset.control, 30); WL.U.capArray(asset.ownership, 30); WL.U.capArray(bucket.controlClaims, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.ownershipClaims, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 120);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'domainAsset', type: 'control_claim', assetId: asset.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    revenue: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var asset = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensureAsset(root, d, ledger);
      var kind = d.evidenceKind || (p.type === 'domain_tax_evidence_candidate' ? 'tax' : (p.type === 'domain_rent_evidence_candidate' ? 'rent' : 'revenue'));
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, assetId: asset.id, assetName: asset.name, amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'silver', evidenceKind: kind, status: 'evidence_only_no_inventory_grant', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      asset.revenueEvidence.push(rec);
      if (kind === 'tax') bucket.taxRecords.push(rec); else if (kind === 'rent') bucket.rentRecords.push(rec); else bucket.revenueRecords.push(rec);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: kind, assetId: asset.id, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: rec.status });
      WL.U.capArray(asset.revenueEvidence, 40); WL.U.capArray(bucket.taxRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.rentRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.revenueRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 120);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'domainAsset', type: kind + '_evidence', assetId: asset.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    upkeep: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var asset = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensureAsset(root, d, ledger);
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, assetId: asset.id, assetName: asset.name, amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'silver', evidenceKind: d.evidenceKind || 'upkeep', status: 'evidence_only_no_auto_spend', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      asset.upkeepEvidence.push(rec);
      if (rec.evidenceKind === 'maintenance') bucket.maintenanceRecords.push(rec); else bucket.upkeepRecords.push(rec);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: rec.evidenceKind, assetId: asset.id, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: rec.status });
      WL.U.capArray(asset.upkeepEvidence, 40); WL.U.capArray(bucket.upkeepRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.maintenanceRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 120);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'domainAsset', type: 'upkeep_evidence', assetId: asset.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var d = WL.DomainAssetSystem.ensure(root); var lines = [];
      lines.push('Domain Assets: assets ' + d.assetIds.length + ', holdings ' + d.holdingIds.length + ', rooms ' + d.roomIds.length + ', control claims ' + d.controlClaims.length + ', taxes ' + d.taxRecords.length + ', upkeep ' + d.upkeepRecords.length);
      if (!d.assetIds.length) { lines.push('Holdings: (none)'); return lines; }
      var shown = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < d.assetIds.length && i < 5; i++) { var a = d.assetsById[d.assetIds[i]]; if (a) shown.push(a.name + ' [' + a.type + '; ' + (a.status || 'active') + ']'); }
      lines.push('Holdings: ' + (shown.length ? shown.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      var recent = [];
      if (d.taxRecords.length) { var t = d.taxRecords[d.taxRecords.length - 1]; recent.push('tax ' + t.assetName + ' ' + t.amount + ' ' + t.currency + ' [no inventory grant]'); }
      if (d.revenueRecords.length) { var rv = d.revenueRecords[d.revenueRecords.length - 1]; recent.push('revenue ' + rv.assetName + ' ' + rv.amount + ' ' + rv.currency + ' [evidence]'); }
      if (d.upkeepRecords.length) { var u = d.upkeepRecords[d.upkeepRecords.length - 1]; recent.push('upkeep ' + u.assetName + ' ' + u.amount + ' ' + u.currency + ' [no auto spend]'); }
      if (d.roomIds.length) { var room = d.roomsById[d.roomIds[d.roomIds.length - 1]]; if (room) recent.push('room ' + room.name + ' in ' + room.assetName); }
      lines.push('Recent Asset Evidence: ' + (recent.length ? recent.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.DomainAssetReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) { return WL.DomainAssetSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger); };

  // Owner note: EconomyTransactionSystem owns quotes, debts, failed purchases, wage/service evidence, and payment records.
  WL.EconomyTransactionSystem = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.economy || typeof root.economy !== 'object') root.economy = WL.Schema.root().economy;
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.priceQuotes)) root.economy.priceQuotes = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.serviceQuotes)) root.economy.serviceQuotes = [];
      if (!root.economy.debtsById || typeof root.economy.debtsById !== 'object') root.economy.debtsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.debtIds)) root.economy.debtIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.failedPurchases)) root.economy.failedPurchases = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.wagePayments)) root.economy.wagePayments = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.servicePayments)) root.economy.servicePayments = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.purchaseDenials)) root.economy.purchaseDenials = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.transactions)) root.economy.transactions = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.economy.recent)) root.economy.recent = [];
      if (!root.advanced) root.advanced = WL.Schema.root().advanced;
      if (!root.advanced.economy || typeof root.advanced.economy !== 'object') root.advanced.economy = { priceQuotes: [], debts: [], failedPurchases: [] };
      if (!Array.isArray(root.advanced.economy.priceQuotes)) root.advanced.economy.priceQuotes = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.advanced.economy.debts)) root.advanced.economy.debts = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.advanced.economy.failedPurchases)) root.advanced.economy.failedPurchases = [];
      return root.economy;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'economy_price_quote_candidate') return WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.priceQuote(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'economy_service_quote_candidate') return WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.serviceQuote(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'economy_failed_purchase_candidate') return WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.failedPurchase(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'economy_debt_candidate') return WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.debt(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'economy_wage_payment_candidate') return WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.wagePayment(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'economy_service_payment_candidate') return WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.servicePayment(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'economy', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_economy_event' };
    },
    pushTransaction: function (root, rec) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root);
      e.transactions.push(rec); e.recent.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(e.transactions, 120); WL.U.capArray(e.recent, 60);
      return rec;
    },
    priceQuote: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var rec = { id: d.targetId || ('quote_' + WL.U.hash(ledger.key)), key: ledger.key, itemName: d.itemName || '', amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'gold', quoteKind: d.quoteKind || 'item', vendorName: d.vendorName || '', status: 'quoted', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      e.priceQuotes.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(e.priceQuotes, 60);
      root.advanced.economy.priceQuotes.push({ key: rec.key, itemName: rec.itemName, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, phrase: rec.phrase }); WL.U.capArray(root.advanced.economy.priceQuotes, 60);
      WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.pushTransaction(root, { key: ledger.key, type: 'price_quote', subject: rec.itemName, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: 'quote_only_no_item' });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'economy', type: 'price_quote', key: ledger.key };
    },
    serviceQuote: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var rec = { id: d.targetId || ('service_quote_' + WL.U.hash(ledger.key)), key: ledger.key, serviceName: d.serviceName || 'service', actorName: d.actorName || '', amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'silver', status: d.status || 'quoted', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      e.serviceQuotes.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(e.serviceQuotes, 60);
      WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.pushTransaction(root, { key: ledger.key, type: 'service_quote', subject: rec.serviceName, actorName: rec.actorName, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: 'quote_only_no_completion' });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'economy', type: 'service_quote', key: ledger.key };
    },
    failedPurchase: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var rec = { id: d.targetId || ('failed_purchase_' + WL.U.hash(ledger.key)), key: ledger.key, itemName: d.itemName || '', amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || '', reason: d.reason || 'failed_purchase', status: 'failed', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      e.failedPurchases.push(rec); e.purchaseDenials.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(e.failedPurchases, 60); WL.U.capArray(e.purchaseDenials, 60);
      root.advanced.economy.failedPurchases.push({ key: rec.key, itemName: rec.itemName, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, reason: rec.reason }); WL.U.capArray(root.advanced.economy.failedPurchases, 60);
      WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.pushTransaction(root, { key: ledger.key, type: 'failed_purchase', subject: rec.itemName, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: 'no_item_no_spend' });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'economy', type: 'failed_purchase', key: ledger.key };
    },
    debt: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var id = d.targetId || ('debt_' + WL.U.hash(ledger.key));
      if (!e.debtsById[id]) { e.debtsById[id] = { id: id, creditor: d.creditor || '', amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'silver', reason: d.reason || 'debt', debtKind: d.debtKind || 'general', status: d.status || 'owed', createdKey: ledger.key, history: [] }; e.debtIds.push(id); }
      var rec = e.debtsById[id]; rec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, action: 'debt_recorded', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn }); WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 20);
      root.advanced.economy.debts.push({ key: ledger.key, creditor: rec.creditor, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, paid: false }); WL.U.capArray(root.advanced.economy.debts, 60);
      WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.pushTransaction(root, { key: ledger.key, type: 'debt', subject: rec.creditor, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: rec.status, reason: rec.reason });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'economy', type: 'debt', debtId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    wagePayment: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var rec = { id: d.targetId || ('wage_payment_' + WL.U.hash(ledger.key)), key: ledger.key, actorName: d.actorName || '', amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'silver', paymentKind: d.paymentKind || 'wage', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      e.wagePayments.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(e.wagePayments, 60);
      WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.pushTransaction(root, { key: ledger.key, type: 'wage_payment', subject: rec.actorName, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: 'payment_evidence' });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'economy', type: 'wage_payment', key: ledger.key };
    },
    servicePayment: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root); var d = p.data || {};
      var rec = { id: d.targetId || ('service_payment_' + WL.U.hash(ledger.key)), key: ledger.key, actorName: d.actorName || '', serviceName: d.serviceName || 'service', amount: Number(d.amount || 0), currency: d.currency || 'silver', status: d.status || 'paid_evidence', phrase: p.textPreview, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      e.servicePayments.push(rec); WL.U.capArray(e.servicePayments, 60);
      WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.pushTransaction(root, { key: ledger.key, type: 'service_payment', subject: rec.serviceName, actorName: rec.actorName, amount: rec.amount, currency: rec.currency, status: 'payment_evidence_not_completion' });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'economy', type: 'service_payment', key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var e = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.ensure(root); var lines = [];
      lines.push('Economy: quotes ' + e.priceQuotes.length + ', services ' + e.serviceQuotes.length + ', debts ' + e.debtIds.length + ', failed purchases ' + e.failedPurchases.length + ', wages paid ' + e.wagePayments.length);
      var parts = [];
      if (e.priceQuotes.length) { var q = e.priceQuotes[e.priceQuotes.length - 1]; parts.push('last quote ' + q.itemName + ' ' + q.amount + ' ' + q.currency + ' [no item]'); }
      if (e.serviceQuotes.length) { var sq = e.serviceQuotes[e.serviceQuotes.length - 1]; parts.push('service ' + sq.serviceName + ' ' + sq.amount + ' ' + sq.currency); }
      if (e.debtIds.length) { var d = e.debtsById[e.debtIds[e.debtIds.length - 1]]; if (d) parts.push('debt to ' + d.creditor + ' ' + d.amount + ' ' + d.currency); }
      if (e.failedPurchases.length) { var fp = e.failedPurchases[e.failedPurchases.length - 1]; parts.push('failed ' + fp.itemName + ' [no item/spend]'); }
      lines.push('Recent: ' + (parts.length ? parts.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.EconomyTransactionReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) { return WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger); };


  // Owner note: CraftingSystem owns recipe/material/quality/repair evidence. It never grants crafted items or spends inventory directly.
  WL.CraftingSystem = {
    dedicatedOwnerActive: true,
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.advanced || typeof root.advanced !== 'object') root.advanced = WL.Schema.root().advanced;
      if (!root.advanced.crafting || typeof root.advanced.crafting !== 'object') root.advanced.crafting = { version: '9.11A', recipesById: {}, recipeIds: [], projectsById: {}, projectIds: [], materialLedgers: [], qualityLedgers: [], repairLedgers: [], completionLedgers: [], denied: [], recent: [], lastProjectId: '' };
      var c = root.advanced.crafting;
      if (!c.recipesById || typeof c.recipesById !== 'object') c.recipesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(c.recipeIds)) c.recipeIds = [];
      if (!c.projectsById || typeof c.projectsById !== 'object') c.projectsById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(c.projectIds)) c.projectIds = [];
      ['materialLedgers','qualityLedgers','repairLedgers','completionLedgers','denied','recent'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(c[k])) c[k] = []; });
      if (typeof c.lastProjectId !== 'string') c.lastProjectId = '';
      c.version = '9.11A';
      return c;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'crafting_recipe_candidate') return WL.CraftingSystem.recipe(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'crafting_project_candidate' || p.type === 'crafting_completion_candidate') return WL.CraftingSystem.project(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'crafting_quality_candidate') return WL.CraftingSystem.quality(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'crafting_repair_candidate') return WL.CraftingSystem.repair(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'crafting_denial') return WL.CraftingSystem.denial(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'crafting', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_crafting_event' };
    },
    projectId: function (name) { return 'craft_' + WL.U.slug(WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(name || 'unknown_craft')); },
    ensureProject: function (root, data, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.CraftingSystem.ensure(root);
      var name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(data.projectName || data.recipeName || 'Unknown Craft') || 'Unknown Craft';
      var id = data.projectId || WL.CraftingSystem.projectId(name);
      if (!bucket.projectsById[id]) {
        bucket.projectsById[id] = { id: id, name: name, status: 'in_progress_evidence_only', recipeId: data.recipeId || '', materials: [], materialLedger: [], quality: '', qualityHistory: [], repairHistory: [], completionEvidence: [], timeSpent: [], outputItemGranted: false, inventoryConsumptionApplied: false, history: [] };
        if (bucket.projectIds.indexOf(id) < 0) bucket.projectIds.push(id);
      }
      var proj = bucket.projectsById[id];
      ['materials','materialLedger','qualityHistory','repairHistory','completionEvidence','timeSpent','history'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(proj[k])) proj[k] = []; });
      proj.name = proj.name || name;
      bucket.lastProjectId = id;
      return proj;
    },
    recipe: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.CraftingSystem.ensure(root);
      var name = WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(p.data.recipeName || 'Unknown Recipe') || 'Unknown Recipe';
      var id = p.data.recipeId || ('recipe_' + WL.U.slug(name));
      if (!bucket.recipesById[id]) {
        bucket.recipesById[id] = { id: id, name: name, known: true, source: 'story_output', history: [], outputItemGranted: false };
        if (bucket.recipeIds.indexOf(id) < 0) bucket.recipeIds.push(id);
      }
      var rec = bucket.recipesById[id];
      rec.known = true;
      rec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview, confidence: p.data.confidence || '' });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 30);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'recipe_known', recipeId: id, name: name });
      WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'crafting', type: 'recipe_known', recipeId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    addMaterials: function (proj, materials, ledger, mode) {
      materials = Array.isArray(materials) ? materials : [];
      var added = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < materials.length; i++) {
        if (!materials[i] || !materials[i].name) continue;
        var mat = { key: ledger.key, name: WL.EventScanner.cleanMaterialName(materials[i].name), quantity: materials[i].quantity || 1, mode: mode || 'recorded' };
        proj.materials.push(mat);
        added.push(mat);
      }
      return added;
    },
    project: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.CraftingSystem.ensure(root);
      var proj = WL.CraftingSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      var mode = p.type === 'crafting_completion_candidate' ? 'completion_consumed_evidence' : 'project_material_evidence';
      var mats = WL.CraftingSystem.addMaterials(proj, p.data.materials || [], ledger, mode);
      if (p.data.time) proj.timeSpent.push({ key: ledger.key, amount: p.data.time.amount, unit: p.data.time.unit || 'hour', mode: mode });
      if (p.data.quality) { proj.quality = p.data.quality; proj.qualityHistory.push({ key: ledger.key, quality: p.data.quality, phrase: p.textPreview }); }
      if (p.type === 'crafting_completion_candidate') {
        proj.status = 'completion_evidence_pending_inventory_validation';
        proj.completionEvidence.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview, materials: mats, quality: p.data.quality || proj.quality || '' });
        bucket.completionLedgers.push({ key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, projectName: proj.name, materials: mats, quality: p.data.quality || proj.quality || '', status: proj.status });
      } else {
        proj.status = proj.status === 'completion_evidence_pending_inventory_validation' ? proj.status : 'in_progress_evidence_only';
      }
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, projectName: proj.name, materials: mats, time: p.data.time || null, type: p.type, phrase: p.textPreview };
      proj.materialLedger.push(rec);
      proj.history.push({ key: ledger.key, type: p.type, phrase: p.textPreview });
      bucket.materialLedgers.push(rec);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: p.type, projectId: proj.id, name: proj.name });
      WL.U.capArray(proj.materials, 80); WL.U.capArray(proj.materialLedger, 60); WL.U.capArray(proj.history, 60); WL.U.capArray(bucket.materialLedgers, 160); WL.U.capArray(bucket.completionLedgers, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'crafting', type: p.type === 'crafting_completion_candidate' ? 'crafting_completion_evidence' : 'crafting_project_evidence', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    quality: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.CraftingSystem.ensure(root);
      var proj = WL.CraftingSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      var quality = p.data.quality || 'quality_evidence';
      proj.quality = quality;
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, projectName: proj.name, quality: quality, phrase: p.textPreview };
      proj.qualityHistory.push(rec);
      bucket.qualityLedgers.push(rec);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'crafting_quality', projectId: proj.id, quality: quality });
      WL.U.capArray(proj.qualityHistory, 40); WL.U.capArray(bucket.qualityLedgers, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'crafting', type: 'crafting_quality_evidence', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    repair: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.CraftingSystem.ensure(root);
      var proj = WL.CraftingSystem.ensureProject(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      var mats = WL.CraftingSystem.addMaterials(proj, p.data.materials || [], ledger, 'repair_material_evidence');
      proj.status = p.data.status || 'repair_evidence_only';
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: proj.id, projectName: proj.name, materials: mats, time: p.data.time || null, status: proj.status, phrase: p.textPreview };
      proj.repairHistory.push(rec);
      bucket.repairLedgers.push(rec);
      bucket.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'repair_evidence', projectId: proj.id, status: proj.status });
      WL.U.capArray(proj.repairHistory, 40); WL.U.capArray(bucket.repairLedgers, 120); WL.U.capArray(bucket.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'crafting', type: 'repair_evidence', projectId: proj.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    denial: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var bucket = WL.CraftingSystem.ensure(root);
      bucket.denied.push({ key: ledger.key, reason: p.data.reason || 'unconfirmed_crafting_language', phrase: p.textPreview });
      WL.U.capArray(bucket.denied, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED_DENIAL', applied: true, family: 'crafting', type: 'crafting_denial', key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, limit) {
      var c = WL.CraftingSystem.ensure(root);
      limit = limit || 3;
      var lines = [];
      lines.push('Crafting: recipes ' + c.recipeIds.length + ', projects ' + c.projectIds.length + ', materials ' + c.materialLedgers.length + ', completions ' + c.completionLedgers.length + ', repairs ' + c.repairLedgers.length);
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < c.projectIds.length && parts.length < limit; i++) {
        var p = c.projectsById[c.projectIds[i]];
        if (p) parts.push(p.name + ' [' + p.status + (p.quality ? '; ' + p.quality : '') + ']');
      }
      lines.push('Recent crafting: ' + (parts.length ? parts.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.CraftingReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.CraftingSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };

  // Owner note: WarfareSystem owns force records, casualties, morale, logistics, and control claims as evidence.
  WL.WarfareSystem = {
    dedicatedOwnerActive: true,
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.advanced || typeof root.advanced !== 'object') root.advanced = WL.Schema.root().advanced;
      if (!root.advanced.warfare || typeof root.advanced.warfare !== 'object') root.advanced.warfare = { version: '9.11B', forcesById: {}, forceIds: [], casualties: [], controlClaims: [], moraleRecords: [], logisticsRecords: [], denied: [], recent: [], lastForceId: '' };
      var w = root.advanced.warfare;
      if (!w.forcesById || typeof w.forcesById !== 'object') w.forcesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(w.forceIds)) w.forceIds = [];
      ['casualties','controlClaims','moraleRecords','logisticsRecords','denied','recent'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(w[k])) w[k] = []; });
      if (typeof w.lastForceId !== 'string') w.lastForceId = '';
      w.version = '9.11B';
      return w;
    },
    cleanForceName: function (name) {
      var n = WL.U.norm(name || '');
      n = n.replace(/^(?:the|a|an)\s+/i, '');
      n = n.replace(/\b(?:march(?:es)?|advance(?:s)?|arrive(?:s)?|hold(?:s)?|guard(?:s)?|deploy(?:s)?|rall(?:y|ies)|take(?:s)?|capture(?:s)?|seize(?:s)?|control(?:s)?)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      n = n.replace(/\b(?:army|force|company|legion|battalion|warband|unit)\s+of\s+\d+\s+/i, '');
      n = n.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      return WL.U.title(n || 'Unknown Force');
    },
    ensureForce: function (root, data, ledger) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      var name = WL.WarfareSystem.cleanForceName(data.forceName || 'Unknown Force');
      var id = data.forceId || ('force_' + WL.U.slug(name));
      if (!w.forcesById[id]) {
        w.forcesById[id] = { id: id, name: name, total: 0, remaining: 0, casualties: 0, wounded: 0, status: 'evidence_only', morale: 'unknown', logistics: [], controlClaims: [], history: [] };
        w.forceIds.push(id);
      }
      var f = w.forcesById[id];
      if (!Array.isArray(f.history)) f.history = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(f.logistics)) f.logistics = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(f.controlClaims)) f.controlClaims = [];
      f.name = f.name || name;
      w.lastForceId = id;
      return f;
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'warfare_force_candidate') return WL.WarfareSystem.force(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'warfare_casualty_candidate') return WL.WarfareSystem.casualty(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'warfare_control_candidate') return WL.WarfareSystem.control(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'warfare_morale_candidate') return WL.WarfareSystem.morale(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'warfare_logistics_candidate') return WL.WarfareSystem.logistics(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'warfare_denial') return WL.WarfareSystem.denial(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'warfare', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_warfare_event' };
    },
    force: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      var f = WL.WarfareSystem.ensureForce(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      var count = WL.U.clamp(Number(p.data.count || 0), 0, 999999);
      if (count > 0) {
        f.total = Math.max(f.total || 0, count);
        if (!f.remaining || f.remaining < count - (f.casualties || 0)) f.remaining = Math.max(0, count - (f.casualties || 0));
      }
      f.status = p.data.status || 'active_force_evidence';
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, forceId: f.id, forceName: f.name, count: count, status: f.status, phrase: p.textPreview };
      f.history.push(rec);
      w.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'force_record', forceId: f.id, count: count });
      WL.U.capArray(f.history, 80); WL.U.capArray(w.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'warfare', type: 'force_record', forceId: f.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    casualty: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      var f = WL.WarfareSystem.ensureForce(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      var n = WL.U.clamp(Number(p.data.casualties || 0), 0, 999999);
      if (p.data.casualtyKind === 'wounded') f.wounded = (f.wounded || 0) + n;
      else {
        f.casualties = (f.casualties || 0) + n;
        f.remaining = Math.max(0, (f.remaining || 0) - n);
      }
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, forceId: f.id, forceName: f.name, casualties: n, casualtyKind: p.data.casualtyKind || 'dead_or_lost', reason: p.data.reason || '', remaining: f.remaining || 0, phrase: p.textPreview };
      f.history.push(rec);
      w.casualties.push(rec);
      w.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'casualty_record', forceId: f.id, casualties: n, remaining: f.remaining || 0 });
      WL.U.capArray(f.history, 80); WL.U.capArray(w.casualties, 160); WL.U.capArray(w.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'warfare', type: 'casualty_record', forceId: f.id, remaining: f.remaining || 0, key: ledger.key };
    },
    control: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      var f = WL.WarfareSystem.ensureForce(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      var placeName = WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(p.data.placeName || 'Unknown Place');
      var placeId = p.data.placeId || ('place_' + WL.U.slug(placeName));
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, forceId: f.id, forceName: f.name, placeId: placeId, placeName: placeName, truthStatus: p.data.truthStatus || 'claim_until_proven', status: 'control_claim_evidence_only', phrase: p.textPreview };
      f.controlClaims.push(rec);
      w.controlClaims.push(rec);
      w.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'control_claim', forceId: f.id, placeName: placeName });
      WL.U.capArray(f.controlClaims, 80); WL.U.capArray(w.controlClaims, 160); WL.U.capArray(w.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'warfare', type: 'control_claim', forceId: f.id, placeName: placeName, key: ledger.key };
    },
    morale: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      var f = WL.WarfareSystem.ensureForce(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      f.morale = p.data.morale || 'morale_evidence';
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, forceId: f.id, forceName: f.name, morale: f.morale, phrase: p.textPreview };
      w.moraleRecords.push(rec);
      f.history.push(rec);
      w.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'morale_record', forceId: f.id, morale: f.morale });
      WL.U.capArray(w.moraleRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(f.history, 80); WL.U.capArray(w.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'warfare', type: 'morale_record', forceId: f.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    logistics: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      var f = WL.WarfareSystem.ensureForce(root, p.data || {}, ledger);
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, forceId: f.id, forceName: f.name, logistics: p.data.logistics || 'logistics_evidence', resource: p.data.resource || '', phrase: p.textPreview };
      f.logistics.push(rec);
      w.logisticsRecords.push(rec);
      w.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'logistics_record', forceId: f.id, resource: rec.resource });
      WL.U.capArray(f.logistics, 80); WL.U.capArray(w.logisticsRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(w.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'warfare', type: 'logistics_record', forceId: f.id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    denial: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      w.denied.push({ key: ledger.key, reason: p.data.reason || 'noncanonical_warfare_text', phrase: p.textPreview });
      WL.U.capArray(w.denied, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED_DENIAL', applied: true, family: 'warfare', type: 'warfare_denial', key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, limit) {
      var w = WL.WarfareSystem.ensure(root);
      limit = limit || 4;
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < w.forceIds.length && parts.length < limit; i++) {
        var f = w.forcesById[w.forceIds[i]];
        if (f) parts.push(f.name + ' ' + (f.remaining || 0) + '/' + (f.total || 0) + (f.morale && f.morale !== 'unknown' ? ' morale:' + f.morale : ''));
      }
      var lines = [];
      lines.push('Warfare: forces ' + w.forceIds.length + ', casualties ' + w.casualties.length + ', control claims ' + w.controlClaims.length + ', morale ' + w.moraleRecords.length + ', logistics ' + w.logisticsRecords.length);
      lines.push('Recent warfare: ' + (parts.length ? parts.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.WarfareReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.WarfareSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };


  // Owner note: EvolutionAbsorptionSystem owns bounded absorption/evolution candidates and threshold evidence only.
  WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem = {
    dedicatedOwnerActive: true,
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.advanced || typeof root.advanced !== 'object') root.advanced = WL.Schema.root().advanced;
      if (!root.advanced.absorption || typeof root.advanced.absorption !== 'object') root.advanced.absorption = { version: '9.11C', candidatesById: {}, candidateIds: [], sourceUseKeys: [], thresholdRecords: [], denied: [], recent: [] };
      if (!root.advanced.evolution || typeof root.advanced.evolution !== 'object') root.advanced.evolution = { version: '9.11C', candidatesById: {}, candidateIds: [], thresholdNotes: [], denied: [], recent: [] };
      var a = root.advanced.absorption;
      var e = root.advanced.evolution;
      if (!a.candidatesById || typeof a.candidatesById !== 'object') a.candidatesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(a.candidateIds)) a.candidateIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(a.sourceUseKeys)) a.sourceUseKeys = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(a.thresholdRecords)) a.thresholdRecords = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(a.denied)) a.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(a.recent)) a.recent = [];
      if (!e.candidatesById || typeof e.candidatesById !== 'object') e.candidatesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(e.candidateIds)) e.candidateIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(e.thresholdNotes)) e.thresholdNotes = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(e.denied)) e.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(e.recent)) e.recent = [];
      a.version = '9.11C';
      e.version = '9.11C';
      return { absorption: a, evolution: e };
    },
    cleanCandidateName: function (value) {
      var n = WL.EventScanner.cleanAdvancedName(value || '');
