      n = n.replace(/\s+(?:and\s+gain|with\s+gain|granting|instantly|immediately)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '').trim();
      if (!n || /^(?:it|this|that|something|anything|power)$/i.test(n)) return '';
      return WL.U.title(n);
    },
    stabilityForStatus: function (status) {
      if (/denied/.test(status || '')) return 'denied';
      if (/unstable|threshold/.test(status || '')) return 'unstable';
      if (/stable/.test(status || '')) return 'stable';
      return 'candidate';
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'evolution_absorption_denial') return WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.denial(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'evolution_absorption_candidate') {
        if (p.data.candidateKind === 'evolution') return WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.evolution(root, p, ledger);
        return WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.absorption(root, p, ledger);
      }
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'evolutionAbsorption', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_evolution_absorption_event' };
    },
    absorption: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var buckets = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.ensure(root);
      var a = buckets.absorption;
      var sourceName = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.cleanCandidateName(p.data.sourceName || 'Unknown Source');
      var id = p.data.candidateId || ('absorb_' + WL.U.slug(sourceName));
      if (!a.candidatesById[id]) {
        a.candidatesById[id] = { id: id, kind: 'absorption', sourceName: sourceName, targetForm: p.data.targetForm || '', status: 'candidate_evidence_only', stability: 'candidate', bounded: true, progress: 0, thresholdEvidence: [], history: [] };
        a.candidateIds.push(id);
      }
      var rec = a.candidatesById[id];
      rec.sourceName = rec.sourceName || sourceName;
      if (p.data.targetForm) rec.targetForm = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.cleanCandidateName(p.data.targetForm);
      rec.progress = WL.U.clamp((rec.progress || 0) + (Number(p.data.progress || 1) || 1), 0, 100);
      rec.status = p.data.status || rec.status || 'candidate_evidence_only';
      rec.stability = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.stabilityForStatus(rec.status);
      if (p.data.thresholdNote) {
        var th = { key: ledger.key, candidateId: id, kind: 'absorption', note: WL.U.norm(p.data.thresholdNote), status: rec.status, progress: rec.progress, phrase: p.textPreview };
        rec.thresholdEvidence.push(th);
        a.thresholdRecords.push(th);
      }
      rec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview, progress: p.data.progress || 1, status: rec.status });
      if (a.sourceUseKeys.indexOf(id) < 0) a.sourceUseKeys.push(id);
      a.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'absorption_candidate', candidateId: id, status: rec.status, progress: rec.progress });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 60); WL.U.capArray(rec.thresholdEvidence, 40); WL.U.capArray(a.thresholdRecords, 120); WL.U.capArray(a.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'evolutionAbsorption', type: 'absorption_candidate', candidateId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    evolution: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var buckets = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.ensure(root);
      var e = buckets.evolution;
      var targetForm = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.cleanCandidateName(p.data.targetForm || 'Unknown Form');
      var id = p.data.candidateId || ('evolve_' + WL.U.slug(targetForm));
      if (!e.candidatesById[id]) {
        e.candidatesById[id] = { id: id, kind: 'evolution', targetForm: targetForm, status: 'candidate_evidence_only', stability: 'candidate', bounded: true, progress: 0, thresholdEvidence: [], history: [], formApplied: false, raceOverwriteApplied: false };
        e.candidateIds.push(id);
      }
      var rec = e.candidatesById[id];
      rec.targetForm = rec.targetForm || targetForm;
      rec.progress = WL.U.clamp((rec.progress || 0) + (Number(p.data.progress || 1) || 1), 0, 100);
      rec.status = p.data.status || rec.status || 'candidate_evidence_only';
      rec.stability = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.stabilityForStatus(rec.status);
      rec.formApplied = false;
      rec.raceOverwriteApplied = false;
      if (p.data.thresholdNote) {
        var th = { key: ledger.key, candidateId: id, kind: 'evolution', note: WL.U.norm(p.data.thresholdNote), status: rec.status, progress: rec.progress, phrase: p.textPreview };
        rec.thresholdEvidence.push(th);
        e.thresholdNotes.push(th);
      }
      rec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview, progress: p.data.progress || 1, status: rec.status });
      e.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'evolution_candidate', candidateId: id, status: rec.status, progress: rec.progress });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.history, 60); WL.U.capArray(rec.thresholdEvidence, 40); WL.U.capArray(e.thresholdNotes, 120); WL.U.capArray(e.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'evolutionAbsorption', type: 'evolution_candidate', candidateId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    denial: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var buckets = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.ensure(root);
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, reason: p.data.reason || 'unsafe_evolution_absorption_claim', phrase: p.textPreview, sourceName: p.data.sourceName || '', targetForm: p.data.targetForm || '', status: 'denied' };
      buckets.absorption.denied.push(rec);
      buckets.evolution.denied.push(rec);
      buckets.absorption.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, type: 'denial', reason: rec.reason });
      WL.U.capArray(buckets.absorption.denied, 100); WL.U.capArray(buckets.evolution.denied, 100); WL.U.capArray(buckets.absorption.recent, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED_DENIAL', applied: true, family: 'evolutionAbsorption', type: 'evolution_absorption_denial', key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root, limit) {
      var b = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.ensure(root);
      limit = limit || 4;
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < b.absorption.candidateIds.length && parts.length < limit; i++) {
        var a = b.absorption.candidatesById[b.absorption.candidateIds[i]];
        if (a) parts.push(a.sourceName + ' [' + a.stability + '; +' + (a.progress || 0) + ']');
      }
      for (var j = 0; j < b.evolution.candidateIds.length && parts.length < limit; j++) {
        var e = b.evolution.candidatesById[b.evolution.candidateIds[j]];
        if (e) parts.push(e.targetForm + ' [' + e.stability + '; +' + (e.progress || 0) + ']');
      }
      var lines = [];
      lines.push('Absorption/Evolution: absorption ' + b.absorption.candidateIds.length + ', evolution ' + b.evolution.candidateIds.length + ', threshold evidence ' + (b.absorption.thresholdRecords.length + b.evolution.thresholdNotes.length) + ', denied ' + Math.max(b.absorption.denied.length, b.evolution.denied.length));
      lines.push('Recent evolution: ' + (parts.length ? parts.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      return lines;
    },
    detailLines: function (root, limit) {
      var lines = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.summary(root, limit || 8);
      var b = WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.ensure(root);
      var shown = 0;
      limit = limit || 8;
      for (var i = 0; i < b.absorption.candidateIds.length && shown < limit; i++, shown++) {
        var a = b.absorption.candidatesById[b.absorption.candidateIds[i]];
        if (a) lines.push('- Absorb ' + a.sourceName + ': ' + a.status + ', progress ' + (a.progress || 0) + ', bounded/no form overwrite');
      }
      for (var j = 0; j < b.evolution.candidateIds.length && shown < limit; j++, shown++) {
        var e = b.evolution.candidatesById[b.evolution.candidateIds[j]];
        if (e) lines.push('- Evolve ' + e.targetForm + ': ' + e.status + ', progress ' + (e.progress || 0) + ', formApplied=' + (!!e.formApplied));
      }
      if (Math.max(b.absorption.denied.length, b.evolution.denied.length)) lines.push('Denied unsafe claims: ' + Math.max(b.absorption.denied.length, b.evolution.denied.length));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.EvolutionAbsorptionReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };

  // Owner note: LoreAuthoritySystem owns revealed vs hidden lore authority and source-card refs only.
  WL.LoreAuthoritySystem = {
    dedicatedOwnerActive: true,
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.loreAuthority || typeof root.loreAuthority !== 'object') root.loreAuthority = WL.Schema.root().loreAuthority;
      if (!root.loreAuthority.sourcesById || typeof root.loreAuthority.sourcesById !== 'object') root.loreAuthority.sourcesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.sourceIds)) root.loreAuthority.sourceIds = [];
      if (!root.loreAuthority.revealedById || typeof root.loreAuthority.revealedById !== 'object') root.loreAuthority.revealedById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.revealedIds)) root.loreAuthority.revealedIds = [];
      if (!root.loreAuthority.hiddenById || typeof root.loreAuthority.hiddenById !== 'object') root.loreAuthority.hiddenById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.hiddenIds)) root.loreAuthority.hiddenIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.regionalTriggers)) root.loreAuthority.regionalTriggers = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.denied)) root.loreAuthority.denied = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.loreAuthority.recent)) root.loreAuthority.recent = [];
      root.loreAuthority.version = '9.12A';
      return root.loreAuthority;
    },
    syncStoryCards: function (root, cards) {
      var la = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.ensure(root);
      cards = Array.isArray(cards) ? cards : WL.U.getStoryCards(WL.U.getGlobalState());
      var sig = WL.U.hash(cards.map(function (card) { return WL.U.safeString((card && (card.title || card.keys || card.key || card.name || '')) + '|' + (card && (card.type || '') || '') + '|' + (card && (card.entry || card.value || card.description || card.text || card.body || '') || '')); }).join('||'));
      if (la.lastSyncHash === sig) return { status: 'UNCHANGED', count: la.sourceIds.length };
      la.lastSyncHash = sig;
      for (var i = 0; i < cards.length && i < 240; i++) {
        var card = cards[i] || {};
        var title = WL.U.safeString(card.title || card.name || card.keys || card.key || ('Story Card ' + i));
        var body = WL.U.safeString(card.entry || card.value || card.description || card.text || card.body || '');
        var type = WL.U.safeString(card.type || 'world');
        if (!title && !body) continue;
        var hay = (title + ' ' + body).toLowerCase();
        var isLore = /\b(?:god|goddess|aethros|decay|storm|life|endurance|depth|balance|memory|silence|destruction|order|conflict|faction|nation|region|world persistence|lore|history|race|lineage|creature|divine)\b/.test(hay) || /^(?:god|race|lineage|faction|nation|region|system|event|creature|spirit_court)$/i.test(type);
        if (!isLore) continue;
        var id = 'lore_source_' + WL.U.slug(title || ('card_' + i));
        var rec = la.sourcesById[id] || { id: id, title: title, type: type, visibility: 'hidden_until_revealed', sourceCardRef: title, region: WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.regionFromText(title + ' ' + body), tags: [], summary: '' };
        rec.title = title; rec.type = type; rec.sourceCardRef = title; rec.region = rec.region || WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.regionFromText(title + ' ' + body);
        rec.summary = WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(body || title, 220) : WL.U.safeString(body || title).slice(0, 220);
        rec.tags = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.tagsFromText(title + ' ' + body);
        la.sourcesById[id] = rec;
        if (la.sourceIds.indexOf(id) < 0) la.sourceIds.push(id);
        if (la.hiddenIds.indexOf(id) < 0 && la.revealedIds.indexOf(id) < 0) { la.hiddenById[id] = { id: id, title: title, sourceCardRef: title, reason: 'story_card_lore_import_hidden_until_revealed' }; la.hiddenIds.push(id); }
      }
      WL.U.capArray(la.sourceIds, 240); WL.U.capArray(la.hiddenIds, 240);
      return { status: 'SYNCED', count: la.sourceIds.length };
    },
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal || {};
      if (p.type === 'lore_authority_denial') return WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.denial(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'lore_reveal_candidate') return WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.reveal(root, p, ledger);
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'loreAuthority', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_lore_authority_event' };
    },
    reveal: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var la = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.ensure(root);
      var title = WL.U.title(p.data.topic || p.data.title || p.data.targetName || 'World Lore');
      var id = 'lore_revealed_' + WL.U.slug(title);
      var existingSource = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.findSource(root, title);
      var rec = la.revealedById[id] || { id: id, title: title, visibility: 'revealed', sourceRefs: [], region: p.data.region || '', evidence: [], tags: [] };
      rec.title = title; rec.visibility = 'revealed'; rec.region = p.data.region || rec.region || (existingSource && existingSource.region) || '';
      rec.tags = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.tagsFromText(title + ' ' + (p.data.phrase || '')).concat(existingSource && existingSource.tags || []);
      rec.tags = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.unique(rec.tags).slice(0, 12);
      if (existingSource && rec.sourceRefs.indexOf(existingSource.sourceCardRef || existingSource.title) < 0) rec.sourceRefs.push(existingSource.sourceCardRef || existingSource.title);
      rec.evidence.push({ key: ledger.key, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0, phrase: WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(p.data.phrase || p.textPreview || '', 220) : WL.U.safeString(p.data.phrase || p.textPreview || '').slice(0, 220) });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 12);
      la.revealedById[id] = rec;
      if (la.revealedIds.indexOf(id) < 0) la.revealedIds.push(id);
      if (existingSource) {
        existingSource.visibility = 'revealed';
        var hid = existingSource.id;
        var idx = la.hiddenIds.indexOf(hid);
        if (idx >= 0) la.hiddenIds.splice(idx, 1);
        delete la.hiddenById[hid];
      }
      if (rec.region) { la.regionalTriggers.push({ key: ledger.key, title: title, region: rec.region, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0 }); WL.U.capArray(la.regionalTriggers, 120); }
      la.recent.push({ key: ledger.key, action: 'lore_revealed', title: title, region: rec.region || '', turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0 });
      WL.U.capArray(la.recent, 80); if (root.dirty && root.dirty.targets) { if (root.dirty.targets.indexOf('context') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('context'); if (root.dirty.targets.indexOf('cards') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('cards'); root.dirty.reasons.push('lore authority revealed'); WL.U.capArray(root.dirty.targets, 40); WL.U.capArray(root.dirty.reasons, 40); }
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'loreAuthority', type: 'lore_revealed', id: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    denial: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var la = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.ensure(root);
      la.denied.push({ key: ledger.key, reason: p.data.reason || 'lore_authority_denied', phrase: WL.ContextBudgeter ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(p.data.phrase || p.textPreview || '', 220) : WL.U.safeString(p.data.phrase || p.textPreview || '').slice(0, 220), turn: root.runtime.currentTurn || 0 });
      WL.U.capArray(la.denied, 80);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'loreAuthority', type: 'lore_denial', key: ledger.key };
    },
    findSource: function (root, title) {
      var la = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.ensure(root);
      var slug = WL.U.slug(title);
      var direct = la.sourcesById['lore_source_' + slug];
      if (direct) return direct;
      for (var i = 0; i < la.sourceIds.length; i++) { var rec = la.sourcesById[la.sourceIds[i]]; if (rec && (WL.U.slug(rec.title) === slug || WL.U.lower(rec.title).indexOf(WL.U.lower(title)) >= 0 || WL.U.lower(title).indexOf(WL.U.lower(rec.title)) >= 0)) return rec; }
      return null;
    },
    regionFromText: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.safeString(text);
      var regions = ['Verdant Archive','Iron Marches','Fractured Kingdoms','Stone Veil','Harmonic Coast','Borderlands','Frozen Expanse','Ashen Wastes','Green-War Zone','Blighted Marches','Frosthaven','Obel City'];
      for (var i = 0; i < regions.length; i++) if (new RegExp('\b' + regions[i].replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\b', 'i').test(t)) return regions[i];
      return '';
    },
    tagsFromText: function (text) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(text); var tags = [];
      [['god','god'],['divine','divine'],['race','race'],['lineage','lineage'],['faction','faction'],['nation','nation'],['region','region'],['creature','creature'],['death','death'],['decay','decay'],['storm','storm'],['memory','memory'],['silence','silence'],['order','order'],['conflict','conflict'],['life','life'],['depth','depth'],['balance','balance']].forEach(function (pair) { if (t.indexOf(pair[0]) >= 0 && tags.indexOf(pair[1]) < 0) tags.push(pair[1]); });
      return tags;
    },
    unique: function (arr) { var out = []; arr = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []; for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { var v = WL.U.safeString(arr[i]); if (v && out.indexOf(v) < 0) out.push(v); } return out; },
    summary: function (root, limit) {
      var la = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.ensure(root);
      var ids = la.revealedIds || [];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < (limit || 3); i++) { var rec = la.revealedById[ids[i]]; if (rec) parts.push(rec.title + (rec.region ? ' [' + rec.region + ']' : '')); }
      return ['Lore: revealed ' + ids.length + ', hidden sources ' + ((la.hiddenIds || []).length) + (parts.length ? ' | ' + parts.join('; ') : ' | (none revealed)')];
    },
    detailLines: function (root, limit) {
      var la = WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.ensure(root);
      var lines = [WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.summary(root, limit || 6)[0]];
      for (var i = 0; i < la.revealedIds.length && lines.length < (limit || 8); i++) { var rec = la.revealedById[la.revealedIds[i]]; if (rec) lines.push('Revealed: ' + rec.title + (rec.region ? ' @ ' + rec.region : '') + (rec.sourceRefs && rec.sourceRefs.length ? ' | sources ' + rec.sourceRefs.slice(0, 3).join(', ') : '')); }
      if (!la.revealedIds.length) lines.push('Revealed: (none)');
      if (la.hiddenIds.length) lines.push('Hidden imported sources: ' + la.hiddenIds.length + ' (not injected until revealed/relevant).');
      if (la.denied.length) lines.push('Denied: ' + la.denied.slice(-3).map(function (d) { return d.reason; }).join(', '));
      return lines;
    }
  };
  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.LoreAuthorityReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) { return WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.apply(root, validation, ledger); };

  // Owner note: AdvancedBoundarySystem keeps legacy advanced shells; absorption/evolution are now owned by EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.
  WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem = {
    apply: function (root, validation, ledger) {
      var p = validation.proposal;
      if (p.type === 'economy_price_quote_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.price(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'economy_debt_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.debt(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'crafting_recipe_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.recipe(root, p, ledger);
      if (p.type === 'crafting_material_candidate' || p.type === 'crafting_completion_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.craftingProject(root, p, ledger);
      if (/^domain_/.test(p.type)) return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'advanced', type: p.type, reason: 'domain_project_events_are_owned_by_DomainProjectSystem' };
      if (p.type === 'warfare_force_candidate' || p.type === 'warfare_casualty_candidate' || p.type === 'warfare_control_candidate') {
        if (WL.WarfareSystem && WL.WarfareSystem.dedicatedOwnerActive) return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'advanced', type: p.type, reason: 'warfare_events_are_owned_by_WarfareSystem' };
        if (p.type === 'warfare_force_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.force(root, p, ledger);
        if (p.type === 'warfare_casualty_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.forceCasualty(root, p, ledger);
        if (p.type === 'warfare_control_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.forceControl(root, p, ledger);
      }
      if (p.type === 'absorption_candidate' || p.type === 'evolution_candidate') {
        if (WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem && WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.dedicatedOwnerActive) return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'advanced', type: p.type, reason: 'evolution_absorption_events_are_owned_by_EvolutionAbsorptionSystem' };
        if (p.type === 'absorption_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.absorption(root, p, ledger);
        if (p.type === 'evolution_candidate') return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.evolution(root, p, ledger);
      }
      return { status: 'IGNORED', applied: false, family: 'advanced', type: p.type, reason: 'unsupported_boundary_event' };
    },
    price: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, itemName: p.data.itemName, amount: p.data.amount, currency: p.data.currency, phrase: p.textPreview };
      root.advanced.economy.priceQuotes.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(root.advanced.economy.priceQuotes, 40);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'price_quote', key: ledger.key };
    },
    debt: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, creditor: p.data.creditor, amount: p.data.amount, currency: p.data.currency, paid: false };
      root.advanced.economy.debts.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(root.advanced.economy.debts, 40);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'debt', key: ledger.key };
    },
    recipe: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.recipeId || ('recipe_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.recipeName));
      if (!root.advanced.crafting.recipesById[id]) {
        root.advanced.crafting.recipesById[id] = { id: id, name: p.data.recipeName, known: true, history: [] };
        root.advanced.crafting.recipeIds.push(id);
      }
      root.advanced.crafting.recipesById[id].history.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'recipe_known', recipeId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    craftingProject: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.projectId || ('craft_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.projectName || 'unknown_craft'));
      if (!root.advanced.crafting.projectsById[id]) {
        root.advanced.crafting.projectsById[id] = { id: id, name: p.data.projectName || 'Unknown Craft', status: 'in_progress_evidence_only', materials: [], materialLedger: [], completionEvidence: [], outputItemGranted: false };
        root.advanced.crafting.projectIds.push(id);
      }
      var proj = root.advanced.crafting.projectsById[id];
      var mats = p.data.materials || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < mats.length; i++) proj.materials.push({ key: ledger.key, name: mats[i].name, quantity: mats[i].quantity });
      if (p.type === 'crafting_completion_candidate') {
        proj.status = 'completion_evidence_pending_inventory_validation';
        proj.completionEvidence.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview });
      }
      proj.materialLedger.push({ key: ledger.key, materials: mats, type: p.type, phrase: p.textPreview });
      root.advanced.crafting.materialLedgers.push({ key: ledger.key, projectId: id, materials: mats, type: p.type });
      WL.U.capArray(root.advanced.crafting.materialLedgers, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'crafting_boundary_project', projectId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    project: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.projectId || ('project_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.projectName));
      if (!root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id]) {
        root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id] = { id: id, name: p.data.projectName, status: 'started', progressNotes: [] };
        root.advanced.domain.projectIds.push(id);
      }
      root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id].progressNotes.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_project', projectId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    domainProgress: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.projectId || ('project_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.projectName || 'unknown_project'));
      if (!root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id]) {
        root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id] = { id: id, name: p.data.projectName || 'Unknown Project', status: 'in_progress', progressNotes: [], progressPercent: 0, workers: [] };
        root.advanced.domain.projectIds.push(id);
      }
      var proj = root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id];
      if (!proj.progressNotes) proj.progressNotes = [];
      if (!proj.workers) proj.workers = [];
      proj.progressPercent = Math.max(proj.progressPercent || 0, WL.U.clamp(p.data.progressPercent || 0, 0, 100));
      if (proj.progressPercent >= 100) proj.status = 'complete_evidence_pending_validation';
      else proj.status = 'in_progress';
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: id, progressPercent: proj.progressPercent, phrase: p.textPreview };
      proj.progressNotes.push(rec);
      root.advanced.domain.progressLedgers.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(root.advanced.domain.progressLedgers, 60);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_progress', projectId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    domainAssignment: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.projectId || ('project_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.projectName || 'unknown_project'));
      if (!root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id]) {
        root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id] = { id: id, name: p.data.projectName || 'Unknown Project', status: 'assignment_only', progressNotes: [], progressPercent: 0, workers: [] };
        root.advanced.domain.projectIds.push(id);
      }
      var proj = root.advanced.domain.projectsById[id];
      if (!proj.progressNotes) proj.progressNotes = [];
      if (!proj.workers) proj.workers = [];
      var actorName = p.data.actorName || '';
      if (actorName && proj.workers.indexOf(actorName) < 0) proj.workers.push(actorName);
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, projectId: id, actorName: actorName, phrase: p.textPreview };
      root.advanced.domain.assignments.push(rec);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'domain_assignment', projectId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    force: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.forceId || ('force_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.forceName));
      if (!root.advanced.warfare.forcesById[id]) {
        root.advanced.warfare.forcesById[id] = { id: id, name: p.data.forceName, total: p.data.count || 0, remaining: p.data.count || 0, casualties: 0, history: [] };
        root.advanced.warfare.forceIds.push(id);
      }
      root.advanced.warfare.forcesById[id].history.push({ key: ledger.key, action: 'force_count', count: p.data.count, phrase: p.textPreview });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'force_count', forceId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    forceCasualty: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.forceId || ('force_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.forceName));
      var f = root.advanced.warfare.forcesById[id];
      if (!f) {
        f = { id: id, name: p.data.forceName, total: 0, remaining: 0, casualties: 0, history: [] };
        root.advanced.warfare.forcesById[id] = f;
        root.advanced.warfare.forceIds.push(id);
      }
      var n = WL.U.clamp(p.data.casualties || 0, 0, 999999);
      f.casualties += n;
      f.remaining = Math.max(0, (f.remaining || 0) - n);
      root.advanced.warfare.casualties.push({ key: ledger.key, forceId: id, casualties: n, reason: p.data.reason || '', phrase: p.textPreview });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'force_casualty', forceId: id, remaining: f.remaining, key: ledger.key };
    },
    forceControl: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var forceName = p.data.forceName || 'Unknown Force';
      var placeName = p.data.placeName || 'Unknown Place';
      var rec = { key: ledger.key, forceName: forceName, placeName: placeName, truthStatus: 'claim_or_control_evidence', phrase: p.textPreview };
      root.advanced.warfare.controlClaims.push(rec);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'warfare_control_claim', key: ledger.key };
    },
    absorption: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.candidateId || ('absorb_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.sourceName));
      if (!root.advanced.absorption.candidatesById[id]) {
        root.advanced.absorption.candidatesById[id] = { id: id, sourceName: p.data.sourceName, status: 'candidate_evidence_only', bounded: true, progress: 0, thresholdNotes: [], history: [] };
        root.advanced.absorption.candidateIds.push(id);
      }
      var ac = root.advanced.absorption.candidatesById[id];
      ac.progress = Math.min(100, (ac.progress || 0) + (p.data.progress || 1));
      if (p.data.thresholdNote) ac.thresholdNotes.push({ key: ledger.key, note: p.data.thresholdNote });
      ac.history.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview, progress: p.data.progress || 1 });
      WL.U.capArray(ac.history, 20);
      if (root.advanced.absorption.sourceUseKeys.indexOf(id) < 0) root.advanced.absorption.sourceUseKeys.push(id);
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'absorption_candidate', candidateId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    evolution: function (root, p, ledger) {
      var id = p.data.candidateId || ('evolve_' + WL.U.slug(p.data.targetForm));
      if (!root.advanced.evolution.candidatesById[id]) {
        root.advanced.evolution.candidatesById[id] = { id: id, targetForm: p.data.targetForm, status: 'candidate_evidence_only', bounded: true, progress: 0, history: [] };
        root.advanced.evolution.candidateIds.push(id);
      }
      var ec = root.advanced.evolution.candidatesById[id];
      ec.progress = Math.min(100, (ec.progress || 0) + (p.data.progress || 1));
      ec.history.push({ key: ledger.key, phrase: p.textPreview, progress: p.data.progress || 1 });
      WL.U.capArray(ec.history, 20);
      root.advanced.evolution.thresholdNotes.push({ key: ledger.key, candidateId: id, progress: ec.progress, phrase: p.textPreview });
      return { status: 'APPLIED', applied: true, family: 'advanced', type: 'evolution_candidate', candidateId: id, key: ledger.key };
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var lines = [];
      lines.push('Price quotes: ' + root.advanced.economy.priceQuotes.length);
      lines.push('Recipes known: ' + root.advanced.crafting.recipeIds.length);
      lines.push('Domain projects: ' + root.advanced.domain.projectIds.length);
      lines.push('Warfare forces: ' + root.advanced.warfare.forceIds.length);
      lines.push('Crafting material ledgers: ' + root.advanced.crafting.materialLedgers.length);
      lines.push('Domain progress ledgers: ' + root.advanced.domain.progressLedgers.length);
      lines.push('Warfare control claims: ' + root.advanced.warfare.controlClaims.length);
      lines.push('Absorption candidates: ' + root.advanced.absorption.candidateIds.length);
      lines.push('Evolution candidates: ' + root.advanced.evolution.candidateIds.length);
      lines.push('Contracts: ' + ((root.contracts && root.contracts.contractIds || []).length));
      lines.push('Employees: ' + ((root.labor && root.labor.employeeIds || []).length));
      return lines;
    }
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.CombatThreatReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.CombatThreatSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.CombatOutcomeReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };

  WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.AdvancedBoundaryReducer = function (root, validation, ledger) {
    return WL.AdvancedBoundarySystem.apply(root, validation, ledger);
  };

  // Owner note: DirtyQueue marks mirrors for context/card refresh; it is not a gameplay owner.
  WL.DirtyQueue = {
    mark: function (root, reducerResults) {
      var anyApplied = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < reducerResults.length; i++) if (reducerResults[i].applied) anyApplied = true;
      if (anyApplied) {
        root.dirty.targets.push('diagnostics');
        for (var d = 0; d < reducerResults.length; d++) {
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'inventory' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('inventory') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('inventory');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'quest' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('quests') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('quests');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'form' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('body') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('body');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'form' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('profile') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('profile');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'raceTrait' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('profile') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('profile');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'raceTrait' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('body') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('body');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'ability' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('abilities') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('abilities');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'progression' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('progression') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('progression');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'combatReward' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('progression') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('progression');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'combatReward' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('combat') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('combat');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'time' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('time') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('time');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'place' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('places') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('places');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'actor' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('actors') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('actors');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'social' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('actors') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('actors');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'social' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('places') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('places');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'combat' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('combat') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('combat');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'combatOutcome' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('combat') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('combat');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'matchup' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('combat') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('combat');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'loreAuthority' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('context') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('context');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'loreAuthority' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('cards') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('cards');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'crafting' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('advanced') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('advanced');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'advanced' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('advanced') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('advanced');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'contract' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('contracts') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('contracts');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'labor' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('labor') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('labor');
          if (reducerResults[d].family === 'summon' && root.dirty.targets.indexOf('actors') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('actors');
        }
        root.dirty.reasons.push('pipeline_or_owner_update');
        WL.U.capArray(root.dirty.targets, 40);
        WL.U.capArray(root.dirty.reasons, 40);
      }
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // 08. [WL-PIPELINE] OperationLedger and Diagnostics

  // ============================================================
  // Owner note: OperationLedger dedupes side effects by operation keys.
  WL.OperationLedger = {
    makeKey: function (parts) { return WL.U.slug((parts || []).join('|')); },
    has: function (root, key) { return !!(root.operationLedger.keysById[WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([key])]); },
    add: function (root, key, reason) {
      var k = WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([key]);
      if (root.operationLedger.keysById[k]) {
        root.operationLedger.duplicateSkips.push({ key: k, reason: reason || 'duplicate', turn: root.runtime.currentTurn });
        WL.U.capArray(root.operationLedger.duplicateSkips, 80);
        return { applied: false, duplicate: true, key: k };
      }
      root.operationLedger.keysById[k] = { key: k, reason: reason || '', turn: root.runtime.currentTurn };
      root.operationLedger.recentKeys.push(k);
      WL.U.capArray(root.operationLedger.recentKeys, WL.Constants.maxRecentKeys);
      return { applied: true, duplicate: false, key: k };
    }
  };

  // Owner note: Diagnostics stores compact audit/debug records only.
  WL.Diagnostics = {
    row: function (root, subsystem, level, message, extra) {
      var rec = { turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, subsystem: subsystem || 'system', level: level || 'info', message: WL.U.norm(message).slice(0, 240), extra: extra || null };
      root.diagnostics.audit.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(root.diagnostics.audit, WL.Constants.maxAuditRows);
      return rec;
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // 09. [WL-MIRRORS] ContextBudgeter and Card Mirror Systems

  // ============================================================
  // Mirror note: ContextBudgeter builds bounded next-turn truth packets. Context is read-only.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] ContextBudgeter
  WL.ContextBudgeter = {
    modeCaps: Object.freeze({ small: 1100, medium: 2200, high: 3600 }),
    hardMaxChars: function (infoObj) {
      var maxChars = 0;
      try { if (typeof infoObj === 'object' && infoObj && typeof infoObj.maxChars === 'number' && infoObj.maxChars > 0) maxChars = Math.floor(infoObj.maxChars); } catch (e) {}
      try { if (!maxChars && typeof info === 'object' && info && typeof info.maxChars === 'number' && info.maxChars > 0) maxChars = Math.floor(info.maxChars); } catch (e2) {}
      return maxChars;
    },
    maxPacketChars: function (root, infoObj) {
      var mode = (root && root.features && root.features.contextMode) || 'small';
      if (!WL.ContextBudgeter.modeCaps[mode]) mode = 'small';
      var cap = WL.ContextBudgeter.modeCaps[mode];
      var maxChars = WL.ContextBudgeter.hardMaxChars(infoObj);
      if (maxChars > 0) {
        var share = Math.floor(maxChars * 0.35);
        if (maxChars < 700) share = Math.max(40, Math.floor(maxChars * 0.60));
        cap = Math.min(cap, Math.max(40, share), maxChars);
      }
      return cap;
    },
    clip: function (text, max) {
      var t = WL.U.norm(text);
      max = WL.U.clamp(max || 0, 0, 999999);
      if (!max) return '';
      if (t.length <= max) return t;
      if (max <= 3) return t.slice(0, max);
      return t.slice(0, Math.max(0, max - 3)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '...';
    },
    microPacket: function (root, mode, max) {
      var line = '[WL Context ' + (mode || 'small') + '] HP ' + root.body.hp + '/' + root.body.maxHp + '; ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.conditionLine(root) + '; place ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.currentPlaceName(root) + '; read-only.';
      return WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(line, max || 120);
    },
    joinNames: function (arr, map, field, max) {
      arr = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < arr.length && out.length < (max || 6); i++) {
        var obj = map ? map[arr[i]] : arr[i];
        var name = obj && (obj[field || 'name'] || obj.displayName || obj.title) || obj;
        name = WL.U.safeString(name);
        if (name) out.push(name);
      }
      return out.length ? out.join(', ') : '(none)';
    },
    currentPlaceName: function (root) {
      var id = root.places && root.places.currentId;
      var p = id && root.places.placesById && root.places.placesById[id];
      return p && p.name ? WL.U.safeString(p.name) : '(unknown)';
    },
    activeQuestLine: function (root) {
      var ids = root.quests && root.quests.activeIds || [];
      if (!ids.length) return 'Active Quest: (none)';
      var q = root.quests.questsById[ids[ids.length - 1]];
      if (!q) return 'Active Quest: (none)';
      return 'Active Quest: ' + WL.U.safeString(q.title || q.objective) + ' — ' + WL.U.safeString(q.objective || q.status);
    },
    threatLine: function (root) {
      var ids = root.combat && root.combat.groupIds || [];
      if (!ids.length) return 'Threats: (none confirmed)';
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < 4; i++) {
        var g = root.combat.groupCountsById[ids[i]];
        if (g) parts.push(WL.U.safeString(g.name || ids[i]) + ' x' + WL.U.safeString(g.remaining != null ? g.remaining : g.count));
      }
      return 'Threats: ' + (parts.join(', ') || '(none confirmed)');
    },
    itemLine: function (root, max) {
      var ids = root.inventory && root.inventory.ownedIds || [];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < (max || 5); i++) {
        var item = root.inventory.itemsById[ids[i]];
        if (item) parts.push(WL.U.safeString(item.displayName) + (item.quantity > 1 ? ' x' + item.quantity : ''));
      }
      return 'Carried: ' + (parts.join(', ') || '(none)');
    },
    abilityLine: function (root, max) {
      var parts = [];
      var ids = root.skills && root.skills.skillIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && parts.length < (max || 4); i++) if (root.skills.skillsById[ids[i]]) parts.push(root.skills.skillsById[ids[i]].name + ' [skill]');
      ids = root.abilities && root.abilities.abilityIds || [];
      for (var j = 0; j < ids.length && parts.length < (max || 4); j++) if (root.abilities.abilitiesById[ids[j]]) parts.push(root.abilities.abilitiesById[ids[j]].name + ' [ability]');
      return 'Relevant Abilities: ' + (parts.length ? parts.join(', ') : '(none stable)');
    },
    conditionLine: function (root) {
      var parts = [];
      var injuries = root.body && root.body.injuries || [];
      var conds = root.body && root.body.conditions || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < injuries.length && parts.length < 3; i++) parts.push(WL.U.safeString(injuries[i].name) + ' [' + WL.U.safeString(injuries[i].severity || 'injury') + ']');
      for (var j = 0; j < conds.length && parts.length < 5; j++) parts.push(WL.U.safeString(conds[j].name) + ' [' + WL.U.safeString(conds[j].severity || 'condition') + ']');
      return 'Conditions: ' + (parts.join(', ') || '(none)');
    },
    recentLine: function (root) {
      var r = root.pending && root.pending.lastPipeline;
      if (!r) return 'Recent Changes: (none this turn)';
      return 'Recent Changes: ' + WL.U.safeString(r.hook) + ' events=' + r.events + ', proposals=' + r.proposals + ', reducers=' + r.reducers;
    },
    identitySurfaceLine: function (root, mode) {
      var ids = root.inventory && root.inventory.ownedIds || [];
      var stacked = [], uniques = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var item = root.inventory.itemsById[ids[i]];
        if (!item || !item.displayName) continue;
        var label = WL.U.safeString(item.displayName) + ((item.quantity || 1) > 1 ? ' x' + item.quantity : '');
        if (item.stackable) stacked.push(label);
        else uniques.push(label);
      }
      var max = mode === 'high' ? 4 : (mode === 'medium' ? 3 : 2);
      var parts = [];
      if (stacked.length) parts.push('stacked ' + stacked.slice(0, max).join(', '));
      if (uniques.length) parts.push('unique ' + uniques.slice(0, max).join(', '));
      return 'Identity: clean item names; ' + (parts.join('; ') || 'no carried item identity records');
    },
    costSurfaceLine: function (root, mode) {
      var max = mode === 'high' ? 3 : (mode === 'medium' ? 2 : 1);
      var costs = WL.AbilityCostSystem && WL.AbilityCostSystem.summary ? WL.AbilityCostSystem.summary(root).filter(function (line) { return line && line !== '(none)'; }).slice(0, max) : [];
      return 'Ability Costs: ' + (costs.length ? costs.join(' | ') : '(none observed/hardened yet)');
    },
    graphSurfaceLine: function (root, mode) {
      if (!WL.WorldGraphIndex || typeof WL.WorldGraphIndex.rebuild !== 'function') return 'World Graph: (unavailable)';
      var graph = WL.WorldGraphIndex.rebuild(root);
      if (mode === 'small') return 'World Graph: nodes ' + graph.nodeIds.length + ', links ' + graph.edges.length;
      var names = graph.nodeIds.slice(0, mode === 'high' ? 5 : 3).map(function (id) { return graph.nodesById[id] && graph.nodesById[id].title; }).filter(Boolean);
      return 'World Graph: nodes ' + graph.nodeIds.length + ', links ' + graph.edges.length + (names.length ? ' — ' + names.join(', ') : '');
    },
    compactSummaryLine: function (label, summaryLines, fallback, maxParts) {
      summaryLines = Array.isArray(summaryLines) ? summaryLines : [];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < summaryLines.length && parts.length < (maxParts || 2); i++) {
        var line = WL.U.safeString(summaryLines[i]);
        if (!line || /^\(?none\)?$/i.test(line) || /:\s*\(none\)/i.test(line)) continue;
        line = line.replace(/^[-\s]+/, '').replace(/^[A-Za-z\s\/]+:\s*/, '');
        if (line) parts.push(line);
      }
      return label + ': ' + (parts.length ? parts.join(' | ') : (fallback || '(none)'));
    },
    presentLine: function (root, mode) {
      var names = [];
      var ids = root.actors && root.actors.presentIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && names.length < (mode === 'high' ? 8 : 4); i++) {
        var actor = root.actors.actorsById && root.actors.actorsById[ids[i]];
        if (actor && actor.name) names.push(WL.U.safeString(actor.name));
      }
      if (root.social && root.social.presence && root.social.presence.actorIds) {
        var pids = root.social.presence.actorIds;
        for (var j = 0; j < pids.length && names.length < (mode === 'high' ? 8 : 4); j++) {
          var rec = root.social.presence.actorsById && root.social.presence.actorsById[pids[j]];
          var nm = rec && WL.U.safeString(rec.actorName || rec.name || '');
          if (nm && names.indexOf(nm) < 0) names.push(nm);
        }
      }
      var groups = [];
      if (root.social && root.social.presence && root.social.presence.genericGroupIds) {
        var gids = root.social.presence.genericGroupIds;
        for (var g = 0; g < gids.length && groups.length < 3; g++) {
          var gr = root.social.presence.genericGroupsById && root.social.presence.genericGroupsById[gids[g]];
          if (gr && gr.label) groups.push(WL.U.safeString(gr.label) + (gr.count ? ' x' + gr.count : ''));
        }
      }
      return 'Present: ' + (names.length ? names.join(', ') : '(none confirmed)') + (groups.length ? '; groups ' + groups.join(', ') : '');
    },
    socialRiskLine: function (root, mode) {
      if (!root.social || !WL.SocialConsequenceSystem) return 'Social Risk: (none confirmed)';
      var bits = [];
      if (root.features && root.features.reputationLocalStandingEnabled !== false) {
        var reps = WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.reputationSummary(root).filter(function (x) { return x && !/^Reputation:\s*\(none\)/i.test(x); });
        if (reps.length) bits.push('rep ' + reps.slice(0, mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1).join(' | '));
      }
      if (root.features && root.features.factionLawResponseFoundationEnabled !== false) {
        var law = WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.lawSummary(root).filter(function (x) { return x && !/^Law\/Enforcement:\s*\(none\)/i.test(x); });
        if (law.length) bits.push('law ' + law.slice(0, mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1).join(' | '));
      }
      if (mode === 'high' && root.features && root.features.witnessEligibilityLedgerEnabled !== false) {
        var wit = WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.witnessSummary(root).filter(function (x) { return x && !/^Witnesses:\s*\(none\)/i.test(x); });
        if (wit.length) bits.push('witness ' + wit.slice(0, 1).join(' | '));
      }
      return 'Social Risk: ' + (bits.length ? bits.join('; ') : '(none confirmed)');
    },
    obligationLine: function (root, mode) {
      var bits = [];
      var q = WL.ContextBudgeter.activeQuestLine(root);
      if (q && !/\(none\)/.test(q)) bits.push(q.replace(/^Active Quest:\s*/, 'quest '));
      if (root.features && root.features.contractLifecycleFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.ContractSystem) {
        var cs = WL.ContractSystem.summary(root).filter(function (x) { return x && !/^Contracts:\s*0\b/.test(x); });
        if (cs.length) {
          var cdetails = cs.slice(1).length ? cs.slice(1) : cs;
          bits.push('contract ' + cdetails.slice(0, mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1).join(' | ').replace(/^Contracts:\s*/, ''));
        }
      }
      if (root.features && root.features.laborFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.LaborSystem) {
        var ls = WL.LaborSystem.summary(root).filter(function (x) { return x && !/^Labor:\s*0\b/.test(x); });
        if (ls.length) bits.push('labor ' + ls.slice(0, 1).join(' | ').replace(/^Labor:\s*/, ''));
      }
      if (root.features && root.features.domainProjectMvpEnabled !== false && WL.DomainProjectSystem) {
        var ds = WL.DomainProjectSystem.summary(root).filter(function (x) { return x && !/^Domain Projects:\s*0\b/.test(x); });
        if (ds.length) {
          var ddetails = ds.slice(1).length ? ds.slice(1) : ds;
          bits.push('domain ' + ddetails.slice(0, mode === 'small' ? 1 : 2).join(' | ').replace(/^Domain Projects:\s*/, ''));
        }
      }
      if (root.features && root.features.economyTransactionFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.EconomyTransactionSystem) {
        var es = WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.summary(root).filter(function (x) { return x && !/^Economy:\s*0\b/.test(x); });
        if (es.length && mode !== 'small') bits.push('economy ' + es.slice(0, 1).join(' | ').replace(/^Economy:\s*/, ''));
      }
      return 'Obligations: ' + (bits.length ? bits.join('; ') : '(none active)');
    },
    coreMechanicsLine: function (root, mode) {
      var bits = [];
      if (root.features && root.features.progressionFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem) bits.push(WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.summary(root, 1)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.statFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.StatFormulaSystem) bits.push(WL.StatFormulaSystem.summary(root, 1)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.xpBudgetSystemEnabled !== false && WL.XPBudgetSystem && mode !== 'small') bits.push(WL.XPBudgetSystem.summary(root, 1)[0]);
      return 'Mechanics: ' + (bits.filter(Boolean).join(' | ') || '(baseline)');
    },
    pushLine: function (lines, seen, line) {
      line = WL.U.norm(line || '');
      if (!line) return false;
      if (line.length > 240) line = WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(line, 240);
      var key = WL.U.hash(line);
      if (seen[key]) return false;
      seen[key] = true;
      lines.push(line);
      return true;
    },
    renderPacket: function (root, mode) {
      var lines = [];
      var seen = {};
      var time = 'Day ' + root.time.day + ' ' + String(root.time.hour).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(root.time.minute).padStart(2, '0');
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, '[WorldLedger Context — Build 9.12B Truth Packet / ' + mode + ' — priority]');

      // Priority 1: immediate playable truth. These lines must survive first in small packets.
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Resources: HP ' + root.body.hp + '/' + root.body.maxHp + ', MP ' + root.body.mp + '/' + root.body.maxMp + ', EP ' + root.body.ep + '/' + root.body.maxEp + '. ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.conditionLine(root));
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Scene: ' + time + ' | Place: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.currentPlaceName(root));
      if (mode === 'high') WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.presentLine(root, mode));
      if (root.social && WL.SocialConsequenceSystem) {
        var sp = WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.presenceSummary(root);
        WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Presence: ' + sp.slice(0, mode === 'small' ? 2 : 3).join(' | ').replace(/^Named present:\s*/, ''));
      }
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.threatLine(root));
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.socialRiskLine(root, mode));
      if (root.social && WL.SocialConsequenceSystem) {
        if (root.features && root.features.reputationLocalStandingEnabled !== false) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Reputation: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.reputationSummary(root).slice(0, mode === 'small' ? 1 : 2).join(' | ').replace(/^Reputation:\s*/, ''));
        if (root.features && root.features.witnessEligibilityLedgerEnabled !== false) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Witnesses: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.witnessSummary(root).slice(0, mode === 'small' ? 1 : 2).join(' | ').replace(/^Witnesses:\s*/, ''));
        if (root.features && root.features.rumorPropagationEnabled !== false) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Rumors: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.rumorSummary(root).slice(0, mode === 'small' ? 1 : 2).join(' | ').replace(/^Rumors:\s*/, ''));
        if (root.features && root.features.crimeEvidenceClueFoundationEnabled !== false) {
          var cs = WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.crimeSummary(root);
          var cls = WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.clueSummary(root);
          WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Crime/Evidence: ' + cs.slice(0, 1).join(' | ').replace(/^Crime Cases:\s*/, '') + ' / ' + cls.slice(0, 1).join(' | ').replace(/^Clues:\s*/, ''));
        }
        if (root.features && root.features.factionLawResponseFoundationEnabled !== false) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Law Risk: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.lawSummary(root).slice(0, 1).join(' | ').replace(/^Law\/Enforcement:\s*/, ''));
        if (mode !== 'small') WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Knowledge: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.knowledgeSummary(root).slice(0, 2).join(' | ').replace(/^Knowledge:\s*/, ''));
        if (root.features && root.features.socialTreatmentSystemEnabled !== false && WL.SocialTreatmentSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 3 : 1)[0]);
      }
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.economyTransactionFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.EconomyTransactionSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Economy: ' + WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.summary(root).slice(0, mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1).join(' | ').replace(/^Economy:\s*/, ''));
      if (mode === 'high') WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.recentLine(root));
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.obligationLine(root, mode));

      // Priority 2: active companions/control surfaces and directly usable player state.
      if (root.features && root.features.partyFollowerSystemEnabled !== false && WL.PartyFollowerSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.PartyFollowerSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.summonSystemEnabled !== false && WL.SummonSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.SummonSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.controlledEntitySystemEnabled !== false && WL.ControlledEntitySystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ControlledEntitySystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.itemLine(root, mode === 'high' ? 10 : (mode === 'medium' ? 6 : 3)));
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.abilityLine(root, mode === 'high' ? 8 : 4));
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.identitySurfaceLine(root, mode));
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.costSurfaceLine(root, mode));

      // Priority 3: formulas, body fit, and combat detail. Small keeps only the highest-signal summaries.
      if (root.features && root.features.bodyFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.BodyFormulaSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.BodyFormulaSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.coreMechanicsLine(root, mode));
      if (root.features && root.features.abilityGrowthSystemEnabled !== false && WL.AbilityGrowthSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.detailLines(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.combatOutcomeSystemEnabled !== false && WL.CombatOutcomeSystem && root.combatOutcome && root.combatOutcome.outcomeIds && root.combatOutcome.outcomeIds.length) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.matchupSystemEnabled !== false && WL.MatchupSystem && root.matchup && root.matchup.recordIds && root.matchup.recordIds.length) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.MatchupSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.threatTierSystemEnabled !== false && WL.ThreatTierSystem && root.threatTiers && root.threatTiers.tierIds && root.threatTiers.tierIds.length) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ThreatTierSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.combatRewardResolverEnabled !== false && WL.CombatRewardResolver && root.combatRewards && root.combatRewards.estimateIds && root.combatRewards.estimateIds.length) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.CombatRewardResolver.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);

      // Priority 4: broader domain/economy/crafting/war/lore/world-web surfaces. These never outrank immediate risk.
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.domainAssetFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.DomainAssetSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.compactSummaryLine('Domain Assets', WL.DomainAssetSystem.summary(root).slice(0, mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1), '(none)', mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1));
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.craftingSystemEnabled !== false && WL.CraftingSystem && root.advanced && root.advanced.crafting && ((root.advanced.crafting.recipeIds || []).length || (root.advanced.crafting.projectIds || []).length || (root.advanced.crafting.materialLedgers || []).length)) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.compactSummaryLine('Crafting', WL.CraftingSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2), '(none)', mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1));
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.warfareSystemEnabled !== false && WL.WarfareSystem && root.advanced && root.advanced.warfare && ((root.advanced.warfare.forceIds || []).length || (root.advanced.warfare.controlClaims || []).length || (root.advanced.warfare.casualties || []).length)) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.compactSummaryLine('Warfare', WL.WarfareSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2), '(none)', mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1));
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.evolutionAbsorptionSystemEnabled !== false && WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem && root.advanced && ((root.advanced.absorption && (root.advanced.absorption.candidateIds || []).length) || (root.advanced.evolution && (root.advanced.evolution.candidateIds || []).length))) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.compactSummaryLine('Absorption/Evolution', WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2), '(none)', mode === 'high' ? 2 : 1));
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.raceTraitSystemEnabled !== false && WL.RaceTraitSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.RaceTraitSystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (mode !== 'small' && root.features && root.features.loreAuthoritySystemEnabled !== false && WL.LoreAuthoritySystem && root.loreAuthority && root.loreAuthority.revealedIds && root.loreAuthority.revealedIds.length) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.summary(root, mode === 'high' ? 4 : 2)[0]);
      if (mode !== 'small') WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.graphSurfaceLine(root, mode));
      if (mode !== 'small') WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Player: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.name) + ' | True Race: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.trueRace || root.player.raceSpecies) + ' | Current Form: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.currentForm));
      if (mode === 'high') {
        WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Places Known: ' + Object.keys(root.places.placesById || {}).length + ' | Contradictions: ' + (root.places.contradictions || []).length + ' | Routes: ' + (root.time.routeIds || []).length);
        WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.ContextBudgeter.recentLine(root));
        if (root.features && root.features.xpBudgetSystemEnabled !== false && WL.XPBudgetSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.XPBudgetSystem.summary(root, 4)[0]);
        if (root.features && root.features.statFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.StatFormulaSystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.StatFormulaSystem.summary(root, 4)[0]);
        if (root.features && root.features.loreAuthoritySystemEnabled !== false && WL.LoreAuthoritySystem) WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.summary(root, 4)[0]);
      }
      WL.ContextBudgeter.pushLine(lines, seen, 'Canon: read-only; commands/cards/context do not grant mechanics; candidate records stay uncertain until confirmed.');
      return lines.join('\n');
    },
    build: function (root, baseText, infoObj) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.contextBudgeterEnabled === false) {
        var disabledBase = String(baseText == null ? '' : baseText);
        var disabledMax = WL.ContextBudgeter.hardMaxChars(infoObj || (typeof info === 'object' ? info : null));
        return disabledMax ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(disabledBase, disabledMax) : disabledBase;
      }
      var mode = root.features.contextMode || 'small';
      if (!WL.ContextBudgeter.modeCaps[mode]) mode = 'small';
      var infoRef = infoObj || (typeof info === 'object' ? info : null);
      var maxChars = WL.ContextBudgeter.hardMaxChars(infoRef);
      var cap = WL.ContextBudgeter.maxPacketChars(root, infoRef);
      var rendered = WL.ContextBudgeter.renderPacket(root, mode);
      var packet = WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(rendered, cap);
      var base = String(baseText == null ? '' : baseText);
      if (maxChars > 0 && maxChars <= 80) return WL.ContextBudgeter.microPacket(root, mode, maxChars);
      if (!base) {
        var soloLimit = maxChars ? Math.min(WL.ContextBudgeter.modeCaps[mode] || cap, maxChars) : cap;
        packet = WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(rendered, soloLimit);
        if (maxChars && packet.length > maxChars) return WL.ContextBudgeter.microPacket(root, mode, maxChars);
        return packet;
      }
      var joined = base + '\n\n' + packet;
      if (!maxChars || joined.length <= maxChars) return joined;
      var sep = '\n\n';
      var packetBudget = Math.min(cap, Math.max(170, Math.floor(maxChars * 0.45)));
      if (maxChars < 700) packetBudget = Math.max(170, Math.floor(maxChars * 0.55));
      packet = WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(rendered, packetBudget);
      if (packet.length + sep.length >= maxChars) return WL.ContextBudgeter.microPacket(root, mode, maxChars);
      var keepBase = Math.max(0, maxChars - packet.length - sep.length);
      var finalText = WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(base, keepBase) + sep + packet;
      return finalText.length > maxChars ? WL.ContextBudgeter.clip(finalText, maxChars) : finalText;
    }
  };

  // Mirror note: ContextSystem exposes ContextBudgeter without mutating canon.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] ContextSystem
  WL.ContextSystem = {
    build: function (root, baseText) {
      if (root && root.features && root.features.loreAuthoritySystemEnabled !== false && WL.LoreAuthoritySystem) WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.syncStoryCards(root);
      return WL.ContextBudgeter.build(root, baseText, (typeof info === 'object' ? info : null));
    }
  };


  // Mirror note: WorldGraphIndex provides compact relationship links for context/cards.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] WorldGraphIndex
  WL.WorldGraphIndex = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.worldGraph || typeof root.worldGraph !== 'object') root.worldGraph = { nodesById: {}, nodeIds: [], edges: [], lastRebuildTurn: 0, warnings: [] };
      if (!root.worldGraph.nodesById || typeof root.worldGraph.nodesById !== 'object') root.worldGraph.nodesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.worldGraph.nodeIds)) root.worldGraph.nodeIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.worldGraph.edges)) root.worldGraph.edges = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.worldGraph.warnings)) root.worldGraph.warnings = [];
      return root.worldGraph;
    },
    node: function (root, kind, id, title, data) {
      var graph = WL.WorldGraphIndex.ensure(root);
      if (!id || !title || (WL.GeneratedCardPolicy && WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.isTrashTitle && WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.isTrashTitle(title))) return null;
      var key = kind + ':' + id;
      var node = graph.nodesById[key] || { id: key, refId: id, kind: kind, title: WL.U.safeString(title), weight: 0, tags: [], links: [] };
      node.title = WL.U.safeString(title);
      node.kind = kind;
      node.refId = id;
      node.weight = Math.max(node.weight || 0, data && data.weight || 1);
      node.tags = WL.U.unique((node.tags || []).concat(data && data.tags || []));
      node.summary = WL.U.safeString(data && data.summary || node.summary || '');
      graph.nodesById[key] = node;
      if (graph.nodeIds.indexOf(key) < 0) graph.nodeIds.push(key);
      return node;
    },
    edge: function (root, fromKey, toKey, relation, weight) {
      if (!fromKey || !toKey || fromKey === toKey) return null;
      var graph = WL.WorldGraphIndex.ensure(root);
      var id = WL.U.hash(fromKey + '|' + toKey + '|' + relation);
      for (var i = 0; i < graph.edges.length; i++) if (graph.edges[i].id === id) return graph.edges[i];
      var edge = { id: id, from: fromKey, to: toKey, relation: relation || 'related', weight: weight || 1 };
      graph.edges.push(edge);
      WL.U.capArray(graph.edges, 240);
      return edge;
    },
    touchItem: function (root, item, relation) {
      if (!item || !item.id || !item.displayName) return null;
      return WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'item', item.id, item.displayName, { weight: item.cardEligible === false ? 1 : 2, tags: item.tags || [], summary: 'Inventory item: ' + (item.category || 'misc') });
    },
    rebuild: function (root) {
      var graph = WL.WorldGraphIndex.ensure(root);
      graph.nodesById = {}; graph.nodeIds = []; graph.edges = [];
      var playerName = root.player && root.player.name && root.player.name !== 'Unknown' ? root.player.name : 'Player';
      var player = WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'player', 'player', playerName, { weight: 5, tags: ['player'] });
      var actorKeys = Object.keys(root.actors.actorsById || {});
      for (var a = 0; a < actorKeys.length; a++) {
        var actor = root.actors.actorsById[actorKeys[a]];
        if (actor && actor.name) {
          var an = WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'actor', actor.id || actorKeys[a], actor.name, { weight: 4, tags: ['actor'], summary: actor.summary || actor.status || '' });
          if (player && an) WL.WorldGraphIndex.edge(root, player.id, an.id, 'knows_or_observed', 2);
        }
      }
      var placeKeys = Object.keys(root.places.placesById || {});
      for (var p = 0; p < placeKeys.length; p++) {
        var place = root.places.placesById[placeKeys[p]];
        if (place && place.name) WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'place', place.id || placeKeys[p], place.name, { weight: 4, tags: ['place', place.type || 'place'], summary: place.type || 'confirmed place' });
      }
      var itemIds = root.inventory.ownedIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < itemIds.length; i++) {
        var item = root.inventory.itemsById[itemIds[i]];
        if (item && item.displayName) {
          var inode = WL.WorldGraphIndex.touchItem(root, item, 'owned_by_player');
          if (player && inode) WL.WorldGraphIndex.edge(root, player.id, inode.id, 'owns', item.stackable ? 1 : 3);
        }
      }
      var questIds = [].concat(root.quests.activeIds || [], root.quests.offeredIds || [], root.quests.completedIds || []);
      for (var q = 0; q < questIds.length; q++) {
        var quest = root.quests.questsById[questIds[q]];
        if (quest && quest.title) WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'quest', quest.id || questIds[q], quest.title, { weight: quest.status === 'active' ? 5 : 3, tags: ['quest', quest.status || 'unknown'], summary: quest.objective || '' });
      }
      var contractIds = root.contracts && root.contracts.contractIds || [];
      for (var ct = 0; ct < contractIds.length; ct++) {
        var con = root.contracts.contractsById[contractIds[ct]];
        if (con && con.partyB) {
          var cn = WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'contract', con.id || contractIds[ct], con.partyB + ' Contract', { weight: con.status === 'active' ? 4 : 2, tags: ['contract', con.status || 'unknown'], summary: con.work || '' });
          var actorKey = 'actor:' + (con.partyBId || ('actor_' + WL.U.slug(con.partyB)));
          if (cn) WL.WorldGraphIndex.edge(root, actorKey, cn.id, 'party_to_contract', 2);
        }
      }
      var empIds = root.labor && root.labor.employeeIds || [];
      for (var le = 0; le < empIds.length; le++) {
        var emp = root.labor.employeesById[empIds[le]];
        if (emp && emp.actorName) WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'employee', emp.id || empIds[le], emp.actorName + ' — ' + (emp.role || 'Worker'), { weight: emp.status === 'employed' ? 3 : 1, tags: ['labor', emp.status || 'unknown'], summary: emp.assignment || '' });
      }
      var abilityIds = [].concat(root.abilities.abilityIds || [], root.skills.skillIds || [], root.talents.talentIds || [], root.passives.passiveIds || []);
      for (var ab = 0; ab < abilityIds.length; ab++) {
        var rec = root.abilities.abilitiesById[abilityIds[ab]] || root.skills.skillsById[abilityIds[ab]] || root.talents.talentsById[abilityIds[ab]] || root.passives.passivesById[abilityIds[ab]];
        if (rec && rec.name) WL.WorldGraphIndex.node(root, 'ability', rec.id || abilityIds[ab], rec.name, { weight: rec.stable || rec.status === 'stable' ? 4 : 2, tags: ['ability', rec.status || 'candidate'], summary: 'Ability/skill/passive record' });
      }
      graph.lastRebuildTurn = root.runtime.currentTurn || 0;
      return graph;
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var graph = WL.WorldGraphIndex.rebuild(root);
      return ['Nodes: ' + graph.nodeIds.length, 'Edges: ' + graph.edges.length].concat(graph.nodeIds.slice(0, 12).map(function (id) { var n = graph.nodesById[id]; return '- ' + n.kind + ': ' + n.title; }));
    }
  };

  // Mirror note: CardCandidateRegistry scores durable card candidates and rejects broad junk identities.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] CardCandidateRegistry
  WL.CardCandidateRegistry = {
    ensure: function (root) {
      if (!root.cards.candidatesById || typeof root.cards.candidatesById !== 'object') root.cards.candidatesById = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.cards.candidateIds)) root.cards.candidateIds = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(root.cards.candidateLog)) root.cards.candidateLog = [];
    },
    rejectReason: function (kind, title, rec) {
      var clean = WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.cleanTitle(title || '');
      if (!clean || WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.isTrashTitle(clean)) return 'trash_title';
      if (WL.CardRegistry.isBroadTrigger(clean)) return 'broad_trigger';
      if (/\b(?:thing|object|person|someone|something|unknown|none|empty)\b/i.test(clean)) return 'abstract_or_generic_title';
      if (kind === 'item') {
        if (!rec || rec.cardEligible === false) return 'item_not_card_eligible';
        if (rec.stackable && /^(?:material|ammunition|consumable)$/.test(rec.category || '')) return 'ordinary_stack_not_carded';
      }
      return '';
    },
    score: function (kind, rec) {
      var s = 1;
      if (kind === 'actor' || kind === 'place' || kind === 'quest') s += 4;
      if (kind === 'ability') s += 3;
      if (kind === 'item') s += rec && rec.stackable ? 1 : 3;
      if (rec && rec.status === 'active') s += 2;
      if (rec && rec.tags && rec.tags.length) s += rec.tags.length;
      if (rec && (rec.summary || rec.objective || rec.sourceHistory && rec.sourceHistory.length > 1)) s += 1;
      return s;
    },
    addCandidate: function (root, out, kind, id, title, summary, rec) {
      WL.CardCandidateRegistry.ensure(root);
      title = WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.cleanTitle(title || '');
      var reason = WL.CardCandidateRegistry.rejectReason(kind, title, rec);
      if (reason) {
        root.cards.candidateLog.push({ turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, kind: kind, title: title || '(blank)', status: 'rejected', reason: reason });
        WL.U.capArray(root.cards.candidateLog, 80);
        return;
      }
      var cid = id || ('gen_' + kind + '_' + WL.U.slug(title));
      var score = WL.CardCandidateRegistry.score(kind, rec || {});
      var cand = { kind: kind, id: cid, title: title, summary: WL.U.safeString(summary || ''), score: score, source: 'confirmed_reducer_state', graphNodeId: kind + ':' + (rec && rec.id || id || WL.U.slug(title)) };
      root.cards.candidatesById[cid] = cand;
      if (root.cards.candidateIds.indexOf(cid) < 0) root.cards.candidateIds.push(cid);
      out.push(cand);
    },
    collect: function (root, max) {
      WL.CardCandidateRegistry.ensure(root);
      if (WL.WorldGraphIndex && typeof WL.WorldGraphIndex.rebuild === 'function') WL.WorldGraphIndex.rebuild(root);
      var out = [];
      var actorIds = WL.U.unique((root.actors.presentIds || []).concat(root.actors.referencedIds || [], Object.keys(root.actors.actorsById || {})));
      for (var a = 0; a < actorIds.length; a++) { var actor = root.actors.actorsById[actorIds[a]]; if (actor && actor.name) WL.CardCandidateRegistry.addCandidate(root, out, 'actor', 'gen_actor_' + WL.U.slug(actor.name), actor.name, actor.summary || actor.status || 'Named actor remembered by WorldLedger.', actor); }
      var placeKeys = Object.keys(root.places.placesById || {});
      for (var p = 0; p < placeKeys.length; p++) { var place = root.places.placesById[placeKeys[p]]; if (place && place.name) WL.CardCandidateRegistry.addCandidate(root, out, 'place', 'gen_place_' + WL.U.slug(place.name), place.name, (place.type || 'place') + '; confirmed world structure mirror.', place); }
      var abilityIds = (root.abilities.abilityIds || []).concat(root.skills.skillIds || [], root.talents.talentIds || [], root.passives.passiveIds || []);
      for (var i = 0; i < abilityIds.length; i++) { var rec = root.abilities.abilitiesById[abilityIds[i]] || root.skills.skillsById[abilityIds[i]] || root.talents.talentsById[abilityIds[i]] || root.passives.passivesById[abilityIds[i]]; if (rec && rec.name) WL.CardCandidateRegistry.addCandidate(root, out, 'ability', 'gen_ability_' + WL.U.slug(rec.name), rec.name, 'Ability/skill/passive mirror; mechanics remain reducer-owned.', rec); }
      var itemIds = root.inventory.ownedIds || [];
      for (var it = 0; it < itemIds.length; it++) { var item = root.inventory.itemsById[itemIds[it]]; if (item && item.displayName) WL.CardCandidateRegistry.addCandidate(root, out, 'item', 'gen_item_' + WL.U.slug(item.displayName), item.displayName, 'Confirmed possessed item mirror; no card-prose grants.', item); }
      var questIds = (root.quests.activeIds || []).concat(root.quests.offeredIds || []);
      for (var q = 0; q < questIds.length; q++) { var quest = root.quests.questsById[questIds[q]]; if (quest && quest.title) WL.CardCandidateRegistry.addCandidate(root, out, 'quest', 'gen_quest_' + WL.U.slug(quest.title), quest.title, WL.U.safeString(quest.objective || quest.status || 'Quest mirror.'), quest); }
      out.sort(function (a, b) { return (b.score || 0) - (a.score || 0) || WL.U.lower(a.title).localeCompare(WL.U.lower(b.title)); });
      return out.slice(0, max || 8);
    },
    summary: function (root) {
      var cands = WL.CardCandidateRegistry.collect(root, 20);
      return ['Candidates: ' + cands.length].concat(cands.map(function (c) { return '- [' + c.kind + '/' + c.score + '] ' + c.title; }));
    }
  };

  // Mirror note: CardRegistry defines protected/generated card identity surfaces.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] CardRegistry
  WL.CardRegistry = {
    markerPrefix: 'WL-PROTECTED:',
    metaPrefix: '<!-- WL:',
    protectedDefs: Object.freeze([
      { id: 'player_sheet', title: 'Player Sheet', keys: 'WL — Player Sheet' },
      { id: 'body_status', title: 'Body & Status', keys: 'WL — Body & Status' },
      { id: 'inventory_equipment', title: 'Inventory & Equipment', keys: 'WL — Inventory & Equipment' },
      { id: 'abilities', title: 'Abilities', keys: 'WL — Abilities' },
      { id: 'skills', title: 'Skills', keys: 'WL — Skills' },
      { id: 'passives', title: 'Passives', keys: 'WL — Passives' },
      { id: 'quest_log', title: 'Quest Log', keys: 'WL — Quest Log' },
      { id: 'people_factions', title: 'People & Factions', keys: 'WL — People & Factions' },
      { id: 'places_time', title: 'Places & Time', keys: 'WL — Places & Time' },
      { id: 'settings', title: 'WorldLedger Settings', keys: 'WL — WorldLedger Settings' },
      { id: 'command_audit', title: 'Command Log & Audit', keys: 'WL — Command Log & Audit' }
    ]),
    defById: function (id) {
      for (var i = 0; i < WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefs.length; i++) if (WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefs[i].id === id) return WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefs[i];
      return null;
    },
    marker: function (id) { return 'WL-PROTECTED:' + id; },
    generatedMarker: function (id) { return 'WL-GENERATED:' + id; },
    cleanVisibleKey: function (title) { return WL.U.title(title || '').replace(/\b(?:WorldLedger\s+Generated|WL[- ](?:PROTECTED|GENERATED)|schema|owner)\b/ig, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); },
    generatedKeys: function (title, id) { return WL.CardRegistry.cleanVisibleKey(title) || 'WorldLedger Memory'; },
    isBroadTrigger: function (value) {
      var v = WL.U.lower(value).replace(/^(?:the|a|an)\s+/, '');
      return /^(?:inn|street|door|counter|town|city|magic|item|quest|road|room|guard|guards|shop|market|person|people|none|unknown|empty|are_empty|are empty|no items|known places|command|audit|pass|fail|status)$/.test(v);
    }
  };

  // Mirror note: CardRenderer formats truth safely; it does not create gameplay truth from prose.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] CardRenderer
  WL.CardRenderer = {
