    lines: function (title) { return ['# ' + WL.U.safeString(title), '']; },
    cleanUserNotes: function (oldEntry) {
      var text = String(oldEntry || '');
      var marker = '## User Notes';
      var idx = text.indexOf(marker);
      if (idx < 0) return '';
      var notes = text.slice(idx + marker.length);
      notes = notes.replace(/\[WL-META[^\]]*\]/g, '');
      notes = notes.replace(/<!--\s*WL:[\s\S]*?-->/g, '');
      notes = notes.replace(/\(Add personal notes below this heading\. WorldLedger preserves this section once, but never treats it as mechanics\.\)/g, '');
      notes = notes.replace(/\s+$/g, '').replace(/^\s+/g, '');
      return notes ? notes.slice(0, 2000) : '';
    },
    appendMeta: function (lines, id, userNotes) {
      var marker = /^gen_/i.test(id || '') ? WL.CardRegistry.generatedMarker(id) : WL.CardRegistry.marker(id);
      lines.push('');
      lines.push('## User Notes');
      lines.push(userNotes ? WL.U.safeString(userNotes) : '(Add personal notes below this heading. WorldLedger preserves this section once, but never treats it as mechanics.)');
      lines.push('');
      lines.push('<!-- WL: ' + marker + ' id=' + id + ' schema=' + WL.SCHEMA_VERSION + ' build=' + WL.BUILD_VERSION + ' owner=CardRenderer -->');
      return lines;
    },
    renderProtected: function (root, id, oldEntry) {
      var def = WL.CardRegistry.defById(id) || { id: id, title: WL.U.title(id), keys: 'WorldLedger, ' + id };
      var lines = WL.CardRenderer.lines(def.title);
      if (id === 'player_sheet') WL.CardRenderer.renderPlayer(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'body_status') WL.CardRenderer.renderBody(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'inventory_equipment') WL.CardRenderer.renderInventory(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'abilities') WL.CardRenderer.renderAbilities(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'skills') WL.CardRenderer.renderSkills(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'passives') WL.CardRenderer.renderPassives(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'quest_log') WL.CardRenderer.renderQuests(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'people_factions') WL.CardRenderer.renderPeople(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'places_time') WL.CardRenderer.renderPlacesTime(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'settings') WL.CardRenderer.renderSettings(root, lines);
      else if (id === 'command_audit') WL.CardRenderer.renderAudit(root, lines);
      else lines.push('No renderer installed for this protected card.');
      WL.CardRenderer.appendMeta(lines, id, WL.CardRenderer.cleanUserNotes(oldEntry));
      return lines.join('\n').replace(/\[object Object\]/g, '[object]');
    },
    renderGenerated: function (root, rec, oldEntry) {
      rec = rec || {};
      var title = WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.cleanTitle(rec.title || rec.name || 'WorldLedger Memory');
      var lines = WL.CardRenderer.lines(title);
      lines.push('Kind: ' + WL.U.safeString(rec.kind || 'memory'));
      lines.push('Summary: ' + WL.U.safeString(rec.summary || 'Durable WorldLedger mirror.'));
      if (rec.score != null) lines.push('Importance: ' + WL.U.safeString(rec.score));
      if (rec.graphNodeId) lines.push('World Link: ' + WL.U.safeString(rec.graphNodeId));
      if (rec.kind === 'actor') lines.push('Actor memory is evidence-tracked; extras remain scene-only.');
      if (rec.kind === 'place') lines.push('Place memory mirrors confirmed structure and contradictions.');
      if (rec.kind === 'ability') lines.push('Ability memory mirrors candidate/stable records; card prose does not grant mechanics.');
      if (rec.kind === 'item') lines.push('Item memory mirrors confirmed possession/history; card prose does not grant items.');
      if (rec.kind === 'quest') lines.push('Quest memory mirrors lifecycle/rewards; card prose does not pay rewards.');
      WL.CardRenderer.appendMeta(lines, rec.id || ('generated_' + WL.U.slug(title)), WL.CardRenderer.cleanUserNotes(oldEntry));
      return lines.join('\n').replace(/\[object Object\]/g, '[object]');
    },
    renderPlayer: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Name: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.name));
      lines.push('Pronouns: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.pronouns || 'unknown'));
      lines.push('Race / True Race / Current Form: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.raceSpecies) + ' / ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.trueRace) + ' / ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.currentForm));
      lines.push('Appearance: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.player.appearance));
      lines.push('Class / Profession / Origin: ' + WL.U.safeString([root.player.classLabel, root.player.profession, root.player.origin].filter(Boolean).join(' / ') || 'undeclared'));
      lines.push('Progression: ' + WL.ProgressionSystem.summary(root)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.progressionFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem) lines.push(WL.ProgressionFormulaSystem.summary(root, 2)[1]);
      if (root.features && root.features.xpBudgetSystemEnabled !== false && WL.XPBudgetSystem) lines.push(WL.XPBudgetSystem.summary(root, 3)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.statFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.StatFormulaSystem) lines.push(WL.StatFormulaSystem.summary(root, 3)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.raceTraitSystemEnabled !== false && WL.RaceTraitSystem) lines.push(WL.RaceTraitSystem.summary(root, 3)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.evolutionAbsorptionSystemEnabled !== false && WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem) lines.push(WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.summary(root, 3)[0]);
    },
    renderBody: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('HP/MP/EP: ' + root.body.hp + '/' + root.body.maxHp + ' | ' + root.body.mp + '/' + root.body.maxMp + ' | ' + root.body.ep + '/' + root.body.maxEp);
      lines.push('Disguise: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.body.activeDisguise || '(none)'));
      lines.push('Illusion: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.body.activeIllusion || '(none)'));
      lines.push('Temporary Form: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.body.temporaryForm || '(none)'));
      lines.push('Body Traits: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.body.bodyTraits, null, 'name', 12));
      if (root.features && root.features.raceTraitSystemEnabled !== false && WL.RaceTraitSystem) lines.push(WL.RaceTraitSystem.summary(root, 6)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.bodyFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.BodyFormulaSystem) lines.push(WL.BodyFormulaSystem.summary(root, 6)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.statFormulaSystemEnabled !== false && WL.StatFormulaSystem) lines.push(WL.StatFormulaSystem.summary(root, 3)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.combatOutcomeSystemEnabled !== false && WL.CombatOutcomeSystem) lines.push(WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.summary(root, 4)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.matchupSystemEnabled !== false && WL.MatchupSystem) lines.push(WL.MatchupSystem.summary(root, 4)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.evolutionAbsorptionSystemEnabled !== false && WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem) lines.push(WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.summary(root, 4)[0]);
      lines.push('Injuries: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.body.injuries, null, 'name', 12));
      lines.push('Conditions: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.body.conditions, null, 'name', 12));
    },
    renderInventory: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Currency: ' + (root.inventory.currency.gold || 0) + ' gold, ' + (root.inventory.currency.silver || 0) + ' silver, ' + (root.inventory.currency.copper || 0) + ' copper');
      lines.push('Stack Policy: stack ordinary identical consumables/materials/ammunition; keep weapons, armor, named, magical, quest, damaged, equipped, or history-bearing items separate.');
      lines.push('Owned Items:');
      var ids = root.inventory.ownedIds || [];
      if (!ids.length) lines.push('- (none)');
      var itemLimit = 80;
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && i < itemLimit; i++) { var it = root.inventory.itemsById[ids[i]]; if (it) lines.push('- ' + WL.U.safeString(it.displayName) + ((it.quantity || 1) > 1 ? ' x' + (it.quantity || 1) : '') + ' [' + WL.U.safeString(it.condition || 'unknown') + '; ' + (it.stackable ? 'stacked' : 'unique') + '; ' + WL.U.safeString(it.category || 'misc') + ']'); }
      if (ids.length > itemLimit) lines.push('- ... ' + (ids.length - itemLimit) + ' more owned item records kept in state.');
    },
    renderAbilities: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Stable Abilities: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.abilities.abilityIds, root.abilities.abilitiesById, 'name', 20));
      lines.push('Inbox/Candidates: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.abilities.inboxIds, root.abilities.inboxById, 'name', 20));
      lines.push('Denied Transfers: ' + (root.abilities.denied || []).length);
      var costLines = WL.AbilityCostSystem.summary(root).slice(0, 8);
      lines.push('Development Matrix: inbox -> unstable -> practiced -> stable -> hardened; costs harden from story evidence and repeated use.');
      lines.push('Costs: ' + (costLines.length && costLines[0] !== '(none)' ? costLines.join(' | ') : '(none)'));
      if (root.features && root.features.abilityGrowthSystemEnabled !== false && WL.AbilityGrowthSystem) lines.push(WL.AbilityGrowthSystem.detailLines(root, 6).join(' | '));
    },
    renderSkills: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Skills: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.skills.skillIds, root.skills.skillsById, 'name', 30));
      lines.push('Unstable Skills: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.skills.unstableIds, root.skills.unstableById, 'name', 30));
    },
    renderPassives: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Passives: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.passives.passiveIds, root.passives.passivesById, 'name', 30));
      lines.push('Weak Candidates: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.joinNames(root.passives.weakCandidateIds, root.passives.weakCandidateById, 'name', 30));
    },
    renderQuests: function (root, lines) {
      var ids = [].concat(root.quests.activeIds || [], root.quests.offeredIds || [], root.quests.completedIds || []);
      if (!ids.length) lines.push('(none)');
      var seen = {};
      var questLimit = 50;
      var shown = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && shown < questLimit; i++) { var q = root.quests.questsById[ids[i]]; if (q && !seen[q.id]) { seen[q.id] = true; shown++; lines.push('- [' + WL.U.safeString(q.status) + '] ' + WL.U.safeString(q.title) + ': ' + WL.U.safeString(q.objective)); } }
      if (ids.length > shown) lines.push('- ... ' + (ids.length - shown) + ' more quest records kept in state.');
    },
    renderPeople: function (root, lines) {
      var ids = root.actors.referencedIds.concat(root.actors.presentIds || []);
      if (!ids.length) lines.push('(none)');
      var seen = {};
      var shown = 0;
      var actorLimit = 80;
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length && shown < actorLimit; i++) { var a = root.actors.actorsById[ids[i]]; if (a && !seen[a.id]) { seen[a.id] = true; shown++; lines.push('- ' + WL.U.safeString(a.name) + ': ' + WL.U.safeString(a.summary || a.status || 'known actor')); } }
      var actorCount = Object.keys(root.actors.actorsById || {}).length;
      if (actorCount > shown) lines.push('- ... ' + (actorCount - shown) + ' more actor records kept in state.');
      lines.push('Scene Extras: ' + ((root.actors.sceneExtras || []).length || 0));
      if (root.features && root.features.partyFollowerSystemEnabled !== false && WL.PartyFollowerSystem) lines.push(WL.PartyFollowerSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.summonSystemEnabled !== false && WL.SummonSystem) lines.push(WL.SummonSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.controlledEntitySystemEnabled !== false && WL.ControlledEntitySystem) lines.push(WL.ControlledEntitySystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.combatOutcomeSystemEnabled !== false && WL.CombatOutcomeSystem) lines.push(WL.CombatOutcomeSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.matchupSystemEnabled !== false && WL.MatchupSystem) lines.push(WL.MatchupSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.combatRewardResolverEnabled !== false && WL.CombatRewardResolver) lines.push(WL.CombatRewardResolver.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.warfareSystemEnabled !== false && WL.WarfareSystem) lines.push(WL.WarfareSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.evolutionAbsorptionSystemEnabled !== false && WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem) lines.push(WL.EvolutionAbsorptionSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.features && root.features.loreAuthoritySystemEnabled !== false && WL.LoreAuthoritySystem) lines.push(WL.LoreAuthoritySystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      if (root.social && root.features && root.features.presenceKnowledgeFoundationEnabled !== false) {
        lines.push('Presence: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.presenceSummary(root).join(' | '));
        lines.push('Knowledge Facts: ' + ((root.social.knowledge && root.social.knowledge.factIds || []).length));
        if (root.features.witnessEligibilityLedgerEnabled !== false) lines.push('Witness Ledger: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.witnessSummary(root).join(' | '));
        if (root.features.reputationLocalStandingEnabled !== false) lines.push('Local Standing: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.reputationSummary(root).join(' | '));
        if (root.features.rumorPropagationEnabled !== false) lines.push('Rumors: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.rumorSummary(root).join(' | '));
        if (root.features.crimeEvidenceClueFoundationEnabled !== false) { lines.push('Crime Cases: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.crimeSummary(root).join(' | ')); lines.push('Clues: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.clueSummary(root).join(' | ')); }
        if (root.features.factionLawResponseFoundationEnabled !== false) lines.push('Law/Enforcement: ' + WL.SocialConsequenceSystem.lawSummary(root).join(' | '));
        if (root.features.socialTreatmentSystemEnabled !== false && WL.SocialTreatmentSystem) lines.push(WL.SocialTreatmentSystem.summary(root, 8)[0]);
      }
      if (root.features && root.features.contractLifecycleFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.ContractSystem) {
        lines.push('Contracts: ' + WL.ContractSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
        lines.push('Labor: ' + WL.LaborSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
      }
      if (root.features && root.features.domainProjectMvpEnabled !== false && WL.DomainProjectSystem) lines.push('Domain Projects: ' + WL.DomainProjectSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
      if (root.features && root.features.domainAssetFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.DomainAssetSystem) lines.push('Domain Assets: ' + WL.DomainAssetSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
      if (root.features && root.features.economyTransactionFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.EconomyTransactionSystem) lines.push('Economy: ' + WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
    },
    renderPlacesTime: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Current Time: Day ' + root.time.day + ' ' + String(root.time.hour).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(root.time.minute).padStart(2, '0'));
      lines.push('Current Place: ' + WL.ContextBudgeter.currentPlaceName(root));
      var keys = Object.keys(root.places.placesById || {});
      lines.push('Known Places: ' + keys.length);
      for (var i = 0; i < keys.length && i < 20; i++) { var p = root.places.placesById[keys[i]]; lines.push('- ' + WL.U.safeString(p.name) + ' [' + WL.U.safeString(p.type || 'place') + ']'); }
      lines.push('Contradictions: ' + (root.places.contradictions || []).length);
      if (WL.WorldGraphIndex && typeof WL.WorldGraphIndex.summary === 'function') lines.push('World Graph: ' + WL.WorldGraphIndex.summary(root).slice(0, 2).join(' | '));
      if (root.features && root.features.domainProjectMvpEnabled !== false && WL.DomainProjectSystem) lines.push('Domain Projects: ' + WL.DomainProjectSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
      if (root.features && root.features.domainAssetFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.DomainAssetSystem) lines.push('Domain Assets: ' + WL.DomainAssetSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
      if (root.features && root.features.economyTransactionFoundationEnabled !== false && WL.EconomyTransactionSystem) lines.push('Economy: ' + WL.EconomyTransactionSystem.summary(root).join(' | '));
    },
    renderSettings: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Build: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION);
      lines.push('Stage: ' + WL.BUILD_STAGE);
      lines.push('Release Status: ' + WL.STATUS);
      lines.push('Context Mode: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.contextMode));
      lines.push('Story Card Writes: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.storyCardWritesEnabled));
      lines.push('Generated Cards: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.generatedCardsEnabled));
      lines.push('Surface Integration: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.identityAbilitySurfaceEnabled));
      lines.push('Presence/Knowledge Foundation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.presenceKnowledgeFoundationEnabled));
      lines.push('Witness Ledger: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.witnessEligibilityLedgerEnabled));
      lines.push('Reputation/Standing Foundation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.reputationLocalStandingEnabled));
      lines.push('Rumor Propagation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.rumorPropagationEnabled));
      lines.push('Crime/Evidence/Clue Foundation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.crimeEvidenceClueFoundationEnabled));
      lines.push('Faction/Law Response Foundation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.factionLawResponseFoundationEnabled));
      lines.push('Contract Lifecycle Foundation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.contractLifecycleFoundationEnabled));
      lines.push('Labor Foundation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.laborFoundationEnabled));
      lines.push('Domain Project MVP: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.domainProjectMvpEnabled));
      lines.push('Economy Transaction Foundation: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.economyTransactionFoundationEnabled));
      lines.push('Race Trait System: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.raceTraitSystemEnabled));
      lines.push('Party/Follower System: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.features.partyFollowerSystemEnabled));
    },
    renderAudit: function (root, lines) {
      lines.push('Last Pipeline: ' + WL.U.safeString(root.runtime.lastPipelineSummary || '(none)'));
      lines.push('Recent Operation Keys: ' + (root.operationLedger.recentKeys || []).length);
      lines.push('Duplicate Skips: ' + (root.operationLedger.duplicateSkips || []).length);
      lines.push('Card Candidates: ' + ((root.cards && root.cards.candidateIds || []).length));
      if (root.worldGraph) lines.push('World Graph: nodes ' + ((root.worldGraph.nodeIds || []).length) + ', links ' + ((root.worldGraph.edges || []).length));
      lines.push('Cost Records: ' + ((root.abilityCosts && root.abilityCosts.costIds || []).length));
      var audit = root.diagnostics.audit || [];
      for (var i = Math.max(0, audit.length - 8); i < audit.length; i++) lines.push('- ' + WL.U.safeString(audit[i].subsystem) + ': ' + WL.U.safeString(audit[i].message));
    }
  };

  // Mirror note: GeneratedCardPolicy controls human-readable generated cards and trigger safety.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] GeneratedCardPolicy
  WL.GeneratedCardPolicy = {
    cleanTitle: function (title) {
      return WL.U.title(title || '')
        .replace(/\b(?:WorldLedger\s+Generated|WL[- ](?:PROTECTED|GENERATED)|Generated Card|schema|owner)\b/ig, '')
        .replace(/\s*,\s*/g, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    },
    isTrashTitle: function (title) {
      var t = WL.U.lower(title).replace(/^(?:the|a|an)\s+/, '');
      if (!t) return true;
      if (/^(?:are empty|empty|none|unknown|no items?|no armor|no weapon|no coin|known places|command log|command|audit|status|pass|fail|worldledger generated)$/.test(t)) return true;
      if (/\b(?:are empty|pockets? are empty|no armor|no weapon|no coin|known places|generated-card policy|card check|release check|summary pass)\b/.test(t)) return true;
      if (/\b(?:WL-PROTECTED|WL-GENERATED|WL-META|WorldLedger Generated)\b/i.test(title)) return true;
      return false;
    },
    canGenerateTitle: function (title) {
      var t = WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.cleanTitle(title || '');
      if (!t || t.length < 3 || t.length > 80) return false;
      if (WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.isTrashTitle(t)) return false;
      if (WL.CardRegistry.isBroadTrigger(t)) return false;
      if (/\b(?:quest|task|mission|reward|item|thing|object|person|someone|something)\b/i.test(t)) return false;
      return true;
    }
  };

  // Mirror note: CardApiAdapter is the safe Story Card API boundary.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] CardApiAdapter
  WL.CardApiAdapter = {
    cards: function () { return WL.U.getStoryCards(WL.U.getGlobalState()); },
    hasWriteApi: function () { return typeof addStoryCard === 'function' && typeof updateStoryCard === 'function'; },
    cardText: function (card) { return WL.U.safeString((card && (card.entry || card.description || card.text || card.body || card.value)) || ''); },
    cardKeys: function (card) { return WL.U.safeString((card && (card.keys || card.key || card.title || card.name)) || ''); },
    findByMarker: function (marker) {
      var cards = WL.CardApiAdapter.cards();
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
        var hay = WL.CardApiAdapter.cardKeys(cards[i]) + '\n' + WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(cards[i]);
        if (hay.indexOf(marker) >= 0) out.push(i);
      }
      return out;
    },
    ensureSingleton: function (root, def, entry) {
      var marker = WL.CardRegistry.marker(def.id);
      var found = WL.CardApiAdapter.findByMarker(marker);
      if (!WL.CardApiAdapter.hasWriteApi()) return { status: 'API_UNAVAILABLE', applied: false, id: def.id };
      try {
        if (!found.length) {
          var idx = addStoryCard(def.keys, entry, 'world');
          if (idx === false) return { status: 'ADD_SKIPPED_DUP_KEYS', applied: false, id: def.id, index: idx };
          if (root.cards.protectedIds.indexOf(def.id) < 0) root.cards.protectedIds.push(def.id);
          return { status: 'ADDED', applied: true, id: def.id, index: idx };
        }
        var index = found[0];
        var old = WL.CardApiAdapter.cards()[index] || {};
        if (WL.U.hash(WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(old)) === WL.U.hash(entry) && (WL.CardApiAdapter.cardKeys(old) + '\n' + WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(old)).indexOf(marker) >= 0) return { status: 'UNCHANGED', applied: false, id: def.id, index: index };
        updateStoryCard(index, def.keys, entry, old.type || 'world');
        if (found.length > 1) root.cards.warnings.push({ id: def.id, warning: 'duplicate_protected_card_markers_detected', count: found.length });
        WL.U.capArray(root.cards.warnings, 40);
        if (root.cards.protectedIds.indexOf(def.id) < 0) root.cards.protectedIds.push(def.id);
        return { status: 'UPDATED', applied: true, id: def.id, index: index };
      } catch (e) {
        root.cards.warnings.push({ id: def.id, warning: 'card_api_error', message: WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e) });
        WL.U.capArray(root.cards.warnings, 40);
        return { status: 'ERROR', applied: false, id: def.id, error: WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e) };
      }
    },
    ensureGeneratedSingleton: function (root, rec, entry) {
      var marker = WL.CardRegistry.generatedMarker(rec.id);
      var found = WL.CardApiAdapter.findByMarker(marker);
      if (!WL.CardApiAdapter.hasWriteApi()) return { status: 'API_UNAVAILABLE', applied: false, id: rec.id, generated: true };
      try {
        var keys = WL.CardRegistry.generatedKeys(rec.title, rec.id);
        if (!found.length) {
          var idx = addStoryCard(keys, entry, 'world');
          if (idx === false) return { status: 'ADD_SKIPPED_DUP_KEYS', applied: false, id: rec.id, generated: true };
          if (root.cards.generatedIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.cards.generatedIds.push(rec.id);
          return { status: 'GENERATED_ADDED', applied: true, id: rec.id, index: idx, generated: true };
        }
        var index = found[0];
        var old = WL.CardApiAdapter.cards()[index] || {};
        if (WL.U.hash(WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(old)) === WL.U.hash(entry) && (WL.CardApiAdapter.cardKeys(old) + '\n' + WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(old)).indexOf(marker) >= 0) return { status: 'GENERATED_UNCHANGED', applied: false, id: rec.id, index: index, generated: true };
        updateStoryCard(index, keys, entry, old.type || 'world');
        if (root.cards.generatedIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.cards.generatedIds.push(rec.id);
        return { status: 'GENERATED_UPDATED', applied: true, id: rec.id, index: index, generated: true };
      } catch (e) {
        root.cards.warnings.push({ id: rec.id, warning: 'generated_card_api_error', message: WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e) });
        WL.U.capArray(root.cards.warnings, 40);
        return { status: 'ERROR', applied: false, id: rec.id, generated: true, error: WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e) };
      }
    }
  };

  // Mirror note: CardSync flushes dirty card mirrors after reducers commit accepted changes.

  // [WL-ORG:MIRRORS] CardSync
  WL.CardSync = {
    generatedCandidates: function (root, max) {
      if (WL.CardCandidateRegistry && typeof WL.CardCandidateRegistry.collect === 'function') return WL.CardCandidateRegistry.collect(root, max || 8);
      var out = [];
      var seen = {};
      function add(kind, id, title, summary) {
        title = WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.cleanTitle(title || '');
        id = id || ('generated_' + WL.U.slug(kind + '_' + title));
        if (!WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.canGenerateTitle(title)) return;
        if (seen[id]) return;
        seen[id] = true;
        out.push({ kind: kind, id: id, title: title, summary: summary || '' });
      }
      var actorIds = WL.U.unique((root.actors.presentIds || []).concat(root.actors.referencedIds || []));
      for (var a = 0; a < actorIds.length && out.length < (max || 8); a++) {
        var actor = root.actors.actorsById[actorIds[a]];
        if (actor && actor.name) add('actor', 'gen_actor_' + WL.U.slug(actor.name), actor.name, actor.summary || actor.status || 'Named actor remembered by WorldLedger.');
      }
      var placeKeys = Object.keys(root.places.placesById || {});
      for (var p = 0; p < placeKeys.length && out.length < (max || 8); p++) {
        var place = root.places.placesById[placeKeys[p]];
        if (place && place.name) add('place', 'gen_place_' + WL.U.slug(place.name), place.name, (place.type || 'place') + '; confirmed world structure mirror.');
      }
      var abilityIds = (root.abilities.abilityIds || []).concat(root.skills.skillIds || [], root.talents.talentIds || [], root.passives.passiveIds || []);
      for (var i = 0; i < abilityIds.length && out.length < (max || 8); i++) {
        var rec = root.abilities.abilitiesById[abilityIds[i]] || root.skills.skillsById[abilityIds[i]] || root.talents.talentsById[abilityIds[i]] || root.passives.passivesById[abilityIds[i]];
        if (rec && rec.name) add('ability', 'gen_ability_' + WL.U.slug(rec.name), rec.name, 'Ability/skill/passive mirror; mechanics remain reducer-owned.');
      }
      var itemIds = root.inventory.ownedIds || [];
      for (var it = 0; it < itemIds.length && out.length < (max || 8); it++) {
        var item = root.inventory.itemsById[itemIds[it]];
        if (item && item.displayName) add('item', 'gen_item_' + WL.U.slug(item.displayName), item.displayName, 'Confirmed possessed item mirror; no card-prose grants.');
      }
      var questIds = (root.quests.activeIds || []).concat(root.quests.offeredIds || []);
      for (var q = 0; q < questIds.length && out.length < (max || 8); q++) {
        var quest = root.quests.questsById[questIds[q]];
        if (quest && quest.title) add('quest', 'gen_quest_' + WL.U.slug(quest.title), quest.title, WL.U.safeString(quest.objective || quest.status || 'Quest mirror.'));
      }
      return out.slice(0, max || 8);
    },
    flushGenerated: function (root, reason) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === false || root.features.generatedCardPolicyEnabled === false) return { status: 'GENERATED_DISABLED', applied: false, results: [] };
      if (root.features.storyCardWritesEnabled === false) return { status: 'WRITES_DISABLED', applied: false, results: [] };
      var candidates = WL.CardSync.generatedCandidates(root, 8);
      // 9.13C-R1: explicit 0 is a valid degradation value. Do not use `||` fallback here.
      var createLimit = (typeof root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn === 'number') ? WL.U.clamp(root.features.generatedCardCreatesPerTurn, 0, 20) : 1;
      var updateLimit = (typeof root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn === 'number') ? WL.U.clamp(root.features.generatedCardUpdatesPerTurn, 0, 50) : 4;
      var maxGenerated = (typeof root.features.maxGeneratedCards === 'number') ? WL.U.clamp(root.features.maxGeneratedCards, 0, 500) : 96;
      var created = 0, updated = 0, results = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
        var rec = candidates[i];
        var marker = WL.CardRegistry.generatedMarker(rec.id);
        var found = WL.CardApiAdapter.findByMarker(marker);
        if (!found.length && maxGenerated && (root.cards.generatedIds || []).length >= maxGenerated) {
          var capRow = { status: 'GENERATED_CAP_REACHED', applied: false, id: rec.id, generated: true, cap: maxGenerated };
          root.cards.generatedCapWarnings.push({ id: rec.id, turn: root.runtime.currentTurn, cap: maxGenerated });
          WL.U.capArray(root.cards.generatedCapWarnings, 40);
          results.push(capRow);
          continue;
        }
        if (!found.length && created >= createLimit) continue;
        if (found.length && updated >= updateLimit) continue;
        var oldEntry = found.length ? WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(WL.CardApiAdapter.cards()[found[0]]) : '';
        var entry = WL.CardRenderer.renderGenerated(root, rec, oldEntry);
        var opKey = WL.OperationLedger.makeKey(['card', rec.id, WL.U.hash(entry), 'generated_write']);
        var currentMatches = false;
        if (found.length) {
          var currentCard = WL.CardApiAdapter.cards()[found[0]] || {};
          currentMatches = WL.U.hash(WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(currentCard)) === WL.U.hash(entry) && (WL.CardApiAdapter.cardKeys(currentCard) + '\n' + WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(currentCard)).indexOf(marker) >= 0;
        }
        if (currentMatches && WL.OperationLedger.has(root, opKey)) { results.push({ status: 'DUPLICATE_SKIPPED', id: rec.id, generated: true }); continue; }
        var res = WL.CardApiAdapter.ensureGeneratedSingleton(root, rec, entry);
        if ((res.status === 'GENERATED_ADDED' || res.status === 'GENERATED_UPDATED' || res.status === 'GENERATED_UNCHANGED') && !WL.OperationLedger.has(root, opKey)) WL.OperationLedger.add(root, opKey, 'generated_card_write_success');
        if (res.status === 'GENERATED_ADDED') created++;
        if (res.status === 'GENERATED_UPDATED' || res.status === 'GENERATED_UNCHANGED') updated++;
        results.push(res);
      }
      return { status: 'GENERATED_FLUSHED', applied: true, results: results };
    },
    flushDirty: function (root, reason) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.cardSyncEnabled === false || root.features.protectedCardsEnabled === false) return { status: 'DISABLED', applied: false };
      if (root.features.storyCardWritesEnabled === false) return { status: 'WRITES_DISABLED', applied: false };
      var defs = WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefs;
      var dirtyTargets = root.dirty && root.dirty.targets || [];
      var meaningfulDirty = dirtyTargets.some(function (t) { return t && t !== 'diagnostics'; });
      var protectedReady = root.cards && root.cards.protectedIds && root.cards.protectedIds.length >= defs.length;
      if (!meaningfulDirty && protectedReady) {
        var cands = (root.features.generatedCardsEnabled !== false && WL.CardSync.generatedCandidates) ? WL.CardSync.generatedCandidates(root, 8) : [];
        var pendingGenerated = false;
        for (var c = 0; c < cands.length; c++) if (root.cards.generatedIds.indexOf(cands[c].id) < 0 && WL.CardApiAdapter.findByMarker(WL.CardRegistry.generatedMarker(cands[c].id)).length === 0) pendingGenerated = true;
        if (!pendingGenerated) {
          root.cards.dirtyIds = [];
          root.dirty.targets = [];
          root.dirty.reasons = [];
          return { status: 'SKIPPED_CLEAN', applied: false, results: [] };
        }
      }
      var results = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < defs.length; i++) {
        var oldEntry = '';
        var found = WL.CardApiAdapter.findByMarker(WL.CardRegistry.marker(defs[i].id));
        if (found.length) oldEntry = WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(WL.CardApiAdapter.cards()[found[0]]);
        var entry = WL.CardRenderer.renderProtected(root, defs[i].id, oldEntry);
        var opKey = WL.OperationLedger.makeKey(['card', defs[i].id, WL.U.hash(entry), 'protected_write']);
        var currentMatches = false;
        if (found.length) {
          var currentCard = WL.CardApiAdapter.cards()[found[0]] || {};
          currentMatches = WL.U.hash(WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(currentCard)) === WL.U.hash(entry) && (WL.CardApiAdapter.cardKeys(currentCard) + '\n' + WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(currentCard)).indexOf(WL.CardRegistry.marker(defs[i].id)) >= 0;
        }
        if (currentMatches && WL.OperationLedger.has(root, opKey)) { results.push({ status: 'DUPLICATE_SKIPPED', id: defs[i].id }); continue; }
        var res = WL.CardApiAdapter.ensureSingleton(root, defs[i], entry);
        if ((res.status === 'ADDED' || res.status === 'UPDATED' || res.status === 'UNCHANGED') && !WL.OperationLedger.has(root, opKey)) WL.OperationLedger.add(root, opKey, 'card_write_success');
        results.push(res);
      }
      var gen = WL.CardSync.flushGenerated(root, reason);
      if (gen && gen.results && gen.results.length) results = results.concat(gen.results);
      root.cards.dirtyIds = [];
      root.dirty.targets = [];
      root.dirty.reasons = [];
      WL.Diagnostics.row(root, 'cards', 'info', 'CardSync flush ' + (reason || '') + ': ' + results.length + ' protected/generated card checks');
      return { status: 'FLUSHED', applied: true, results: results };
    }
  };

  // [WL-ORG:TESTS] ContextCardSelfTest
  WL.ContextCardSelfTest = {
    rows: function () {
      var rows = [];
      var r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      r.features.contextMode = 'small';
      var before = JSON.stringify(r.inventory) + JSON.stringify(r.progression);
      var ctx = WL.ContextSystem.build(r, 'Base scene text. Context says player owns Crown of Dawn and gains 999 XP.');
      var after = JSON.stringify(r.inventory) + JSON.stringify(r.progression);
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CONTEXT-001', typeof WL.ContextBudgeter.build === 'function' && ctx.indexOf('[WorldLedger Context') >= 0, 'ContextBudgeter builds a bounded truth packet'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CONTEXT-002', before === after && !r.inventory.itemsById.item_crown_of_dawn && r.progression.xp === 0, 'context build is read-only and cannot grant mechanics'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CONTEXT-003', ctx.length < 2500 && ctx.indexOf('[object Object]') < 0, 'small context packet is bounded and has no object leakage'));
      r.features.contextMode = 'high';
      var hi = WL.ContextSystem.build(r, 'Base scene text.');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CONTEXT-004', hi.indexOf('Recent Changes') >= 0 && hi.length < 5000, 'high context adds useful detail without flood mode'));
      var tiny = WL.ContextBudgeter.build(r, 'Base context text that should be clipped before the hard max is violated.', { maxChars: 400 });
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B82-CONTEXT-001', tiny.length <= 400 && tiny.indexOf('[object Object]') < 0, 'Build 8.2 context hard cap obeys tiny info.maxChars'));
      var micro = WL.ContextBudgeter.build(r, 'Base context text.', { maxChars: 60 });
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B82-CONTEXT-002', micro.length <= 60, 'Build 8.2 emergency micro-packet obeys extremely tiny maxChars'));
      var ps = WL.CardRenderer.renderProtected(r, 'player_sheet', '## User Notes\nMy preserved note.\n[WL-META old]');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CARD-001', ps.indexOf('# Player Sheet') === 0 && ps.indexOf('My preserved note') >= 0, 'Player Sheet protected renderer preserves user notes once'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CARD-002', ps.indexOf('[WL-META') < 0 && (ps.match(/<!-- WL: WL-PROTECTED:/g) || []).length === 1 && ps.indexOf('v=1.1.5') < 0, 'protected card renderer writes one compact metadata marker and no visible WL-META/stale marker'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CARD-003', ps.indexOf('[object Object]') < 0, 'protected card renderer safe-strings nested data'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CARD-004', WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefs.length >= 10, 'protected card registry includes required card surfaces'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CARD-005', WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.canGenerateTitle('Copper Lantern') && !WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.canGenerateTitle('inn') && !WL.GeneratedCardPolicy.canGenerateTitle('quest'), 'generated-card policy accepts specific names and rejects broad triggers'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B8-CARD-006', typeof WL.CardApiAdapter.ensureSingleton === 'function' && typeof WL.CardSync.flushDirty === 'function', 'CardApiAdapter and CardSync authorities installed'));
      var oldCards = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis.storyCards : undefined;
      var oldAdd = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis.addStoryCard : undefined;
      var oldUpdate = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis.updateStoryCard : undefined;
      try {
        if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') {
          globalThis.storyCards = [];
          globalThis.addStoryCard = function () { return false; };
          globalThis.updateStoryCard = function () {};
          var failRoot = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
          failRoot.features.storyCardWritesEnabled = true;
          WL.CardSync.flushDirty(failRoot, 'selftest_failed_add');
          var failKeys = Object.keys(failRoot.operationLedger.keysById || {}).length;
          globalThis.addStoryCard = function (keys, entry, type) { globalThis.storyCards.push({ keys: keys, entry: entry, type: type || 'world' }); return globalThis.storyCards.length - 1; };
          globalThis.updateStoryCard = function (idx, keys, entry, type) { if (!globalThis.storyCards[idx]) throw new Error('missing card'); globalThis.storyCards[idx] = { keys: keys, entry: entry, type: type || 'world' }; return true; };
          WL.CardSync.flushDirty(failRoot, 'selftest_retry_after_failed_add');
          rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B82-CARD-001', failKeys === 0 && globalThis.storyCards.length === WL.CardRegistry.protectedDefs.length, 'Build 8.2 failed card adds do not poison ledger and remain retryable'));
          globalThis.storyCards = [];
          globalThis.addStoryCard = function (keys, entry, type) { globalThis.storyCards.push({ keys: keys, entry: entry, type: type || 'world' }); return globalThis.storyCards.length - 1; };
          globalThis.updateStoryCard = function (idx, keys, entry, type) { if (!globalThis.storyCards[idx]) throw new Error('missing card'); globalThis.storyCards[idx] = { keys: keys, entry: entry, type: type || 'world' }; return true; };
          var updateRoot = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
          updateRoot.features.storyCardWritesEnabled = true;
          updateRoot.features.generatedCardsEnabled = false;
          WL.CardSync.flushDirty(updateRoot, 'selftest_initial_cards');
          updateRoot.inventory.itemsById.item_brass_key = { id: 'item_brass_key', displayName: 'Brass Key', quantity: 1, stackable: false, condition: 'intact', custody: 'owned_by_player', sourceHistory: [] };
          updateRoot.inventory.ownedIds.push('item_brass_key');
          updateRoot.dirty.targets.push('inventory');
          var updateLedgerBefore = Object.keys(updateRoot.operationLedger.keysById || {}).length;
          globalThis.updateStoryCard = function () { throw new Error('mock update failure'); };
          WL.CardSync.flushDirty(updateRoot, 'selftest_update_failure');
          var updateLedgerAfterFail = Object.keys(updateRoot.operationLedger.keysById || {}).length;
          globalThis.updateStoryCard = function (idx, keys, entry, type) { if (!globalThis.storyCards[idx]) throw new Error('missing card'); globalThis.storyCards[idx] = { keys: keys, entry: entry, type: type || 'world' }; return true; };
          updateRoot.dirty.targets.push('inventory');
          WL.CardSync.flushDirty(updateRoot, 'selftest_update_retry');
          var invCard = globalThis.storyCards.filter(function (c) { return String(c.keys || '').indexOf('Inventory') >= 0; })[0];
          rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B82-CARD-002', updateLedgerAfterFail === updateLedgerBefore && invCard && String(invCard.entry || '').indexOf('Brass Key') >= 0, 'Build 8.2 failed card updates do not poison ledger and remain retryable'));
        } else {
          rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B82-CARD-001', true, 'Build 8.2 card retry selftest skipped outside global runtime'));
        }
      } catch (e) {
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B82-CARD-001', false, 'Build 8.2 card retry selftest threw: ' + WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e)));
      } finally {
        if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') {
          globalThis.storyCards = oldCards;
          globalThis.addStoryCard = oldAdd;
          globalThis.updateStoryCard = oldUpdate;
        }
      }
      return rows;
    }
  };

  // [WL-ORG:OWNERS] LivePollutionCleanup93D
  WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D = {
    badItemSlugs: Object.freeze({ are_empty: 1, empty: 1, no_armor: 1, no_weapon: 1, no_coin: 1 }),
    isBadGeneratedItemName: function (name) {
      var s = WL.U.slug(name || '');
      if (WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.badItemSlugs[s]) return true;
      return /^(?:are\s+empty|empty|no\s+armor|no\s+weapon|no\s+coin)$/i.test(WL.U.norm(name || ''));
    },
    isBadInjuryName: function (name) {
      var n = WL.U.norm(name || '');
      if (!n) return false;
      return /^(?:Begins\s+in\s+Your\s+Calves\s+Wound|Through\s+the\s+Street\s+Noise\s+Wound)$/i.test(n) || /Street\s+Noise\s+Wound/i.test(n) || /^Begins\s+in\s+Your\b/i.test(n);
    },
    injuryDamageValue: function (inj) {
      var dmg = Number(inj && inj.hpDamage || 0);
      if (isFinite(dmg) && dmg > 0) return WL.U.clamp(dmg, 0, 999);
      var sev = WL.U.lower(inj && inj.severity || 'minor');
      if (sev === 'severe') return 16;
      if (sev === 'moderate') return 8;
      return 4;
    },
    ensureCondition: function (root, name, severity) {
      if (!root.body.conditions || !Array.isArray(root.body.conditions)) root.body.conditions = [];
      var id = 'condition_' + WL.U.slug(name);
      for (var i = 0; i < root.body.conditions.length; i++) {
        if (root.body.conditions[i].id === id || WL.U.slug(root.body.conditions[i].name || '') === WL.U.slug(name)) {
          root.body.conditions[i].severity = root.body.conditions[i].severity || severity || 'minor';
          root.body.conditions[i].status = 'active';
          root.body.conditions[i].cleanup93D = true;
          return root.body.conditions[i];
        }
      }
      var rec = { id: id, name: name, severity: severity || 'minor', status: 'active', phrase: 'Build 9.3D cleanup of known 9.2 exertion pollution', cleanup93D: true };
      root.body.conditions.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(root.body.conditions, 40);
      return rec;
    },
    removeBadInventory: function (root, summary) {
      var ids = Object.keys(root.inventory.itemsById || {});
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var id = ids[i];
        var item = root.inventory.itemsById[id] || {};
        if (!WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.isBadGeneratedItemName(item.displayName || item.name || id)) continue;
        delete root.inventory.itemsById[id];
        summary.removedItems.push(id);
      }
      root.inventory.ownedIds = (root.inventory.ownedIds || []).filter(function (id) { return !!root.inventory.itemsById[id]; });
      root.inventory.log = (root.inventory.log || []).filter(function (r) { return !WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.isBadGeneratedItemName((r && (r.name || r.itemId)) || ''); });
    },
    removeBadInjuries: function (root, summary) {
      var kept = [];
      var restored = 0;
      var calf = false;
      var injuries = root.body.injuries || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < injuries.length; i++) {
        var inj = injuries[i] || {};
        if (WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.isBadInjuryName(inj.name || '')) {
          restored += WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.injuryDamageValue(inj);
          summary.removedInjuries.push(inj.name || 'unknown');
          if (/Calves/i.test(inj.name || '') || /calves/i.test(inj.phrase || '')) calf = true;
        } else kept.push(inj);
      }
      root.body.injuries = kept;
      if (restored > 0) {
        root.body.hp = Math.min(root.body.maxHp, Number(root.body.hp || 0) + restored);
        summary.hpRestored += restored;
      }
      if (calf) {
        root.body.ep = Math.min(Number(root.body.ep || root.body.maxEp), Math.max(0, Number(root.body.maxEp || 100) - 28));
        WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.ensureCondition(root, 'Winded', 'minor');
        summary.epAdjusted = true;
      }
    },
    removeBadCardState: function (root, summary) {
      root.cards.generatedIds = (root.cards.generatedIds || []).filter(function (id) {
        var bad = /gen_item_are_empty|are_empty/i.test(id || '');
        if (bad) summary.removedCardIds.push(id);
        return !bad;
      });
      var keys = Object.keys(root.operationLedger.keysById || {});
      for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        if (/gen_item_are_empty|are_empty/i.test(keys[i])) {
          delete root.operationLedger.keysById[keys[i]];
          summary.removedLedgerKeys += 1;
        }
      }
      root.operationLedger.recentKeys = (root.operationLedger.recentKeys || []).filter(function (k) { return !/gen_item_are_empty|are_empty/i.test(k || ''); });
    },
    removeBadStoryCards: function (summary) {
      var cards = WL.U.getStoryCards(WL.U.getGlobalState());
      if (!Array.isArray(cards) || !cards.length) return;
      for (var i = cards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var c = cards[i] || {};
        var hay = WL.CardApiAdapter.cardKeys(c) + '\n' + WL.CardApiAdapter.cardText(c);
        var bad = /gen_item_are_empty|#\s*Are\s+Empty\b|WL-GENERATED:gen_item_are_empty/i.test(hay) || (/\bAre\s+Empty\b/i.test(hay) && /Confirmed possessed item mirror/i.test(hay));
        if (!bad) continue;
        var removed = false;
        try { if (typeof removeStoryCard === 'function') { removeStoryCard(i); removed = true; } } catch (e) {}
        if (!removed) {
          try { cards.splice(i, 1); removed = true; } catch (e2) {}
        }
        summary.removedStoryCards += removed ? 1 : 0;
      }
    },
    run: function (root, stateObj) {
      if (!root || !root.features || root.features.livePollutionCleanup93DEnabled === false) return { applied: false, reason: 'disabled' };
      if (!root.cleanup || typeof root.cleanup !== 'object') root.cleanup = { lastRunTurn: 0, notes: [] };
      if (!Array.isArray(root.cleanup.notes)) root.cleanup.notes = [];
      var summary = { applied: false, removedItems: [], removedInjuries: [], removedCardIds: [], removedStoryCards: 0, removedLedgerKeys: 0, hpRestored: 0, epAdjusted: false };
      WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.removeBadInventory(root, summary);
      WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.removeBadInjuries(root, summary);
      WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.removeBadCardState(root, summary);
      WL.LivePollutionCleanup93D.removeBadStoryCards(summary);
      summary.applied = !!(summary.removedItems.length || summary.removedInjuries.length || summary.removedCardIds.length || summary.removedStoryCards || summary.removedLedgerKeys || summary.hpRestored || summary.epAdjusted);
      if (summary.applied) {
        root.cleanup.lastRunTurn = root.runtime && root.runtime.currentTurn || WL.U.getActionCount();
        root.cleanup.notes.push({ turn: root.cleanup.lastRunTurn, kind: 'build93d_known_live_pollution_cleanup', summary: summary });
        WL.U.capArray(root.cleanup.notes, 20);
        if (root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.targets)) {
          if (root.dirty.targets.indexOf('cards') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('cards');
          if (root.dirty.targets.indexOf('body') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('body');
          if (root.dirty.targets.indexOf('inventory') < 0) root.dirty.targets.push('inventory');
        }
        try { WL.Diagnostics.row(root, 'cleanup', 'info', 'Build 9.3D removed known 9.2 live pollution', summary); } catch (e) {}
      }
      WL.StateManager.enforceInvariants(root);
      return summary;
    }
  };

        var pc = r.contracts.contractsById[r.contracts.contractIds[0]];
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96A-PROMISE-001', pc && pc.status === 'promised' && r.inventory.currency.silver === 0 && r.labor.employeeIds.length === 0, 'promise creates terms/promised contract only; it does not pay or employ until confirmed'));

        r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96A-REFUSAL-001', r.labor.refusals.length === 1 && r.contracts.contractIds.length === 0, 'refusal records labor evidence without creating a contract'));

        r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Bran breaches the contract and leaves the job.', 'output');
        var bc = r.contracts.contractsById[r.contracts.contractIds[0]];
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96A-BREACH-001', bc && bc.status === 'breached' && r.contracts.breaches.length === 1, 'breach updates existing contract status and breach ledger'));

        r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96A-MIRA-001', r.contracts.contractIds.length === 1 && r.labor.employeeIds.length === 1 && /Mira/i.test(r.labor.employeesById[r.labor.employeeIds[0]].actorName || ''), 'worker-agreement phrasing creates contract and labor record'));

        r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Old Bren asks you to clear the wolves from his farm and promises 15 gold.', 'output');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96A-QUEST-001', Object.keys(r.quests.questsById || {}).length === 1 && r.contracts.contractIds.length === 0, 'quest offer remains quest/reward promise, not contract/labor record'));

        r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You hire Bran for 2 silver per day to repair the north wall.', 'output');
        var ccmd = WL.CommandRouter.route('/contracts', r);
        var lcmd = WL.CommandRouter.route('/labor', r);
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96A-CMD-001', /Command:\s*\/contracts/.test(ccmd) && /Bran/.test(ccmd) && /Command:\s*\/labor/.test(lcmd) && /Employees/.test(lcmd), '/contracts and /labor commands expose compact read-only surfaces'));
        var before = JSON.stringify({ contracts: r.contracts, labor: r.labor, inventory: r.inventory, quests: r.quests });
        WL.CommandRouter.route('/contracts', r); WL.CommandRouter.route('/labor', r);
        var after = JSON.stringify({ contracts: r.contracts, labor: r.labor, inventory: r.inventory, quests: r.quests });
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96A-CMD-002', before === after, 'contract/labor commands are read-only'));
      } catch (e) {
        rows.push(WL.Assert.fail('B96A-ERR', 'Build 9.6A self-test exception: ' + WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e)));
      } finally {
        if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') globalThis.state = preserveState;
      }
      return rows;
    }
  };

  };


  // [WL-ORG:TESTS] RaceTrait97ASelfTest
  WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest = {
    withStoryCards: function (cards, fn) {
      var oldCards = null;
      try { oldCards = globalThis.storyCards; globalThis.storyCards = cards || []; return fn(); }
      finally { try { globalThis.storyCards = oldCards || []; } catch (e) {} }
    },
    freshRaceRoot: function (raceName, cards) {
      var root = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      root.player.raceSpecies = raceName;
      root.player.trueRace = raceName;
      root.player.currentForm = raceName;
      WL.RaceTraitSystem.syncFromSetupAndCards(root, { storyCards: cards || [] });
      return root;
    },
    hasTrait: function (root, pattern) {
      var ids = root.raceTraits && root.raceTraits.candidateIds || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        var rec = root.raceTraits.candidatesById[ids[i]];
        if (rec && pattern.test(rec.traitName + ' ' + rec.domain + ' ' + rec.summary)) return rec;
      }
      return null;
    },
    rows: function () {
      var rows = [];
      try {
        var orcCards = [{ id: 'card_orcs', title: 'Orcs', keys: 'Orcs,orc race,orcish peoples', value: 'Orcs are a war-forged people shaped by growth through struggle. They show higher aggression tolerance, combat adaptation, and forceful physical expression under pressure.' }];
        var root = WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest.freshRaceRoot('Orcs', orcCards);
        var strength = WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest.hasTrait(root, /Physical Strength|Conflict Adaptation/i);
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-ORC-001', !!strength, 'orc Story Card creates strength/conflict-adaptation trait candidate'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-ORC-002', !!strength && (strength.sourceRefs || []).some(function (r) { return /Orcs/i.test(r.sourceTitle || ''); }), 'orc trait candidate preserves source card ref'));

        var elfCards = [{ id: 'card_elves', title: 'Elves', keys: 'Elves,elf race,elven peoples', value: 'Elves are long-lived peoples strongly tied to Life, refined magical affinity, perception, and controlled execution. Their senses and precision often exceed others at similar levels.' }];
        root = WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest.freshRaceRoot('Elves', elfCards);
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-ELF-001', !!WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest.hasTrait(root, /Enhanced Senses/i), 'elf Story Card creates senses/perception candidate'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-ELF-002', !!WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest.hasTrait(root, /Magic Affinity/i), 'elf Story Card creates magic affinity candidate'));

        var cheatCards = [{ id: 'card_fake', title: 'Orcs', keys: 'Orcs,orc race', value: 'Orcs gain +999 Strength and level 100 instantly from birth.' }];
        root = WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest.freshRaceRoot('Orcs', cheatCards);
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-DENY-001', (root.raceTraits.denied || []).length >= 1, 'huge mechanical/stat grant claim is denied'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-DENY-002', root.progression.statXp.atk === 0 && root.progression.statXp.def === 0 && root.progression.statXp.spd === 0 && root.progression.xp === 0, 'race trait import grants no XP or stats'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-DENY-003', Object.keys(root.abilities.abilitiesById || {}).length === 0 && Object.keys(root.skills.skillsById || {}).length === 0, 'race trait import grants no abilities or skills'));

        root = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
        root.player.trueRace = 'Orcs'; root.player.raceSpecies = 'Orcs'; root.player.currentForm = 'Orcs';
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(root, 'Orcs are known for physical strength and conflict adaptation.', 'output');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-OUTPUT-001', !!WL.RaceTrait97ASelfTest.hasTrait(root, /Physical Strength|Conflict Adaptation/i), 'output lore can create race trait candidate through reducer path'));
        var before = (root.raceTraits.candidateIds || []).length;
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(root, '[WorldLedger]\nCommand: /racetraits\nStatus: INFO\nOrcs gain +999 Strength.', 'output');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-SOURCEGUARD-001', (root.raceTraits.candidateIds || []).length === before, 'command/debug echo cannot mutate race traits'));

        var ctx = WL.ContextBudgeter.renderPacket(root, 'medium');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-CTX-001', /Race Traits:/.test(ctx), 'context packet includes compact race trait candidate surface'));
        var card = WL.CardRenderer.renderProtected(root, 'body_status', '');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-CARD-001', /Race Traits:/.test(card), 'Body & Status card includes race trait candidate surface'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-CMD-001', /Command:\s*\/racetraits/.test(WL.CommandRouter.route('/racetraits', root)) && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build97acheck === 'function', 'race trait commands route compactly without recursive self-check routing'));
      } catch (e) {
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B97A-ERR', false, 'Build 9.7A self-test exception: ' + WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e)));
      }
      return rows;
    }
  };

        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B96C-CARD-001', /Domain Assets:/.test(card), 'People & Factions card includes domain asset summary surface'));
        var before = JSON.stringify({ domainAssets: r.domainAssets, inventory: r.inventory, advancedDomain: r.advanced.domain });
        WL.CommandRouter.route('/assets', r); if (typeof WL.CommandRenderer.assetcheck !== 'function') throw new Error('assetcheck missing');

    scenarioCatalog: function () {
      return [
        { id: 'RM-INV', label: 'inventory acquisition, denial, currency, equipment, stack/idempotency', kind: 'old-regression' },

        { id: 'RM-SOCIAL', label: 'presence, witnesses, reputation, rumors, crimes, clues, law', kind: 'live-scenario' },
        { id: 'RM-LORE', label: 'revealed vs hidden lore, world bible import, no hidden leakage', kind: 'old-regression' },
        { id: 'RM-HARDENING', label: 'migration, cleanup/quarantine, safe mode/degradation, command read-only', kind: 'hardening' }
      ];
    },
    hasNoFail: function (rows) {
      rows = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) if (rows[i] && rows[i].status === 'FAIL') return false;
      return true;
    },
    countStatus: function (rows, status) {
      rows = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
      var n = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) if (rows[i] && rows[i].status === status) n++;
      return n;
    },
    commandReadOnly: function (root, command) {
      var before = WL.U.hash(JSON.stringify(root));
      var out = WL.CommandRouter.route(command, root);
      var after = WL.U.hash(JSON.stringify(root));
      return { out: out, readOnly: before === after, compact: String(out || '').length <= 4000 };
    },
    rows: function () {
      var rows = [];
      try {
        var catalog = WL.ReleaseMatrix100ASelfTest.scenarioCatalog();
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-CATALOG-001', catalog.length >= 14, 'release matrix defines broad old/regression/live/hardening scenario categories'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-CATALOG-002', catalog.some(function (c) { return c.id === 'RM-DOMAIN'; }) && catalog.some(function (c) { return c.id === 'RM-LORE'; }) && catalog.some(function (c) { return c.id === 'RM-HARDENING'; }), 'matrix includes domain/kingdom, lore, and hardening categories'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-ID-001', WL.BUILD_VERSION === 'clean-core-build-10-0a-release-matrix-regression-gate' && WL.SCHEMA_ID === 'worldledger.clean-core.schema.build10_0a', 'Build 10.0A identity is active'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-FLAG-001', WL.FeatureDefaults.releaseMatrix100AEnabled === true, 'release matrix feature flag is present'));

        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-GATE-912A', typeof WL.LoreAuthority912ASelfTest.rows === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build912acheck === 'function', '9.12A lore gate and command remain installed'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-GATE-912B', typeof WL.ContextPriority912BSelfTest.rows === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build912bcheck === 'function', '9.12B context-priority gate and command remain installed'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-GATE-912C', typeof WL.CommandSurface912CSelfTest.rows === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build912ccheck === 'function', '9.12C command-surface gate and command remain installed'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-GATE-913A', typeof WL.StateMigration913ASelfTest.rows === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build913acheck === 'function', '9.13A migration gate and command remain installed'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-GATE-913B', typeof WL.CleanupQuarantine913BSelfTest.rows === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build913bcheck === 'function', '9.13B cleanup/quarantine gate and command remain installed'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-GATE-913C', typeof WL.SafeMode913CSelfTest.rows === 'function' && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build913ccheck === 'function', '9.13C safe-mode gate and command remain installed'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-GATE-OWNERS', typeof WL.InventoryEquipmentSystem.apply === 'function' && typeof WL.WorldGraphIndex.rebuild === 'function' && typeof WL.DomainProjectSystem.apply === 'function' && typeof WL.CombatRewardResolver.apply === 'function', 'critical gameplay owners remain installed'));

        var r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Mira hands you the brass key and the iron lantern.', 'output');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-LIVE-INV-001', !!r.inventory.itemsById.item_brass_key && !!r.inventory.itemsById.item_iron_lantern, 'live-style inventory handoff records two real items'));
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You do not take the obsidian crown; it is only a rumor.', 'output');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-LIVE-INV-002', !r.inventory.itemsById.item_obsidian_crown, 'live-style denial does not grant bait item'));

        var place = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(place, 'The Copper Lantern is an inn near the east gate.', 'output');
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(place, 'You enter the Copper Lantern.', 'output');
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(place, 'Mira smiles warmly after you help her.', 'output');
        WL.WorldGraphIndex.rebuild(place, 'release_matrix_probe');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-LIVE-WORLD-001', !!place.places.placesById.place_copper_lantern && !!place.actors.actorsById.actor_mira && place.worldGraph.nodeIds.length >= 2, 'live-style place/actor/worldgraph web persists'));

        var route = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(route, 'The road from Riverwood to Northwatch takes two hours.', 'output');
        WL.Runtime.runPipeline(route, 'Rain makes the trip take four hours.', 'output');
        var rid = WL.EventScanner.routeId('Riverwood', 'Northwatch');
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-LIVE-TIME-001', !!route.time.routesById[rid] && route.time.routesById[rid].baseMinutes === 120 && route.time.routesById[rid].delays.length === 1, 'live-style route and delay remain separate'));

        var root = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
        var commands = ['/releasematrix','/commands','/safemode','/cleanup','/migration','/lore','/worldgraph'];
        for (var c = 0; c < commands.length; c++) {
          var check = WL.ReleaseMatrix100ASelfTest.commandReadOnly(root, commands[c]);
          rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-CMD-' + (c + 1), check.readOnly && check.compact && /\[WorldLedger\]/.test(check.out), commands[c] + ' is read-only and compact enough for AI Dungeon command output'));
        }
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-PRESERVE-001', typeof WL.CommandRenderer.build913ccheck === 'function' && typeof WL.CleanupManager.run === 'function' && typeof WL.Migration.migrate === 'function', '10.0A preserves 9.13C/9.13B/9.13A hardening owners'));
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B100A-NO-GAMEPLAY-001', !WL.ReducerRegistry.handlers.ReleaseMatrixReducer && !WL.EventScanner.detectReleaseMatrixCandidates, 'release matrix adds no scanner or gameplay reducer authority'));
      } catch (e) {
        rows.push(WL.Assert.fail('B100A-ERR', 'Build 10.0A release matrix exception: ' + WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e)));
      }
      return rows;
    }
  };

  // Command note: CommandRouter is read-only/control UI and must not commit gameplay mechanics.

  // [WL-ORG:COMMANDS] CommandRouter
  WL.CommandRouter = {
    compactOutput: function (root, text) {
      var cap = WL.U.clamp((root && root.features && root.features.liveCommandOutputMaxChars) || WL.Constants.maxCommandOutputChars || 3600, 800, 4000);
      var out = String(text == null ? '' : text);
      if (out.length <= cap) return out;
      return out.slice(0, Math.max(0, cap - 140)).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '\n[WorldLedger: command output compacted for live AI Dungeon limits. Use specific check commands for narrower detail.]\n';
    },
    route: function (text, root) {
      if (!root.features.commandsEnabled) return text;
      var name = WL.U.commandName(text);
      var renderer = WL.CommandRenderer[name] || WL.CommandRenderer.unknown;
      var displayRoot = (root && typeof root === 'object') ? WL.U.clone(root) : root;
      return WL.CommandRouter.compactOutput(root, renderer(displayRoot, WL.U.commandArgs(text), name));
    }
  };

      if (hh.length < 2) hh = '0' + hh;
      if (mm.length < 2) mm = '0' + mm;
      lines.push('Current Time: Day ' + WL.U.safeString(t.day || 1) + ' ' + hh + ':' + mm);

    renderObjects: function (items, title) {
      var arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
      var lines = [title + ': ' + arr.length];
      for (var i = 0; i < Math.min(arr.length, 12); i++) {
        var item = arr[i];
        lines.push('- ' + (item.status || item.family || 'row') + ' ' + (item.family || '') + '/' + (item.type || '') + ' ' + (item.targetName || item.reason || item.textPreview || ''));
      }
      return lines.join('\n');
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // 11. [WL-TESTS] Assertions / SourceAudit / SelfTest

  // ============================================================

  WL.Assert = {
    pass: function (id, condition, label) { return { status: condition ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', id: id, label: label }; },
    fail: function (id, label) { return { status: 'FAIL', id: id, label: label }; },
    warn: function (id, label) { return { status: 'WARN', id: id, label: label }; },
    block: function (id, label) { return { status: 'BLOCKED', id: id, label: label }; }
  };


  // [WL-ORG:TESTS] InventoryCurrencyDenialSelfTest
  WL.InventoryCurrencyDenialSelfTest = {
    rows: function () {
      var rows = [];
      var r;
      function names(root) { return root.inventory.ownedIds.map(function (id) { return root.inventory.itemsById[id] && root.inventory.itemsById[id].displayName || id; }); }
      function has(root, name) { return names(root).some(function (x) { return WL.U.lower(x) === WL.U.lower(name); }); }

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You pick up the idea of a brass key while reading the map, not an actual key.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-DENY-001', names(r).length === 0, 'idea/metaphor pickup does not create an item'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'A sign reads: "You pick up the red healing potion." It is only an example sentence.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-DENY-002', names(r).length === 0, 'written sign/example pickup does not create an item'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Mira says, "You pick up the minor healing vial," as a grammar lesson. Nothing changes hands.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-DENY-003', names(r).length === 0, 'NPC lesson/quoted pickup does not create an item'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Mira refuses to give you the jeweled crown, but she hands you the red healing potion.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-MIXED-001', has(r, 'Red Healing Potion') && !has(r, 'Jeweled Crown'), 'mixed refusal/handoff grants only the confirmed item'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You retrieve the black gate key from the drawer.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-RETRIEVE-001', has(r, 'Black Gate Key'), 'retrieve from drawer counts as confirmed acquisition'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You recover your bearings after the fall.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-RETRIEVE-002', names(r).length === 0, 'recovering bearings does not create inventory'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'He counts out seventy dull copper coins into a small worn leather pouch. He hands it to you.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-CURRENCY-001', r.inventory.currency.copper === 70 && names(r).length === 0, 'multi-clause pouch handoff grants currency, not malformed item'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You take 70 copper coins and place them into your pocket.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-CURRENCY-002', r.inventory.currency.copper === 70 && names(r).length === 0, 'taking counted coins into pocket grants currency, not coin item'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot(); r.inventory.currency.copper = 70;
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You count out thirty copper coins from your pouch. The woman sweeps them into a box.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-CURRENCY-003', r.inventory.currency.copper === 40, 'counting out copper spends/removes currency'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot(); r.inventory.currency.gold = 10;
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You buy the iron dagger for 8 gold.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-PURCHASE-001', r.inventory.currency.gold === 2 && has(r, 'Iron Dagger'), 'confirmed purchase spends currency and adds item'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'The iron dagger costs 8 gold.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B72-QUOTE-001', names(r).length === 0 && r.inventory.currency.gold === 0 && r.advanced.economy.priceQuotes.length === 1, 'price quote records quote only'));

      return rows;
    }
  };


  // [WL-ORG:TESTS] AbilityActorJunkCompactionSelfTest
  WL.AbilityActorJunkCompactionSelfTest = {
    rows: function () {
      var rows = [];
      var r;
      function ownedNames(root) { return root.inventory.ownedIds.map(function (id) { return root.inventory.itemsById[id] && root.inventory.itemsById[id].displayName || id; }); }
      function hasActor(root, id) { return !!(root.actors.actorsById[id]); }
      function hasPlace(root, id) { return !!(root.places.placesById[id]); }

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You pretend to use Azure Dragon Step while telling a joke.', 'output');

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B75-JUNK-001', !hasActor(r, 'actor_ring') && !hasActor(r, 'actor_iron_keys') && ownedNames(r).length === 0, 'ring of keys does not become actor or inventory'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

      return rows;
    }
  };

  // [WL-ORG:TESTS] ThreatBoundaryDepthSelfTest
  WL.ThreatBoundaryDepthSelfTest = {
    rows: function () {

      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-THREAT-002', r.combat.threatProfilesById.threat_drake && r.combat.threatProfilesById.threat_drake.tags.indexOf('drake') >= 0, 'drake receives distinct lesser-dragonkin tags'));
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-THREAT-003', r.combat.threatProfilesById.threat_wyvern && r.combat.threatProfilesById.threat_wyvern.tags.indexOf('aerial_predator') >= 0, 'wyvern receives aerial predator threat tags'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();

      var iw = r.combat.threatProfilesById.threat_inferno_wolves;
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-THREAT-004', !!iw && iw.tags.indexOf('elemental_fire') >= 0 && iw.tags.some(function (t) { return /group_pressure_pack/.test(t); }) && iw.tags.indexOf('territory_advantage') >= 0, 'inferno wolf pack gets elemental, pack, and territory pressure'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      r.progression.level = 1;
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'A level 1 player meets an ancient dragon.', 'output');
      var ad = r.combat.threatProfilesById.threat_ancient_dragon;
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-THREAT-005', !!ad && ad.level >= 600 && /impossible|nearly/.test(ad.danger), 'ancient dragon stays world-side dangerous despite level-1 bait'));
      r.progression.level = 100;
      var ratXp = WL.CombatThreatSystem.challengeXpEstimate(WL.CombatThreatSystem.estimateThreat('normal rat').level, 100, 1);
      var soldierXp = WL.CombatThreatSystem.challengeXpEstimate(WL.CombatThreatSystem.estimateThreat('untrained soldier').level, 1, 1);

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You craft healing salve using two herbs and one glass vial.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-CRAFT-001', !!r.advanced.crafting.projectsById.craft_healing_salve && r.advanced.crafting.materialLedgers.length === 1 && r.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf('item_healing_salve') < 0, 'crafting material accounting records project without granting output item'));
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'After consuming two herbs and one glass vial you complete the healing salve.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-CRAFT-002', r.advanced.crafting.projectsById.craft_healing_salve.status === 'completion_evidence_pending_inventory_validation' && r.inventory.ownedIds.indexOf('item_healing_salve') < 0, 'crafting completion stays evidence and does not bypass inventory validation'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Construction begins on North Wall.', 'output');
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Workers make 30% progress on North Wall.', 'output');
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Mira is assigned to North Wall.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-DOMAIN-001', r.advanced.domain.projectsById.project_north_wall.progressPercent === 30 && r.advanced.domain.assignments.length === 1, 'domain project progress and worker assignment are bounded evidence'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'An army of 20 soldiers marches north.', 'output');
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'The soldiers take the bridge.', 'output');
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, '5 soldiers die in the ambush.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-WAR-001', r.advanced.warfare.controlClaims.length === 1 && r.advanced.warfare.forcesById.force_soldiers.remaining === 15, 'warfare control and casualty evidence preserve force counts'));

      r = WL.PipelineSelfTest.freshRoot();
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'You absorb the wolf essence.', 'output');
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'After repeated wolf essence exposure your body resists the cold better.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-ABSORB-001', r.advanced.absorption.candidatesById.absorb_wolf_essence.progress >= 1 && r.progression.statXp.atk === 0 && r.player.currentForm === 'unknown', 'absorption threshold evidence remains bounded without free stats/form'));
      WL.Runtime.runPipeline(r, 'Your evolution toward Ancient Dragon progresses.', 'output');
      rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B76-EVOLVE-001', r.advanced.evolution.candidatesById.evolve_ancient_dragon && r.player.currentForm !== 'Ancient Dragon', 'evolution progress stays candidate and does not overwrite form'));
      return rows;
    }
  };

      } catch (e) {
        rows.push(WL.Assert.pass('B95B-ERR', false, 'Build 9.5B self-test exception: ' + WL.U.safeString(e && e.message || e)));
      }
      return rows;
    }
  };
